uae.t: n. 阿联酋（阿拉伯联合酋长国）

e.en: {Ubiquinone} helps cells produce energy in the mitochondria.
e.zh: 泛醌帮助细胞在线粒体中产生能量。

e.en: The supplement contains {ubiquinone}, also known as CoQ10.
e.zh: 这款补剂含有泛醌，也就是辅酶Q10。

ubiquitous.t: adj. 无处不在的；普遍存在的

e.en: Smartphones have become {ubiquitous} in classrooms around the world.
e.zh: 智能手机已在全球的课堂里随处可见。

e.en: Coffee shops are now {ubiquitous} in every neighborhood.
e.zh: 如今每个街区都开满了咖啡店。

ubiquitously.t: adv. 普遍地；无处不在地

e.en: QR codes are {ubiquitously} used for payment in China.
e.zh: 二维码在中国被普遍用于支付。

e.en: The phrase appears {ubiquitously} across modern advertising campaigns.
e.zh: 这个说法在现代广告中无处不在。

ubiquity.t: n. 普遍存在；无所不在

e.en: The {ubiquity} of streaming has reshaped the music industry.
e.zh: 流媒体的普及重塑了整个音乐行业。

e.en: He marveled at the {ubiquity} of plastic in modern life.
e.zh: 他惊叹于塑料在现代生活中无处不在。

ubs.t: n. 瑞银集团（瑞士银行）

ucla.t: n. 加州大学洛杉矶分校

e.en: She got accepted to {UCLA} for her master's program.
e.zh: 她被加州大学洛杉矶分校的硕士项目录取了。

e.en: {UCLA} has one of the best film schools in America.
e.zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校拥有美国最好的电影学院之一。

ucta.t: n. 英国《不公平合同条款法》缩写

e.en: The contract clause was challenged under {UCTA} in court.
e.zh: 该合同条款依据《不公平合同条款法》在法庭上受到质疑。

e.en: British law students must learn {UCTA} for contract exams.
e.zh: 英国法学生必须为合同法考试学习《不公平合同条款法》。

e.en: The bank issued new {UDCs} to qualified small businesses.
e.zh: 银行向合格的小企业发放了新的城市发展凭证。

e.en: Several {UDCs} were retired from circulation last quarter.
e.zh: 上个季度有几张城市发展凭证退出了流通。

e.en: The farmer washed the cow's {udder} before milking.
e.zh: 农夫在挤奶前清洗了奶牛的乳房。

e.en: A swollen {udder} can signal infection in dairy cows.
e.zh: 奶牛乳房肿胀可能是感染的信号。

udf.t: n. 用户自定义函数（User Defined Function 缩写）

udo.t: n. 独活（一种日本蔬菜）

udon.t: n. 乌冬面（日式粗面条）

e.en: I ordered a steaming bowl of {udon} for lunch.
e.zh: 我午餐点了一碗热气腾腾的乌冬面。

e.en: This shop makes the thickest {udon} noodles in town.
e.zh: 这家店做的乌冬面是全城最粗的。

uefa.t: n. 欧洲足球协会联盟

e.en: The team qualified for the {UEFA} Champions League final.
e.zh: 球队晋级了欧洲足联冠军联赛决赛。

e.en: {UEFA} announced new rules for next season's tournament.
e.zh: 欧洲足联公布了下赛季比赛的新规则。

ufc.t: n. 终极格斗冠军赛（综合格斗赛事）

uff.t: int. 唉、呃（表示厌烦或疲倦）

uffizi.t: n. 乌菲兹美术馆（意大利佛罗伦萨）

e.en: We waited two hours to enter the {Uffizi} gallery.
e.zh: 我们排了两个小时的队才进了乌菲兹美术馆。

e.en: Botticelli's Venus hangs in the {Uffizi} in Florence.
e.zh: 波提切利的《维纳斯》收藏于佛罗伦萨的乌菲兹美术馆。

e.en: He spent two years teaching English in rural {Uganda}.
e.zh: 他在乌干达乡村教了两年英语。

e.en: {Uganda} is famous for its mountain gorilla treks.
e.zh: 乌干达以山地大猩猩徒步而闻名。

ugandan.t:
adj. 乌干达的
n. 乌干达人

e.en: The chef prepared a traditional {Ugandan} stew for dinner.
e.zh: 厨师为晚餐做了一道传统的乌干达炖菜。

e.en: She married a {Ugandan} doctor she met in London.
e.zh: 她嫁给了在伦敦认识的一位乌干达医生。

ugc.t: n. 用户生成内容（User Generated Content）

ugh.t: int. 呃、啊（表示厌恶、不适）

e.en: The film exposes the {ugliness} of political corruption.
e.zh: 这部电影揭露了政治腐败的丑恶。

e.en: There's a strange beauty hidden in the city's industrial {ugliness}.
e.zh: 这座城市工业化的丑陋中藏着一种奇特的美。

ugly.t:
adj. 丑陋的；难看的
adj. 丑恶的；糟糕的

e.en: That sweater is honestly the {ugly} kind I secretly love.
e.zh: 那件毛衣说实话很丑,但我偷偷喜欢。

e.en: The argument turned {ugly} once people started shouting.
e.zh: 人们开始大喊之后,这场争论就变得很难看了。

ujamaa.t: n. 乌贾马（坦桑尼亚村社社会主义）

e.en: Tanzania's {ujamaa} policy emphasized village-based collective farming.
e.zh: 坦桑尼亚的乌贾马政策强调以村庄为基础的集体耕作。

e.en: Kwanzaa celebrates {ujamaa}, the principle of cooperative economics.
e.zh: 宽扎节庆祝乌贾马,即合作经济的原则。

ukaea.t: n. 英国原子能管理局

e.en: The {UKAEA} leads Britain's research into fusion energy.
e.zh: 英国原子能管理局主导英国的核聚变能源研究。

e.en: Engineers at {UKAEA} tested a new tokamak reactor design.
e.zh: 英国原子能管理局的工程师测试了一种新的托卡马克反应堆设计。

uke.t: n. 尤克里里（ukulele 的简称）

ukelele.t: n. 尤克里里（小型四弦吉他）

e.en: He strummed a cheerful tune on his {ukelele}.
e.zh: 他用尤克里里弹奏了一首欢快的曲子。

e.en: She bought a tiny {ukelele} as a souvenir from Hawaii.
e.zh: 她从夏威夷买了一把小尤克里里作纪念品。

e.en: {Ukraine} is known for its vast wheat fields and rich culture.
e.zh: 乌克兰以广阔的麦田和丰富的文化而闻名。

e.en: Many tourists visit {Ukraine} to see Kyiv's historic cathedrals.
e.zh: 许多游客前往乌克兰参观基辅的历史教堂。

ukrainian.t:
adj. 乌克兰的
n. 乌克兰人；乌克兰语

e.en: She speaks fluent {Ukrainian} and Russian at home.
e.zh: 她在家里能流利地说乌克兰语和俄语。

e.en: The restaurant serves traditional {Ukrainian} borscht and dumplings.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应传统的乌克兰罗宋汤和饺子。

ukulele.t: n. 尤克里里（夏威夷小吉他）

e.en: He learned to play the {ukulele} from YouTube tutorials.
e.zh: 他通过 YouTube 教程学会了弹尤克里里。

e.en: The four-string {ukulele} is easy for beginners to pick up.
e.zh: 四弦的尤克里里对初学者来说很容易上手。

ulama.t: n. 乌理玛（伊斯兰教学者群体）

e.en: The {ulama} issued a ruling on the new banking practice.
e.zh: 伊斯兰学者就新的银行业务做法发布了裁决。

e.en: Local {ulama} gathered to discuss community education reforms.
e.zh: 当地的伊斯兰教学者聚集起来讨论社区教育改革。

ulan.t: n. 乌兰（多用于地名，如乌兰巴托）

e.en: We flew into {Ulan} Bator for our Mongolia trip.
e.zh: 我们飞抵乌兰巴托开始蒙古之旅。

e.en: The train passes through {Ulan} Ude on its way east.
e.zh: 火车东行途中会经过乌兰乌德。

ulcer.t: n. 溃疡（如胃溃疡、口腔溃疡）

e.en: Stress and spicy food can worsen a stomach {ulcer}.
e.zh: 压力和辛辣食物会使胃溃疡恶化。

e.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics to treat the mouth {ulcer}.
e.zh: 医生开了抗生素来治疗口腔溃疡。

e.en: Without treatment, the wound can {ulcerate} and become infected.
e.zh: 如果不治疗,伤口会溃烂并被感染。

e.en: Skin can {ulcerate} when blood circulation is severely impaired.
e.zh: 血液循环严重受阻时皮肤会溃烂。

ulcerated.t: adj. 溃烂的；形成溃疡的

e.en: The patient had an {ulcerated} sore on his foot.
e.zh: 病人脚上有一处溃烂的伤口。

e.en: Her {ulcerated} stomach lining required immediate medical attention.
e.zh: 她溃烂的胃黏膜需要立即就医。

e.en: The biopsy showed signs of {ulceration} in the intestine.
e.zh: 活检显示肠道有溃疡的迹象。

e.en: Diabetics must watch their feet for any sign of {ulceration}.
e.zh: 糖尿病患者必须留意脚部是否出现溃疡。

ulcerative.t: adj. 溃疡性的（如溃疡性结肠炎）

e.en: He was diagnosed with {ulcerative} colitis last spring.
e.zh: 他在去年春天被诊断出溃疡性结肠炎。

e.en: {Ulcerative} conditions of the gut often require lifelong management.
e.zh: 肠道的溃疡性疾病往往需要终生管理。

ulema.t: n. 乌理玛（伊斯兰教学者）

e.en: The {ulema} debated whether the new law conflicted with tradition.
e.zh: 伊斯兰学者们就新法律是否与传统冲突展开辩论。

e.en: A respected {ulema} delivered the sermon at Friday prayers.
e.zh: 一位受人尊敬的伊斯兰学者在周五礼拜上布道。

ullswater.t: n. 阿尔斯沃特湖（英国湖区）

e.en: We rented a boat and paddled across {Ullswater} at dawn.
e.zh: 我们租了一条船,在黎明时分划过阿尔斯沃特湖。

e.en: {Ullswater} is one of the most scenic lakes in England.
e.zh: 阿尔斯沃特湖是英格兰风景最美的湖泊之一。

e.en: He fractured his {ulna} during the skateboarding accident.
e.zh: 他在滑板事故中摔断了尺骨。

e.en: The {ulna} runs along the inner side of the forearm.
e.zh: 尺骨沿着前臂内侧延伸。

e.en: She felt tingling caused by an irritated {ulnar} nerve.
e.zh: 她因尺神经受刺激而感到刺痛。

e.en: Cyclists sometimes develop {ulnar} pain from gripping the handlebars.
e.zh: 骑车的人有时会因抓握把手而出现尺侧疼痛。

ulster.t: n. 阿尔斯特（北爱尔兰地区）

e.en: He grew up on a small farm in {Ulster}.
e.zh: 他在阿尔斯特的一个小农场长大。

e.en: She wore a heavy {Ulster} coat against the winter wind.
e.zh: 她穿着一件厚重的阿尔斯特大衣抵御寒风。

ulsterman.t: n. 阿尔斯特人（北爱尔兰人）

e.en: The proud {Ulsterman} sang folk songs from his hometown.
e.zh: 这位自豪的阿尔斯特人唱着家乡的民谣。

e.en: As an {Ulsterman}, he supported the local rugby team passionately.
e.zh: 作为一个阿尔斯特人,他热情地支持当地的橄榄球队。

ulterior.t: adj. 别有用心的；隐秘的（如 ulterior motive）

e.en: I suspect she has {ulterior} motives for being so helpful.
e.zh: 我怀疑她如此热心是别有用心。

e.en: His generosity hid an {ulterior} business agenda.
e.zh: 他的慷慨背后隐藏着另有所图的商业目的。

e.en: In Latin verse, stress rarely falls on the {ultima}.
e.zh: 在拉丁诗中,重音很少落在最后一个音节上。

e.en: The {Ultima} game series shaped early role-playing video games.
e.zh: 《创世纪》系列游戏塑造了早期的角色扮演电子游戏。

e.en: Philosophers debate the {ultimacy} of human reason.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论人类理性是否具有终极性。

e.en: He questioned the {ultimacy} of any single moral principle.
e.zh: 他质疑任何单一道德原则的终极性。

ultimate.t:
adj. 最终的；最根本的
n. 极致

e.en: This phone is the {ultimate} gadget for travel photographers.
e.zh: 这款手机是旅行摄影师的终极利器。

e.en: Our {ultimate} goal is to make clean energy affordable.
e.zh: 我们的最终目标是让清洁能源变得人人负担得起。

e.en: {Ultimately}, the success of the project depends on funding.
e.zh: 归根结底,项目的成败取决于资金。

e.en: She tried several jobs but {ultimately} returned to teaching.
e.zh: 她尝试过几份工作,但最终还是回到了教学岗位。

e.en: His boss issued an {ultimatum}: meet the deadline or resign.
e.zh: 他的老板下了最后通牒:要么按期完成,要么辞职。

e.en: The country rejected the {ultimatum} from its neighbor.
e.zh: 该国拒绝了邻国发出的最后通牒。

ultra.t:
adj. 极端的；超级的
pref. 超-

e.en: This laptop is {ultra} thin and weighs barely a kilogram.
e.zh: 这台笔记本超薄,重量几乎不到一公斤。

e.en: She trained hard to finish her first {ultra} marathon.
e.zh: 她刻苦训练,完成了她的第一次超级马拉松。

e.en: The {ultraconservative} faction blocked the climate bill.
e.zh: 极端保守派阻止了这项气候法案。

e.en: His {ultraconservative} views often clashed with younger colleagues.
e.zh: 他极端保守的观点常常与年轻同事产生冲突。

ultralight.t:
adj. 超轻的
n. 超轻型飞机

e.en: This {ultralight} backpack is perfect for long-distance hiking.
e.zh: 这款超轻背包非常适合长途徒步。

e.en: He flies an {ultralight} aircraft over the coast every weekend.
e.zh: 他每个周末都驾驶超轻型飞机飞越海岸。

e.en: She painted the sky a deep {ultramarine} blue.
e.zh: 她把天空涂成深深的群青色。

e.en: The artist mixed {ultramarine} pigment for the ocean scene.
e.zh: 艺术家调出群青色颜料来画海景。

e.en: The startup moved into an {ultramodern} office downtown.
e.zh: 这家初创公司搬进了市中心一栋超现代化的办公楼。

e.en: Her apartment features {ultramodern} furniture and smart lighting.
e.zh: 她的公寓配备了超现代的家具和智能灯光。

ultramundane.t: adj. 超凡脱俗的；世外的

e.en: The novel explores {ultramundane} realms beyond ordinary perception.
e.zh: 这部小说探索了超越普通感知的超凡领域。

e.en: Mystics often describe {ultramundane} experiences during deep meditation.
e.zh: 神秘主义者常常描述深度冥想中的超凡体验。

ultraportable.t: adj. 超便携的（笔记本等）

e.en: This {ultraportable} laptop fits easily into a small bag.
e.zh: 这款超便携笔记本电脑能轻松放进小包里。

e.en: Reporters love the {ultraportable} camera for field assignments.
e.zh: 记者们很喜欢这款超便携相机用于外勤采访。

e.en: The cleaner uses {ultrasonic} waves to remove grime from jewelry.
e.zh: 这种清洁器利用超声波清除珠宝上的污垢。

e.en: Bats navigate by emitting {ultrasonic} pulses in the dark.
e.zh: 蝙蝠通过发出超声波脉冲在黑暗中导航。

e.en: He studies {ultrasonics} to develop better medical imaging tools.
e.zh: 他研究超声学,以开发更好的医学成像工具。

e.en: Modern dentistry relies heavily on {ultrasonics} for cleaning teeth.
e.zh: 现代牙科非常依赖超声学来清洁牙齿。

e.en: {Ultrasonography} is commonly used to monitor fetal development.
e.zh: 超声检查常用于监测胎儿发育。

e.en: The clinic offers {ultrasonography} for early disease detection.
e.zh: 该诊所提供超声检查以便早期发现疾病。

ultrasound.t: n. 超声波；B 超检查

e.en: The doctor scheduled an {ultrasound} to check the baby's heartbeat.
e.zh: 医生安排做一次超声波检查来听胎儿心跳。

e.en: They used {ultrasound} to detect cracks in the metal pipe.
e.zh: 他们用超声波来检测金属管中的裂纹。

ultraviolet.t:
adj. 紫外线的
n. 紫外线

e.en: Sunscreen helps protect your skin from {ultraviolet} radiation.
e.zh: 防晒霜有助于保护皮肤免受紫外线辐射。

e.en: The lamp emits {ultraviolet} light to disinfect the room.
e.zh: 这盏灯发出紫外线给房间消毒。

e.en: The mourners began to {ululate} as the procession passed.
e.zh: 送葬队伍经过时,哀悼者开始放声哀号。

e.en: Wolves {ululate} across the valley on cold winter nights.
e.zh: 在寒冷的冬夜,狼群在山谷中嗥叫。

e.en: The crowd's joyful {ululation} echoed through the village square.
e.zh: 人群欢快的呼喊声在村庄广场上回荡。

e.en: A piercing {ululation} signaled the start of the ceremony.
e.zh: 一阵尖锐的呼喊声标志着仪式的开始。

ulysses.t: n. 尤利西斯（人名/小说名）

e.en: James Joyce's {Ulysses} is famous for its stream of consciousness.
e.zh: 詹姆斯·乔伊斯的《尤利西斯》以意识流手法而闻名。

e.en: In Greek myth, {Ulysses} took ten years to reach home.
e.zh: 在希腊神话中,尤利西斯花了十年才回到家。

e.en: Each {umbel} of the flower contains dozens of tiny blossoms.
e.zh: 花的每一个伞形花序都包含几十朵小花。

e.en: Carrots produce a delicate white {umbel} in their second year.
e.zh: 胡萝卜在第二年会开出精致的白色伞形花序。

e.en: She mixed {umber} into the paint for warmer shadows.
e.zh: 她在颜料中加入赭土色,使阴影显得更温暖。

e.en: The walls were painted a rich {umber} brown.
e.zh: 墙壁被刷成了浓郁的赭色棕。

umbilical.t:
adj. 脐的；脐带的
n. 脐带式管线

e.en: The doctor carefully cut the baby's {umbilical} cord.
e.zh: 医生小心地剪断了婴儿的脐带。

e.en: An {umbilical} cable connected the astronaut to the spacecraft.
e.zh: 一根脐带式电缆将宇航员与航天器相连。

e.en: The doctor examined the baby's {umbilicus} after birth.
e.zh: 医生在婴儿出生后检查了肚脐。

e.en: A small infection developed around the patient's {umbilicus}.
e.zh: 病人的肚脐周围出现了轻微感染。

e.en: The moon passed into Earth's deep {umbra} tonight.
e.zh: 今晚月亮进入了地球深深的本影区。

e.en: During the eclipse, the {umbra} darkened the city completely.
e.zh: 日食期间,本影把整座城市完全笼罩在黑暗中。

e.en: He took {umbrage} at her sarcastic remark.
e.zh: 他对她讥讽的话感到很不快。

e.en: Critics took {umbrage} at the company's tone-deaf advertisement.
e.zh: 评论人士对那家公司毫无分寸的广告深感不满。

e.en: Astronomers measured the {umbral} shadow during the eclipse.
e.zh: 天文学家在日食期间测量了本影的阴影。

e.en: The painting captured the {umbral} darkness of the forest.
e.zh: 那幅画捕捉到了森林中浓重的阴影。

umbrella.t:
n. 伞；保护伞
adj. 总括性的

e.en: Don't forget to bring an {umbrella} today.
e.zh: 今天别忘了带把雨伞。

e.en: These services fall under the {umbrella} of public health.
e.zh: 这些服务都属于公共卫生这一范畴。

e.en: Colorful {umbrellas} dotted the rainy city street.
e.zh: 五颜六色的雨伞点缀着雨中的街道。

e.en: The cafe set out {umbrellas} on its outdoor patio.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆在露台上撑起了遮阳伞。

umbria.t: n. 翁布里亚（意大利大区）

e.en: We spent a week exploring the hill towns of {Umbria}.
e.zh: 我们花了一周时间游览翁布里亚的山城小镇。

e.en: {Umbria} is famous for its truffles and rolling green hills.
e.zh: 翁布里亚以松露和绵延的青山而闻名。

umbrian.t:
adj. 翁布里亚的
n. 翁布里亚人

e.en: She fell in love with {Umbrian} cuisine on her trip.
e.zh: 她在旅行中爱上了翁布里亚的菜肴。

e.en: The painting reflects the warm tones of the {Umbrian} countryside.
e.zh: 这幅画呈现了翁布里亚乡间温暖的色调。

e.en: He added a sour {umeboshi} to his rice ball.
e.zh: 他在饭团里加了一颗酸酸的梅干。

e.en: {Umeboshi} is often eaten for breakfast in Japan.
e.zh: 在日本,梅干常常作为早餐的一部分食用。

e.en: The speaker called for unity across the global {umma}.
e.zh: 演讲者呼吁全球穆斯林社群团结一致。

e.en: Scholars debated the future of the {umma} online.
e.zh: 学者们在网上讨论穆斯林社群的未来。

ummah.t: n. 乌玛；伊斯兰共同体

e.en: Ramadan brings the {ummah} together in shared devotion.
e.zh: 斋月让整个穆斯林社群在共同的虔诚中团聚。

e.en: He spoke about responsibilities within the global {ummah}.
e.zh: 他谈到了在全球穆斯林社群中肩负的责任。

e.en: "{Ummm}, I'm not really sure about that," she replied.
e.zh: 她回答说:"嗯……我也不太确定。"

e.en: "{Ummm}, can you repeat the question?" he asked.
e.zh: 他问道:"嗯……你能再说一遍问题吗?"

umpire.t:
n. 裁判员
v. 当裁判

e.en: The {umpire} signaled that the runner was out.
e.zh: 裁判示意那名跑垒员出局。

e.en: Players often argue with the {umpire} over close calls.
e.zh: 球员经常因为边缘判罚和裁判争执。

umpteen.t: adj. 许多的；无数的（口语）

e.en: I've told you {umpteen} times to lock the door.
e.zh: 我跟你说过无数次要锁门了。

e.en: She tried {umpteen} different recipes before finding the right one.
e.zh: 她试了好多种食谱才找到合适的那一个。

umpteenth.t: adj. 第无数次的；老多次的

e.en: This is the {umpteenth} time he's been late this week.
e.zh: 这已经是他这周不知道第几次迟到了。

e.en: For the {umpteenth} time, please turn off the lights.
e.zh: 我都说了无数遍了,请把灯关掉。

unabashed.t: adj. 不害臊的；毫不掩饰的

e.en: She is an {unabashed} fan of cheesy pop music.
e.zh: 她毫不掩饰地喜欢俗气的流行音乐。

e.en: He showed {unabashed} enthusiasm for the new project.
e.zh: 他对这个新项目表现出毫不掩饰的热情。

unabashedly.t: adv. 毫不掩饰地；坦然地

e.en: The film is {unabashedly} romantic from start to finish.
e.zh: 这部电影从头到尾都毫不掩饰地浪漫。

e.en: She {unabashedly} sang along to every song on the radio.
e.zh: 她毫不害羞地跟着收音机里的每首歌一起唱。

unabated.t: adj. 不减弱的；持续强劲的

e.en: The storm continued {unabated} throughout the night.
e.zh: 风暴整夜未曾减弱,持续肆虐。

e.en: Demand for the new phone remains {unabated}.
e.zh: 市场对这款新手机的需求依然居高不下。

unable.t: adj. 不能的；无法做到的

e.en: I was {unable} to attend the meeting yesterday.
e.zh: 我昨天没能参加那个会议。

e.en: The app is {unable} to connect to the server.
e.zh: 这个应用无法连接到服务器。

unabridged.t: adj. 未删节的；完整版的

e.en: She listened to the {unabridged} audiobook on her commute.
e.zh: 她在通勤途中听了完整未删节的有声书。

e.en: This edition contains the {unabridged} text of the novel.
e.zh: 这个版本收录了这部小说的完整未删节内容。

unaccented.t: adj. 无重音的；非重读的

e.en: He speaks clear, {unaccented} English despite growing up abroad.
e.zh: 尽管在国外长大,他却说着清晰、没有口音的英语。

e.en: The {unaccented} syllables in this word are pronounced softly.
e.zh: 这个单词里的非重读音节发音要轻一些。

unacceptable.t: adj. 不可接受的；无法容忍的

e.en: His rude behavior at the meeting was completely {unacceptable}.
e.zh: 他在会议上的粗鲁行为完全无法接受。

e.en: The delivery delay is {unacceptable} for our biggest client.
e.zh: 对我们最大的客户来说,这次延迟交货是不可接受的。

e.en: The website loads {unacceptably} slowly on mobile devices.
e.zh: 该网站在手机上加载得慢得让人无法忍受。

e.en: Air pollution levels are {unacceptably} high this week.
e.zh: 本周的空气污染水平高得令人无法接受。

unaccompanied.t: adj. 无人陪同的；无伴奏的

e.en: Children under twelve cannot fly {unaccompanied} on this airline.
e.zh: 十二岁以下儿童不得单独搭乘本航空公司的航班。

e.en: She sang the folk song {unaccompanied} by any instrument.
e.zh: 她在没有任何乐器伴奏下清唱了那首民谣。

unaccountable.t: adj. 无法解释的；无需负责的

e.en: For some {unaccountable} reason, the printer keeps turning itself off.
e.zh: 出于某种莫名其妙的原因,打印机老是自动关机。

e.en: Senior managers should not be {unaccountable} for their decisions.
e.zh: 高层管理者不应对自己的决定不负任何责任。

unaccountably.t: adv. 莫名其妙地；无法解释地

e.en: The train was {unaccountably} delayed for over three hours.
e.zh: 火车莫名其妙地晚点了三个多小时。

e.en: She felt {unaccountably} sad after reading the old letter.
e.zh: 读完那封旧信后,她莫名地感到悲伤。

unaccounted.t: adj. 下落不明的；未被计入的

e.en: Two passengers are still {unaccounted} for after the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生后仍有两名乘客下落不明。

e.en: Several thousand dollars remain {unaccounted} for in the budget.
e.zh: 预算中仍有数千美元去向不明。

unaccredited.t: adj. 未经认证的；未获授权的

e.en: Employers often ignore degrees from {unaccredited} online universities.
e.zh: 雇主通常会忽略未获认证的网络大学颁发的学位。

e.en: The clinic was shut down because its doctors were {unaccredited}.
e.zh: 该诊所因其医生未获资质认证而被关闭。

unaccustomed.t: adj. 不习惯的；不寻常的

e.en: Tourists are often {unaccustomed} to the spicy local food.
e.zh: 游客通常吃不惯当地辛辣的食物。

e.en: He felt nervous, {unaccustomed} to speaking in front of crowds.
e.zh: 他感到紧张,不习惯在人群面前讲话。

unachievable.t: adj. 无法实现的；难以达成的

e.en: The sales targets this quarter seem completely {unachievable}.
e.zh: 本季度的销售目标看起来完全无法实现。

e.en: Don't set {unachievable} goals or you'll quickly lose motivation.
e.zh: 不要设定无法达成的目标,否则你会很快失去动力。

unacknowledged.t: adj. 未被承认的；未被答复的

e.en: Her contributions to the project went largely {unacknowledged}.
e.zh: 她对该项目的贡献在很大程度上未得到认可。

e.en: Many emails to customer support remain {unacknowledged} for days.
e.zh: 许多发给客服的邮件好几天都没人回复。

unacquainted.t: adj. 不熟悉的；不相识的

e.en: I am completely {unacquainted} with the new software they installed.
e.zh: 我对他们新装的那款软件一无所知。

e.en: The two writers were {unacquainted} before the conference last year.
e.zh: 这两位作家在去年的会议之前并不相识。

unaddressed.t: adj. 未被处理的；未写地址的

e.en: His concerns about safety remained {unaddressed} by management.
e.zh: 他对安全的担忧始终没有得到管理层的回应。

e.en: Several {unaddressed} envelopes were sitting on the office desk.
e.zh: 办公桌上放着几个没写收件人的信封。

e.en: The {unadjusted} figures show a sharp rise in unemployment.
e.zh: 未经调整的数据显示失业率急剧上升。

e.en: Sales numbers are {unadjusted} for seasonal variation in this report.
e.zh: 本报告中的销售数据未对季节性波动进行调整。

unadorned.t: adj. 朴素的；未加修饰的

e.en: She prefers a simple, {unadorned} style of clothing.
e.zh: 她偏爱简朴、不加装饰的服装风格。

e.en: The room had plain white walls and {unadorned} wooden floors.
e.zh: 房间是朴素的白墙和未加装饰的木地板。

e.en: Watching the kids open presents was {unadulterated} joy.
e.zh: 看着孩子们拆礼物是一种纯粹的快乐。

e.en: The shop sells {unadulterated} honey straight from the beekeeper.
e.zh: 这家店出售直接从养蜂人那里来的纯正蜂蜜。

unadventurous.t: adj. 保守的；缺乏冒险精神的

e.en: He's an {unadventurous} eater who only orders plain pasta.
e.zh: 他吃东西很保守,只点白意面。

e.en: Their vacation choices are safe and a little {unadventurous}.
e.zh: 他们的度假选择很保守,有点缺乏冒险精神。

unaffected.t: adj. 不受影响的；自然真诚的

e.en: Coastal towns were badly hit, but inland villages remained {unaffected}.
e.zh: 沿海城镇受灾严重,但内陆村庄未受影响。

e.en: Despite her fame, she has an {unaffected} and friendly manner.
e.zh: 尽管成名,她举止仍然自然而友善。

unaffiliated.t: adj. 无隶属关系的；独立的

e.en: Many young voters now describe themselves as politically {unaffiliated}.
e.zh: 许多年轻选民如今自称没有政治派别归属。

e.en: The clinic is {unaffiliated} with any major hospital network.
e.zh: 该诊所不隶属于任何大型医院网络。

unaffordable.t: adj. 负担不起的；买不起的

e.en: Housing in the city center has become {unaffordable} for most families.
e.zh: 市中心的住房对大多数家庭来说已变得难以负担。

e.en: Quality healthcare should not be {unaffordable} for ordinary workers.
e.zh: 优质的医疗不应让普通劳动者负担不起。

e.en: She is {unafraid} to speak her mind in meetings.
e.zh: 她在会议上敢于直言不讳。

e.en: The little dog seemed completely {unafraid} of the thunderstorm.
e.zh: 那只小狗似乎完全不怕雷雨。

unaided.t: adj. 独自的；无人协助的

e.en: After surgery, she could finally walk {unaided} across the room.
e.zh: 手术后,她终于能不靠搀扶走过房间。

e.en: The child solved the puzzle {unaided} in just five minutes.
e.zh: 那孩子独立在五分钟内解开了拼图。

unalienable.t: adj. 不可剥夺的；不可转让的

e.en: The constitution guarantees certain {unalienable} rights to every citizen.
e.zh: 宪法保障每位公民某些不可剥夺的权利。

e.en: Freedom of conscience is an {unalienable} human right.
e.zh: 良心自由是一项不可剥夺的人权。

unaligned.t: adj. 未对齐的；不结盟的

e.en: The picture frames on the wall look slightly {unaligned}.
e.zh: 墙上的相框看起来有点没对齐。

e.en: Several countries remained {unaligned} during the Cold War.
e.zh: 冷战期间有几个国家保持不结盟立场。

e.en: The twin sisters look identical but are completely {unalike} in personality.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎姐妹长得一模一样,但性格截然不同。

e.en: Although both are novels, the two books are entirely {unalike}.
e.zh: 虽然都是小说,这两本书却完全不同。

unallocated.t: adj. 未分配的；尚未划拨的

e.en: There is still some {unallocated} budget left for marketing.
e.zh: 市场推广还有一部分未分配的预算。

e.en: Several seats in the front row remained {unallocated} until showtime.
e.zh: 前排有几个座位直到开演前都未分配出去。

unalloyed.t: adj. 纯粹的；毫无掺杂的

e.en: Winning the championship brought her {unalloyed} happiness.
e.zh: 赢得冠军给她带来了纯粹的幸福。

e.en: The film received {unalloyed} praise from critics worldwide.
e.zh: 这部电影得到了全球影评人毫无保留的赞誉。

unalterable.t: adj. 不可改变的；无法更动的

e.en: His decision to retire was firm and {unalterable}.
e.zh: 他退休的决定坚定不移,无可更改。

e.en: Some laws of physics are considered {unalterable} truths.
e.zh: 某些物理定律被视为不可改变的真理。

unalterably.t: adv. 不可改变地；坚定地

e.en: That conversation {unalterably} changed our friendship forever.
e.zh: 那次谈话不可逆转地改变了我们的友谊。

e.en: He is {unalterably} opposed to the proposed merger.
e.zh: 他坚决反对这项拟议中的合并。

unaltered.t: adj. 未被改变的；保持原样的

e.en: The recipe has remained {unaltered} for over a century.
e.zh: 这个食谱一个多世纪以来都未曾改动。

e.en: Despite the renovation, the kitchen layout was left {unaltered}.
e.zh: 尽管进行了翻修,厨房的布局却保持原样。

unambiguous.t: adj. 明确的；毫不含糊的

e.en: The contract uses {unambiguous} language to avoid any disputes.
e.zh: 合同使用清晰明确的措辞以避免任何争议。

e.en: The election results sent an {unambiguous} message to the government.
e.zh: 选举结果向政府传递了一个明确无误的信息。

unambiguously.t: adv. 明确地；毫不含糊地

e.en: The judge {unambiguously} rejected the defendant's appeal.
e.zh: 法官明确无误地驳回了被告的上诉。

e.en: The data {unambiguously} supports our research hypothesis.
e.zh: 数据明确地支持了我们的研究假设。

unambitious.t: adj. 没有野心的；胸无大志的

e.en: His career goals seem rather {unambitious} for someone so talented.
e.zh: 对一个这么有才华的人来说,他的职业目标显得有些缺乏抱负。

e.en: Critics called the new policy timid and {unambitious}.
e.zh: 评论人士称这项新政策胆小且缺乏雄心。

unamused.t: adj. 不觉好笑的；不悦的

e.en: The teacher was clearly {unamused} by the students' prank.
e.zh: 老师显然觉得学生们的恶作剧一点也不好笑。

e.en: My boss looked {unamused} when I arrived late again.
e.zh: 我又迟到时,老板脸色一点也不好看。

e.en: Huge amounts of survey data remain {unanalysed} on the server.
e.zh: 服务器上还有大量未经分析的调查数据。

e.en: The samples sat {unanalysed} in the lab for several months.
e.zh: 那些样本在实验室里搁置了几个月,未做分析。

e.en: There was complete {unanimity} among voters on this single issue.
e.zh: 在这一问题上,选民们的意见完全一致。

e.en: The committee reached rare {unanimity} on the new safety rules.
e.zh: 委员会在新安全规则上罕见地达成了一致。

unanimous.t: adj. 一致同意的；全体赞成的

e.en: The jury was {unanimous} in finding the defendant not guilty.
e.zh: 陪审团一致裁定被告无罪。

e.en: Critics were {unanimous} in praising the actor's performance.
e.zh: 评论家一致称赞这位演员的表演。

unanimously.t: adv. 一致地；全体赞同地

e.en: The board {unanimously} approved the proposal yesterday afternoon.
e.zh: 董事会昨天下午一致通过了该提案。

e.en: Members voted {unanimously} to extend the contract another year.
e.zh: 成员们一致投票将合同再延长一年。

e.en: Inspectors arrived {unannounced} at the factory this morning.
e.zh: 检查员今早未经通知就来到了工厂。

e.en: My in-laws have a habit of showing up {unannounced}.
e.zh: 我的公婆有不打招呼就来访的习惯。

unanswerable.t: adj. 无法回答的；无可辩驳的

e.en: Why we exist is perhaps an {unanswerable} philosophical question.
e.zh: 我们为何存在,这或许是一个无解的哲学问题。

e.en: Children often ask {unanswerable} questions about the universe.
e.zh: 孩子们经常问一些关于宇宙的无法回答的问题。

unanswered.t: adj. 未被回答的；未回应的

e.en: Many of my emails to support have gone {unanswered}.
e.zh: 我发给客服的许多邮件都没有回复。

e.en: Her question about the missing files remains {unanswered}.
e.zh: 她关于丢失文件的问题至今未得到答复。

unanticipated.t: adj. 未预料到的；意外的

e.en: The project ran into several {unanticipated} technical problems.
e.zh: 该项目遇到了几个意料之外的技术问题。

e.en: Heavy rain caused {unanticipated} delays at the airport.
e.zh: 大雨导致机场出现意料之外的延误。

unapologetic.t: adj. 毫无歉意的；理直气壮的

e.en: She is {unapologetic} about her ambition to lead the company.
e.zh: 她对自己想要领导公司的雄心毫不掩饰、绝不致歉。

e.en: The director made an {unapologetic} film about social inequality.
e.zh: 这位导演拍了一部毫不妥协地揭露社会不平等的电影。

unapologetically.t: adv. 毫不歉意地；理直气壮地

e.en: She dresses {unapologetically} in bright, colorful outfits every day.
e.zh: 她每天毫不掩饰地穿着鲜艳多彩的衣服。

e.en: The brand is {unapologetically} aimed at younger consumers.
e.zh: 该品牌毫不避讳地以年轻消费者为目标。

unappealing.t: adj. 没有吸引力的；不讨喜的

e.en: The cold cafeteria food looked completely {unappealing}.
e.zh: 食堂里冷掉的饭菜看起来一点都不诱人。

e.en: Working overtime on weekends sounds quite {unappealing} to me.
e.zh: 周末加班对我来说听起来相当不吸引人。

unappetizing.t: adj. 令人没胃口的；倒胃口的

e.en: The leftover soup looked grey and rather {unappetizing}.
e.zh: 剩下的汤呈灰色,看起来很倒胃口。

e.en: Hospital meals can sometimes be a bit {unappetizing}.
e.zh: 医院的伙食有时让人没什么食欲。

unappreciated.t: adj. 不被赏识的；不受重视的

e.en: Many parents feel {unappreciated} for the work they do at home.
e.zh: 许多父母觉得他们在家中的付出没有得到重视。

e.en: His efforts on the team went largely {unappreciated} by management.
e.zh: 他在团队中的努力基本没有得到管理层的赏识。

unappreciative.t: adj. 不领情的；不知感恩的

e.en: The audience seemed strangely {unappreciative} of the brilliant performance.
e.zh: 观众对这场精彩的演出显得出奇地不领情。

e.en: Don't be {unappreciative} of all the help your friends offered.
e.zh: 不要不感激朋友们提供的所有帮助。

unapproachable.t: adj. 难以接近的；不好相处的

e.en: My new boss seems cold and rather {unapproachable}.
e.zh: 我的新老板似乎冷漠,让人不太敢接近。

e.en: Famous celebrities can sometimes appear {unapproachable} in public.
e.zh: 著名人士有时在公众面前显得难以接近。

e.en: The pharmacy cannot sell {unapproved} medications to customers.
e.zh: 药房不得向顾客出售未经批准的药物。

e.en: Your expense report contains several {unapproved} purchases.
e.zh: 你的报销单上有几笔未经批准的支出。

unarguable.t: adj. 无可争辩的；不容置疑的

e.en: It is {unarguable} that smoking damages your health.
e.zh: 吸烟有害健康,这一点无可争辩。

e.en: Her talent as a pianist is simply {unarguable}.
e.zh: 她作为钢琴家的才华是毋庸置疑的。

e.en: The suspect was {unarmed} when police approached the vehicle.
e.zh: 警察接近车辆时，嫌疑人没有携带武器。

e.en: He practices {unarmed} combat techniques every weekend.
e.zh: 他每个周末都练习徒手格斗技巧。

unarmored.t: adj. 无装甲的；无防护的

e.en: The {unarmored} jeep was vulnerable to roadside attacks.
e.zh: 那辆没有装甲的吉普车很容易遭到路边袭击。

e.en: Light infantry move faster but remain {unarmored}.
e.zh: 轻步兵移动更快，但缺乏装甲保护。

unarticulated.t: adj. 未清晰表达的；未说出口的

e.en: Many of her fears remained {unarticulated} during therapy.
e.zh: 治疗期间她的许多恐惧仍未被说出口。

e.en: The team had {unarticulated} assumptions that caused conflict.
e.zh: 团队中存在未明说的假设，导致了冲突。

unashamed.t: adj. 毫不羞愧的；坦然的

e.en: She is {unashamed} about her love for cheesy pop music.
e.zh: 她毫不掩饰自己对俗气流行歌曲的喜爱。

e.en: He gave an {unashamed} grin after winning the prize.
e.zh: 赢得奖项后，他露出了毫不羞涩的笑容。

unashamedly.t: adv. 毫不羞愧地；公然地

e.en: The film is {unashamedly} sentimental from start to finish.
e.zh: 这部电影从头到尾都毫不掩饰地煽情。

e.en: He {unashamedly} copied his rival's marketing strategy.
e.zh: 他毫不羞愧地抄袭了对手的营销策略。

unasked.t: adj. 未被问及的；主动的

e.en: She offered her opinion {unasked} during the meeting.
e.zh: 会议上她不请自来地发表了自己的意见。

e.en: Many important questions went {unasked} at the press conference.
e.zh: 新闻发布会上许多重要问题都没人提出。

unassailable.t: adj. 无懈可击的；不可辩驳的

e.en: The champion holds an {unassailable} lead going into the finals.
e.zh: 冠军以无可撼动的优势进入决赛。

e.en: Her reputation for honesty is {unassailable}.
e.zh: 她诚实的声誉无可置疑。

e.en: The bookshelf arrived {unassembled} in a flat cardboard box.
e.zh: 书架装在扁平的纸箱里，需要自己组装。

e.en: Several {unassembled} parts were missing from the kit.
e.zh: 套件中缺少了几个未组装的零件。

unassertive.t: adj. 不爱出头的；温和的

e.en: His {unassertive} manner makes negotiations difficult for him.
e.zh: 他不够强势的性格让他在谈判中比较吃亏。

e.en: She seemed too {unassertive} to lead such a big team.
e.zh: 她似乎太缺乏魄力，难以领导这么大的团队。

e.en: There are still three {unassigned} tickets in the project tracker.
e.zh: 项目跟踪器里还有三个未分配的工单。

e.en: New hires often start with {unassigned} desks for the first week.
e.zh: 新员工头一周通常没有固定的工位。

unassisted.t: adj. 无人协助的；独自的

e.en: The toddler walked across the room {unassisted}.
e.zh: 那个学步的孩子独自一人走过了房间。

e.en: She completed the climb {unassisted} by ropes or guides.
e.zh: 她在没有绳索和向导帮助下完成了攀登。

unassociated.t: adj. 无关联的；未关联的

e.en: The two crimes appear to be {unassociated} with each other.
e.zh: 这两起案件看上去彼此并无关联。

e.en: Side effects {unassociated} with the drug were also reported.
e.zh: 也有人报告了与该药物无关的副作用。

e.en: Despite his fame, the actor remains {unassuming} and friendly.
e.zh: 尽管很有名气，这位演员依然谦逊友好。

e.en: The cafe has an {unassuming} entrance on a side street.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆的入口很不起眼，藏在一条小街上。

e.en: She prefers staying {unattached} while focusing on her career.
e.zh: 她专注事业，宁愿保持单身。

e.en: Several {unattached} cables were dangling behind the desk.
e.zh: 桌子后面挂着几根没接上的线缆。

unattainable.t: adj. 无法达到的；遥不可及的

e.en: Perfection is an {unattainable} goal for most projects.
e.zh: 对大多数项目来说，完美是个无法企及的目标。

e.en: The luxury apartment felt {unattainable} on his salary.
e.zh: 以他的薪水，那套豪华公寓简直高不可攀。

unattended.t: adj. 无人看管的；无人值守的

e.en: Please do not leave your luggage {unattended} in the airport.
e.zh: 请不要在机场让行李无人看管。

e.en: The {unattended} server crashed overnight without anyone noticing.
e.zh: 那台无人看管的服务器在夜里崩溃了，没人发现。

unattractive.t: adj. 不吸引人的；没魅力的

e.en: The job offer had several {unattractive} terms in the contract.
e.zh: 这份工作合同里有几个条款不太吸引人。

e.en: He found the wallpaper pattern strangely {unattractive}.
e.zh: 他觉得那种墙纸图案莫名地难看。

e.en: The startup released {unaudited} financial figures to investors.
e.zh: 这家初创公司向投资者公布了未经审计的财务数据。

e.en: Regulators flagged the {unaudited} accounts as a serious risk.
e.zh: 监管机构指出未经审计的账目构成重大风险。

unauthorised.t: adj. 未经授权的（英式拼写）

e.en: The system blocked an {unauthorised} login attempt from overseas.
e.zh: 系统拦截了一次来自海外的未授权登录。

e.en: {Unauthorised} access to the database is strictly prohibited.
e.zh: 严禁未经授权访问该数据库。

unauthorized.t: adj. 未经授权的；越权的

e.en: The app returned a 401 error for {unauthorized} requests.
e.zh: 对于未授权的请求，应用会返回 401 错误。

e.en: He was fired for making {unauthorized} purchases on the company card.
e.zh: 他因用公司卡进行未经授权的消费而被解雇。

e.en: The {unavailability} of spare parts delayed the repair by weeks.
e.zh: 零件缺货使维修工作推迟了好几周。

e.en: Please note the doctor's {unavailability} on Friday afternoons.
e.zh: 请注意，这位医生周五下午无法就诊。

unavailable.t: adj. 不可用的；无法获得的

e.en: That product is currently {unavailable} in your region.
e.zh: 该产品目前在你所在的地区暂时无货。

e.en: The manager was {unavailable} for comment after the incident.
e.zh: 事件发生后经理无法接受采访。

e.en: All her efforts to save the company proved {unavailing}.
e.zh: 她为挽救公司所做的一切努力都徒劳无功。

e.en: His pleas for mercy were entirely {unavailing}.
e.zh: 他求情完全没有效果。

e.en: Some delays are simply {unavoidable} during the holiday season.
e.zh: 在假期期间，某些延误确实无法避免。

e.en: A small price increase has become {unavoidable} this year.
e.zh: 今年小幅涨价已经在所难免。

e.en: The flight was {unavoidably} delayed due to severe weather.
e.zh: 由于恶劣天气，航班不可避免地延误了。

e.en: She was {unavoidably} late because of the traffic accident.
e.zh: 她因为交通事故不得已迟到了。

unaware.t: adj. 未察觉的；不知情的

e.en: Many users are {unaware} of how their data is collected.
e.zh: 许多用户并不知道自己的数据是如何被收集的。

e.en: He was completely {unaware} of the meeting change.
e.zh: 他完全不知道会议时间已经改了。

e.en: Their {unawareness} of the new rules caused several mistakes.
e.zh: 他们对新规定的不了解导致了几次错误。

e.en: Public {unawareness} about the scam helped it spread quickly.
e.zh: 公众对这一骗局缺乏认识，使其迅速蔓延。

unawares.t: adv. 冷不防地；出其不意地

e.en: The sudden announcement caught the whole team {unawares}.
e.zh: 那突如其来的通告让整个团队措手不及。

e.en: The thunderstorm caught hikers {unawares} on the open ridge.
e.zh: 雷暴袭来时让山脊上的徒步者猝不及防。

e.en: She left the {unbaked} cookies in the fridge overnight.
e.zh: 她把还没烤的曲奇面团放进冰箱过夜。

e.en: Don't eat the {unbaked} pie crust straight from the bowl.
e.zh: 别直接从碗里吃没烤过的派皮。

unbalance.t:
v. 使失去平衡
n. 失衡

e.en: A sudden gust of wind can {unbalance} a small drone.
e.zh: 一阵突如其来的风可能让小型无人机失去平衡。

e.en: Tough questions seemed to {unbalance} the candidate on stage.
e.zh: 尖锐的问题似乎让那位候选人在台上乱了方寸。

unbalanced.t: adj. 失衡的；（心理）不稳定的

e.en: His diet is heavily {unbalanced} toward sugar and fat.
e.zh: 他的饮食严重偏向糖和脂肪,很不均衡。

e.en: The article gave an {unbalanced} view of the conflict.
e.zh: 这篇文章对那场冲突的描述很不公正。

unbanning.t: v. 解除禁令（unban 的现在分词）

e.en: The platform is considering {unbanning} several controversial accounts.
e.zh: 该平台正在考虑解封几个有争议的账户。

e.en: Fans are pushing for the {unbanning} of the popular streamer.
e.zh: 粉丝们在呼吁解封那位人气主播。

e.en: In medieval times, {unbaptized} infants caused theological worry.
e.zh: 在中世纪,未受洗的婴儿引发了神学上的担忧。

e.en: He grew up {unbaptized} but still attended church regularly.
e.zh: 他从小没受洗,但仍然定期去教堂。

e.en: The summer heat in the city was nearly {unbearable}.
e.zh: 城里夏天的高温几乎让人无法忍受。

e.en: Losing the dog was {unbearable} for the whole family.
e.zh: 失去那只狗对全家人来说都难以承受。

e.en: The meeting dragged on {unbearably} until late evening.
e.zh: 那场会议一直拖到深夜,令人难以忍受。

e.en: It was {unbearably} hot inside the parked car.
e.zh: 停着的车里热得让人受不了。

unbeatable.t: adj. 无敌的；无法超越的

e.en: The store offers {unbeatable} prices on winter jackets.
e.zh: 这家店冬季外套的价格无人能比。

e.en: On clay courts, she has been nearly {unbeatable} this season.
e.zh: 本赛季在红土赛场上她几乎所向无敌。

unbeaten.t: adj. 未被击败的；保持全胜的

e.en: The team has gone {unbeaten} for fifteen straight games.
e.zh: 该队已经连续十五场保持不败。

e.en: Her record in the long jump remains {unbeaten} after years.
e.zh: 她在跳远上的纪录多年来仍未被打破。

unbecoming.t: adj. 不得体的；不相称的

e.en: That kind of language is {unbecoming} of a senior diplomat.
e.zh: 那种言辞与一位资深外交官的身份不相称。

e.en: The dress was unflattering and quite {unbecoming} on her.
e.zh: 那条裙子并不衬她,甚至有些难看。

unbeknown.t: adj. 不为人知的；未被察觉的

e.en: {Unbeknown} to his parents, he had quit the course.
e.zh: 他父母并不知道,他早就退掉了那门课。

e.en: The leak was, {unbeknown} to staff, being carefully monitored.
e.zh: 员工并不知情,那次泄漏其实正被仔细监控。

unbeknownst.t: adj. 不为人知的；瞒着的

e.en: {Unbeknownst} to her, the meeting had already been canceled.
e.zh: 她并不知道,那场会议早已被取消了。

e.en: He had been recording the call, {unbeknownst} to the others.
e.zh: 其他人都不知道,他一直在录这通电话。

unbelief.t: n. 不信；怀疑（尤指宗教）

e.en: She stared at the screen in stunned {unbelief}.
e.zh: 她目瞪口呆地盯着屏幕,难以置信。

e.en: His {unbelief} only deepened after years of hard questions.
e.zh: 经过多年艰难追问,他的不信只是更深了。

e.en: The view from the rooftop bar was simply {unbelievable}.
e.zh: 从屋顶酒吧看出去的景色简直令人难以置信。

e.en: It is {unbelievable} how fast this baby is growing.
e.zh: 这宝宝长得真是快得难以置信。

e.en: The new phone is {unbelievably} thin and light.
e.zh: 这款新手机薄得轻得令人难以置信。

e.en: Traffic was {unbelievably} bad on the way to the airport.
e.zh: 去机场路上的交通堵得难以置信。

e.en: He was raised religious but became an {unbeliever} in college.
e.zh: 他从小信教,但上大学后变成了不信教的人。

e.en: The pastor spoke gently with the curious {unbeliever}.
e.zh: 牧师温和地与那位好奇的非信徒交谈。

e.en: She gave him an {unbelieving} look across the table.
e.zh: 她隔着桌子向他投去一个难以置信的眼神。

e.en: The crowd watched in {unbelieving} silence as he scored.
e.zh: 他得分时,观众难以置信地静静看着。

unbelted.t: adj. 未系安全带的；未束腰的

e.en: Driving while {unbelted} is illegal in most states.
e.zh: 在大多数州,不系安全带开车是违法的。

e.en: He sat {unbelted} in the back, scrolling on his phone.
e.zh: 他没系安全带坐在后座,刷着手机。

e.en: After hours at the desk, I had to {unbend} my back.
e.zh: 在桌前坐了几个小时后,我得伸展一下腰。

e.en: The strict teacher began to {unbend} a little before retirement.
e.zh: 那位严厉的老师在退休前开始变得稍微随和。

unbending.t: adj. 坚定不屈的；不妥协的

e.en: She is {unbending} when it comes to product quality.
e.zh: 在产品质量上,她毫不妥协。

e.en: His {unbending} stance on the rule frustrated his teammates.
e.zh: 他在那条规则上毫不让步,让队友很沮丧。

e.en: We need an {unbiased} review of the candidate's work.
e.zh: 我们需要对该候选人的工作做一次公正的评估。

e.en: The study aimed to provide {unbiased} data on the drug.
e.zh: 这项研究旨在提供关于该药物的客观数据。

unbidden.t: adj. 未被邀请的；自发的

e.en: Memories of that summer came {unbidden} to her mind.
e.zh: 那个夏天的回忆不请自来,涌上她心头。

e.en: He arrived {unbidden} at the family dinner.
e.zh: 他没受邀就出现在了家庭晚餐上。

e.en: You can {unbind} the shortcut key in the settings menu.
e.zh: 你可以在设置菜单里解除该快捷键的绑定。

e.en: She tried to {unbind} the rope around the package.
e.zh: 她试着解开包裹上的绳子。

e.en: I prefer {unbleached} flour for baking whole-grain bread.
e.zh: 我烤全麦面包时更喜欢用未漂白的面粉。

e.en: The bag is made from {unbleached} cotton canvas.
e.zh: 这个包是用未漂白的棉帆布做的。

e.en: He has an {unblemished} record after ten years on the job.
e.zh: 工作十年来他保持着无瑕的履历。

e.en: The apple looked perfectly {unblemished} on the shelf.
e.zh: 那个苹果摆在货架上看起来完美无瑕。

unblinking.t: adj. 目不转睛的；镇定的

e.en: The cat fixed me with an {unblinking} stare.
e.zh: 那只猫一眨不眨地盯着我。

e.en: She offered an {unblinking} assessment of the project's risks.
e.zh: 她对项目风险给出了毫不回避的评估。

unblinkingly.t: adv. 毫不眨眼地；镇定地

e.en: He stared {unblinkingly} at the screen for hours.
e.zh: 他目不转睛地盯着屏幕看了好几个小时。

e.en: The report {unblinkingly} describes the company's failures.
e.zh: 那份报告毫不避讳地描述了公司的失败。

e.en: Tap here to {unblock} this contact on WhatsApp.
e.zh: 点这里就能在 WhatsApp 上解除对该联系人的屏蔽。

e.en: A plumber came to {unblock} the kitchen sink.
e.zh: 水管工来疏通厨房的水槽。

unblocked.t: adj. 已解除屏蔽的；畅通的

e.en: I finally {unblocked} my ex on Instagram last night.
e.zh: 我昨晚终于在 Instagram 上把前任解除屏蔽了。

e.en: Once the drain was {unblocked}, the water drained quickly.
e.zh: 下水道疏通后,水很快就排走了。

e.en: He had to {unbolt} the gate to let the truck in.
e.zh: 他得把大门的插销拉开,好让卡车进来。

e.en: Use a wrench to {unbolt} the panel from the frame.
e.zh: 用扳手把面板从框架上拧下来。

e.en: She {unbolted} the door and stepped into the garden.
e.zh: 她拉开门闩,走进了花园。

e.en: The mechanic {unbolted} the wheel to replace the tire.
e.zh: 机修工把轮子拆下来换轮胎。

e.en: The vaccine protects both the mother and her {unborn} baby.
e.zh: 这种疫苗能同时保护母亲和她未出生的孩子。

e.en: We owe a clean planet to {unborn} generations.
e.zh: 我们应当为后代留下一个干净的地球。

unbothered.t: adj. 毫不在意的；淡定的

e.en: She seemed completely {unbothered} by the criticism online.
e.zh: 对网上的批评,她看上去完全不在意。

e.en: He stayed {unbothered} as the whole office panicked.
e.zh: 整个办公室都慌了,他依然不为所动。

unbound.t: adj. 未装订的；不受约束的

e.en: The pages came {unbound} from the old textbook.
e.zh: 那本旧课本的书页都散开了。

e.en: She felt {unbound} by traditional rules of fashion.
e.zh: 她觉得自己不再受传统时尚规则的束缚。

unbounded.t: adj. 无限的；无边无际的

e.en: Children show an {unbounded} curiosity about the world.
e.zh: 孩子们对世界有着无穷无尽的好奇心。

e.en: This function returns an {unbounded} stream of values.
e.zh: 这个函数返回一个无界的数据流。

unbowed.t: adj. 不屈服的；不低头的

e.en: After years of setbacks, she remained {unbowed}.
e.zh: 经历多年的挫折后,她依然不屈不挠。

e.en: The team left the field bloodied but {unbowed}.
e.zh: 球队带着伤离开球场,却毫不气馁。

e.en: She slowly {unbraided} her long hair before bed.
e.zh: 睡前她慢慢地把长辫子解开。

e.en: The frayed rope had partly {unbraided} at the end.
e.zh: 那根破旧的绳子末端已经散开了。

e.en: The young pine grew as a tall, {unbranched} stem.
e.zh: 那棵小松树长成了一根高高的、没有分枝的主干。

e.en: This molecule has a simple {unbranched} carbon chain.
e.zh: 这个分子有一条简单的无分支碳链。

e.en: I usually buy the {unbranded} pasta to save money.
e.zh: 为了省钱我一般买无品牌的意面。

e.en: Plain {unbranded} T-shirts are popular with minimalists.
e.zh: 极简主义者很喜欢无品牌的纯色 T 恤。

unbreakable.t: adj. 牢不可破的；摔不坏的

e.en: The phone case is advertised as nearly {unbreakable}.
e.zh: 这款手机壳宣传几乎摔不坏。

e.en: They share an {unbreakable} bond after twenty years.
e.zh: 二十年后他们依然有着牢不可破的情谊。

unbridgeable.t: adj. 无法弥合的（分歧等）

e.en: There seems to be an {unbridgeable} gap between the two parties.
e.zh: 双方之间似乎存在难以弥合的鸿沟。

e.en: Their differences in values felt {unbridgeable}.
e.zh: 他们在价值观上的分歧让人觉得无法跨越。

unbridled.t: adj. 无拘无束的；肆意的

e.en: The kids screamed with {unbridled} excitement at the concert.
e.zh: 孩子们在演唱会上兴奋得毫无节制地尖叫。

e.en: The film criticizes {unbridled} consumerism in modern cities.
e.zh: 这部电影批判了现代城市中肆无忌惮的消费主义。

unbroken.t: adj. 完整的；连续不断的

e.en: The team has an {unbroken} winning streak this season.
e.zh: 球队本赛季保持着不败的连胜纪录。

e.en: Snow lay {unbroken} across the wide field.
e.zh: 积雪完整无瑕地覆盖着辽阔的田野。

e.en: Don't {unbuckle} your seatbelt until the plane has fully stopped.
e.zh: 飞机完全停稳之前不要解开安全带。

e.en: He bent down to {unbuckle} his hiking boots.
e.zh: 他弯下腰解开登山靴的扣带。

e.en: She {unbuckled} the toddler from the car seat.
e.zh: 她把孩子从安全座椅里解了下来。

e.en: His belt was {unbuckled} after the long meal.
e.zh: 那顿大餐后,他的腰带都松开了。

unbundling.t: n. 拆分销售；业务拆分

e.en: Streaming services are {unbundling} channels from cable TV.
e.zh: 流媒体服务正在把频道从有线电视套餐中拆分出来。

e.en: The startup focuses on {unbundling} traditional banking products.
e.zh: 这家初创公司专注于将传统银行产品拆分重组。

e.en: She called her sister to {unburden} herself about work.
e.zh: 她打电话给姐姐倾诉工作上的烦恼。

e.en: Therapy helped him {unburden} years of silent grief.
e.zh: 心理治疗帮他卸下了多年压在心里的悲伤。

e.en: After the storm, several artifacts were {unburied} on the beach.
e.zh: 风暴过后,海滩上有几件文物被翻了出来。

e.en: The bodies remained {unburied} for days after the disaster.
e.zh: 灾难过后,遗体好几天都没能下葬。

e.en: A few pages of the diary survived {unburned} in the fire.
e.zh: 日记里有几页在火中幸存了下来。

e.en: Only a small patch of forest remained {unburned}.
e.zh: 森林里只剩下一小片没有被烧到。

e.en: A few {unburnt} pages survived at the bottom of the box.
e.zh: 箱底还有几页没烧毁的纸张幸存下来。

e.en: The forest left a patch of {unburnt} trees near the river.
e.zh: 森林大火在河边留下了一片未被烧毁的树木。

e.en: He started to {unbutton} his coat as he entered the warm room.
e.zh: 走进温暖的房间后，他开始解开外套的扣子。

e.en: She paused to {unbutton} her cuffs before washing the dishes.
e.zh: 她先停下来解开袖口的扣子，再去洗碗。

unbuttoned.t: adj. 纽扣已解开的；随便的

e.en: His shirt was {unbuttoned} at the collar after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后，他的衬衫领口已经解开了。

e.en: She {unbuttoned} her jacket and sat down by the fire.
e.zh: 她解开夹克扣子，在火炉旁坐了下来。

uncalculated.t: adj. 未经算计的；非有意的

e.en: His kindness felt genuine and entirely {uncalculated}.
e.zh: 他的善意显得真诚而毫无算计。

e.en: The remark was {uncalculated} but caused real offense.
e.zh: 那句话并非有意而发，却确实冒犯了人。

uncalled.t: adj. 没必要的；未被召唤的

e.en: That sarcastic comment was completely {uncalled} for.
e.zh: 那句讽刺的评论完全是没必要的。

e.en: His rude tone toward the waiter was {uncalled} for.
e.zh: 他对服务员那种粗鲁的语气实在没必要。

e.en: The new chatbot sounds {uncannily} like a real person.
e.zh: 这个新聊天机器人说话听起来诡异地像真人。

e.en: She {uncannily} resembles her grandmother in old photos.
e.zh: 她和老照片里的祖母长得出奇地像。

uncanny.t: adj. 不可思议的；诡异的

e.en: He has an {uncanny} ability to predict stock market trends.
e.zh: 他对股市走势有一种近乎神奇的预测能力。

e.en: There is an {uncanny} resemblance between the twins.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎之间有一种诡异的相似。

e.en: Please {uncap} the marker before drawing on the whiteboard.
e.zh: 在白板上画图前请先把记号笔的笔帽拔下来。

e.en: The new policy will {uncap} the bonus for top performers.
e.zh: 新政策将取消对顶尖员工奖金的上限。

uncapped.t: adj. 无上限的；未加盖的

e.en: The plan offers {uncapped} data for heavy mobile users.
e.zh: 该套餐为重度手机用户提供不限量流量。

e.en: She left the pen {uncapped} and it dried out overnight.
e.zh: 她没把笔帽盖上，结果笔一夜之间就干了。

uncared.t: adj. 无人照料的（常用 uncared-for）

e.en: The garden looked sad and {uncared} for after the move.
e.zh: 搬家之后，花园显得凄凉，无人打理。

e.en: Stray cats here are not {uncared} for; volunteers feed them daily.
e.zh: 这里的流浪猫并非无人照顾，志愿者每天给它们喂食。

uncaring.t: adj. 漠不关心的；冷漠的

e.en: She accused the company of being cold and {uncaring}.
e.zh: 她指责这家公司冷漠无情。

e.en: His {uncaring} attitude toward customers cost him the job.
e.zh: 他对顾客漠不关心的态度让他丢了工作。

e.en: Their footsteps echoed loudly on the {uncarpeted} hallway.
e.zh: 他们的脚步声在没铺地毯的走廊里回响得很大。

e.en: The {uncarpeted} stairs felt cold under her bare feet.
e.zh: 没铺地毯的楼梯踩在她光脚下面冰凉。

uncatchable.t: adj. 追不上的；无法抓住的

e.en: The sprinter looked utterly {uncatchable} in the final lap.
e.zh: 那名短跑选手在最后一圈看起来无人能追。

e.en: Some bugs are {uncatchable} without proper logging in place.
e.zh: 如果没有完善的日志，有些 bug 根本抓不到。

e.en: Philosophers debate whether any event can truly be {uncaused}.
e.zh: 哲学家们争论是否真有事件可以毫无原因地发生。

e.en: He insisted the accident was {uncaused} by human error.
e.zh: 他坚称这起事故并非由人为失误引起。

e.en: Her {unceasing} support helped him through the toughest year.
e.zh: 她持续不断的支持帮他度过了最艰难的一年。

e.en: The {unceasing} rain flooded several streets downtown.
e.zh: 连绵不停的雨水淹没了市中心的几条街道。

e.en: The phone rang {unceasingly} throughout the busy afternoon.
e.zh: 在忙碌的下午，电话一刻不停地响。

e.en: She worked {unceasingly} to finish the report before midnight.
e.zh: 她不停地工作，争取在午夜前完成报告。

e.en: The treaty referred to large tracts of {unced} tribal land.
e.zh: 条约提到了大片未被割让的部落土地。

e.en: Activists argued the territory remained legally {unced}.
e.zh: 活动人士认为该领土在法律上仍未被割让。

uncelebrated.t: adj. 不出名的；未受赞誉的

e.en: Many {uncelebrated} engineers built the systems we rely on daily.
e.zh: 许多默默无闻的工程师建造了我们每天依赖的系统。

e.en: Her birthday passed quietly and {uncelebrated} this year.
e.zh: 今年她的生日悄悄过去，没有任何庆祝。

uncensored.t: adj. 未经审查的；无删节的

e.en: The director released an {uncensored} version of the film online.
e.zh: 导演在网上发布了未删减版的电影。

e.en: He shared his {uncensored} thoughts on the new policy.
e.zh: 他对这项新政策毫无保留地说出了真实想法。

unceremonious.t: adj. 不拘礼节的；唐突的

e.en: His {unceremonious} exit from the company surprised everyone.
e.zh: 他从公司草率离开的方式让所有人都很惊讶。

e.en: The package arrived in an {unceremonious} brown envelope.
e.zh: 包裹装在一个普普通通的牛皮纸信封里寄到了。

e.en: She was {unceremoniously} dropped from the team last week.
e.zh: 上周她被毫不客气地踢出了队伍。

e.en: He {unceremoniously} dumped the laundry onto the bed.
e.zh: 他二话不说把脏衣服一股脑儿倒在了床上。

e.en: The future of the project remains {uncertain} after the layoffs.
e.zh: 裁员之后，这个项目的前景仍不明朗。

e.en: She felt {uncertain} about accepting the job offer.
e.zh: 她对是否接受这份工作仍然犹豫不决。

e.en: He smiled {uncertainly} when asked about his future plans.
e.zh: 被问到未来的打算时，他迟疑地笑了笑。

e.en: The child stepped {uncertainly} onto the icy sidewalk.
e.zh: 孩子犹豫地踏上结了冰的人行道。

uncertainties.t: n. 不确定因素（uncertainty 的复数）

e.en: Investors hate the {uncertainties} surrounding next quarter's earnings.
e.zh: 投资者讨厌下季度收益所带来的不确定性。

e.en: Life is full of small {uncertainties} you must accept.
e.zh: 生活中充满了你必须接受的小小不确定。

uncertainty.t: n. 不确定性；难以预料

e.en: There is real {uncertainty} about when the project will ship.
e.zh: 项目何时上线存在真正的不确定性。

e.en: Her voice carried a hint of {uncertainty} during the interview.
e.zh: 她在面试时语气里带着一丝迟疑。

uncertified.t: adj. 未经认证的；无证书的

e.en: The clinic was fined for hiring {uncertified} nurses.
e.zh: 该诊所因雇用未持证护士而被罚款。

e.en: Avoid downloading {uncertified} apps from random websites.
e.zh: 避免从不明网站下载未经认证的应用。

unchained.t: adj. 已解开锁链的；不受约束的

e.en: The dog was finally {unchained} and ran across the yard.
e.zh: 那只狗终于被解开链子,跑过院子。

e.en: Streaming services {unchained} audiences from the TV schedule.
e.zh: 流媒体服务把观众从电视节目表中解放出来。

unchallengeable.t: adj. 无法质疑的；不容争辩的

e.en: Her record in the marathon remains {unchallengeable} this year.
e.zh: 她今年在马拉松的纪录仍然无人能及。

e.en: The CEO acted as if his authority were {unchallengeable}.
e.zh: 那位CEO表现得仿佛他的权威不容挑战。

unchallenged.t: adj. 未受挑战的；无人反对的

e.en: His claim went {unchallenged} during the entire meeting.
e.zh: 他的说法在整场会议中都没有人质疑。

e.en: The team has been {unchallenged} at the top of the league.
e.zh: 该队在联赛榜首一直无人能撼动。

unchangeable.t: adj. 无法改变的；固定的

e.en: Some facts about the past are simply {unchangeable}.
e.zh: 关于过去的某些事实就是无法改变的。

e.en: The username you pick is {unchangeable} after registration.
e.zh: 你注册时选的用户名之后无法更改。

unchanged.t: adj. 未变的；保持原样的

e.en: The price has remained {unchanged} for over a decade.
e.zh: 这个价格十多年来一直没有变化。

e.en: Her opinion of him was {unchanged} after the apology.
e.zh: 道歉之后她对他的看法依然没变。

unchanging.t: adj. 始终如一的；恒定的

e.en: The mountains feel ancient and {unchanging} in the morning light.
e.zh: 晨光中,群山显得古老而恒久不变。

e.en: He admired her {unchanging} loyalty to old friends.
e.zh: 他敬佩她对老朋友始终如一的忠诚。

unchaperoned.t: adj. 无人陪伴的；无监护的

e.en: Teenagers were not allowed to travel {unchaperoned} back then.
e.zh: 那时候青少年不被允许在没有大人陪同下出行。

e.en: The kids spent an {unchaperoned} afternoon at the mall.
e.zh: 孩子们在商场度过了一个无人陪同的下午。

uncharacteristic.t: adj. 与平日不同的；反常的

e.en: His angry outburst was completely {uncharacteristic} of him.
e.zh: 他那次发火完全不像他平时的样子。

e.en: The team made an {uncharacteristic} number of mistakes today.
e.zh: 球队今天犯了反常的多次失误。

e.en: She was {uncharacteristically} quiet during dinner last night.
e.zh: 昨晚吃饭时她反常地安静。

e.en: The usually punctual manager arrived {uncharacteristically} late.
e.zh: 那位一向准时的经理反常地迟到了。

uncharged.t: adj. 未充电的；未被起诉的

e.en: My phone was completely {uncharged} when I needed it most.
e.zh: 在我最需要手机的时候它完全没电了。

e.en: The suspect was released, still {uncharged} after 48 hours.
e.zh: 嫌疑人在48小时后仍未被起诉,获释离开。

e.en: It would be {uncharitable} to judge her on one mistake.
e.zh: 因一个错误就评判她,未免太刻薄了。

e.en: His {uncharitable} comments about the volunteers upset everyone.
e.zh: 他对志愿者刻薄的评论让大家都很不快。

e.en: Critics spoke {uncharitably} about the director's debut film.
e.zh: 评论家对这位导演的处女作苛刻地评论。

e.en: He {uncharitably} dismissed her idea without even reading it.
e.zh: 他连看都没看就刻薄地否定了她的想法。

uncharted.t: adj. 地图上未标明的；未知的

e.en: The startup is moving into {uncharted} legal territory.
e.zh: 这家创业公司正进入未知的法律领域。

e.en: Early sailors feared the {uncharted} waters of the Pacific.
e.zh: 早期水手害怕太平洋那片未知的海域。

unchartered.t: adj. 未经特许的；无执照的

e.en: Operating an {unchartered} bank is illegal in most countries.
e.zh: 在大多数国家经营无牌银行是违法的。

e.en: They flew home on an {unchartered} private jet.
e.zh: 他们乘坐一架未注册的私人飞机回家了。

e.en: Please {uncheck} the box if you don't want emails.
e.zh: 如果你不想收邮件,请取消勾选这个框。

e.en: You can {uncheck} optional features before installing the app.
e.zh: 安装应用前你可以取消勾选可选功能。

unchecked.t: adj. 未加抑制的；未勾选的

e.en: Left {unchecked}, small bugs can crash the entire system.
e.zh: 小漏洞若不加以制止,会导致整个系统崩溃。

e.en: The privacy option was {unchecked} by default in the form.
e.zh: 表单里那个隐私选项默认是没有勾选的。

e.en: The {unchosen} candidates were thanked and sent home.
e.zh: 未被选中的候选人被致谢后送走了。

e.en: Every choice leaves an {unchosen} path behind it.
e.zh: 每个选择背后都留下一条未被选择的路。

e.en: The doctor noted that the baby was {uncircumcised}.
e.zh: 医生注明这名婴儿未行包皮环切。

e.en: Many cultures leave male infants {uncircumcised} by tradition.
e.zh: 许多文化按传统不为男婴行包皮环切。

e.en: His {uncivil} tone shocked everyone at the dinner table.
e.zh: 他粗鲁的语气让饭桌上每个人都很震惊。

e.en: Online debates often turn {uncivil} within just a few replies.
e.zh: 网上辩论往往几条回复后就变得不文明。

e.en: Eating dinner at midnight feels positively {uncivilized}.
e.zh: 半夜才吃晚饭感觉简直太没规矩了。

e.en: The novel portrays the frontier as wild and {uncivilized}.
e.zh: 这部小说把边疆描绘得野蛮而未开化。

unclaimed.t: adj. 无人认领的；未被领取的

e.en: There is millions of dollars in {unclaimed} bank deposits.
e.zh: 有数百万美元的银行存款无人认领。

e.en: An {unclaimed} suitcase was sitting alone at the airport.
e.zh: 机场有个无人认领的行李箱孤零零地放着。

e.en: She tried to {unclasp} the necklace without help.
e.zh: 她试着自己解开项链的扣子。

e.en: Please {unclasp} your seatbelt only after the plane stops.
e.zh: 请等飞机停稳后再解开安全带。

e.en: He {unclasped} his hands and stood up slowly.
e.zh: 他松开双手,慢慢地站了起来。

e.en: She {unclasped} the bracelet and placed it on the dresser.
e.zh: 她解下手镯,把它放在梳妆台上。

e.en: His music is genuinely {unclassifiable} by any single genre.
e.zh: 他的音乐确实无法归入任何单一流派。

e.en: The strange creature was {unclassifiable} under current biology.
e.zh: 按现有生物学,这种奇怪的生物无法归类。

unclassified.t: adj. 未分类的；非机密的

e.en: The report draws only on {unclassified} government documents.
e.zh: 这份报告只引用了非机密的政府文件。

e.en: Many emails in the inbox are still {unclassified} by topic.
e.zh: 收件箱里很多邮件还没按主题分类。

uncle.t: n. 叔叔、舅舅、姑父、姨夫

e.en: My {uncle} taught me how to ride a bike.
e.zh: 我叔叔教会了我怎么骑自行车。

e.en: We're flying to Sydney to visit my {uncle} next week.
e.zh: 下周我们要飞去悉尼看望我舅舅。

unclean.t: adj. 不干净的；不纯洁的

e.en: Wash your hands — {unclean} fingers spread germs easily.
e.zh: 洗洗手吧,脏手指很容易传播细菌。

e.en: In some traditions, certain foods are considered {unclean}.
e.zh: 在一些传统里,某些食物被认为是不洁的。

e.en: The restaurant was shut down for {uncleanliness} in the kitchen.
e.zh: 那家餐厅因厨房不卫生被关停了。

e.en: Inspectors noted the {uncleanliness} of the public restrooms.
e.zh: 检查人员指出了公共卫生间的脏乱情况。

e.en: It's still {unclear} when the new feature will launch.
e.zh: 新功能何时上线目前仍不清楚。

e.en: His instructions were so {unclear} that everyone got lost.
e.zh: 他的指示太含糊,所有人都弄迷糊了。

uncleared.t: adj. 未清理的；未结清的

e.en: There are several {uncleared} transactions in your account.
e.zh: 你的账户里还有几笔未结算的交易。

e.en: The {uncleared} snow on the road made driving dangerous.
e.zh: 路面上没清扫的积雪让开车变得很危险。

e.en: He spoke too {unclearly} for the microphone to pick up.
e.zh: 他说得太含糊,麦克风都收不清楚。

e.en: The terms were written {unclearly} in the contract.
e.zh: 合同里那些条款写得含混不清。

e.en: Try to {unclench} your jaw when you feel stressed.
e.zh: 感到紧张时试着放松你紧咬的下巴。

e.en: She slowly {unclench}ed her fists and took a deep breath.
e.zh: 她慢慢松开攥紧的拳头,深吸了一口气。

e.en: All my {uncles} showed up for the family reunion.
e.zh: 家庭聚会上我所有的叔叔舅舅都到了。

e.en: Her {uncles} live in three different countries.
e.zh: 她的几位叔伯分别住在三个不同的国家。

unclipped.t: adj. 解开夹子的；未修剪的

e.en: He {unclipped} the dog's leash when they reached the park.
e.zh: 到公园后他把狗绳的扣子解开了。

e.en: She {unclipped} the microphone from her collar after the talk.
e.zh: 演讲结束后她把麦克风从领口取了下来。

e.en: Use baking soda and vinegar to {unclog} a slow drain.
e.zh: 用小苏打和醋可以疏通排水慢的下水道。

e.en: New traffic rules aim to {unclog} the city center.
e.zh: 新交规旨在缓解市中心的交通拥堵。

e.en: Once we {unclogged} the printer, it worked fine again.
e.zh: 我们把打印机的卡纸清掉以后,它又能正常用了。

e.en: The widened road has finally {unclogged} morning traffic.
e.zh: 拓宽后的道路终于缓解了早高峰的拥堵。

e.en: The toddler ran around the house completely {unclothed}.
e.zh: 那个小孩光着身子在屋里到处跑。

e.en: The painting depicts an {unclothed} figure by the river.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了河边一个赤身的人物。

e.en: We hiked under a beautifully {unclouded} sky.
e.zh: 我们在万里无云的晴空下徒步。

e.en: She offered an {unclouded} view of the situation.
e.zh: 她对局势给出了一个清晰客观的看法。

e.en: I love how {uncluttered} this app's home screen feels.
e.zh: 我很喜欢这款应用主屏幕那种简洁清爽的感觉。

e.en: Her desk is always neat and {uncluttered}.
e.zh: 她的桌面总是整整齐齐,毫不杂乱。

uncoated.t: adj. 未涂层的；无包衣的

e.en: The book is printed on {uncoated} paper for a softer look.
e.zh: 这本书用的是未涂布的纸张,质感更柔和。

e.en: {Uncoated} steel rusts quickly when exposed to rain.
e.zh: 未涂层的钢材一旦淋雨很快就会生锈。

e.en: Watch the snake slowly {uncoil} from the branch.
e.zh: 看那条蛇慢慢地从树枝上舒展开来。

e.en: He helped me {uncoil} the garden hose across the lawn.
e.zh: 他帮我把花园水管在草坪上铺开。

e.en: The cat stretched and {uncoiled} on the warm rug.
e.zh: 那只猫在暖暖的毯子上伸了个懒腰,舒展开身体。

e.en: She {uncoiled} the extension cord and plugged it in.
e.zh: 她把电源延长线展开,然后插上插头。

uncollected.t: adj. 未被领取的；未收集的

e.en: There's a pile of {uncollected} mail at the front door.
e.zh: 前门那儿堆着一摞没人取的邮件。

e.en: The city is owed millions in {uncollected} taxes.
e.zh: 这座城市还有数百万未收回的税款。

e.en: The bank wrote off the loan as {uncollectible}.
e.zh: 银行把那笔贷款作为坏账核销了。

e.en: Most of these old debts are now considered {uncollectible}.
e.zh: 这些旧债大多已被视为无法收回。

uncolored.t: adj. 未着色的；不带偏见的

e.en: She prefers {uncolored} lip balm for everyday use.
e.zh: 她日常更喜欢用无色的润唇膏。

e.en: His report gave an {uncolored} account of the events.
e.zh: 他的报告对事件给出了一个不带主观色彩的描述。

uncoloured.t: adj. 未着色的（uncolored 英式拼写）

e.en: The packaging uses {uncoloured} recycled cardboard.
e.zh: 这种包装用的是未染色的再生纸板。

e.en: She wanted an {uncoloured} version of the truth.
e.zh: 她想了解一个不加修饰的真相。

e.en: He answered the door with messy, {uncombed} hair.
e.zh: 他顶着一头乱糟糟没梳过的头发去开门。

e.en: The puppy's fur was tangled and {uncombed}.
e.zh: 小狗的毛打着结,从来没梳过。

uncontroversial.t: adj. 无争议的；没有异议的

e.en: Recycling is a fairly {uncontroversial} topic these days.
e.zh: 如今回收再利用是个相当没有争议的话题。

e.en: He started with an {uncontroversial} opening statement.
e.zh: 他以一段没有争议的开场白开始发言。

unconventional.t: adj. 非传统的；不落俗套的

e.en: Her {unconventional} approach to teaching surprised the parents.
e.zh: 她非常规的教学方式让家长们感到意外。

e.en: The startup uses an {unconventional} hiring process based on portfolios.
e.zh: 这家初创公司采用基于作品集的非常规招聘流程。

unconventionality.t: n. 非传统性；不拘一格

e.en: His {unconventionality} made him a favorite among art students.
e.zh: 他的不落俗套让他深受艺术系学生喜爱。

e.en: The brand thrives on the {unconventionality} of its designs.
e.zh: 该品牌靠其与众不同的设计风格蓬勃发展。

unconventionally.t: adv. 非常规地；不落俗套地

e.en: She dresses {unconventionally} for tech conferences.
e.zh: 她在科技大会上的穿着总是别具一格。

e.en: The film is {unconventionally} structured around a single phone call.
e.zh: 这部电影以一通电话为主线,结构非常另类。

unconverted.t: adj. 未转换的；未皈依的

e.en: The attic remains {unconverted} and full of old boxes.
e.zh: 阁楼仍未改造,堆满了旧箱子。

e.en: Many leads stay {unconverted} despite repeated follow-up emails.
e.zh: 尽管反复发跟进邮件,许多潜在客户仍未成交。

e.en: He remains {unconvicted} despite years of investigation.
e.zh: 尽管调查多年,他仍未被定罪。

e.en: Several suspects were released {unconvicted} due to weak evidence.
e.zh: 由于证据不足,几名嫌疑人未被定罪即获释。

unconvinced.t: adj. 未被说服的；仍存疑的

e.en: The investors remained {unconvinced} after the long pitch.
e.zh: 听完冗长的路演,投资人依然不为所动。

e.en: She looked {unconvinced} when he explained the delay.
e.zh: 他解释延误原因时,她看上去并不相信。

unconvincing.t: adj. 没有说服力的；难以令人信服的

e.en: His apology felt rehearsed and {unconvincing}.
e.zh: 他的道歉听起来像是排练过的,难以让人信服。

e.en: The data offered an {unconvincing} case for the new policy.
e.zh: 这些数据并不能有力支持这项新政策。

e.en: He smiled {unconvincingly} as the camera flashed.
e.zh: 相机闪光时,他勉强挤出一个不自然的笑容。

e.en: She {unconvincingly} claimed she had read the entire report.
e.zh: 她声称自己读完了整份报告,但听起来很假。

e.en: Don't eat {uncooked} chicken under any circumstances.
e.zh: 任何情况下都不要吃没煮熟的鸡肉。

e.en: The pasta was still {uncooked} in the middle.
e.zh: 这意大利面中间还是夹生的。

uncooperative.t: adj. 不合作的；不配合的

e.en: The witness was {uncooperative} during the interview.
e.zh: 那名证人在问话时不愿配合。

e.en: My printer has been {uncooperative} all morning.
e.zh: 我的打印机一上午都不听使唤。

uncoordinated.t: adj. 不协调的；动作笨拙的

e.en: The rescue effort looked chaotic and {uncoordinated}.
e.zh: 救援行动显得混乱而缺乏协调。

e.en: He's a great coder but pretty {uncoordinated} on the dance floor.
e.zh: 他是个出色的程序员,但跳起舞来手脚不太协调。

e.en: Let me {uncork} this wine before the guests arrive.
e.zh: 我先把这瓶酒打开,客人马上就到了。

e.en: The team finally got to {uncork} their championship celebration.
e.zh: 球队终于可以尽情庆祝夺冠了。

uncorked.t: adj. 已拔塞的；已开瓶的

e.en: She {uncorked} the champagne with a satisfying pop.
e.zh: 她啪的一声拔开了香槟瓶塞,声音很过瘾。

e.en: The pitcher {uncorked} a wild throw to first base.
e.zh: 投手向一垒投出了一记完全失控的暴投。

e.en: The draft went to print with several {uncorrected} typos.
e.zh: 草稿付印时还留着几处未改正的错字。

e.en: {Uncorrected} vision can lead to chronic headaches.
e.zh: 未矫正的视力问题可能导致慢性头痛。

uncorrelated.t: adj. 不相关的；无关联的

e.en: The two metrics turned out to be completely {uncorrelated}.
e.zh: 事实证明,这两个指标之间完全没有相关性。

e.en: Investors prefer {uncorrelated} assets to spread risk.
e.zh: 投资者偏好不相关的资产以分散风险。

e.en: The article relied on {uncorroborated} claims from anonymous sources.
e.zh: 这篇报道依据的是匿名来源未经证实的说法。

e.en: Police dismissed the tip as {uncorroborated} gossip.
e.zh: 警方认为这条线索只是未经证实的流言。

uncorrupted.t: adj. 未损坏的（文件）；未腐化的

e.en: Luckily the backup file was {uncorrupted}.
e.zh: 幸好备份文件没有损坏。

e.en: She admired his {uncorrupted} idealism after twenty years in politics.
e.zh: 她敬佩他从政二十年仍未变质的理想主义。

e.en: In English, 'water' is an {uncountable} noun.
e.zh: 在英语里,“water”是不可数名词。

e.en: There were {uncountable} stars over the desert that night.
e.zh: 那晚沙漠上空繁星无数,数也数不清。

uncounted.t: adj. 未被计入的；无数的

e.en: Thousands of mail-in ballots remained {uncounted} overnight.
e.zh: 成千上万张邮寄选票一夜之间仍未清点完。

e.en: {Uncounted} hours went into preparing the demo.
e.zh: 为了准备这次演示,投入了数不清的时间。

uncouple.t: v. 解开；分离（车厢、连接）

e.en: Workers moved in to {uncouple} the freight cars.
e.zh: 工人上前把货运车厢一节节解开。

e.en: The company plans to {uncouple} its hardware and software businesses.
e.zh: 公司计划将硬件和软件业务拆分开。

uncoupled.t: adj. 已分离的；已解耦的

e.en: The locomotive was quickly {uncoupled} from the broken car.
e.zh: 机车迅速与故障车厢脱钩。

e.en: Salaries here are {uncoupled} from performance reviews.
e.zh: 这里的薪资与绩效考评是脱钩的。

e.en: His {uncouth} behavior at dinner embarrassed everyone.
e.zh: 他在晚宴上的粗鲁举止让大家都很尴尬。

e.en: It's considered {uncouth} to talk loudly on the train.
e.zh: 在火车上大声说话被认为很没教养。

uncover.t:
v. 揭露；发现
v. 揭开…的盖子

e.en: Reporters worked for months to {uncover} the scandal.
e.zh: 记者们花了几个月才揭开这桩丑闻。

e.en: Please {uncover} the dish before microwaving it.
e.zh: 放进微波炉前请先把盖子拿开。

uncovered.t: adj. 无遮盖的；被揭露的

e.en: Auditors {uncovered} millions in unreported expenses.
e.zh: 审计员查出了数百万未申报的支出。

e.en: The leftovers sat {uncovered} in the fridge overnight.
e.zh: 剩菜在冰箱里没盖盖子放了一整晚。

uncovering.t: v. 揭露；发现（uncover 的动名词）

e.en: The documentary focuses on {uncovering} hidden labor abuses.
e.zh: 这部纪录片专注于揭露隐蔽的劳工剥削行为。

e.en: She loves {uncovering} new indie bands on streaming platforms.
e.zh: 她喜欢在流媒体平台上挖掘新的独立乐队。

uncovers.t: v. 揭露；发现（uncover 第三人称单数）

e.en: Each episode {uncovers} a new clue about the missing heir.
e.zh: 每一集都会揭开关于失踪继承人的新线索。

e.en: The audit usually {uncovers} a few minor billing errors.
e.zh: 审计通常会查出几处小的账单错误。

uncreated.t: adj. 未创建的；本来存在的

e.en: Many philosophers describe the universe as {uncreated} and eternal.
e.zh: 许多哲学家将宇宙描述为未被创造的、永恒的存在。

e.en: That folder remained {uncreated} until the script ran successfully.
e.zh: 那个文件夹直到脚本成功运行后才被创建。

e.en: His solution to the problem was safe but {uncreative}.
e.zh: 他对这个问题的解决方案稳妥，但缺乏创意。

e.en: I feel {uncreative} when I haven't slept enough.
e.zh: 睡眠不足时我就觉得自己一点创造力都没有。

uncredited.t: adj. 未署名的；未被记功的

e.en: She did most of the writing but went {uncredited} in the film.
e.zh: 剧本大部分是她写的，但电影里没有署她的名。

e.en: Many open source contributors do {uncredited} work every day.
e.zh: 许多开源贡献者每天都在做没有署名的工作。

uncritical.t: adj. 不加批判的；盲从的

e.en: Don't be {uncritical} of everything you read online.
e.zh: 别对网上看到的一切都不加思考地全盘接受。

e.en: His fans are completely {uncritical} of his new album.
e.zh: 他的粉丝对他的新专辑毫无批判地一味追捧。

uncritically.t: adv. 不加批判地；盲目地

e.en: Many users {uncritically} accept whatever the algorithm shows them.
e.zh: 许多用户不加分辨地接受算法推送的一切内容。

e.en: He repeated the rumor {uncritically} to his coworkers.
e.zh: 他不加思考地把那个传闻转述给了同事。

uncrossed.t: adj. 未交叉的；未划线的（支票）

e.en: She sat with her legs {uncrossed} during the long meeting.
e.zh: 漫长的会议中，她双腿没有交叉地坐着。

e.en: There were several {uncrossed} items on his to-do list.
e.zh: 他的待办清单上还有几项没划掉。

e.en: We chose an {uncrowded} beach for our weekend getaway.
e.zh: 我们选了一个不拥挤的海滩度过周末。

e.en: The café is pleasantly {uncrowded} on weekday mornings.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆工作日早上人不多，很舒服。

e.en: She is the {uncrowned} queen of indie podcasting.
e.zh: 她是独立播客界无冕的女王。

e.en: He remains the {uncrowned} champion of office trivia nights.
e.zh: 他一直是办公室知识问答之夜的无冕冠军。

e.en: The priest performed the {unction} on the dying man.
e.zh: 神父为那位临终之人进行了傅油礼。

e.en: He spoke with a smooth {unction} that made me suspicious.
e.zh: 他说话时那种圆滑的口气让我起了疑心。

e.en: The salesman had an {unctuous} smile that put me off.
e.zh: 那个推销员笑得过于谄媚，让我很反感。

e.en: His {unctuous} compliments were obviously insincere.
e.zh: 他那些油腻的恭维一听就不是真心的。

e.en: The host greeted the celebrity guest {unctuously} on stage.
e.zh: 主持人在台上对那位明星嘉宾极尽阿谀之能事。

e.en: He nodded {unctuously} at every word the boss said.
e.zh: 老板说的每句话他都谄媚地点头附和。

uncuffed.t: adj. 未戴手铐的；无袖口的

e.en: He left his shirt sleeves {uncuffed} for a casual look.
e.zh: 他没有扣袖口，营造出一种随意的造型。

e.en: The suspect was {uncuffed} after the charges were dropped.
e.zh: 指控撤销后，嫌疑人的手铐被解开了。

uncultivated.t: adj. 未开垦的；未受教化的

e.en: Most of the land behind the farm is still {uncultivated}.
e.zh: 农场后面的大部分土地仍然是荒地。

e.en: His taste in music is broad but {uncultivated}.
e.zh: 他对音乐的口味很广，但不太精致。

e.en: He felt {uncultured} when his friends discussed opera.
e.zh: 朋友们讨论歌剧时，他觉得自己很没文化。

e.en: Calling someone {uncultured} is generally considered rude.
e.zh: 说别人没文化通常被认为是很无礼的。

uncured.t: adj. 未治愈的；未腌制的

e.en: The recipe calls for {uncured} bacon without added nitrates.
e.zh: 这个食谱用的是未腌制、不含添加亚硝酸盐的培根。

e.en: Her chronic condition remains {uncured} despite years of treatment.
e.zh: 经过多年治疗，她的慢性病仍未治愈。

e.en: The cat slowly began to {uncurl} from its nap.
e.zh: 那只猫睡醒后慢慢地伸开蜷缩的身子。

e.en: She watched the fern leaves {uncurl} in the spring sun.
e.zh: 她看着蕨叶在春日阳光下慢慢舒展开来。

e.en: The {uncurtained} window let moonlight flood the bedroom.
e.zh: 那扇没拉窗帘的窗户让月光洒满了卧室。

e.en: She felt exposed sleeping next to an {uncurtained} window.
e.zh: 在没有窗帘的窗户旁睡觉让她觉得很没安全感。

uncut.t: adj. 未删减的；未切割的

e.en: The director released an {uncut} version with twenty extra minutes.
e.zh: 导演发布了多了二十分钟的未删减版本。

e.en: He gave her an {uncut} diamond as an engagement gift.
e.zh: 他送给她一颗未经切割的钻石作为订婚礼物。

undamaged.t: adj. 未损坏的；完好无损的

e.en: Luckily the laptop was {undamaged} after the fall.
e.zh: 幸好笔记本电脑摔下后毫发无损。

e.en: Please return any {undamaged} items in their original packaging.
e.zh: 请将任何完好无损的商品用原包装退回。

undammed.t: adj. 未筑坝的；水流自由的

e.en: Conservationists want the river left {undammed} to protect salmon.
e.zh: 环保人士希望保留这条河不被筑坝以保护鲑鱼。

e.en: The last {undammed} stretch flows freely through the valley.
e.zh: 最后一段未筑坝的河水自由地穿过山谷。

e.en: She found an {undated} love letter in the old book.
e.zh: 她在那本旧书里发现了一封没有日期的情书。

e.en: The contract is {undated}, which makes it harder to enforce.
e.zh: 这份合同没有日期，这使它更难被执行。

e.en: {Undaunted} by the rain, the runners finished the marathon.
e.zh: 跑者们没有被雨吓退，跑完了整场马拉松。

e.en: She remained {undaunted} despite three rejection letters.
e.zh: 尽管收到三封拒信，她依然没有气馁。

uncomfortable.t: adj. 不舒服的；不自在的

e.en: The chair was so {uncomfortable} that I couldn't sit through the meeting.
e.zh: 那把椅子坐着太难受，我没法熬过整场会议。

e.en: She felt {uncomfortable} discussing salary with her new boss.
e.zh: 和新上司谈薪水让她感到很不自在。

uncomfortably.t: adv. 不舒服地；令人不安地

e.en: The room was {uncomfortably} hot during the summer afternoon.
e.zh: 那个房间在夏日午后热得让人受不了。

e.en: He shifted {uncomfortably} when asked about his past job.
e.zh: 被问到以前的工作时，他不安地动了动身子。

uncommercial.t: adj. 非商业性的；不以盈利为目的的

e.en: The director's films are beautiful but completely {uncommercial}.
e.zh: 这位导演的电影很美，但完全没有商业价值。

e.en: Indie bands often pride themselves on their {uncommercial} sound.
e.zh: 独立乐队常以自己不商业化的音乐风格为豪。

uncommitted.t: adj. 未作承诺的；中立的

e.en: Many voters remain {uncommitted} ahead of the election.
e.zh: 许多选民在选举前仍未表态支持哪一方。

e.en: He's {uncommitted} to any single project right now.
e.zh: 他目前还没确定要专心做哪个项目。

e.en: It's not {uncommon} for flights to be delayed in winter.
e.zh: 冬天航班延误并不少见。

e.en: She has an {uncommon} talent for spotting fake reviews.
e.zh: 她有一种识别虚假评论的非凡才能。

e.en: The weather has been {uncommonly} warm for November.
e.zh: 今年十一月的天气暖得异乎寻常。

e.en: He is {uncommonly} patient with first-time users.
e.zh: 他对新用户有着不同寻常的耐心。

uncommunicative.t: adj. 沉默寡言的；不爱交流的

e.en: My teenager has been {uncommunicative} since school started again.
e.zh: 开学以后我家青少年就变得不爱说话了。

e.en: The witness was nervous and {uncommunicative} during questioning.
e.zh: 那位证人在问话时紧张得几乎不开口。

uncompensated.t: adj. 未获补偿的；无报酬的

e.en: Many caregivers do hours of {uncompensated} work each week.
e.zh: 很多照护者每周都做大量没有报酬的工作。

e.en: The overtime he put in remained completely {uncompensated}.
e.zh: 他加的那些班完全没有得到任何补偿。

e.en: Their pricing is {uncompetitive} compared to other cloud providers.
e.zh: 和其他云服务商相比，他们的定价缺乏竞争力。

e.en: The match was so {uncompetitive} that fans left early.
e.zh: 那场比赛一边倒，球迷们提前就走了。

e.en: The report blames the industry's {uncompetitiveness} on outdated technology.
e.zh: 报告将该行业缺乏竞争力归咎于技术老旧。

e.en: High labor costs are a major source of {uncompetitiveness}.
e.zh: 高昂的人力成本是缺乏竞争力的主要原因。

uncompleted.t: adj. 未完成的；未结束的

e.en: She left several {uncompleted} drafts in her documents folder.
e.zh: 她的文件夹里留着好几份没写完的草稿。

e.en: The {uncompleted} bridge has been an eyesore for years.
e.zh: 那座烂尾的桥多年来一直是个碍眼的存在。

e.en: I prefer recipes that are quick and {uncomplicated}.
e.zh: 我喜欢那种又快又简单的食谱。

e.en: The surgery is fairly {uncomplicated} and recovery is short.
e.zh: 这个手术相当简单，恢复期也很短。

e.en: He made some {uncomplimentary} remarks about the new design.
e.zh: 他对新设计说了几句不太好听的评价。

e.en: The review was honest but quite {uncomplimentary}.
e.zh: 那篇评论虽然诚实，但相当不留情面。

e.en: The toddler stared at the math homework with an {uncomprehending} look.
e.zh: 那个小孩一脸茫然地盯着数学作业。

e.en: She gave him an {uncomprehending} smile and walked away.
e.zh: 她报以一个不明所以的微笑后就走开了。

uncompressed.t: adj. 未压缩的（文件、数据）

e.en: The {uncompressed} video file took up over ten gigabytes.
e.zh: 那个未压缩的视频文件占了十多个 GB。

e.en: Audiophiles prefer {uncompressed} audio for the best sound quality.
e.zh: 发烧友为了最佳音质更喜欢未压缩的音频。

uncompromised.t: adj. 未妥协的；未受损害的

e.en: The product offers {uncompromised} security for sensitive business data.
e.zh: 该产品为敏感商业数据提供毫不妥协的安全保障。

e.en: Her artistic vision remained {uncompromised} despite commercial pressure.
e.zh: 尽管面临商业压力，她的艺术追求始终未被妥协。

e.en: The judge is known for her {uncompromising} stance on fraud.
e.zh: 那位法官以对欺诈毫不妥协的立场闻名。

e.en: He has an {uncompromising} commitment to clean code.
e.zh: 他对代码整洁有着毫不妥协的坚持。

uncompromisingly.t: adv. 毫不妥协地；坚定地

e.en: She speaks {uncompromisingly} about the need for reform.
e.zh: 她毫不妥协地谈论改革的必要性。

e.en: The film is {uncompromisingly} dark from start to finish.
e.zh: 这部电影从头到尾都是毫不留情的黑暗风格。

unconcealed.t: adj. 未加掩饰的；公开的

e.en: She watched the awards with {unconcealed} envy.
e.zh: 她带着毫不掩饰的羡慕看着颁奖。

e.en: His {unconcealed} delight at the news made everyone smile.
e.zh: 他对这个消息毫不掩饰的喜悦让大家都笑了。

e.en: He shrugged with apparent {unconcern} when told about the deadline.
e.zh: 被告知截止日期时，他耸耸肩，一副毫不在意的样子。

e.en: Her {unconcern} for office gossip made her popular.
e.zh: 她对办公室八卦的毫不在意让她很受欢迎。

unconcerned.t: adj. 漠不关心的；无忧虑的

e.en: The cat seemed completely {unconcerned} by the loud thunderstorm.
e.zh: 那只猫对外面的雷雨似乎完全不在意。

e.en: He's {unconcerned} about the latest social media trends.
e.zh: 他对最新的社交媒体潮流毫不关心。

unconcernedly.t: adv. 漠不关心地；若无其事地

e.en: She kept typing {unconcernedly} as the alarm blared outside.
e.zh: 外面警报声大作，她却若无其事地继续打字。

e.en: The dog walked {unconcernedly} past the barking puppies.
e.zh: 那只狗满不在乎地从那群狂吠的小狗旁走过。

e.en: A good parent offers {unconditional} love and support.
e.zh: 好的父母会给予无条件的爱和支持。

e.en: The store has an {unconditional} 30-day return policy.
e.zh: 这家店实行三十天无条件退货政策。

e.en: She supports her best friend {unconditionally} through everything.
e.zh: 无论遇到什么事，她都无条件地支持她最好的朋友。

e.en: The company refunds purchases {unconditionally} within two weeks.
e.zh: 公司对两周内的购买无条件退款。

unconditioned.t: adj. 非条件的；天生的（反射）

e.en: Hunger is an {unconditioned} response that all babies share.
e.zh: 饥饿是所有婴儿都有的非条件反射。

e.en: The cabin had an {unconditioned} attic that got very hot.
e.zh: 小屋的阁楼没有空调，热得不行。

unconfined.t: adj. 不受限制的；无拘束的

e.en: Their joy was {unconfined} when the team finally won.
e.zh: 球队终于赢球时，他们的喜悦无以言表。

e.en: Wild horses roam {unconfined} across the open plains.
e.zh: 野马在开阔的平原上自由自在地驰骋。

e.en: {Unconfirmed} reports suggest the CEO may resign next week.
e.zh: 未经证实的消息称首席执行官可能下周辞职。

e.en: The booking is still {unconfirmed} until you receive an email.
e.zh: 在收到邮件前，这个预订仍未确认。

uncongenial.t: adj. 不投缘的；不适宜的

e.en: He found the office atmosphere cold and {uncongenial}.
e.zh: 他觉得办公室气氛冷淡，让人不舒服。

e.en: Desk work proved {uncongenial} to her restless personality.
e.zh: 案头工作并不适合她那不安分的性格。

unconnected.t: adj. 未连接的；无关联的

e.en: The two crimes appear to be entirely {unconnected}.
e.zh: 这两起案件看起来完全没有关联。

e.en: My laptop is showing as {unconnected} to the network.
e.zh: 我的笔记本电脑显示未连接到网络。

unconquerable.t: adj. 不可战胜的；难以克服的

e.en: She showed an {unconquerable} spirit throughout her illness.
e.zh: 在整个患病期间，她展现出无法被击垮的精神。

e.en: For years the fortress was considered {unconquerable}.
e.zh: 多年来这座要塞被视为不可攻克的。

e.en: The remote peak remained {unconquered} until last summer.
e.zh: 那座偏远的山峰直到去年夏天才被攻克。

e.en: The ancient city stood {unconquered} for centuries.
e.zh: 这座古城几个世纪以来未被攻陷。

unconscionable.t: adj. 过分的；不合情理的

e.en: Charging that much for medicine is simply {unconscionable}.
e.zh: 药品卖这么贵简直丧尽天良。

e.en: It would be {unconscionable} to ignore their cries for help.
e.zh: 对他们的求救置之不理是不可饶恕的。

unconscionably.t: adv. 过分地；不合情理地

e.en: The wait time at the clinic was {unconscionably} long.
e.zh: 诊所的等待时间长得令人无法接受。

e.en: He behaved {unconscionably} toward his elderly parents.
e.zh: 他对年迈的父母表现得毫无良心可言。

unconscious.t:
adj. 失去知觉的；无意识的
n. 潜意识

e.en: She was knocked {unconscious} by the falling branch.
e.zh: 她被掉下来的树枝砸晕了过去。

e.en: Many of our biases are {unconscious} and hard to spot.
e.zh: 我们的许多偏见是无意识的，很难察觉。

unconsciously.t: adv. 无意识地；不自觉地

e.en: He {unconsciously} tapped his foot to the music.
e.zh: 他不自觉地随着音乐打起了节拍。

e.en: We {unconsciously} pick up habits from the people around us.
e.zh: 我们会不自觉地染上身边人的习惯。

e.en: The blow caused him to slip into {unconsciousness}.
e.zh: 那一击使他陷入了昏迷。

e.en: Doctors monitored her closely during her brief {unconsciousness}.
e.zh: 她短暂昏迷期间，医生对她进行了密切观察。

unconsidered.t: adj. 未经考虑的；轻率的

e.en: He spoke in haste, with words clearly {unconsidered}.
e.zh: 他匆忙开口，所说的话显然未经深思。

e.en: Several important factors went {unconsidered} in the report.
e.zh: 报告中有几个重要因素未被纳入考虑。

e.en: The cliff is made of loose, {unconsolidated} sand.
e.zh: 这座悬崖由松散、未固结的沙子构成。

e.en: Their debts remain {unconsolidated} across several lenders.
e.zh: 他们的债务分散在几家贷款机构，尚未整合。

e.en: The court ruled the new law {unconstitutional}.
e.zh: 法院裁定这项新法律违宪。

e.en: Critics argue the policy is plainly {unconstitutional}.
e.zh: 批评人士认为这项政策明显违宪。

e.en: The judge highlighted the {unconstitutionality} of the search.
e.zh: 法官指出了这次搜查的违宪性。

e.en: Lawyers debated the {unconstitutionality} of the curfew for hours.
e.zh: 律师们就宵禁的违宪性辩论了数小时。

e.en: The agency had {unconstitutionally} detained the protesters.
e.zh: 该机构以违宪方式拘留了抗议者。

e.en: Evidence gathered {unconstitutionally} cannot be used at trial.
e.zh: 以违宪手段取得的证据不能在庭审中使用。

unconstrained.t: adj. 不受约束的；自如的

e.en: Children played freely, {unconstrained} by adult rules.
e.zh: 孩子们尽情玩耍，不受大人规则的约束。

e.en: The model performs well in {unconstrained} environments.
e.zh: 该模型在不受限制的环境中表现良好。

unconsummated.t: adj. 未完成的（尤指婚姻未圆房）

e.en: Their brief, {unconsummated} romance ended after the summer.
e.zh: 他们短暂而未真正发展的恋情在夏末结束。

e.en: The merger remained {unconsummated} after months of talks.
e.zh: 经过数月谈判，这宗合并仍未达成。

uncontainable.t: adj. 难以抑制的；控制不住的

e.en: Her excitement on graduation day was {uncontainable}.
e.zh: 毕业那天她兴奋得无法抑制。

e.en: The wildfire became {uncontainable} within hours.
e.zh: 那场野火在几小时内就变得无法控制。

uncontaminated.t: adj. 未受污染的；纯净的

e.en: The lab needs samples of {uncontaminated} groundwater.
e.zh: 实验室需要未受污染的地下水样本。

e.en: It's hard to find {uncontaminated} soil near the factory.
e.zh: 在工厂附近很难找到未被污染的土壤。

uncontentious.t: adj. 无争议的；不引发争论的

e.en: They started with a few {uncontentious} agenda items.
e.zh: 他们先从几项没有争议的议程开始讨论。

e.en: The first proposal was deliberately kept {uncontentious}.
e.zh: 第一项提案被刻意设计得没有争议。

uncontested.t: adj. 无异议的；无对手的

e.en: She won the seat in an {uncontested} election.
e.zh: 她在一场无人竞争的选举中赢得了席位。

e.en: The divorce was quick because it was {uncontested}.
e.zh: 由于双方没有异议，离婚办得很快。

uncontrollable.t: adj. 无法控制的；难以抑制的

e.en: She burst into {uncontrollable} laughter at the joke.
e.zh: 听到那个笑话她忍不住放声大笑。

e.en: The fire grew {uncontrollable} after the wind shifted.
e.zh: 风向一变，火势便变得无法控制。

e.en: He was shaking {uncontrollably} from the cold.
e.zh: 他冻得浑身止不住地发抖。

e.en: She sobbed {uncontrollably} when she heard the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息，她忍不住放声痛哭。

uncontrolled.t: adj. 不受控制的；放任的

e.en: {Uncontrolled} diabetes can lead to serious complications.
e.zh: 未受控制的糖尿病可能导致严重并发症。

e.en: The forest suffered from years of {uncontrolled} logging.
e.zh: 这片森林多年来饱受无序砍伐之苦。

undead.t:
adj. 不死的，亡灵的
n. 不死生物

e.en: The game features zombies, vampires, and other {undead} creatures.
e.zh: 这款游戏里有僵尸、吸血鬼和其他不死生物。

e.en: He's writing a novel about an {undead} detective in Tokyo.
e.zh: 他在写一部关于东京一位不死侦探的小说。

undecidable.t: adj. 不可判定的，无法裁决的

e.en: The halting problem is famously {undecidable} in computer science.
e.zh: 停机问题在计算机科学中是出了名的不可判定。

e.en: Some questions remain {undecidable} no matter how clever the algorithm.
e.zh: 无论算法多巧妙，有些问题仍是不可判定的。

undecided.t: adj. 未决定的，犹豫不决的

e.en: Many voters are still {undecided} a week before the election.
e.zh: 距离选举还有一周，许多选民仍未决定。

e.en: I'm {undecided} between the chicken and the fish.
e.zh: 我还没决定要点鸡肉还是鱼。

undecipherable.t: adj. 无法破译的，难以辨认的

e.en: His handwriting is almost completely {undecipherable}.
e.zh: 他的字迹几乎完全无法辨认。

e.en: The ancient script remains {undecipherable} to modern scholars.
e.zh: 这种古代文字至今仍让现代学者无法破译。

undeclared.t: adj. 未申报的；未声明的

e.en: Customs officers found several {undeclared} items in his luggage.
e.zh: 海关人员在他行李中查到几件未申报的物品。

e.en: The variable is {undeclared}, which causes a runtime error.
e.zh: 该变量未声明，因此引发了运行时错误。

e.en: The walls were plain and completely {undecorated}.
e.zh: 墙壁朴素，完全没有任何装饰。

e.en: She prefers a simple, {undecorated} cake for her birthday.
e.zh: 她生日喜欢简单、不加装饰的蛋糕。

undefeated.t: adj. 未尝败绩的，全胜的

e.en: The team finished the season {undefeated}.
e.zh: 该队以全胜战绩结束了本赛季。

e.en: She remains {undefeated} after twenty professional fights.
e.zh: 她在二十场职业比赛后仍保持不败。

undefended.t: adj. 无防御的；无辩护的

e.en: The eastern border was left {undefended} during the night.
e.zh: 夜间东部边境处于无人防守状态。

e.en: His thesis went {undefended} because he missed the deadline.
e.zh: 由于错过截止日期，他的论文未能进行答辩。

undefiled.t: adj. 纯洁的，未被玷污的

e.en: The mountain spring water was pure and {undefiled}.
e.zh: 山泉水纯净无瑕，未受污染。

e.en: She wanted to keep her reputation {undefiled} by gossip.
e.zh: 她希望自己的名声不被流言玷污。

undefinable.t: adj. 无法定义的，难以描述的

e.en: There's an {undefinable} charm about that little café.
e.zh: 那家小咖啡馆有种说不清的魅力。

e.en: Love is often described as an {undefinable} feeling.
e.zh: 爱常被形容为一种难以定义的感觉。

undefined.t: adj. 未定义的（编程中表示无值）

e.en: The function returned {undefined} instead of a number.
e.zh: 该函数返回了 undefined，而不是一个数字。

e.en: Her role on the team is still {undefined}.
e.zh: 她在团队中的角色仍未明确。

undelivered.t: adj. 未投递的，未送达的

e.en: Several packages remained {undelivered} due to the storm.
e.zh: 由于暴风雨，有几个包裹仍未送达。

e.en: The email bounced back as {undelivered}.
e.zh: 那封邮件被退回，显示未能送达。

undemanding.t: adj. 要求不高的，轻松的

e.en: He prefers {undemanding} work that lets him relax.
e.zh: 他喜欢轻松不费心的工作，能让自己放松。

e.en: The film is light and {undemanding}, perfect for a flight.
e.zh: 这部电影轻松不烧脑，很适合在飞机上看。

e.en: Critics called the new voting law deeply {undemocratic}.
e.zh: 批评人士称这项新投票法极不民主。

e.en: Banning opposition parties is clearly {undemocratic}.
e.zh: 禁止反对党显然是不民主的做法。

undemonstrative.t: adj. 感情内敛的，不外露的

e.en: Her father was kind but {undemonstrative} with his feelings.
e.zh: 她父亲心地善良，却不善于流露感情。

e.en: He's {undemonstrative}, but you can tell he cares.
e.zh: 他不善表达，但看得出他很在乎。

undemonstratively.t: adv. 不流露感情地，含蓄地

e.en: He nodded {undemonstratively} when she shared the good news.
e.zh: 她分享好消息时，他只是不动声色地点了点头。

e.en: She accepted the award {undemonstratively} and walked off stage.
e.zh: 她平静无波地接过奖项，便走下了舞台。

undeniable.t: adj. 不可否认的，确凿的

e.en: Her talent for music is simply {undeniable}.
e.zh: 她的音乐天赋是无可否认的。

e.en: There's {undeniable} chemistry between the two leads.
e.zh: 两位主角之间有着无可否认的默契。

undeniably.t: adv. 无可否认地，确实地

e.en: The new phone is {undeniably} faster than last year's model.
e.zh: 这款新手机毫无疑问比去年的型号更快。

e.en: She is {undeniably} one of the best writers of her generation.
e.zh: 她无疑是她那代人中最出色的作家之一。

undependable.t: adj. 不可靠的，靠不住的

e.en: The old car has become too {undependable} for long trips.
e.zh: 那辆旧车已经太不靠谱，跑长途不行了。

e.en: He's friendly but {undependable} when deadlines matter.
e.zh: 他人很友好，但在赶截止日期时靠不住。

under.t:
prep. 在…之下
adv. 在下方

e.en: The cat is hiding {under} the sofa again.
e.zh: 那只猫又躲到沙发底下去了。

e.en: She finished the marathon in just {under} four hours.
e.zh: 她跑完马拉松用了不到四小时。

underachieve.t: v. 表现未达预期，成绩低于实力

e.en: Bright students sometimes {underachieve} when they feel bored.
e.zh: 聪明的学生在感到无聊时有时会发挥不出水平。

e.en: He tends to {underachieve} on tests despite knowing the material.
e.zh: 尽管掌握了内容，他在考试中往往发挥不佳。

underachievement.t: n. 成绩低于实力，表现不佳

e.en: Teachers worry about {underachievement} among gifted children.
e.zh: 老师们担心资优儿童存在成绩不达水平的问题。

e.en: Chronic {underachievement} often points to deeper motivation issues.
e.zh: 长期表现不佳往往反映出更深层的动力问题。

e.en: The coach worked closely with the {underachieving} players.
e.zh: 教练与那些发挥不佳的球员密切合作。

e.en: She tutors students who are {underachieving} in math.
e.zh: 她辅导那些数学成绩不理想的学生。

underactive.t: adj. 活动不足的，功能低下的

e.en: An {underactive} thyroid can cause fatigue and weight gain.
e.zh: 甲状腺功能低下会导致疲劳和体重增加。
