e.en: His immune system seems {underactive} this winter.
e.zh: 今年冬天他的免疫系统似乎不太活跃。

underage.t: adj. 未成年的，未达法定年龄的

e.en: The bar got fined for serving {underage} customers.
e.zh: 那家酒吧因向未成年顾客售酒而被罚款。

e.en: She was caught driving while still {underage}.
e.zh: 她被发现在未到法定年龄时就开车。

e.en: The club has strict rules against admitting {underaged} guests.
e.zh: 该俱乐部严格规定不接待未达年龄的客人。

e.en: Police questioned the {underaged} driver after the crash.
e.zh: 事故发生后，警方对那名未成年司机进行了问询。

underappreciated.t: adj. 未被充分赏识的，被低估的

e.en: Nurses are often {underappreciated} for the work they do.
e.zh: 护士所做的工作常常得不到应有的重视。

e.en: This album is an {underappreciated} gem from the 90s.
e.zh: 这张专辑是九十年代一颗被低估的遗珠。

underarm.t:
n. 腋窝
adj. 下手（投球）的

e.en: He applied {underarm} deodorant before heading to the gym.
e.zh: 他去健身房前涂了腋下止汗剂。

e.en: She tossed the ball with a quick {underarm} throw.
e.zh: 她用一个快速的下手投掷把球抛了出去。

underbelly.t: n. 弱点，阴暗面；腹部下侧

e.en: The documentary exposes the dark {underbelly} of fast fashion.
e.zh: 这部纪录片揭露了快时尚行业阴暗的一面。

e.en: The lizard's pale {underbelly} blended into the rocks.
e.zh: 蜥蜴苍白的腹部与岩石融为一体。

underbid.t: v. 出价低于（他人）；叫牌过低

e.en: A smaller firm managed to {underbid} the major contractor.
e.zh: 一家小公司成功以更低报价压过了大承包商。

e.en: Competitors will {underbid} you to win the contract.
e.zh: 竞争对手会以低于你的报价来抢下合同。

underbidder.t: n. 出价较低的竞标者

e.en: The {underbidder} congratulated the winner after the auction ended.
e.zh: 拍卖结束后,出价次高者向得标人表示祝贺。

e.en: The auction house notified the {underbidder} about a similar piece.
e.zh: 拍卖行通知出价次高者还有一件类似拍品。

e.en: Salt from winter roads corroded the car's {underbody}.
e.zh: 冬季道路上的盐腐蚀了汽车的底盘。

e.en: The mechanic sprayed protective coating on the truck's {underbody}.
e.zh: 修理工在卡车底盘上喷涂了保护涂层。

underboss.t: n. 副头目（黑帮二把手）

e.en: The {underboss} ran daily operations while the boss stayed hidden.
e.zh: 老大隐身幕后,日常事务由二把手打理。

e.en: In the show, the {underboss} betrays his loyal crew.
e.zh: 剧中,二号头目背叛了忠心的手下。

e.en: Hikers cleared the {underbrush} blocking the forest trail.
e.zh: 徒步者清除了挡住林间小径的灌木丛。

e.en: Deer often hide in the dense {underbrush} at dusk.
e.zh: 鹿在黄昏时常藏在茂密的灌木丛中。

e.en: The plane's {undercarriage} failed to deploy during landing.
e.zh: 飞机降落时起落架未能放下。

e.en: He inspected the bike's {undercarriage} after the rough ride.
e.zh: 颠簸骑行后,他检查了自行车的下部结构。

underclass.t: n. 社会底层，下层阶级

e.en: The book examines how cities create a permanent {underclass}.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了城市如何形成一个永久性的底层阶级。

e.en: Economic policies have widened the gap with the {underclass}.
e.zh: 经济政策加大了与底层阶级之间的差距。

e.en: As an {underclassman}, he wasn't allowed to park on campus.
e.zh: 作为低年级学生,他不能在校园内停车。

e.en: The mentorship pairs each {underclassman} with a senior student.
e.zh: 该导师计划为每位低年级生配对一名高年级生。

underclothe.t: v. 给…穿内衣；穿得过少

e.en: Parents shouldn't {underclothe} children in such freezing weather.
e.zh: 在这么严寒的天气里,家长不该给孩子穿得太少。

e.en: It's risky to {underclothe} hikers heading into mountain conditions.
e.zh: 让徒步者衣着单薄地进山是有风险的。

e.en: She packed extra {underclothes} for the long camping trip.
e.zh: 她为长途露营多带了几套贴身内衣。

e.en: Wool {underclothes} keep skiers warm on freezing slopes.
e.zh: 羊毛贴身衣物让滑雪者在严寒雪坡上保持温暖。

e.en: Soldiers wear thermal {underclothing} beneath their winter uniforms.
e.zh: 士兵在冬装下穿着保暖内衣。

e.en: The store sells silk {underclothing} at surprisingly affordable prices.
e.zh: 这家店以出人意料的实惠价格出售真丝内衣。

e.en: Apply a white {undercoat} before painting the walls yellow.
e.zh: 刷黄色墙面之前先涂一层白色底漆。

e.en: The dog's thick {undercoat} sheds heavily every spring.
e.zh: 那只狗厚厚的底层绒毛每年春天都会大量脱落。

e.en: Eating {undercooked} chicken can cause serious food poisoning.
e.zh: 吃没煮熟的鸡肉可能引起严重食物中毒。

e.en: The pasta was slightly {undercooked} but still tasty.
e.zh: 意面稍微有点没煮透,但味道依然不错。

e.en: The census may {undercount} people experiencing homelessness.
e.zh: 人口普查可能漏算无家可归的人群。

e.en: Officials admitted the {undercount} skewed funding allocations.
e.zh: 官员承认漏统数据扭曲了拨款分配。

undercover.t:
adj. 秘密的，卧底的
adv. 秘密地

e.en: An {undercover} officer infiltrated the smuggling ring last year.
e.zh: 一名卧底警官去年潜入了那个走私团伙。

e.en: She spent six months working {undercover} as a journalist.
e.zh: 她以记者身份卧底工作了六个月。

e.en: There's an {undercurrent} of frustration among the engineering team.
e.zh: 工程团队中暗藏着一股不满情绪。

e.en: Strong {undercurrent} swept several swimmers far from shore.
e.zh: 强劲的暗流把几名泳客冲得远离海岸。

e.en: Cheap imports {undercut} local manufacturers across the region.
e.zh: 廉价进口商品使整个地区的本地厂商难以竞争。

e.en: His sarcastic tone {undercut} the sincerity of the apology.
e.zh: 他讽刺的语气削弱了道歉的诚意。

underdeveloped.t: adj. 发展不足的，欠发达的

e.en: The app's analytics dashboard feels {underdeveloped} compared to competitors.
e.zh: 这款应用的数据看板与竞品相比显得不够完善。

e.en: Investment is flowing into previously {underdeveloped} regions of the country.
e.zh: 投资正流向该国此前欠发达的地区。

e.en: Decades of conflict caused chronic {underdevelopment} in the region.
e.zh: 数十年的冲突导致该地区长期欠发达。

e.en: Critics blame the policy for the city's {underdevelopment}.
e.zh: 批评者把这座城市发展滞后归咎于该项政策。

underdog.t: n. 处于劣势者，比赛中不被看好的一方

e.en: Fans love rooting for the {underdog} in big tournaments.
e.zh: 球迷喜欢在大赛中为弱队加油。

e.en: The {underdog} startup beat the industry giant to market.
e.zh: 那家不被看好的初创公司比行业巨头先一步抢占市场。

underdrawing.t: n. 底稿，绘画底层草图

e.en: X-rays revealed the artist's original {underdrawing} beneath the paint.
e.zh: X 光揭示出颜料下方艺术家最初的底稿。

e.en: He sketched a quick {underdrawing} before applying any color.
e.zh: 上色前他先快速画了一张底稿。

underdressed.t: adj. 穿得过少的；穿得不够正式的

e.en: I felt totally {underdressed} at the formal dinner party.
e.zh: 在那场正式的晚宴上,我觉得自己穿得太随便了。

e.en: Don't show up {underdressed} for a job interview.
e.zh: 参加面试时别穿得太过随便。

undereducated.t: adj. 受教育程度不足的

e.en: Many rural kids remain {undereducated} due to teacher shortages.
e.zh: 由于师资短缺，许多农村孩子仍然教育不足。

e.en: The report warned about an {undereducated} workforce facing automation.
e.zh: 报告警告说受教育不足的劳动力将面临自动化冲击。

underemployed.t: adj. 未充分就业的；大材小用的

e.en: Many graduates feel {underemployed} working part-time café jobs.
e.zh: 许多毕业生在咖啡馆做兼职，觉得大材小用。

e.en: She is highly skilled but currently {underemployed} as a cashier.
e.zh: 她技能很强，但目前只能当收银员，屈才了。

e.en: {Underemployment} among young professionals has become a serious concern.
e.zh: 年轻专业人士的就业不足问题已变得相当严重。

e.en: The city's economy hides widespread {underemployment} behind low jobless rates.
e.zh: 低失业率下，这座城市暗藏着普遍的就业不足。

underestimate.t:
v. 低估
n. 低估的数值

e.en: Don't {underestimate} how long this project will actually take.
e.zh: 不要低估这个项目实际需要多长时间。

e.en: People often {underestimate} the power of consistent daily habits.
e.zh: 人们常常低估每日坚持习惯的力量。

underestimated.t: v. 低估（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: I clearly {underestimated} the traffic and arrived an hour late.
e.zh: 我显然低估了交通状况，迟到了一个小时。

e.en: The team {underestimated} their opponent and lost in overtime.
e.zh: 球队低估了对手，结果在加时赛中落败。

underestimates.t:
v. 低估（第三人称单数）
n. 低估（复数）

e.en: He always {underestimates} how much sleep he actually needs.
e.zh: 他总是低估自己实际需要多少睡眠。

e.en: The forecast {underestimates} the impact of the upcoming storm.
e.zh: 该预报低估了即将到来的风暴的影响。

e.en: You're {underestimating} how competitive the job market has become.
e.zh: 你低估了如今就业市场的竞争激烈程度。

e.en: Stop {underestimating} yourself—you handled that presentation brilliantly.
e.zh: 别再小看自己了，那次演讲你表现得非常出色。

e.en: Their {underestimation} of the budget caused the project to stall.
e.zh: 他们对预算的低估导致项目陷入停滞。

e.en: Such {underestimation} of risk is common among first-time investors.
e.zh: 对风险的这种低估在新手投资者中很常见。

e.en: The photo looks {underexposed}—try increasing the brightness slightly.
e.zh: 照片看起来曝光不足，试着稍微调亮一点。

e.en: Many children remain {underexposed} to classical music these days.
e.zh: 如今很多孩子接触古典音乐的机会还是太少。

underfed.t: adj. 喂养不足的；食物不足的

e.en: The rescued puppies looked thin and clearly {underfed}.
e.zh: 被救的小狗们看起来很瘦，明显营养不良。

e.en: Millions of children remain {underfed} in conflict-affected regions.
e.zh: 在冲突地区，仍有数百万儿童食不果腹。

underfinanced.t: adj. 资金不足的；融资不够的

e.en: The startup failed because it was {underfinanced} from the start.
e.zh: 那家初创公司因从一开始资金不足而失败。

e.en: Public schools in the district remain seriously {underfinanced}.
e.zh: 该学区的公立学校资金仍然严重不足。

e.en: Their new apartment has {underfloor} heating throughout the bathroom.
e.zh: 他们的新公寓浴室全部装了地暖。

e.en: Electricians ran cables through the {underfloor} cavity to the kitchen.
e.zh: 电工将电缆穿过地板下的空间通到厨房。

e.en: Wet leaves crunched {underfoot} as we walked through the park.
e.zh: 我们穿过公园时，湿叶子在脚下沙沙作响。

e.en: The puppy is constantly {underfoot} whenever I'm cooking.
e.zh: 我做饭的时候，小狗总是在脚边碍事。

underfunded.t: adj. 经费不足的；资金不够的

e.en: Public libraries remain chronically {underfunded} in many small towns.
e.zh: 在许多小镇，公共图书馆长期资金不足。

e.en: The research lab is {underfunded} and losing top scientists.
e.zh: 该研究实验室资金匮乏，正在流失顶尖科学家。

e.en: Years of {underfunding} have left the hospital short of nurses.
e.zh: 多年的资金不足导致医院护士短缺。

e.en: Critics blame chronic {underfunding} for the school's poor performance.
e.zh: 批评人士将该校表现不佳归咎于长期的资金不足。

e.en: She packed an extra {undergarment} just in case of spills.
e.zh: 她多带了一件内衣，以防弄湿。

e.en: This thermal {undergarment} keeps you warm during winter hikes.
e.zh: 这件保暖内衣能让你在冬季徒步时保持温暖。

e.en: Strong values {undergird} every decision the company makes.
e.zh: 坚定的价值观支撑着公司所做的每一个决定。

e.en: Trust and honesty {undergird} any healthy long-term relationship.
e.zh: 信任和诚实是任何健康长期关系的根基。

underglaze.t:
adj. 釉下的（彩绘）
n. 釉下彩

e.en: The artist applied a blue {underglaze} before firing the bowl.
e.zh: 艺术家在烧制碗之前涂了一层蓝色釉下彩。

e.en: Traditional Chinese porcelain often features delicate {underglaze} painting.
e.zh: 传统中国瓷器常常带有精致的釉下彩绘。

undergo.t: v. 经历；经受（变化、手术等）

e.en: Patients must {undergo} several tests before the surgery is approved.
e.zh: 病人必须在手术获批前接受多项检查。

e.en: The app will {undergo} a major redesign next month.
e.zh: 这款应用下个月将进行一次重大改版。

undergoes.t: v. 经历（第三人称单数）

e.en: Every car {undergoes} strict inspection before leaving the factory.
e.zh: 每辆车出厂前都要经过严格检查。

e.en: Water {undergoes} a phase change when it freezes into ice.
e.zh: 水结冰时会经历一次相态变化。

undergoing.t: v. 正在经历（现在分词）

e.en: The website is currently {undergoing} maintenance and will return shortly.
e.zh: 网站目前正在维护中，很快就会恢复。

e.en: She is {undergoing} treatment and feeling stronger every week.
e.zh: 她正在接受治疗，每周都感觉好一些。

e.en: The neighborhood has {undergone} massive changes in the last decade.
e.zh: 过去十年里这个街区发生了巨大变化。

e.en: He has {undergone} two surgeries but is recovering well.
e.zh: 他做过两次手术，但恢复得很好。

undergrad.t: n. 本科生（undergraduate 的缩写）

e.en: She's a second-year {undergrad} majoring in computer science.
e.zh: 她是计算机科学专业大二的本科生。

e.en: My {undergrad} years flew by faster than I expected.
e.zh: 我的本科岁月过得比想象中要快得多。

undergraduate.t:
n. 本科生
adj. 本科的

e.en: He completed his {undergraduate} degree at a small liberal arts college.
e.zh: 他在一所小型文理学院完成了本科学位。

e.en: The lab hires {undergraduate} students each summer for research projects.
e.zh: 该实验室每年夏天都会招聘本科生参与研究项目。

e.en: Most {undergraduates} live on campus during their first year.
e.zh: 大多数本科生第一年都住在校园里。

e.en: The professor mentors several {undergraduates} working on climate research.
e.zh: 那位教授指导几名做气候研究的本科生。

underground.t:
adj./adv. 地下的；秘密的
n. 地铁（英式）

e.en: London's {underground} system is one of the oldest in the world.
e.zh: 伦敦地铁系统是世界上最古老的地铁之一。

e.en: The band built a loyal {underground} following before going mainstream.
e.zh: 这支乐队走红前在地下圈子积累了一批忠实粉丝。

undergrowth.t: n. 林下灌丛；下层植被

e.en: A rabbit darted out from the dense {undergrowth}.
e.zh: 一只兔子从茂密的灌木丛里窜了出来。

e.en: Hikers struggled through thick {undergrowth} along the trail.
e.zh: 徒步者在小径旁浓密的矮树丛中艰难前行。

underhand.t:
adj. 暗中的；不光彩的
adv. 下手地（投球）

e.en: She tossed the ball {underhand} to the toddler.
e.zh: 她用下手投球的方式把球抛给小宝宝。

e.en: The deal was made through {underhand} backroom negotiations.
e.zh: 这笔交易是通过暗中的幕后谈判达成的。

e.en: Spreading those rumors was a really {underhanded} move.
e.zh: 散布那些谣言实在是非常卑鄙的手段。

e.en: They accused the rival firm of {underhanded} business tactics.
e.zh: 他们指责竞争对手使用不光彩的商业手段。

e.en: The hobbit family {Underhill} lived in a cozy burrow.
e.zh: 姓Underhill的霍比特一家住在一个舒适的地洞里。

e.en: Professor {Underhill} will give the keynote tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 安德希尔教授明天上午将做主题演讲。

e.en: The valley is {underlain} by ancient limestone bedrock.
e.zh: 这片山谷下面是古老的石灰岩基岩。

e.en: His humor was always {underlain} by genuine kindness.
e.zh: 他的幽默背后始终透着真诚的善意。

underlay.t:
n. 衬垫；地毯垫
v. 铺垫

e.en: Install a foam {underlay} before laying the laminate floor.
e.zh: 在铺强化地板之前先垫一层泡沫衬垫。

e.en: Deep anxiety {underlay} her cheerful smile.
e.zh: 她开朗的笑容背后藏着深深的焦虑。

e.en: Wear a thermal {underlayer} when skiing in cold weather.
e.zh: 天冷滑雪时要穿一件保暖内层衣。

e.en: The painter added a gray {underlayer} before the final coat.
e.zh: 画家在最后一层之前先涂了一层灰色底色。

underlayment.t: n. 垫层（地板下铺设材料）

e.en: Roofers rolled out the synthetic {underlayment} before the shingles.
e.zh: 铺瓦之前,屋面工先铺好合成防水垫层。

e.en: Good {underlayment} reduces noise between apartment floors.
e.zh: 优质的衬垫层能减少公寓楼层之间的噪音。

underlie.t: v. 构成…的基础；位于…之下

e.en: Strong principles {underlie} every decision the team makes.
e.zh: 团队的每个决策背后都有坚实的原则。

e.en: Several economic factors {underlie} the recent price hikes.
e.zh: 近期涨价背后有几个经济因素在起作用。

underline.t:
v. 加下划线；强调
n. 下划线

e.en: Please {underline} the key terms in the contract.
e.zh: 请把合同里的关键条款划上线标出来。

e.en: These results {underline} the need for stricter safety rules.
e.zh: 这些结果凸显了制定更严格安全规定的必要性。

underlined.t: v. 加下划线（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: He {underlined} every quote he wanted to remember.
e.zh: 他把每一句想记住的引文都画上了线。

e.en: The CEO's resignation {underlined} the depth of the crisis.
e.zh: CEO的辞职凸显出危机的严重程度。

underlines.t: v. 加下划线；强调（第三人称单数）

e.en: This study {underlines} how vital sleep is for memory.
e.zh: 这项研究强调了睡眠对记忆有多重要。

e.en: Markdown turns text between underscores into {underlines}.
e.zh: Markdown会把下划线之间的文字渲染成下划线样式。

e.en: The boss sent an {underling} to deliver the bad news.
e.zh: 老板派了个下属去通知这个坏消息。

e.en: He resented being treated like an {underling} after twenty years.
e.zh: 干了二十年还被当下手使唤,他心里很不是滋味。

underlining.t:
v. 加下划线（现在分词）
n. 下划线

e.en: She kept {underlining} sentences as she read the textbook.
e.zh: 读教材时,她不停地在句子下面划线。

e.en: The speech kept {underlining} the importance of community.
e.zh: 这场演讲反复强调社区的重要性。

underlying.t: adj. 底层的；潜在的；根本的

e.en: We need to address the {underlying} cause, not just symptoms.
e.zh: 我们需要解决根本原因,而不只是表面症状。

e.en: The {underlying} code is open source and well documented.
e.zh: 底层代码是开源的,而且文档齐全。

e.en: The kitchen was badly {undermanned} during the dinner rush.
e.zh: 晚餐高峰期厨房严重人手不足。

e.en: An {undermanned} crew struggled to keep the ship running.
e.zh: 人手不足的船员勉强维持着船的运转。

e.en: Constant criticism can {undermine} a child's confidence.
e.zh: 不断的批评会损害孩子的自信心。

e.en: Leaks like this {undermine} trust in the entire team.
e.zh: 这样的泄密会动摇整个团队之间的信任。

undermined.t: v. 削弱（过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The scandal {undermined} the senator's reelection campaign.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻严重削弱了这位参议员的连任竞选。

e.en: Heavy rain had {undermined} the foundations of the bridge.
e.zh: 大雨已经掏空了桥梁的地基。

undermines.t: v. 削弱（第三人称单数）

e.en: Skipping standups {undermines} our daily coordination.
e.zh: 不参加每日站会会破坏我们日常的协作。

e.en: That argument {undermines} her own earlier position.
e.zh: 这个论点恰恰削弱了她之前自己的立场。

e.en: Stop {undermining} my decisions in front of the kids.
e.zh: 别再当着孩子的面拆我的台了。

e.en: Erosion is slowly {undermining} the cliffside houses.
e.zh: 侵蚀正在慢慢掏空悬崖边上的房屋地基。

underneath.t:
prep./adv. 在…下面
n. 底部

e.en: The cat is hiding {underneath} the couch again.
e.zh: 猫又躲到沙发下面去了。

e.en: {Underneath} her tough exterior, she's surprisingly shy.
e.zh: 在她坚强的外表下,其实非常害羞。

e.en: Many children in the region remain severely {undernourished}.
e.zh: 该地区许多儿童仍然严重营养不良。

e.en: The rescued puppy was small and clearly {undernourished}.
e.zh: 被救下的小狗体型瘦小,显然营养不良。

underpaid.t:
adj. 报酬过低的
v. underpay 的过去式

e.en: Teachers are notoriously overworked and {underpaid}.
e.zh: 教师工作量大、收入低是出了名的。

e.en: She felt {underpaid} compared to colleagues at other firms.
e.zh: 和其他公司的同行相比,她觉得自己工资偏低。

e.en: The artist starts every portrait with a thin {underpainting}.
e.zh: 这位艺术家画每幅肖像都从一层薄薄的底色开始。

e.en: X-rays revealed an unfinished {underpainting} beneath the masterpiece.
e.zh: X光显示这幅名作底下还有一层未完成的底层画。

e.en: He packed three pairs of clean {underpants} for the trip.
e.zh: 他为这次旅行准备了三条干净的内裤。

e.en: The toddler ran around the house in just his {underpants}.
e.zh: 那个小孩只穿着内裤在屋里跑来跑去。

e.en: The bird's {underpart} is a soft creamy white.
e.zh: 这只鸟的下腹部呈柔和的乳白色。

e.en: Mechanics inspected the {underpart} of the truck for rust.
e.zh: 机修工检查了卡车底部是否生锈。

underpass.t: n. 地下通道；下穿隧道

e.en: Cyclists use the {underpass} to avoid the busy intersection.
e.zh: 骑行者走地下通道以避开繁忙的十字路口。

e.en: The {underpass} flooded after the heavy rainstorm.
e.zh: 暴雨过后,那条地下通道被水淹了。

underpay.t: v. 少付工资；低薪雇用

e.en: Many companies still {underpay} their warehouse workers.
e.zh: 许多公司至今仍在低薪雇佣仓库工人。

e.en: It's illegal to {underpay} employees below the minimum wage.
e.zh: 以低于最低工资的标准付薪是违法的。

underpayment.t: n. 付款不足；工资过低

e.en: She filed a complaint about systematic {underpayment} of overtime hours.
e.zh: 她投诉公司系统性地少付加班费。

e.en: The audit revealed years of tax {underpayment} by the firm.
e.zh: 审计发现该公司多年来少缴税款。

underperformance.t: n. 表现不佳；业绩欠佳

e.en: The fund's {underperformance} disappointed long-term investors.
e.zh: 该基金表现不佳让长期投资者很失望。

e.en: His {underperformance} this quarter prompted a serious review.
e.zh: 他这个季度业绩不佳,引发了一次严肃的检讨。

underperforming.t: adj. 表现欠佳的；业绩落后的

e.en: They sold off the {underperforming} stocks last week.
e.zh: 他们上周抛售了表现欠佳的股票。

e.en: Managers met to discuss the {underperforming} sales team.
e.zh: 经理们开会讨论这支业绩低迷的销售团队。

underpin.t: v. 支撑；巩固（理论、体系）

e.en: Strong evidence must {underpin} every scientific claim.
e.zh: 每一项科学主张都必须有坚实证据作支撑。

e.en: Trust and honesty {underpin} any healthy relationship.
e.zh: 信任与诚实是任何健康关系的根基。

e.en: The theoretical {underpinning} of the model is well established.
e.zh: 该模型的理论基础已得到充分确立。

e.en: Workers reinforced the {underpinning} of the old building.
e.zh: 工人们加固了那栋老建筑的地基。

e.en: Don't {underplay} how serious this security flaw really is.
e.zh: 别淡化这个安全漏洞的严重性。

e.en: The actor chose to {underplay} the emotional scene.
e.zh: 那位演员选择以克制的方式演绎这场情感戏。

e.en: Many rural towns are becoming dangerously {underpopulated}.
e.zh: 许多乡村小镇正变得人口稀少,令人担忧。

e.en: The new server felt {underpopulated} during off-peak hours.
e.zh: 新服务器在非高峰时段显得人气冷清。

underpowered.t: adj. 动力不足的；性能偏弱的

e.en: This laptop feels {underpowered} for video editing tasks.
e.zh: 这台笔记本电脑做视频剪辑性能明显不足。

e.en: The clinical trial was {underpowered} to detect small effects.
e.zh: 该临床试验样本不足,难以检测出微小效应。

e.en: New sellers often {underprice} their handmade goods online.
e.zh: 新卖家在网上常常把手工商品定价过低。

e.en: Don't {underprice} your work just to attract first customers.
e.zh: 别为了吸引首批客户就把作品定得太便宜。

e.en: Analysts say the stock is significantly {underpriced} right now.
e.zh: 分析师称这只股票目前明显被低估。

e.en: The vintage camera was wildly {underpriced} at the flea market.
e.zh: 那台老式相机在跳蚤市场上价格低得离谱。

underprivileged.t: adj. 贫困的；社会地位低的

e.en: The charity provides scholarships for {underprivileged} students.
e.zh: 该慈善机构为弱势群体学生提供奖学金。

e.en: She volunteers tutoring kids from {underprivileged} neighborhoods.
e.zh: 她义务辅导来自贫困社区的孩子。

e.en: Never {underrate} the importance of a good night's sleep.
e.zh: 千万别低估一夜好眠的重要性。

e.en: Critics tend to {underrate} debut novels by unknown authors.
e.zh: 评论家往往低估默默无闻作者的处女作。

e.en: This indie game is seriously {underrated} on Steam.
e.zh: 这款独立游戏在Steam上被严重低估了。

e.en: Patience is an {underrated} skill in software engineering.
e.zh: 耐心是软件工程中一项被低估的能力。

e.en: Some businesses {underreport} income to reduce their tax bill.
e.zh: 一些企业少报收入以减少税款。

e.en: News outlets often {underreport} stories from rural areas.
e.zh: 新闻媒体常常对乡村地区的报道不足。

e.en: {Underreporting} of side effects skews the safety data.
e.zh: 副作用的少报会扭曲安全性数据。

e.en: Researchers worry about widespread {underreporting} of workplace injuries.
e.zh: 研究人员担心工伤事故被普遍少报。

e.en: The report highlighted women's {underrepresentation} in tech leadership.
e.zh: 报告凸显了女性在科技领导层中的代表性不足。

e.en: Minority {underrepresentation} in clinical trials remains a serious issue.
e.zh: 少数族裔在临床试验中的代表性不足仍是严重问题。

e.en: The program supports {underrepresented} groups in computer science.
e.zh: 该项目支持计算机科学领域中代表性不足的群体。

e.en: Rural voters feel {underrepresented} in national politics.
e.zh: 农村选民觉得他们在全国政治中代表性不足。

underscore.t:
n. 下划线（_）
v. 强调

e.en: Recent events {underscore} the need for stronger regulations.
e.zh: 近期事件凸显了加强监管的必要性。

e.en: Variable names in Python often use an {underscore} character.
e.zh: Python 中的变量名常使用下划线字符。

e.en: Engineers are repairing the {undersea} fiber optic cable.
e.zh: 工程师正在维修那条海底光缆。

e.en: Documentaries about {undersea} life always fascinate my kids.
e.zh: 关于海底生物的纪录片总能吸引我的孩子。

e.en: The {undersecretary} of defense addressed the press this morning.
e.zh: 国防部副部长今早召开了新闻发布会。

e.en: She was promoted to {undersecretary} for economic affairs.
e.zh: 她被晋升为主管经济事务的副部长。

e.en: Big retailers can easily {undersell} small neighborhood shops.
e.zh: 大型零售商很容易以低价压过街边小店。

e.en: Don't {undersell} your skills during the salary negotiation.
e.zh: 在谈薪时别贬低自己的能力。

underserved.t: adj. 服务不足的；被忽视的

e.en: The clinic brings healthcare to {underserved} rural communities.
e.zh: 这家诊所为服务不足的农村社区提供医疗服务。

e.en: Public transit options remain {underserved} in this district.
e.zh: 这个地区的公共交通服务依然不足。

e.en: He wore a thin {undershirt} beneath his white dress shirt.
e.zh: 他在白衬衫里面穿了一件薄薄的汗衫。

e.en: Pack a clean {undershirt} for tomorrow's long flight.
e.zh: 为明天的长途飞行准备一件干净的汗衫。

e.en: Check the {underside} of the leaves for tiny pest eggs.
e.zh: 检查叶子背面是否有细小的虫卵。

e.en: The {underside} of the laptop gets quite warm during gaming.
e.zh: 笔记本玩游戏时底部会变得很烫。

undersigned.t:
n. 下列签署人
adj. 在下方签名的

e.en: The {undersigned} hereby agree to all terms in this contract.
e.zh: 以下签署人特此同意本合同的全部条款。

e.en: We, the {undersigned}, support the proposed community recycling program.
e.zh: 我们这些签名者，支持拟议中的社区回收计划。

e.en: Anglers must release any {undersize} fish back into the lake.
e.zh: 垂钓者必须把尺寸不够的鱼放回湖中。

e.en: The shipment was rejected due to {undersize} components on the board.
e.zh: 由于电路板上的元件尺寸偏小，这批货被退回了。

undersized.t: adj. 偏小的；不足尺寸的

e.en: The puppy was {undersized} compared to others in the litter.
e.zh: 这只小狗比同窝其他狗仔个头要小。

e.en: Players complained the gym felt cramped and {undersized} for tournaments.
e.zh: 球员们抱怨体育馆显得拥挤，不够大办比赛。

e.en: She wore a lace {underskirt} beneath her wedding gown.
e.zh: 她在婚纱里面穿了一条蕾丝衬裙。

e.en: The vintage dress comes with a stiff cotton {underskirt}.
e.zh: 这件复古连衣裙搭配一条挺括的棉质衬裙。

underspend.t: v. 少花（预算）；花费不足

e.en: Departments that {underspend} their budget often face cuts next year.
e.zh: 预算花不完的部门，往往会在第二年被削减。

e.en: Try not to {underspend} on safety equipment for the team.
e.zh: 不要在团队的安全装备上花得太少。

e.en: The hospital is dangerously {understaffed} on weekend night shifts.
e.zh: 医院周末夜班的人手严重不足，状况堪忧。

e.en: Customer service is {understaffed}, so wait times are longer.
e.zh: 客服人手不足，所以等待时间会更长。

e.en: I {understand} why you're frustrated, but please hear me out.
e.zh: 我理解你为什么沮丧，但请先听我说完。

e.en: It took years to fully {understand} how the algorithm worked.
e.zh: 花了好几年才真正搞懂这个算法是如何运作的。

understandable.t: adj. 可以理解的；情有可原的

e.en: Her reaction was completely {understandable} given the circumstances.
e.zh: 考虑到当时的情况，她的反应完全可以理解。

e.en: The instructions need to be clear and {understandable} for beginners.
e.zh: 说明对初学者来说必须清晰易懂。

understandably.t: adv. 可以理解地；情有可原地

e.en: She was {understandably} upset after losing her wallet downtown.
e.zh: 她在市中心丢了钱包，难过也是情有可原的。

e.en: Customers are {understandably} frustrated by the repeated app crashes.
e.zh: 用户对应用反复崩溃感到沮丧，这完全可以理解。

understanding.t:
n. 理解；共识
adj. 善解人意的

e.en: My boss is really {understanding} when I need a sick day.
e.zh: 我请病假时，老板真的很通情达理。

e.en: A deeper {understanding} of statistics will help your data analysis.
e.zh: 对统计学有更深的理解会帮助你做数据分析。

understandingly.t: adv. 体谅地；善解人意地

e.en: She nodded {understandingly} as he explained his difficult week.
e.zh: 他讲述自己艰难的一周时，她善解人意地点了点头。

e.en: The therapist listened {understandingly} without rushing to give advice.
e.zh: 治疗师体贴地倾听，没有急着给出建议。

understands.t: v. understand 的第三人称单数

e.en: My dog clearly {understands} the word "walk" better than "sit".
e.zh: 我的狗显然比起“坐下”更懂“散步”这个词。

e.en: He {understands} the trade-offs but still prefers the simpler design.
e.zh: 他明白其中的取舍，但仍然偏爱更简洁的设计。

e.en: Don't {understate} the effort it took to finish this project.
e.zh: 不要轻描淡写完成这个项目所付出的努力。

e.en: Companies sometimes {understate} risks to attract more investors.
e.zh: 公司有时会淡化风险以吸引更多投资者。

e.en: Her outfit was elegant and {understated}, perfect for the gallery.
e.zh: 她的着装优雅低调，非常适合画廊场合。

e.en: The film's {understated} ending left audiences quietly moved.
e.zh: 这部电影含蓄的结尾让观众默默感动。

e.en: Saying the meeting was awkward is a serious {understatement}.
e.zh: 说那场会议尴尬，简直是太轻描淡写了。

e.en: "It's a bit windy" felt like an {understatement} during the storm.
e.zh: 风暴中说“有点风”感觉太过轻描淡写了。

e.en: The car tends to {understeer} when pushed hard through tight corners.
e.zh: 这辆车在急弯中猛踩时容易转向不足。

e.en: Front-wheel-drive vehicles often {understeer} on slippery winter roads.
e.zh: 前驱车在湿滑的冬季路面上常常出现转向不足。

understood.t:
v. understand 的过去式/过去分词
adj. 不言而喻的

e.en: I {understood} the assignment only after reading the example twice.
e.zh: 我读了两遍例子后才弄懂这次的作业。

e.en: It is {understood} that the deadline cannot be extended further.
e.zh: 大家都明白，这个截止日期不能再延后了。

e.en: Ferns and shrubs thrive in the rainforest's shaded {understory}.
e.zh: 蕨类和灌木在雨林阴暗的下层植被中生长茂盛。

e.en: Many songbirds nest in the forest {understory}, hidden from predators.
e.zh: 许多鸣禽在森林下层筑巢，躲避天敌。

e.en: Deep-sea ecosystems remain remarkably {understudied} despite their importance.
e.zh: 尽管深海生态系统至关重要，对其的研究仍然非常不足。

e.en: She {understudied} the lead role for three months before performing.
e.zh: 她为主角做了三个月替补，之后才登台演出。

understudy.t:
n. 替补演员
v. 担任替角

e.en: The {understudy} stepped in when the lead actress fell ill.
e.zh: 女主角生病时，替角顶上了场。

e.en: He served as her {understudy} for two seasons on Broadway.
e.zh: 他在百老汇做了她两季的替角演员。

e.en: Tiny cracks appeared on the {undersurface} of the porcelain bowl.
e.zh: 瓷碗的底面出现了细小的裂纹。

e.en: Mold often grows on the cool {undersurface} of bathroom tiles.
e.zh: 霉菌常常长在浴室瓷砖阴凉的底面上。

e.en: The team agreed to {undertake} a complete redesign of the website.
e.zh: 团队同意对网站进行一次彻底的重新设计。

e.en: Few people would willingly {undertake} such a risky expedition.
e.zh: 很少有人会自愿承担这样一次冒险的远征。

e.en: The repairs will be {undertaken} by a certified contractor.
e.zh: 维修工作将由有资质的承包商承担。

e.en: She has {undertaken} a major research project this year.
e.zh: 她今年承接了一个重大研究项目。

undertaker.t: n. 殡葬业者；丧葬承办人

e.en: The {undertaker} arranged every detail of the funeral.
e.zh: 殡仪员安排了葬礼的每一个细节。

e.en: His grandfather worked as an {undertaker} for forty years.
e.zh: 他的祖父做了四十年殡葬业者。

undertakes.t: v. undertake 的第三人称单数

e.en: Our team {undertakes} complex renovation projects across the city.
e.zh: 我们团队承接全市各地的复杂翻新工程。

e.en: She {undertakes} to deliver the report by Friday.
e.zh: 她承诺周五前交报告。

undertaking.t:
n. 任务；事业
v. 承担（undertake 的 -ing 形式）

e.en: Launching a startup is a risky {undertaking}.
e.zh: 创业是一项有风险的事业。

e.en: He signed an {undertaking} to repay the loan within a year.
e.zh: 他签了一份保证书,承诺一年内还清贷款。

underthings.t: n. 内衣（尤指女性内衣）

e.en: She packed her {underthings} into a small travel pouch.
e.zh: 她把内衣裤装进一个小旅行袋里。

e.en: The drawer was full of neatly folded {underthings}.
e.zh: 抽屉里满是叠得整整齐齐的贴身衣物。

undertone.t:
n. 潜台词；低声
n. 底色

e.en: There was a sarcastic {undertone} in his reply.
e.zh: 他的回答里带着一丝讽刺意味。

e.en: She spoke in an {undertone} so the baby wouldn't wake.
e.zh: 她压低声音说话,免得吵醒宝宝。

e.en: He {undertook} the renovation despite his tight budget.
e.zh: 尽管预算紧张,他还是承担了这次装修。

e.en: The company {undertook} to refund every dissatisfied customer.
e.zh: 公司承诺为每位不满意的顾客退款。

e.en: Swimmers were warned about the dangerous {undertow}.
e.zh: 游泳者被警告小心危险的离岸暗流。

e.en: There's an {undertow} of anxiety beneath her cheerful tone.
e.zh: 她欢快的语气下隐藏着一股焦虑的暗流。

e.en: The {underuse} of public transit wastes city resources.
e.zh: 公共交通的利用不足浪费了城市资源。

e.en: Many companies {underuse} the data they already collect.
e.zh: 许多公司没有充分利用他们已收集的数据。

e.en: The gym in our building is seriously {underused}.
e.zh: 我们楼里的健身房使用率严重偏低。

e.en: This feature is powerful but largely {underused} by customers.
e.zh: 这项功能很强大,但大多数客户都没怎么用。

underutilization.t: n. 利用不足；未充分利用

e.en: Server {underutilization} is costing the company millions yearly.
e.zh: 服务器利用率不足每年让公司损失数百万。

e.en: The report highlighted the {underutilization} of skilled workers.
e.zh: 报告指出了熟练工人未被充分利用的问题。

e.en: Cloud capacity is often badly {underutilized} during off-peak hours.
e.zh: 云资源在非高峰时段经常被严重闲置。

e.en: Her talents were {underutilized} at her previous job.
e.zh: 她在上一份工作中才能没有得到充分发挥。

e.en: Analysts pointed out the stock's clear {undervaluation}.
e.zh: 分析师指出该股票明显被低估。

e.en: Chronic {undervaluation} of caregiving work hurts the economy.
e.zh: 长期低估护理工作的价值损害了经济。

e.en: Don't {undervalue} the importance of a good night's sleep.
e.zh: 不要低估一夜好眠的重要性。

e.en: Bosses often {undervalue} quiet but reliable employees.
e.zh: 老板常常低估沉默却可靠的员工。

undervalued.t: adj. 被低估的；估价过低的

e.en: Many investors believe the stock is currently {undervalued}.
e.zh: 许多投资者认为这只股票目前被低估了。

e.en: She felt {undervalued} after years of unrecognized work.
e.zh: 多年付出无人认可,她感到自己未被重视。

e.en: The diver photographed colorful fish {underwater}.
e.zh: 潜水员在水下拍摄了五彩斑斓的鱼。

e.en: After the crash, his mortgage went {underwater}.
e.zh: 金融危机后,他的房贷成了负资产。

underway.t: adj. 正在进行的；已开始的

e.en: Construction of the new subway line is already {underway}.
e.zh: 新地铁线路的建设已在进行中。

e.en: Negotiations are {underway} to end the strike.
e.zh: 结束罢工的谈判正在进行中。

e.en: He packed extra socks and {underwear} for the trip.
e.zh: 他为这次旅行多带了几双袜子和内衣裤。

e.en: This brand makes the most comfortable cotton {underwear}.
e.zh: 这个牌子做的纯棉内衣最舒服。

underweight.t: adj. 体重不足的；低于标准重量的

e.en: The doctor said the baby is slightly {underweight}.
e.zh: 医生说宝宝体重略低于标准。

e.en: Many models in the industry are dangerously {underweight}.
e.zh: 业内许多模特体重过轻,十分危险。

underwent.t: v. undergo 的过去式（经历、经受）

e.en: She {underwent} surgery to repair her knee last month.
e.zh: 她上个月接受了膝盖修复手术。

e.en: The app {underwent} a complete redesign this year.
e.zh: 这款应用今年经历了彻底的重新设计。

underwhelming.t: adj. 令人失望的；不如预期的

e.en: The new sequel was honestly pretty {underwhelming}.
e.zh: 这部新续集说实话挺让人失望的。

e.en: His presentation was thorough but ultimately {underwhelming}.
e.zh: 他的演示很详尽,但最终并没什么亮点。

e.en: The bird's {underwing} flashed bright orange in flight.
e.zh: 那只鸟飞行时翅膀下方闪现出鲜艳的橙色。

e.en: She admired the moth's delicate {underwing} pattern.
e.zh: 她欣赏着那只飞蛾翅膀下方精致的花纹。

underwood.t: n. 下层灌木丛（林下植被）

e.en: Deer hid in the dense {underwood} of the forest.
e.zh: 鹿群藏在森林茂密的灌木丛中。

e.en: He cleared the {underwood} to make a walking trail.
e.zh: 他清理掉灌木丛,开辟出一条步行小径。

underworld.t:
n. 黑社会
n. 冥界

e.en: The detective infiltrated the city's criminal {underworld}.
e.zh: 那名警探打入了这座城市的犯罪黑社会。

e.en: Greek myths describe Hades ruling the {underworld}.
e.zh: 希腊神话描述哈迪斯统治着冥界。

underwrite.t:
v. 承保；（金融）包销
v. 资助；担保

e.en: Several banks agreed to {underwrite} the company's IPO.
e.zh: 几家银行同意为该公司的首次公开募股承销。

e.en: A local foundation will {underwrite} the new arts program.
e.zh: 一家本地基金会将资助这项新的艺术项目。

underwriter.t: n. 承保人；保险商；证券包销商

e.en: The {underwriter} reviewed her loan application carefully.
e.zh: 核保员仔细审核了她的贷款申请。

e.en: Goldman Sachs served as the lead {underwriter} for the deal.
e.zh: 高盛担任此次交易的主承销商。

underwriting.t: n. 承保业务；证券包销

e.en: The bank's {underwriting} standards have tightened recently.
e.zh: 该银行的承销标准近期已经收紧。

e.en: She works in {underwriting} at a major insurance company.
e.zh: 她在一家大型保险公司从事核保工作。

e.en: The bond issue was {underwritten} by three major banks.
e.zh: 这次债券发行由三家大银行承销。

e.en: The festival is {underwritten} by a local tech company.
e.zh: 这次音乐节由一家本地科技公司赞助承办。

e.en: The investment bank {underwrote} the company's stock offering.
e.zh: 那家投行为公司的股票发行进行了承销。

e.en: A wealthy donor {underwrote} the entire scholarship program.
e.zh: 一位富有的捐赠者全额资助了整个奖学金项目。

e.en: The vet diagnosed the puppy with an {undescended} testicle.
e.zh: 兽医诊断这只小狗患有隐睾症。

e.en: Surgery is often recommended for an {undescended} testicle.
e.zh: 对于隐睾症,通常建议手术治疗。

undeserved.t: adj. 不该得到的；不应受的

e.en: She received an {undeserved} reputation as a troublemaker.
e.zh: 她背上了一个不应得的麻烦制造者名声。

e.en: The criticism he got was completely {undeserved}.
e.zh: 他受到的批评完全不应得。

e.en: His first novel was {undeservedly} ignored by critics.
e.zh: 他的第一部小说被评论界不公平地忽视了。

e.en: She was {undeservedly} blamed for the team's failure.
e.zh: 团队的失败不应该怪到她头上。

undeserving.t: adj. 不配得到的；不值得的

e.en: He felt {undeserving} of so much praise from his peers.
e.zh: 他觉得自己配不上同事们这么多的赞美。

e.en: The policy unfairly labels recipients as {undeserving}.
e.zh: 这项政策不公平地把受助者贴上不配得的标签。

e.en: The report stressed the {undesirability} of further delays.
e.zh: 报告强调进一步拖延是不可取的。

e.en: Everyone agreed on the {undesirability} of raising taxes now.
e.zh: 大家都认为现在加税是不可取的。

undesirable.t: adj. 不受欢迎的；不合意的

e.en: Mixing those two chemicals can cause {undesirable} reactions.
e.zh: 混合这两种化学品可能引发不良反应。

e.en: The medication has a few {undesirable} side effects.
e.zh: 这种药有一些不良的副作用。

undesired.t: adj. 不想要的；非本意的

e.en: The update introduced several {undesired} changes to the interface.
e.zh: 这次更新对界面做了几处不受欢迎的改动。

e.en: She blocked the sender to stop the {undesired} messages.
e.zh: 她屏蔽了发件人,以阻止那些不想收到的信息。

undetectable.t: adj. 无法察觉的；检测不到的

e.en: The virus was nearly {undetectable} in early lab tests.
e.zh: 这种病毒在早期实验室检测中几乎无法被检出。

e.en: Modern antivirals can make HIV {undetectable} in the blood.
e.zh: 现代抗病毒药物能使血液中的艾滋病毒检测不到。

undetected.t: adj. 未被察觉的；未被发现的

e.en: The bug went {undetected} for nearly six months in production.
e.zh: 这个漏洞在生产环境中近六个月都没被发现。

e.en: The thief slipped past the cameras {undetected}.
e.zh: 小偷神不知鬼不觉地从监控下溜了过去。

e.en: The cause of the fire remains {undetermined}.
e.zh: 火灾的起因目前仍未确定。

e.en: The launch date is still {undetermined} pending approval.
e.zh: 发布日期尚未确定,有待批准。

undeterred.t: adj. 不受阻挠的；不气馁的

e.en: {Undeterred} by failure, she launched another startup.
e.zh: 她没有被失败吓倒,又创办了一家新公司。

e.en: He continued climbing, {undeterred} by the heavy rain.
e.zh: 他不顾大雨,继续向上攀登。

undeveloped.t: adj. 未开发的；未发育的

e.en: The town sits next to a large stretch of {undeveloped} land.
e.zh: 小镇旁有一大片未开发的土地。

e.en: His potential as a writer remains largely {undeveloped}.
e.zh: 他作为作家的潜力在很大程度上尚未开发。

undiagnosed.t: adj. 未经诊断的；未被确诊的

e.en: Many adults live for years with {undiagnosed} ADHD.
e.zh: 许多成年人多年来患有未确诊的多动症。

e.en: Her condition went {undiagnosed} until she changed doctors.
e.zh: 她的病情直到她换了医生才被确诊。

undid.t: v. undo 的过去式（撤销、解开）

e.en: She {undid} the top button of her coat.
e.zh: 她解开了大衣最上面的扣子。

e.en: One careless tweet {undid} months of careful PR work.
e.zh: 一条不慎的推文毁掉了几个月的精心公关。

undifferentiated.t: adj. 无差别的；未分化的

e.en: The market treats these products as largely {undifferentiated}.
e.zh: 市场基本把这些产品视为没有差异化的同类。

e.en: Stem cells start out as {undifferentiated} cells.
e.zh: 干细胞最初是未分化的细胞。

undigested.t: adj. 未消化的；未经充分思考的

e.en: Bits of {undigested} food appeared in the test results.
e.zh: 化验结果中出现了一些未消化的食物残渣。

e.en: The lecture left students with a mass of {undigested} facts.
e.zh: 那场讲座让学生满脑子都是未消化的知识点。

undignified.t: adj. 有失体面的；不庄重的

e.en: He made an {undignified} scramble to catch the falling vase.
e.zh: 他手忙脚乱、毫无风度地去接那只掉下来的花瓶。

e.en: Arguing in public is {undignified} for someone in his position.
e.zh: 以他的身份在公开场合争吵实在有失体面。

e.en: The recipe calls for {undiluted} apple juice.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要未稀释的纯苹果汁。

e.en: Her speech was greeted with {undiluted} enthusiasm.
e.zh: 她的演讲获得了毫无保留的热烈欢迎。

undiminished.t: adj. 未减弱的；未减少的

e.en: Her passion for teaching remains {undiminished} after thirty years.
e.zh: 三十年过去了,她对教学的热情依然不减。

e.en: Demand for the product is {undiminished} despite the price hike.
e.zh: 尽管涨价,这款产品的需求丝毫未减。

undiminishing.t: adj. 不减退的；持续不衰的

e.en: Fans showed an {undiminishing} love for the band over decades.
e.zh: 几十年来,歌迷对这支乐队的爱从未减退。

e.en: She faced the challenge with {undiminishing} energy.
e.zh: 她以丝毫不减的精力迎接挑战。

e.en: The food was edible but otherwise totally {unexceptional}.
e.zh: 那食物能吃,但其他方面就乏善可陈了。

e.en: He had an {unexceptional} career until his bestselling novel.
e.zh: 在那本畅销小说出版之前,他的职业生涯平平无奇。

unexceptionally.t: adv. 平庸地；无特别之处

e.en: The hotel staff treated every guest {unexceptionally} well.
e.zh: 酒店员工对每位客人都一视同仁地热情接待。

e.en: She performed {unexceptionally} on the test, scoring near average.
e.zh: 她在考试中表现平平,分数接近平均水平。

e.en: The lecture was {unexciting} and most students lost focus.
e.zh: 那场讲座很无趣，大多数学生都走神了。

e.en: He described his job as steady but rather {unexciting}.
e.zh: 他说他的工作稳定但相当乏味。

unexcused.t: adj. 未经允许的；无故的

e.en: Three {unexcused} absences will lower your final grade.
e.zh: 三次无故缺勤会拉低你的期末成绩。

e.en: Her {unexcused} lateness annoyed the entire team.
e.zh: 她无故迟到惹恼了整个团队。

unexpected.t: adj. 意外的；出乎意料的

e.en: We received an {unexpected} call from an old friend.
e.zh: 我们意外接到一位老朋友的电话。

e.en: The movie ended with an {unexpected} twist.
e.zh: 这部电影以一个出人意料的转折收尾。

unexpectedly.t: adv. 意外地；出人意料地

e.en: The package arrived {unexpectedly} early this morning.
e.zh: 包裹今天早上意外地很早就到了。

e.en: Prices rose {unexpectedly} after the new policy.
e.zh: 新政策出台后，物价出乎意料地上涨了。

e.en: The {unexpectedness} of the news left everyone speechless.
e.zh: 消息的突然让所有人都说不出话来。

e.en: Comedy often relies on the {unexpectedness} of the punchline.
e.zh: 喜剧常常依赖于结尾包袱的出其不意。

unexpired.t: adj. 未过期的；尚未到期的

e.en: Please show an {unexpired} ID at the front desk.
e.zh: 请在前台出示一份未过期的身份证件。

e.en: You can still use the {unexpired} portion of your coupon.
e.zh: 你仍可以使用优惠券中尚未过期的部分。

e.en: She felt an {unexplainable} sadness after the trip.
e.zh: 旅行结束后她感到一种说不清的悲伤。

e.en: The strange lights remain {unexplainable} to scientists.
e.zh: 那些奇怪的光至今让科学家无法解释。

unexplained.t: adj. 未说明的；原因不明的

e.en: Police are investigating the {unexplained} disappearance of the hiker.
e.zh: 警方正在调查这名徒步者无故失踪一事。

e.en: There are several {unexplained} charges on my credit card.
e.zh: 我的信用卡上有几笔无法解释的扣款。

e.en: Workers found an {unexploded} bomb at the construction site.
e.zh: 工人在工地上发现了一枚未爆炸的炸弹。

e.en: The area is sealed off because of {unexploded} ordnance.
e.zh: 由于有未爆炸的弹药，该区域被封锁。

unexploited.t: adj. 未被利用的；未开发的

e.en: The region has vast {unexploited} solar energy potential.
e.zh: 该地区拥有大量尚未开发的太阳能潜力。

e.en: Many {unexploited} markets exist for indie game developers.
e.zh: 独立游戏开发者还有很多未开发的市场。

unexplored.t: adj. 未探索的；未勘察的

e.en: Deep ocean trenches remain largely {unexplored} by humans.
e.zh: 深海沟至今基本上仍是人类未涉足的领域。

e.en: This idea is an {unexplored} angle for our research.
e.zh: 这个想法是我们研究中尚未探讨过的角度。

unexposed.t: adj. 未暴露的；未曝光的

e.en: Keep the film {unexposed} until you load the camera.
e.zh: 在装入相机之前请保持胶卷未曝光。

e.en: Children are healthier when {unexposed} to secondhand smoke.
e.zh: 孩子若不接触二手烟会更健康。

unexpressed.t: adj. 未表达的；没说出的

e.en: His {unexpressed} feelings caused tension in the relationship.
e.zh: 他没有表露的情感让两人关系变得紧张。

e.en: Many great ideas remain {unexpressed} due to fear.
e.zh: 许多绝妙的想法因恐惧而未被说出。

e.en: The {unexpurgated} edition includes scenes cut from the original release.
e.zh: 这个未删节版包含原版被剪掉的场景。

e.en: Readers prefer the {unexpurgated} version of the diary.
e.zh: 读者更喜欢这本日记的未删改版本。

unfailing.t: adj. 始终如一的；可靠的

e.en: Her {unfailing} support helped him through tough times.
e.zh: 她始终如一的支持帮他度过了艰难时期。

e.en: He showed {unfailing} kindness to every customer.
e.zh: 他对每位顾客都始终如一地友善。

unfailingly.t: adv. 始终如一地；屡试不爽地

e.en: My grandmother is {unfailingly} polite to strangers.
e.zh: 我的奶奶对陌生人总是彬彬有礼。

e.en: The bus arrives {unfailingly} on time every morning.
e.zh: 那班公交车每天早上都准时到站。

unfair.t: adj. 不公平的；不公正的

e.en: It's {unfair} to blame her for the team's mistake.
e.zh: 把团队的失误怪在她头上是不公平的。

e.en: Many workers complained about {unfair} pay differences.
e.zh: 许多员工抱怨薪酬差距不公平。

e.en: She felt she was treated {unfairly} by her manager.
e.zh: 她觉得自己受到了经理的不公正对待。

e.en: The article {unfairly} criticized the new restaurant.
e.zh: 那篇文章对这家新餐厅做了不公的批评。

e.en: Students protested the {unfairness} of the grading system.
e.zh: 学生们抗议评分制度的不公平。

e.en: There is real {unfairness} in how housing costs are distributed.
e.zh: 住房成本的分配确实存在不公。

e.en: He admitted being {unfaithful} to his wife last year.
e.zh: 他承认去年对妻子不忠。

e.en: The translation is {unfaithful} to the original poem.
e.zh: 这个译本对原诗不够忠实。

e.en: Her {unfaithfulness} eventually destroyed the marriage.
e.zh: 她的不忠最终毁掉了这段婚姻。

e.en: The novel explores {unfaithfulness} and forgiveness.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了背叛与宽恕。

unfaltering.t: adj. 坚定的；毫不动摇的

e.en: She gave an {unfaltering} performance despite her nerves.
e.zh: 尽管紧张，她还是做出了毫不动摇的表演。

e.en: His {unfaltering} faith inspired the whole community.
e.zh: 他坚定不移的信念鼓舞了整个社区。

e.en: The street names sounded {unfamiliar} to the tourists.
e.zh: 那些街道名对游客来说听起来很陌生。

e.en: I'm {unfamiliar} with this software, can you help?
e.zh: 我对这个软件不熟悉，你能帮我吗？

e.en: My {unfamiliarity} with the city made me anxious.
e.zh: 我对这座城市的陌生让我感到焦虑。

e.en: His {unfamiliarity} with local customs caused awkward moments.
e.zh: 他对当地习俗的不熟悉造成了一些尴尬。

e.en: Wide ties are currently {unfashionable} among young men.
e.zh: 宽领带在年轻男士中目前不再流行。

e.en: It's {unfashionable} to admit you watch reality TV.
e.zh: 承认自己看真人秀如今显得不合潮流。

e.en: Please {unfasten} your seatbelt only when the sign is off.
e.zh: 请只在指示灯熄灭后才解开安全带。

e.en: She tried to {unfasten} the stubborn necklace clasp.
e.zh: 她试着解开那个卡得很紧的项链扣。

unfathomable.t: adj. 深不可测的；难以理解的

e.en: The size of the universe is truly {unfathomable}.
e.zh: 宇宙的大小实在令人无法理解。

e.en: His decision to quit seemed {unfathomable} to coworkers.
e.zh: 他辞职的决定让同事们百思不得其解。

e.en: The contract terms were {unfavorable} for the smaller company.
e.zh: 合同条款对那家较小的公司不利。

e.en: The movie received mostly {unfavorable} reviews online.
e.zh: 这部电影在网上收到了大量负面评价。

e.en: Critics compared the sequel {unfavorably} with the original.
e.zh: 评论家们认为续集不如原作。

e.en: The new policy was viewed {unfavorably} by most voters.
e.zh: 大多数选民对新政策持负面看法。

e.en: Weather conditions were {unfavourable} for the outdoor concert.
e.zh: 天气状况不利于这场户外演唱会。

e.en: She received an {unfavourable} response to her job application.
e.zh: 她的求职申请收到了不太理想的回复。

e.en: His behavior was viewed {unfavourably} by the committee.
e.zh: 他的行为被委员会以不利的眼光看待。

e.en: The new design compares {unfavourably} with last year's model.
e.zh: 新设计与去年的款式相比显得逊色。

unfazed.t: adj. 镇定的；不为所动的

e.en: She seemed {unfazed} by the loud criticism online.
e.zh: 面对网上猛烈的批评，她似乎毫不在意。

e.en: The pilot remained {unfazed} during the rough turbulence.
e.zh: 在剧烈颠簸中飞行员依然镇定自若。

unfeasible.t: adj. 不可行的；行不通的

e.en: Building a tunnel here would be financially {unfeasible}.
e.zh: 在这里修建隧道在经济上不可行。

e.en: The deadline they proposed is completely {unfeasible}.
e.zh: 他们提出的截止日期完全不可行。

e.en: The project has an {unfeasibly} tight timeline for our team.
e.zh: 这个项目的时间表对我们团队来说紧得不切实际。

e.en: Their goals were {unfeasibly} ambitious for a startup.
e.zh: 对一家初创公司而言，他们的目标雄心壮志得不切实际。

unfed.t: adj. 未被喂食的；饿着的

e.en: The stray dogs went {unfed} for several days.
e.zh: 那些流浪狗好几天没人喂食。

e.en: No child should go {unfed} during the school day.
e.zh: 任何孩子在上学期间都不该挨饿。

e.en: His {unfeeling} reply hurt her more than silence would.
e.zh: 他冷漠的回答比沉默更让她伤心。

e.en: People accused the boss of being cold and {unfeeling}.
e.zh: 人们指责老板冷酷无情。

unfeigned.t: adj. 真诚的；非装出来的

e.en: She greeted us with {unfeigned} delight at the airport.
e.zh: 她在机场以毫不做作的喜悦迎接我们。

e.en: His apology showed {unfeigned} regret for the mistake.
e.zh: 他的道歉表现出对错误真心实意的悔意。

e.en: Small earthquakes often go {unfelt} by most residents.
e.zh: 小地震通常大多数居民都感觉不到。

e.en: Her contributions to the project went largely {unfelt}.
e.zh: 她对项目的贡献基本上没被察觉到。

e.en: She rejected the idea that ambition is {unfeminine}.
e.zh: 她反对把雄心壮志视为不像女性的看法。

e.en: In the past, wearing pants was considered {unfeminine}.
e.zh: 过去人们认为穿裤子不够女性化。

unfenced.t: adj. 无围栏的；未设防的

e.en: The {unfenced} backyard makes it easy for deer to wander in.
e.zh: 没有围栏的后院让鹿很容易闯进来。

e.en: Cattle roamed freely across the {unfenced} prairie.
e.zh: 牛群在没有围栏的草原上自由游荡。

unfertilized.t: adj. 未受精的；未施肥的

e.en: The eggs in the carton are {unfertilized} and safe to eat.
e.zh: 盒中的鸡蛋是未受精的，可以放心食用。

e.en: Without bees, many flowers remain {unfertilized}.
e.zh: 没有蜜蜂，许多花朵就无法授粉。

e.en: The new law aims to {unfetter} small businesses from heavy taxes.
e.zh: 这项新法律旨在让小企业摆脱繁重的税负。

e.en: Meditation can help {unfetter} the mind from constant worry.
e.zh: 冥想可以帮助让大脑摆脱无尽的忧虑。

unfettered.t: adj. 不受束缚的；自由的

e.en: Journalists need {unfettered} access to public records.
e.zh: 记者需要不受限制地获取公共记录的权利。

e.en: Children enjoy {unfettered} imagination during free play.
e.zh: 孩子们在自由玩耍时享有不受拘束的想象力。

e.en: Several positions remain {unfilled} after the hiring freeze.
e.zh: 招聘冻结后仍有几个职位空缺。

e.en: Half the seats in the theater were still {unfilled}.
e.zh: 剧场里有一半的座位仍然空着。

unfiltered.t: adj. 未过滤的；未经筛选的

e.en: She gave her {unfiltered} opinion on the new design.
e.zh: 她毫不修饰地说出了对新设计的看法。

e.en: Drinking {unfiltered} tap water can be risky here.
e.zh: 在这里喝未经过滤的自来水可能有风险。

unfinished.t: adj. 未完成的；未结束的

e.en: He left his novel {unfinished} for nearly a decade.
e.zh: 他的小说搁置未完成了近十年。

e.en: There's still some {unfinished} work on my desk.
e.zh: 我桌上还有一些没做完的工作。

unfired.t: adj. 未发射的；未点火的

e.en: The clay pot must remain {unfired} until fully dry.
e.zh: 陶罐在完全干燥之前不能烧制。

e.en: Police recovered the gun with one {unfired} bullet.
e.zh: 警方找回了枪支，里面还有一颗未发射的子弹。

unfit.t: adj. 不适合的；不健康的

e.en: The water was declared {unfit} for human consumption.
e.zh: 这水被判定为不适合人类饮用。

e.en: He felt too {unfit} to run the marathon this year.
e.zh: 他觉得自己今年体力不够跑马拉松。

e.en: There was a growing {unease} among investors before the crash.
e.zh: 股市崩盘前投资者中弥漫着越来越深的不安。

e.en: She felt a strange {unease} walking home that night.
e.zh: 那晚走回家时她感到一种莫名的不安。

uneases.t: n. unease 的复数；不安情绪

e.en: The financial report {uneases} shareholders ahead of the annual meeting.
e.zh: 这份财报让股东们在年会前感到不安。

e.en: His silence {uneases} everyone at the negotiation table.
e.zh: 他的沉默让谈判桌上的每个人都心神不宁。

e.en: She shifted {uneasily} in her chair during the interview.
e.zh: 面试时她在椅子上不安地挪动着身子。

e.en: He laughed {uneasily} when asked about the missing funds.
e.zh: 被问到失踪的资金时他不安地笑了笑。

e.en: There was a sense of {uneasiness} in the quiet office.
e.zh: 安静的办公室里弥漫着一种不安的气氛。

e.en: Her {uneasiness} grew as the deadline approached.
e.zh: 随着截止日期临近,她的不安感越来越强。

e.en: I feel {uneasy} about signing the contract today.
e.zh: 今天就签合同让我心里很不安。

e.en: The two countries maintain an {uneasy} peace.
e.zh: 两国维持着一种脆弱的和平。

uneatable.t: adj. 不能吃的；难以下咽的

e.en: The soup was so salty it was completely {uneatable}.
e.zh: 这汤咸得根本没法吃。

e.en: Burnt toast is basically {uneatable} without lots of butter.
e.zh: 烤焦的吐司不抹大量黄油根本咽不下去。

e.en: She left half her dinner {uneaten} on the plate.
e.zh: 她把晚餐剩了一半在盘子里没动。

e.en: The {uneaten} pizza sat in the fridge for days.
e.zh: 那块没吃的披萨在冰箱里放了好几天。

uneconomic.t: adj. 不经济的；无利可图的

e.en: Running the old factory has become completely {uneconomic}.
e.zh: 继续经营这家老厂已经完全不划算了。

e.en: Small rural routes are often {uneconomic} for bus companies.
e.zh: 偏远地区的小线路对巴士公司来说常常无利可图。

e.en: Heating an empty house is highly {uneconomical}.
e.zh: 给空房子供暖非常不经济。

e.en: Buying single servings is {uneconomical} compared to bulk packs.
e.zh: 买单份装比买大包装划不来。

unedifying.t: adj. 令人反感的；不体面的

e.en: The debate quickly turned into an {unedifying} shouting match.
e.zh: 辩论很快沦为一场令人不堪入目的对骂。

e.en: Their public divorce was an {unedifying} spectacle.
e.zh: 他们公开的离婚闹剧实在不堪入目。

unedited.t: adj. 未经编辑的；未删改的

e.en: He posted the {unedited} footage straight to YouTube.
e.zh: 他把未经剪辑的原片直接传到了 YouTube。

e.en: The {unedited} manuscript still contains many typos.
e.zh: 这份未经编辑的手稿里还有不少错字。

e.en: It's rude to assume rural people are {uneducated}.
e.zh: 以为农村人没受过教育是很不礼貌的。

e.en: His comment came across as an {uneducated} guess.
e.zh: 他的评论听起来像是没根据的乱猜。

e.en: Critics accused {unelected} officials of overstepping their authority.
e.zh: 批评者指责未经选举的官员越权行事。

e.en: An {unelected} committee shouldn't have this much power.
e.zh: 一个非民选的委员会不该掌握这么大权力。

e.en: She was completely {unembarrassed} about asking for a raise.
e.zh: 她毫不尴尬地开口要求加薪。

e.en: He gave an {unembarrassed} grin after spilling the wine.
e.zh: 打翻酒后他毫无窘色地咧嘴一笑。

unembellished.t: adj. 朴实的；不加修饰的

e.en: Just give me the {unembellished} truth, please.
e.zh: 请直接告诉我事实,不要添油加醋。

e.en: Her writing style is plain and {unembellished}.
e.zh: 她的文风朴实无华,不加修饰。

unemotional.t: adj. 不动感情的；冷静的

e.en: He gave an {unemotional} account of the accident.
e.zh: 他不带感情地讲述了那场事故的经过。

e.en: Her {unemotional} response surprised everyone in the room.
e.zh: 她毫无情绪的回应让在场的人都很意外。

unemotionally.t: adv. 不带感情地；冷静地

e.en: The judge spoke {unemotionally} as she read the verdict.
e.zh: 法官在宣读判决时语气毫无波澜。

e.en: He described the breakup {unemotionally}, as if reading news.
e.zh: 他像念新闻一样毫无情绪地讲述了分手经过。

e.en: After the scandal, he was practically {unemployable} in finance.
e.zh: 丑闻之后,他在金融圈基本没人敢雇了。

e.en: Without basic computer skills, many workers feel {unemployable}.
e.zh: 没有基本的电脑技能,许多工人觉得自己根本找不到工作。

unemployed.t: adj. 失业的；未被使用的

e.en: He's been {unemployed} since the factory closed last year.
e.zh: 自从去年工厂倒闭后他就一直没工作。

e.en: The app helps {unemployed} graduates find their first job.
e.zh: 这款应用帮失业的毕业生找到第一份工作。

e.en: Youth {unemployment} hit a record high this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度青年失业率创下历史新高。

e.en: She filed for {unemployment} benefits after being laid off.
e.zh: 被裁员后她申请了失业救济金。

unencumbered.t: adj. 无负担的；不受阻碍的

e.en: He travels light, {unencumbered} by heavy luggage.
e.zh: 他轻装出行,不被沉重的行李拖累。

e.en: Startups are {unencumbered} by the bureaucracy of big companies.
e.zh: 创业公司没有大公司那种官僚负担。

e.en: My inbox feels like an {unending} stream of notifications.
e.zh: 我的收件箱感觉就是没完没了的通知流。

e.en: Parents show {unending} patience with their toddlers.
e.zh: 父母对幼儿展现出无尽的耐心。

e.en: The summer heat in the attic was {unendurable}.
e.zh: 阁楼里夏天的高温简直让人受不了。

e.en: She found the silence after the breakup {unendurable}.
e.zh: 分手后的那种沉默让她无法忍受。

e.en: The new rule turned out to be legally {unenforceable}.
e.zh: 这条新规定在法律上根本无法执行。

e.en: Vague contracts are often {unenforceable} in court.
e.zh: 含糊不清的合同在法庭上往往无法强制执行。

e.en: The speed limit on this road is largely {unenforced}.
e.zh: 这条路上的限速基本没人管。

e.en: An {unenforced} policy is the same as no policy.
e.zh: 不执行的政策等于没有政策。

e.en: Students looked bored and {unengaged} during the lecture.
e.zh: 学生们在课上看起来无聊又心不在焉。

e.en: An {unengaged} audience is every speaker's nightmare.
e.zh: 对内容毫无兴趣的观众是每个演讲者的噩梦。

unenlightened.t: adj. 愚昧的；思想落后的

e.en: His {unenlightened} views on women shocked his coworkers.
e.zh: 他对女性那种落后的看法让同事们大跌眼镜。

e.en: That was a pretty {unenlightened} take on mental health.
e.zh: 对心理健康问题这么说可真是太无知了。

unenthusiastic.t: adj. 不热情的；兴致缺缺的

e.en: The team gave an {unenthusiastic} response to the new policy.
e.zh: 团队对新政策的反应并不热烈。

e.en: He was {unenthusiastic} about working another late shift.
e.zh: 他对再加一次夜班感到提不起劲。

unenviable.t: adj. 令人不羡慕的；棘手的

e.en: She has the {unenviable} task of firing half the team.
e.zh: 她接下了一个谁都不羡慕的任务——裁掉一半团队。

e.en: Being a referee is an {unenviable} job in any sport.
e.zh: 在任何运动里,当裁判都是个吃力不讨好的工作。

e.en: He sits {unenviably} between two warring departments.
e.zh: 他不幸地夹在两个争执不休的部门之间。

e.en: The startup is {unenviably} positioned against three giants.
e.zh: 这家初创公司处于一个让人同情的位置,要对抗三家巨头。

unep.t: n. 联合国环境规划署（缩写）

e.en: The {UNEP} report warns of accelerating biodiversity loss.
e.zh: 联合国环境署的报告警告生物多样性正在加速丧失。

e.en: She works as a climate analyst at {UNEP} headquarters.
e.zh: 她在联合国环境署总部担任气候分析师。

unequal.t: adj. 不平等的；不均等的

e.en: Wages remain deeply {unequal} between the two regions.
e.zh: 两个地区之间的工资水平依然极不平等。

e.en: He felt {unequal} to the challenge of managing a large team.
e.zh: 他觉得自己难以胜任管理一个大团队的挑战。

unequaled.t: adj. 无与伦比的；无双的

e.en: Her record in the marathon remains {unequaled} a decade later.
e.zh: 十年过去了,她的马拉松纪录至今无人能及。

e.en: The view from the summit is {unequaled} in the region.
e.zh: 从山顶看到的景色在这一带无与伦比。

unequalled.t: adj. 无与伦比的（英式拼法）

e.en: The chef's pastry skills are {unequalled} in the city.
e.zh: 这位厨师的甜点手艺在这座城市无人能及。

e.en: The library offers {unequalled} access to medieval manuscripts.
e.zh: 这家图书馆提供了无与伦比的中世纪手稿查阅资源。

e.en: Wealth is distributed very {unequally} across the country.
e.zh: 财富在这个国家的分配极不均衡。

e.en: Household chores are still split {unequally} in many couples.
e.zh: 在许多夫妻之间,家务活的分担依然很不平均。

unequipped.t: adj. 未配备的；缺乏能力的

e.en: Most schools are {unequipped} to handle a mental health crisis.
e.zh: 大多数学校都没有能力应对心理健康危机。

e.en: They were completely {unequipped} for hiking in deep snow.
e.zh: 他们完全没准备好在深雪里徒步。

unequivocal.t: adj. 毫不含糊的；明确的

e.en: The CEO gave an {unequivocal} apology to affected customers.
e.zh: 首席执行官向受影响的用户做出了毫不含糊的道歉。

e.en: Scientists now have {unequivocal} evidence of warming oceans.
e.zh: 科学家如今已掌握海洋变暖的明确证据。

unequivocally.t: adv. 毫不含糊地；明确地

e.en: The court ruled {unequivocally} in favor of the plaintiff.
e.zh: 法院明确无误地判原告胜诉。

e.en: She {unequivocally} denied any involvement in the leak.
e.zh: 她毫不含糊地否认与那次泄露有任何关联。

unerring.t: adj. 精准的；一贯正确的

e.en: She has an {unerring} eye for spotting design flaws.
e.zh: 她有一双从不出错的眼睛,总能挑出设计缺陷。

e.en: The dog showed an {unerring} sense of where its owner was.
e.zh: 这只狗对主人的位置有种从不出错的直觉。

unerringly.t: adv. 精准地；一贯正确地

e.en: The algorithm {unerringly} picks the best route through traffic.
e.zh: 这个算法总能精准地在车流中选出最佳路线。

e.en: He {unerringly} guessed the answer on the first try.
e.zh: 他第一次猜就准确无误地说出了答案。

unesco.t: n. 联合国教科文组织（缩写）

e.en: The old town was added to the {UNESCO} World Heritage list.
e.zh: 这座古城被列入了联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录。

e.en: {UNESCO} funds literacy programs in dozens of countries.
e.zh: 联合国教科文组织在数十个国家资助扫盲项目。

e.en: Children under twelve cannot fly {unescorted}.
e.zh: 十二岁以下的儿童不能无人陪同乘机。

e.en: Visitors are not allowed to wander the lab {unescorted}.
e.zh: 访客不得在没有陪同的情况下在实验室里走动。

unethical.t: adj. 不道德的；违反职业道德的

e.en: Selling user data without consent is clearly {unethical}.
e.zh: 未经同意出售用户数据显然是不道德的。

e.en: The lawyer was disbarred for {unethical} conduct.
e.zh: 那名律师因不道德行为被吊销了执业资格。

uneven.t: adj. 不平整的；不均匀的

e.en: Watch your step — the sidewalk is {uneven} here.
e.zh: 小心脚下,这段人行道高低不平。

e.en: The film's pacing is {uneven} but the acting saves it.
e.zh: 这部电影节奏忽快忽慢,好在演技撑住了。

unevenly.t: adv. 不均匀地；不平整地

e.en: The cake baked {unevenly} because the oven runs hot on one side.
e.zh: 蛋糕烤得不均匀,因为烤箱一侧温度偏高。

e.en: Resources are {unevenly} distributed across the school district.
e.zh: 资源在整个学区的分配很不均衡。

e.en: There's a slight {unevenness} in the floor near the doorway.
e.zh: 门口附近的地面有一点点不平。

e.en: Critics noted the {unevenness} of the album's second half.
e.zh: 乐评人指出这张专辑后半部分水平参差不齐。

uneventful.t: adj. 平淡无事的；无波澜的

e.en: The flight was long but completely {uneventful}.
e.zh: 航班虽然漫长,但一切平静无事。

e.en: After a chaotic week, she was grateful for an {uneventful} Sunday.
e.zh: 经过一周的忙乱,她很庆幸过了一个平淡无事的周日。

e.en: The protest ended {uneventfully} just after sunset.
e.zh: 抗议在日落后不久平静地结束了。

e.en: The package arrived {uneventfully} the next morning.
e.zh: 包裹第二天早上平安无事地送到了。

unexamined.t: adj. 未经审视的；未被检验的

e.en: Many of our daily habits go entirely {unexamined}.
e.zh: 我们日常的许多习惯完全没有被反思过。

e.en: Socrates said the {unexamined} life is not worth living.
e.zh: 苏格拉底说过,未经审视的人生不值得过。

unexceptionable.t: adj. 无可挑剔的；无可非议的

e.en: His proposal was bland but entirely {unexceptionable}.
e.zh: 他的提案虽然平淡,但完全无可挑剔。

e.en: She gave an {unexceptionable} speech that pleased everyone.
e.zh: 她做了一场让所有人都挑不出毛病的演讲。

e.en: His {unfitness} for the role became obvious within weeks.
e.zh: 几周之内他就显然不适合担此职务。

e.en: The doctor warned him about his general {unfitness}.
e.zh: 医生警告他身体状况整体欠佳。

unfitted.t: adj. 不胜任的；不适合的

e.en: He is {unfitted} for the demands of military life.
e.zh: 他不适合军旅生活的种种要求。

e.en: The room came {unfitted}, so we bought all the furniture.
e.zh: 这房间是毛坯交付的，所以我们购置了全部家具。

unfixable.t: adj. 无法修复的；无法解决的

e.en: The crack in the screen is {unfixable} without replacing the panel.
e.zh: 屏幕上的裂痕不换面板就修不好。

e.en: He treats every bug as {unfixable} until proven otherwise.
e.zh: 在被证明之前，他把每个错误都当成无法修复的。

unfixed.t: adj. 未固定的；未确定的

e.en: The leak remained {unfixed} for weeks.
e.zh: 那个漏水问题好几周都没修。

e.en: Several critical issues are still {unfixed} in this release.
e.zh: 这个版本里仍有几个严重问题没修复。

e.en: Her {unflagging} energy kept the team going.
e.zh: 她不知疲倦的精力让团队坚持了下来。

e.en: He showed {unflagging} support throughout the campaign.
e.zh: 整场活动中他都给予不懈的支持。

unflappable.t: adj. 沉着冷静的；临危不乱的

e.en: The pilot stayed {unflappable} during the turbulence.
e.zh: 飞机颠簸时机长依然镇定自若。

e.en: She's {unflappable} under pressure at work.
e.zh: 她在工作压力下从不慌乱。

unflattering.t: adj. 不讨好的；不美化的

e.en: That photo is rather {unflattering}.
e.zh: 那张照片拍得不太好看。

e.en: The article painted an {unflattering} picture of the CEO.
e.zh: 那篇文章把这位CEO描绘得相当难堪。

e.en: I prefer {unflavored} yogurt with fresh fruit.
e.zh: 我喜欢原味酸奶配新鲜水果。

e.en: Use {unflavored} gelatin for this recipe.
e.zh: 这个食谱要用无味明胶。

unflinching.t: adj. 坚定不移的；毫不退缩的

e.en: She gave an {unflinching} account of the disaster.
e.zh: 她毫不回避地讲述了那场灾难。

e.en: He met the criticism with {unflinching} calm.
e.zh: 他以毫不退缩的冷静面对批评。

unflinchingly.t: adv. 毫不退缩地；坚定地

e.en: The documentary {unflinchingly} examines the war's cost.
e.zh: 这部纪录片毫不回避地审视战争的代价。

e.en: She {unflinchingly} defended her decision in public.
e.zh: 她在公开场合毫不退缩地为自己的决定辩护。

unfocused.t: adj. 注意力不集中的；失焦的

e.en: The presentation felt rambling and {unfocused}.
e.zh: 那场演讲显得啰嗦又没重点。

e.en: His eyes were {unfocused} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后他的眼神有些涣散。

unfocussed.t: adj. 不集中的（unfocused 的变体）

e.en: The early draft was {unfocussed} and far too long.
e.zh: 初稿没有重点，而且太长了。

e.en: She felt tired and {unfocussed} during the meeting.
e.zh: 开会时她感到疲倦，注意力也不集中。

e.en: Let the story {unfold} naturally without spoilers.
e.zh: 让故事自然展开，别剧透。

e.en: Carefully {unfold} the map on the table.
e.zh: 小心地把地图在桌上摊开。

unfolded.t:
adj. 已展开的
v. unfold 的过去式

e.en: The drama {unfolded} live on social media.
e.zh: 这场风波在社交媒体上实时上演。

e.en: She {unfolded} the letter and began to read.
e.zh: 她展开信件开始阅读。

unfolding.t:
v. 正在展开；逐步呈现
n. 展开过程

e.en: Reporters covered the {unfolding} crisis around the clock.
e.zh: 记者们全天候报道这场不断发酵的危机。

e.en: He watched the sunrise slowly {unfolding} over the hills.
e.zh: 他望着日出在群山间缓缓铺开。

unfolds.t: v. 展开；逐步呈现（第三人称单数）

e.en: The plot {unfolds} across three timelines.
e.zh: 剧情在三条时间线上展开。

e.en: As the day {unfolds}, more details will emerge.
e.zh: 随着这一天的推进，更多细节会浮现。

e.en: The team lost the match on {unforced} errors.
e.zh: 球队因非受迫性失误输掉了比赛。

e.en: Their friendship felt warm and {unforced}.
e.zh: 他们的友谊温暖而自然。

e.en: The delay was due to {unforeseeable} circumstances.
e.zh: 延误是由于无法预见的情况造成的。

e.en: Such an outcome was completely {unforeseeable} a year ago.
e.zh: 一年前这样的结果完全无法预料。

unforeseen.t: adj. 未预见到的；意外的

e.en: We hit {unforeseen} problems during the rollout.
e.zh: 上线过程中我们遇到了意想不到的问题。

e.en: An {unforeseen} delay pushed the launch to next month.
e.zh: 一次意外延误把发布推到了下个月。

unforgettable.t: adj. 难忘的；令人难以忘怀的

e.en: The trip to Kyoto was truly {unforgettable}.
e.zh: 那次京都之旅真的令人难忘。

e.en: She gave an {unforgettable} performance at the finals.
e.zh: 她在决赛上的表演令人难以忘怀。

e.en: The sky glowed {unforgettably} pink at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时天空泛起令人难忘的粉色。

e.en: He played the role {unforgettably} well.
e.zh: 他把这个角色演得让人难以忘怀。

e.en: Lying to your best friend is {unforgivable}.
e.zh: 对最好的朋友撒谎是不可原谅的。

e.en: Missing her birthday twice would be {unforgivable}.
e.zh: 连续两年错过她的生日就太不应该了。

e.en: The service was {unforgivably} slow that night.
e.zh: 那晚的服务慢得让人无法容忍。

e.en: He was {unforgivably} rude to the staff.
e.zh: 他对员工无礼到了不可原谅的地步。

e.en: The betrayal remained {unforgiven} for years.
e.zh: 那次背叛多年来始终未被原谅。

e.en: She felt {unforgiven} despite his kind words.
e.zh: 尽管他说了好话，她仍觉得自己未被宽恕。

e.en: The desert sun is absolutely {unforgiving}.
e.zh: 沙漠的太阳真是毫不留情。

e.en: He's an {unforgiving} critic of sloppy code.
e.zh: 他对马虎的代码是毫不留情的批评者。

unformed.t: adj. 未成形的；未定型的

e.en: Her opinions on the topic are still {unformed}.
e.zh: 她对这个话题的看法还没有成型。

e.en: The clay sat {unformed} on the wheel.
e.zh: 陶土还没成形地放在转盘上。

e.en: It was an {unfortunate} choice of words.
e.zh: 那个用词选得很不妥当。

e.en: The project hit an {unfortunate} setback last week.
e.zh: 项目上周遭遇了一次不幸的挫折。

e.en: {Unfortunately}, the flight has been cancelled due to weather.
e.zh: 很遗憾,航班因天气原因被取消了。

e.en: I tried to fix it, but {unfortunately} it broke again.
e.zh: 我试着修了一下,可惜又坏了。

e.en: The shelter feeds dozens of {unfortunates} every winter night.
e.zh: 这家收容所每个冬夜都给几十个不幸的人提供餐食。

e.en: Volunteers handed out blankets to the {unfortunates} on the street.
e.zh: 志愿者把毯子分发给街头那些可怜的人。

unfounded.t: adj. 毫无根据的；没有事实依据的

e.en: The rumors about her resignation turned out to be {unfounded}.
e.zh: 关于她辞职的传闻最终被证明是没有根据的。

e.en: His fears about the surgery were completely {unfounded}.
e.zh: 他对手术的担忧完全是多余的。

e.en: {UNFPA} provides reproductive health services in over 150 countries.
e.zh: 联合国人口基金在 150 多个国家提供生殖健康服务。

e.en: The report was jointly published by WHO and {UNFPA}.
e.zh: 这份报告由世卫组织和联合国人口基金联合发布。

e.en: She bought the {unframed} print to save money.
e.zh: 她买了没装框的版画,这样能省点钱。

e.en: An {unframed} canvas leaned against the studio wall.
e.zh: 一幅没装框的画布斜靠在画室的墙边。

unfree.t: adj. 不自由的；受束缚的

e.en: Citizens in {unfree} societies cannot criticize their leaders openly.
e.zh: 在不自由的社会里,公民无法公开批评领导人。

e.en: He felt {unfree} under the company's strict surveillance policy.
e.zh: 在公司严密监控的政策下他觉得毫无自由可言。

unfreedom.t: n. 不自由；受压迫状态

e.en: The book examines daily life under political {unfreedom}.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了在政治不自由下的日常生活。

e.en: Censorship is just one form of {unfreedom}.
e.zh: 审查制度只是不自由的一种表现形式。

unfreeze.t: v. 解冻；解除冻结（账户、资金）

e.en: Try restarting the app to {unfreeze} your screen.
e.zh: 试试重启应用来解除屏幕卡死的状态。

e.en: The bank agreed to {unfreeze} her account this morning.
e.zh: 银行同意今天上午解冻她的账户。

unfrequented.t: adj. 人迹罕至的；少有人去的

e.en: They picnicked by an {unfrequented} stretch of the river.
e.zh: 他们在一段人迹罕至的河边野餐。

e.en: The trail leads to an {unfrequented} mountain lake.
e.zh: 这条小径通向一个鲜少有人造访的山间湖泊。

unfriendly.t: adj. 不友好的；不亲切的

e.en: The hotel staff seemed cold and {unfriendly} at check-in.
e.zh: 办理入住时酒店员工显得既冷淡又不友好。

e.en: This website is really {unfriendly} on mobile devices.
e.zh: 这个网站在手机上用起来真不友好。

unfrozen.t: adj. 已解冻的；未冻结的

e.en: Leave the chicken {unfrozen} in the fridge overnight.
e.zh: 把鸡肉放在冰箱里解冻一晚。

e.en: Once {unfrozen}, the berries lose their firm texture.
e.zh: 浆果一旦解冻就会失去原本的紧实口感。

e.en: Our search for the missing keys proved {unfruitful}.
e.zh: 我们找丢失钥匙的努力毫无结果。

e.en: After several {unfruitful} meetings, we abandoned the project.
e.zh: 开了几次毫无成果的会议后,我们放弃了这个项目。

unfulfilled.t: adj. 未实现的；未得到满足的

e.en: She felt {unfulfilled} in her corporate job.
e.zh: 她在那份公司职位上觉得很没成就感。

e.en: Many of his promises remain {unfulfilled} years later.
e.zh: 多年过去,他的许多承诺仍未兑现。

unfunded.t: adj. 无资金支持的；未拨款的

e.en: The pension plan is largely {unfunded} and at risk.
e.zh: 这项养老金计划基本没有资金支持,处境堪忧。

e.en: His startup idea remained {unfunded} despite many pitches.
e.zh: 尽管推介了很多次,他的创业想法仍然没拿到投资。

e.en: The comedian's jokes were stale and {unfunny} tonight.
e.zh: 今晚那位喜剧演员的段子又老套又不好笑。

e.en: That meme is honestly just {unfunny} and offensive.
e.zh: 那个梗说真的既不好笑又冒犯人。

e.en: Sailors prepared to {unfurl} the sails at dawn.
e.zh: 水手们准备在黎明时分扬起风帆。

e.en: Protesters began to {unfurl} a huge banner across the bridge.
e.zh: 抗议者开始在桥上展开一面巨大的横幅。

unfurled.t:
adj. 已展开的
v. unfurl 的过去式

e.en: The flag {unfurled} dramatically in the strong breeze.
e.zh: 旗帜在强风中戏剧性地展开。

e.en: She {unfurled} the map across the kitchen table.
e.zh: 她在厨房桌上把地图展开。

unfurling.t: v. 正在展开（旗帜、画卷）

e.en: The fern leaves were slowly {unfurling} in the spring sunlight.
e.zh: 蕨叶在春日阳光下缓缓舒展。

e.en: We watched the rope {unfurling} from the dock below.
e.zh: 我们看着绳子从下面的码头上慢慢散开。

e.en: They rented an {unfurnished} apartment to bring their own things.
e.zh: 他们租了一间没带家具的公寓,好用自己的东西。

e.en: The {unfurnished} loft felt huge and echoey.
e.zh: 这间没有家具的阁楼显得又大又空旷。

e.en: My grandmother makes simple, {unfussy} food that everyone loves.
e.zh: 我奶奶做的菜简单不讲究,但人人都爱吃。

e.en: He's an {unfussy} eater who'll try almost anything.
e.zh: 他吃东西不挑剔,几乎什么都愿意尝。

e.en: The puppy ran across the lawn in an {ungainly} gallop.
e.zh: 小狗笨拙地连蹦带跳地跑过草坪。

e.en: Teenagers often feel {ungainly} during a growth spurt.
e.zh: 青少年在快速长高的时候常常觉得自己手脚不协调。

e.en: It would be {ungenerous} not to thank her publicly.
e.zh: 不公开感谢她就太显得小气了。

e.en: His tip was rather {ungenerous} given the great service.
e.zh: 考虑到那么好的服务,他给的小费实在抠门。

e.en: Interrupting her like that was rather {ungentlemanly}.
e.zh: 那样打断她说话实在太没绅士风度了。

e.en: He apologized for his {ungentlemanly} behavior at the party.
e.zh: 他为自己在派对上失礼的行为道了歉。

unglamorous.t: adj. 不光鲜的；平淡无趣的

e.en: Most of programming is {unglamorous} bug fixing and meetings.
e.zh: 编程大部分时候就是修 bug 和开会,没什么光鲜可言。

e.en: Touring sounds exciting but is mostly {unglamorous} hotel rooms.
e.zh: 巡演听起来很酷,实际上多半就是住住毫无亮点的酒店房间。

unglazed.t: adj. 未上釉的；未装玻璃的

e.en: The potter left the bowl {unglazed} for a rustic look.
e.zh: 陶艺师故意没给这只碗上釉,以保持质朴的感觉。

e.en: {Unglazed} terracotta tiles absorb water very quickly.
e.zh: 未上釉的陶土砖吸水非常快。

e.en: Her {ungloved} hand turned red in the freezing wind.
e.zh: 她没戴手套的手在寒风中冻得通红。

e.en: The surgeon never touches the tray with an {ungloved} finger.
e.zh: 外科医生绝不会用没戴手套的手指碰托盘。

unglued.t: adj. 脱胶的；心烦意乱的

e.en: He came {unglued} when the server crashed before launch.
e.zh: 发布前服务器崩溃,他整个人都崩溃了。

e.en: The label had come {unglued} from the bottle.
e.zh: 标签已经从瓶子上脱胶了。

ungodly.t: adj. 不敬神的；不像话的（时间等）

e.en: She wakes up at an {ungodly} hour to train.
e.zh: 她每天在一个不合常理的时间起床训练。

e.en: The traffic noise outside was absolutely {ungodly}.
e.zh: 外面的车流噪音简直让人无法忍受。

ungovernable.t: adj. 难以控制的；难管束的

e.en: The toddler flew into an {ungovernable} rage over the broken toy.
e.zh: 小孩因为玩具坏了发了一通无法控制的脾气。

e.en: Critics called the city {ungovernable} after years of gridlock.
e.zh: 经过多年的僵局,评论家称这座城市已无法治理。

ungoverned.t: adj. 无人治理的；放任的

e.en: The startup operated in a largely {ungoverned} corner of the internet.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在互联网一个几乎无人监管的角落运营。

e.en: His {ungoverned} spending eventually drained the family savings.
e.zh: 他毫无节制的开销最终掏空了家里的积蓄。

e.en: He made an {ungraceful} landing after tripping on the rug.
e.zh: 他被地毯绊倒,落地的姿势很不优雅。

e.en: The app's {ungraceful} error messages confused new users.
e.zh: 这个应用粗糙的错误提示让新用户感到困惑。

e.en: It would be {ungracious} to refuse her birthday invitation.
e.zh: 拒绝她的生日邀请会显得很失礼。

e.en: The losing team gave an {ungracious} interview after the match.
e.zh: 输球的队伍在赛后接受了一次态度欠佳的采访。

e.en: He {ungraciously} accepted the award without thanking anyone.
e.zh: 他毫无风度地接过奖项,没有感谢任何人。

e.en: She {ungraciously} muttered about the gift before leaving.
e.zh: 她临走前还不客气地嘀咕着那份礼物。

ungraded.t: adj. 未分级的；未评分的

e.en: A stack of {ungraded} essays sat on the teacher's desk.
e.zh: 老师桌上堆着一叠还没批改的作文。

e.en: The course is offered on an {ungraded} pass/fail basis.
e.zh: 这门课以不评分的及格/不及格方式开设。

e.en: The chatbot occasionally produces {ungrammatical} but understandable replies.
e.zh: 这个聊天机器人偶尔会输出不合语法但能看懂的回复。

e.en: Her translation was fluent but slightly {ungrammatical} in places.
e.zh: 她的翻译很流畅,但有些地方语法略有不当。

ungraspable.t: adj. 难以理解的；抓不住的

e.en: The scale of the universe feels almost {ungraspable}.
e.zh: 宇宙的尺度大到几乎无法理解。

e.en: To a beginner, recursion can seem completely {ungraspable}.
e.zh: 对初学者来说,递归可能完全难以理解。

ungrateful.t: adj. 忘恩负义的；不知感激的

e.en: Don't be {ungrateful} — your parents drove four hours to visit.
e.zh: 别这么不知感恩,你父母开了四小时车来看你。

e.en: He felt {ungrateful} for complaining about such a generous gift.
e.zh: 他觉得自己抱怨这么慷慨的礼物有些忘恩负义。

ungroomed.t: adj. 不修边幅的；蓬头垢面的

e.en: The rescue dog arrived thin, scared, and badly {ungroomed}.
e.zh: 这只救助犬到达时又瘦又怕,毛发也疏于打理。

e.en: He showed up to the interview looking tired and {ungroomed}.
e.zh: 他面试时看起来疲惫不堪,仪容也不整洁。

ungrounded.t: adj. 无根据的；未接地的

e.en: Her fears about the flight turned out to be {ungrounded}.
e.zh: 她对这次航班的担忧最后证明毫无根据。

e.en: Never plug expensive electronics into an {ungrounded} outlet.
e.zh: 千万不要把贵重电子产品插进没接地的插座。

ungrudging.t: adj. 慷慨的；毫无保留的

e.en: She offered {ungrudging} support throughout the long project.
e.zh: 在整个漫长的项目中,她都毫无保留地给予支持。

e.en: The coach won respect for his {ungrudging} praise of rivals.
e.zh: 教练因毫不吝啬地称赞对手而赢得了尊重。

unguarded.t: adj. 不设防的；（言行）不慎的

e.en: In an {unguarded} moment, he admitted he was scared.
e.zh: 在一个放松警惕的时刻,他承认自己其实很害怕。

e.en: Never leave your laptop {unguarded} in a coffee shop.
e.zh: 在咖啡店里千万别让笔记本电脑无人看管。

e.en: The pharmacist mixed a soothing {unguent} for the burn.
e.zh: 药剂师为烧伤调了一种舒缓的药膏。

e.en: She rubbed a fragrant {unguent} into her sore shoulders.
e.zh: 她把一种带香味的油膏揉进酸痛的肩膀。

unguided.t: adj. 无引导的；无制导的

e.en: The museum offers an {unguided} tour with an audio app.
e.zh: 博物馆提供搭配语音应用的自助参观。

e.en: Children rarely learn calculus through {unguided} exploration.
e.zh: 孩子们很少能靠无人指导的探索学会微积分。

ungulate.t:
n. 有蹄类动物
adj. 有蹄的

e.en: The deer is the most common {ungulate} in this forest.
e.zh: 鹿是这片森林里最常见的有蹄类动物。

e.en: Zebras and giraffes are both {ungulate} mammals of Africa.
e.zh: 斑马和长颈鹿都是非洲的有蹄类哺乳动物。

unhampered.t: adj. 不受妨碍的；畅通无阻的

e.en: With remote work, she's {unhampered} by long commutes.
e.zh: 有了远程办公,她不再受漫长通勤的束缚。

e.en: The river flows {unhampered} now that the dam is gone.
e.zh: 水坝拆除后,河水畅通无阻地流淌。

e.en: He {unhappily} agreed to work through the weekend.
e.zh: 他不情愿地同意整个周末都加班。

e.en: {Unhappily}, the flight was canceled at the last minute.
e.zh: 不幸的是,航班在最后一刻被取消了。

e.en: Long commutes are a major source of {unhappiness}.
e.zh: 漫长的通勤是导致不快乐的一大原因。

e.en: She hid her {unhappiness} behind a polite smile.
e.zh: 她把内心的不快藏在礼貌的微笑后面。

e.en: The novel catalogs the small daily {unhappinesses} of office life.
e.zh: 小说细数了办公室生活中那些日常的小郁闷。

e.en: Therapy helped her name the various {unhappinesses} she'd ignored.
e.zh: 心理咨询帮她说出了那些被她忽视的种种烦恼。

e.en: Customers are {unhappy} with the new pricing model.
e.zh: 用户对新的定价方案很不满意。

e.en: She had an {unhappy} childhood but rarely talks about it.
e.zh: 她童年并不快乐,但很少提起这段经历。

unharmed.t: adj. 未受伤害的；安然无恙的

e.en: All passengers escaped the crash {unharmed}.
e.zh: 所有乘客都从事故中安然无恙地逃了出来。

e.en: The package arrived late but completely {unharmed}.
e.zh: 包裹虽然到得晚,但完好无损。

unharried.t: adj. 不受烦扰的；从容的

e.en: He moved through the kitchen calm and {unharried}.
e.zh: 他在厨房里从容不迫地走动着。

e.en: She enjoys {unharried} mornings with a slow coffee.
e.zh: 她喜欢悠闲不慌的早晨慢慢喝咖啡。

unhcr.t: n. 联合国难民事务高级专员公署

e.en: The {UNHCR} delivered emergency aid to the camp.
e.zh: 联合国难民署向难民营运送了紧急援助。

e.en: She works as a field officer for the {UNHCR}.
e.zh: 她在联合国难民署担任外勤官员。

e.en: Fast food can be quite {unhealthful} long-term.
e.zh: 长期吃快餐对健康相当不利。

e.en: The smog made the air {unhealthful} to breathe.
e.zh: 雾霾让空气吸进去都不利于健康。

e.en: He ate {unhealthily} during exam season.
e.zh: 考试季期间他吃得很不健康。

e.en: She's {unhealthily} obsessed with her phone.
e.zh: 她对手机的痴迷已经到了不健康的地步。

unhealthy.t: adj. 不健康的；有害身心的

e.en: Skipping breakfast every day is {unhealthy}.
e.zh: 每天不吃早餐对身体不好。

e.en: They had an {unhealthy} dynamic at work.
e.zh: 他们在工作中的关系并不健康。

unheard.t: adj. 没被听见的；未获倾听的

e.en: Her warnings went largely {unheard}.
e.zh: 她的警告基本上没人听进去。

e.en: Many workers feel {unheard} by management.
e.zh: 许多员工觉得管理层听不到他们的声音。

unheated.t: adj. 未加热的；无供暖的

e.en: The garage stays {unheated} all winter.
e.zh: 车库整个冬天都没有暖气。

e.en: She prefers {unheated} sake with sushi.
e.zh: 她吃寿司时更喜欢喝冷清酒。

unheeded.t: adj. 被忽视的；未被理会的

e.en: His advice went {unheeded} until it was too late.
e.zh: 他的建议无人理睬，直到为时已晚。

e.en: Safety warnings should never go {unheeded}.
e.zh: 安全警告绝不该被忽视。

unhelpful.t: adj. 无益的；帮不上忙的

e.en: The chatbot's reply was completely {unhelpful}.
e.zh: 那个聊天机器人的回答毫无用处。

e.en: His sarcastic comments were {unhelpful} during the meeting.
e.zh: 他在会上挖苦的话毫无帮助。

unhelpfully.t: adv. 无益地；帮不上忙地

e.en: The manual {unhelpfully} skipped the install step.
e.zh: 那本手册偏偏漏掉了安装步骤，毫无帮助。

e.en: She {unhelpfully} suggested I just buy a new one.
e.zh: 她毫无建设性地建议我干脆买个新的。

unheralded.t: adj. 未被预告的；默默无闻的

e.en: The team's {unheralded} backup goalie saved the game.
e.zh: 那位默默无闻的替补门将救了这场比赛。

e.en: His contribution went {unheralded} for decades.
e.zh: 他的贡献几十年来都没有得到宣扬。

e.en: His {unheroic} retreat disappointed his supporters.
e.zh: 他不光彩的退却让支持者大失所望。

e.en: The novel features a refreshingly {unheroic} protagonist.
e.zh: 小说塑造了一位令人耳目一新的非英雄式主角。

unhesitating.t: adj. 毫不犹豫的；果断的

e.en: She gave an {unhesitating} yes to the proposal.
e.zh: 她毫不犹豫地答应了求婚。

e.en: His {unhesitating} support meant everything to me.
e.zh: 他毫不迟疑的支持对我意义重大。

e.en: He {unhesitatingly} jumped in to help the stranger.
e.zh: 他毫不迟疑地跳上前帮助那位陌生人。

e.en: She {unhesitatingly} agreed to take on the project.
e.zh: 她毫不犹豫地答应接手这个项目。

unhindered.t: adj. 不受阻碍的；畅通的

e.en: Aid trucks finally moved {unhindered} into the city.
e.zh: 救援卡车终于畅通无阻地驶入了城市。

e.en: With good wifi, she works {unhindered} from anywhere.
e.zh: 有了好网络，她在哪都能不受阻碍地工作。

unhinge.t: v. 使精神错乱；取下（门等）的铰链

e.en: The constant noise began to {unhinge} him.
e.zh: 持续的噪音开始让他精神错乱。

e.en: Don't let one bad review {unhinge} your whole week.
e.zh: 别让一条差评搅乱你一整周的心情。

unhinged.t: adj. 精神错乱的；离谱的

e.en: His tweets last night were completely {unhinged}.
e.zh: 他昨晚的推文简直疯了一样。

e.en: The fans went {unhinged} when the band appeared.
e.zh: 乐队一出现，粉丝们就疯狂了起来。

e.en: Wearing socks with sandals is famously {unhip}.
e.zh: 袜子配凉鞋是出了名的不时髦。

e.en: My dad's playlist is endearingly {unhip}.
e.zh: 我爸的歌单老土得很可爱。

unhistorical.t: adj. 非历史的；不符史实的

e.en: That movie's depiction of the battle is {unhistorical}.
e.zh: 那部电影对那场战役的描绘并不符合史实。

e.en: Critics called the novel charming but {unhistorical}.
e.zh: 评论家说这部小说迷人，但不合史实。

e.en: He stopped to {unhitch} the trailer from the truck.
e.zh: 他停下来把拖车从卡车上摘下来。

e.en: Help me {unhitch} the horse before it rains.
e.zh: 下雨前帮我把马解开。

e.en: They formed an {unholy} alliance to crush the rivals.
e.zh: 他们结成了一个邪恶联盟去碾压对手。

e.en: The kids made an {unholy} mess in the kitchen.
e.zh: 孩子们把厨房弄得一团糟。

e.en: Could you {unhook} the back of my dress?
e.zh: 你能帮我解开裙子后面的扣吗？

e.en: He carefully {unhook}ed the fish and released it.
e.zh: 他小心地把鱼摘下钩然后放生了。

unhurried.t: adj. 从容不迫的；不慌不忙的

e.en: They had a long, {unhurried} dinner by the lake.
e.zh: 他们在湖边吃了一顿悠闲的晚餐。

e.en: Her {unhurried} pace calmed everyone in the room.
e.zh: 她从容的节奏让屋里的人都安定下来。

uninfluenced.t: adj. 未受影响的；不受左右的

e.en: The judge's ruling was {uninfluenced} by public opinion.
e.zh: 法官的裁决不受公众舆论影响。

e.en: Her style remains {uninfluenced} by current fashion trends.
e.zh: 她的风格不受当下时尚潮流的影响。

uninformative.t: adj. 信息量少的；无参考价值的

e.en: The error message was vague and totally {uninformative}.
e.zh: 那条错误信息含糊不清，完全无法提供有用信息。

e.en: Reviewers found the documentation surprisingly {uninformative} for a major release.
e.zh: 评测人员觉得这次大版本的文档信息量出奇地少。

uninformed.t: adj. 不知情的；未获信息的

e.en: Voters shouldn't make decisions based on {uninformed} opinions.
e.zh: 选民不应该基于不了解情况的观点作出决定。

e.en: It's irresponsible to give medical advice when you're {uninformed}.
e.zh: 在不了解情况时给出医疗建议是不负责任的。

e.en: The polluted island became {uninhabitable} after the chemical spill.
e.zh: 化学品泄漏后,这座被污染的岛屿变得不宜居住。

e.en: Mars remains {uninhabitable} for humans without advanced technology.
e.zh: 没有先进技术,火星对人类来说仍然无法居住。

uninhabited.t: adj. 无人居住的；荒无人烟的

e.en: They camped on a small {uninhabited} island for a week.
e.zh: 他们在一个无人居住的小岛上露营了一周。

e.en: The cabin had been {uninhabited} for over a decade.
e.zh: 那间小屋已经空置了十多年。

uninhibited.t: adj. 不受拘束的；放得开的

e.en: Children dance in an {uninhibited} way that adults envy.
e.zh: 孩子们跳舞时无拘无束,令大人羡慕。

e.en: Her {uninhibited} laughter filled the entire room.
e.zh: 她毫无顾忌的笑声充满了整个房间。

e.en: The jargon sounds confusing to the {uninitiated} reader.
e.zh: 这些行话对外行读者来说听起来令人困惑。

e.en: For the {uninitiated}, cricket rules can seem overwhelming.
e.zh: 对门外汉来说,板球规则可能令人难以理解。

uninjured.t: adj. 未受伤的；毫发无损的

e.en: Luckily, all passengers walked away {uninjured} from the crash.
e.zh: 幸运的是,所有乘客都从车祸中安然无恙地走了出来。

e.en: The driver emerged {uninjured} but visibly shaken.
e.zh: 司机毫发无伤地走出来,但明显受了惊吓。

uninspired.t: adj. 平庸的；缺乏灵感的

e.en: The menu felt {uninspired} and full of generic dishes.
e.zh: 这份菜单平淡无奇,全是些普通菜品。

e.en: Critics called the sequel lazy and {uninspired}.
e.zh: 评论家称这部续集懒散且毫无新意。

uninspiring.t: adj. 乏味的；激不起兴趣的

e.en: The speaker gave a flat, {uninspiring} keynote address.
e.zh: 演讲者发表了一场平淡乏味的主题演讲。

e.en: The hotel lobby had an {uninspiring} beige color scheme.
e.zh: 酒店大堂的米色配色毫无亮点。

uninstalled.t:
adj. 已卸载的
v. 卸载（uninstall 的过去式）

e.en: I {uninstalled} the app after seeing too many ads.
e.zh: 看到广告太多后我把这个应用卸载了。

e.en: The old printer driver must be {uninstalled} before updating.
e.zh: 更新前必须先卸载旧的打印机驱动。

uninsulated.t: adj. 无绝缘层的；未做保温处理的

e.en: The {uninsulated} attic loses heat rapidly in winter.
e.zh: 这个未做隔热的阁楼冬天散热很快。

e.en: Touching {uninsulated} wires can cause a serious shock.
e.zh: 触碰未绝缘的电线可能导致严重电击。

e.en: Homes in flood zones are often considered {uninsurable}.
e.zh: 洪水区的房屋通常被认为无法投保。

e.en: His medical history made him {uninsurable} by most companies.
e.zh: 他的病史使大多数公司都不愿为他承保。

uninsured.t: adj. 未投保的；没有保险的

e.en: Millions of Americans remain {uninsured} despite reform efforts.
e.zh: 尽管进行了改革,仍有数百万美国人没有保险。

e.en: Driving while {uninsured} carries hefty fines.
e.zh: 无保险驾驶会被处以高额罚款。

e.en: His comment was rude and frankly {unintelligent}.
e.zh: 他的评论既粗鲁又坦白地说毫无智慧。

e.en: The chatbot gave surprisingly {unintelligent} answers to simple questions.
e.zh: 这个聊天机器人对简单问题给出了出奇愚蠢的答案。

e.en: The lecture's {unintelligibility} frustrated even the graduate students.
e.zh: 这场讲座的晦涩难懂连研究生都感到沮丧。

e.en: Poor audio quality contributed to the recording's {unintelligibility}.
e.zh: 糟糕的音质导致录音难以听懂。

unintelligible.t: adj. 难以理解的；听不懂的

e.en: His mumbling was completely {unintelligible} over the phone.
e.zh: 他在电话里嘟哝的话完全听不清楚。

e.en: The handwriting on the note was {unintelligible}.
e.zh: 便条上的字迹根本无法辨认。

unintelligibly.t: adv. 难以理解地；含糊不清地

e.en: He muttered {unintelligibly} as he walked past us.
e.zh: 他从我们身边走过时含糊不清地嘟囔着。

e.en: The drunk man shouted {unintelligibly} at passing cars.
e.zh: 那个醉汉对着过往的车辆胡乱吼叫。

e.en: The new policy had several {unintended} consequences.
e.zh: 这项新政策产生了一些意想不到的后果。

e.en: Her joke caused {unintended} offense at the meeting.
e.zh: 她的玩笑在会上无意中冒犯了人。

e.en: The duplicate charge was completely {unintentional}, the cashier explained.
e.zh: 收银员解释说重复扣款完全是无意的。

e.en: His rude tone was {unintentional} but still hurtful.
e.zh: 他无礼的语气并非有意,但仍然伤人。

e.en: I {unintentionally} sent the email to the wrong person.
e.zh: 我不小心把邮件发给了错误的人。

e.en: She {unintentionally} revealed the surprise party plans.
e.zh: 她无意中透露了惊喜派对的计划。

uninterested.t: adj. 不感兴趣的；冷淡的

e.en: He seemed totally {uninterested} in the job offer.
e.zh: 他对这份工作邀请似乎完全不感兴趣。

e.en: The students looked {uninterested} during the long lecture.
e.zh: 学生们在冗长的讲座中显得兴致索然。

e.en: The documentary was technically polished but ultimately {uninteresting}.
e.zh: 这部纪录片制作精良,但最终还是乏味无趣。

e.en: She found the small talk at parties deeply {uninteresting}.
e.zh: 她觉得派对上的闲聊非常无聊。

e.en: I need three hours of {uninterrupted} time to finish this.
e.zh: 我需要三个小时不被打扰的时间来完成这件事。

e.en: The forest stretched in {uninterrupted} green to the horizon.
e.zh: 森林一片连绵不断的绿色延伸至地平线。

e.en: The fountain has flowed {uninterruptedly} for over a century.
e.zh: 这座喷泉已经不间断地流淌了一个多世纪。

e.en: She worked {uninterruptedly} from morning until evening.
e.zh: 她从早到晚不间断地工作。

uninvited.t: adj. 未受邀请的；不速之客的

e.en: Several {uninvited} guests showed up at the wedding.
e.zh: 几个不速之客出现在了婚礼上。

e.en: He gave {uninvited} advice about my career choices.
e.zh: 他对我的职业选择提出了不请自来的建议。

uninviting.t: adj. 不吸引人的；令人不想靠近的

e.en: The dimly lit alley looked cold and {uninviting}.
e.zh: 灯光昏暗的小巷看起来冰冷又令人却步。

e.en: The lukewarm soup appeared {uninviting} on the plate.
e.zh: 盘中温吞的汤看起来毫无食欲。

uninvolved.t: adj. 不参与的；置身事外的

e.en: He stayed {uninvolved} in the office gossip.
e.zh: 他不参与办公室的八卦。

e.en: An {uninvolved} third party reviewed the dispute.
e.zh: 一名不相关的第三方审查了这场争端。

union.t:
n. 工会；联盟
n. 结合；联合

e.en: The workers voted to form a {union} last month.
e.zh: 工人们上个月投票决定成立工会。

e.en: Their marriage was a happy {union} of two cultures.
e.zh: 他们的婚姻是两种文化的幸福结合。

e.en: Most of the factory workers are now {unionised}.
e.zh: 工厂里大多数工人现在都加入了工会。

e.en: {Unionised} staff went on strike this morning.
e.zh: 加入工会的员工今天上午开始罢工。

unionism.t: n. 工会主义；联合主义

e.en: {Unionism} grew rapidly in the industrial north.
e.zh: 工会运动在工业化的北方迅速发展。

e.en: He wrote a book on the history of British {unionism}.
e.zh: 他写了一本关于英国工会运动史的书。

unionist.t: n. 工会会员；联合主义者

e.en: The {unionist} party won most seats in the region.
e.zh: 联合派政党在该地区赢得了大多数席位。

e.en: She comes from a long line of {unionist} organizers.
e.zh: 她出身于一个工会组织者世家。

e.en: {Unionization} efforts at the warehouse have grown rapidly.
e.zh: 该仓库的工会化运动发展迅猛。

e.en: Management strongly opposed {unionization} of the staff.
e.zh: 管理层强烈反对员工组建工会。

unionize.t: v. 组建工会；加入工会
