e.en: The baristas voted to {unionize} their café.
e.zh: 咖啡师们投票决定让自己的咖啡馆成立工会。

e.en: Drivers are organizing to {unionize} across the platform.
e.zh: 司机们正组织起来,在整个平台上推动建立工会。

e.en: The hospital has been fully {unionized} since 2010.
e.zh: 这家医院自2010年起就完全工会化了。

e.en: {Unionized} teachers received a small pay raise.
e.zh: 加入工会的教师获得了小幅加薪。

unions.t: n. 工会；联盟（union 的复数）

e.en: Several major {unions} backed the candidate.
e.zh: 好几个大型工会支持这位候选人。

e.en: The two {unions} merged into one larger organization.
e.zh: 这两个工会合并为一个更大的组织。

unipolar.t: adj. 单极的（电路、世界格局等）

e.en: Some analysts argue the world is no longer {unipolar}.
e.zh: 一些分析人士认为世界已不再是单极格局。

e.en: She was diagnosed with {unipolar} depression last year.
e.zh: 她去年被诊断为单相抑郁症。

e.en: Modern laptops rarely run on a {uniprocessor} architecture.
e.zh: 现代笔记本电脑很少采用单处理器架构。

e.en: The legacy server still uses an old {uniprocessor} chip.
e.zh: 那台老旧服务器仍在使用一颗单处理器芯片。

unique.t: adj. 独特的；独一无二的

e.en: Every snowflake has a {unique} crystalline pattern.
e.zh: 每片雪花都有独一无二的晶体结构。

e.en: The café offers a {unique} blend of Thai and Italian flavors.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆提供独特的泰式与意式混搭口味。

e.en: She is {uniquely} qualified to lead the project.
e.zh: 她在领导这个项目方面有着无人可比的资历。

e.en: The city is {uniquely} positioned between two rivers.
e.zh: 这座城市坐落在两条河流之间,位置独特。

e.en: The brand's {uniqueness} lies in its handmade designs.
e.zh: 该品牌的独特之处在于其手工设计。

e.en: Each fingerprint's {uniqueness} makes it ideal for identification.
e.zh: 每个指纹的独一无二使其非常适合用于身份识别。

unisex.t: adj. 男女通用的；中性的

e.en: The store sells {unisex} T-shirts in five colors.
e.zh: 这家店销售五种颜色的中性T恤。

e.en: They renovated the office to include {unisex} bathrooms.
e.zh: 他们翻修了办公室,加入了无性别厕所。

unison.t:
n. 一致；齐声
n. (乐) 齐奏

e.en: The crowd shouted the chant in {unison}.
e.zh: 人群齐声高喊那句口号。

e.en: The dancers moved in perfect {unison} on stage.
e.zh: 舞者们在舞台上动作整齐划一。

unisons.t: n. 一致；齐声（unison 的复数）

e.en: The choir practiced several tricky {unisons} before the concert.
e.zh: 合唱团在音乐会前练习了几段棘手的齐唱。

e.en: Their voices fell into beautiful {unisons} throughout the song.
e.zh: 他们的嗓音在整首歌中融成优美的齐声。

unissued.t: adj. 未发行的（股票、证券等）

e.en: The company still has thousands of {unissued} shares.
e.zh: 该公司仍有数千股未发行股票。

e.en: Several {unissued} passports were found in the drawer.
e.zh: 抽屉里发现了几本尚未签发的护照。

unisys.t: n. 优利系统公司（Unisys，美国 IT 公司）

e.en: He spent twenty years as an engineer at {Unisys}.
e.zh: 他在Unisys公司当了二十年工程师。

e.en: The bank still runs key systems on {Unisys} mainframes.
e.zh: 这家银行的关键系统仍运行在Unisys大型机上。

unit.t:
n. 单位；单元
n. (军) 部队；(商品) 件

e.en: Each apartment {unit} has its own balcony.
e.zh: 每个公寓单元都有自己的阳台。

e.en: The meter is the standard {unit} of length.
e.zh: 米是长度的标准单位。

unita.t: n. 安盟（安哥拉反对派组织 UNITA）

e.en: {UNITA} fought a long civil war in Angola.
e.zh: 安盟在安哥拉打了一场漫长的内战。

e.en: Historians still debate {UNITA}'s role in the conflict.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在争论安盟在那场冲突中的角色。

unitard.t: n. 连体紧身衣（舞蹈、体操用）

e.en: The dancer wore a black {unitard} for rehearsal.
e.zh: 那位舞者排练时穿着一件黑色连身紧身衣。

e.en: Gymnasts often compete in a sleek {unitard}.
e.zh: 体操运动员经常穿着贴身的连身紧身衣比赛。

unitarian.t:
n. 一位论派信徒
adj. 一位论派的

e.en: She attends a small {Unitarian} church downtown.
e.zh: 她在市中心一个小型一位论派教会做礼拜。

e.en: His family has been {Unitarian} for three generations.
e.zh: 他家三代都信奉一位论派。

unhurriedly.t: adv. 不慌不忙地；从容地

e.en: He sipped his coffee {unhurriedly} by the window.
e.zh: 他在窗边不紧不慢地喝着咖啡。

e.en: She walked {unhurriedly} along the riverbank.
e.zh: 她沿着河岸悠然地走着。

unhurt.t: adj. 没受伤的；安然无恙的

e.en: Everyone walked away {unhurt} from the crash.
e.zh: 事故中的所有人都安然无恙地走了出来。

e.en: The dog was shaken but completely {unhurt}.
e.zh: 那只狗受了惊吓，但毫发无损。

e.en: The street vendor's kitchen looked {unhygienic} and poorly maintained.
e.zh: 那个街头小贩的厨房看起来不卫生，疏于打理。

e.en: Sharing towels at the gym is honestly pretty {unhygienic}.
e.zh: 在健身房共用毛巾说实话挺不卫生的。

uni.t: n. 大学（university 的口语缩写）

e.en: The crystal showed {uniaxial} symmetry under the polarizing microscope.
e.zh: 该晶体在偏光显微镜下呈现单轴对称性。

e.en: Engineers ran a {uniaxial} tensile test on the steel sample.
e.zh: 工程师对钢材样品进行了单轴拉伸测试。

e.en: Denmark has a {unicameral} parliament with one legislative chamber.
e.zh: 丹麦实行只有一个立法议院的一院制议会。

e.en: Critics argue a {unicameral} legislature speeds up lawmaking significantly.
e.zh: 批评者认为一院制立法机构能大幅加快立法进程。

unicef.t: n. 联合国儿童基金会

e.en: {Unicef} delivered emergency vaccines to children in the conflict zone.
e.zh: 联合国儿童基金会向冲突地区的儿童提供了紧急疫苗。

e.en: She donates monthly to {Unicef} through their website.
e.zh: 她每月通过官网向联合国儿童基金会捐款。

e.en: Bacteria are {unicellular} organisms found almost everywhere on Earth.
e.zh: 细菌是几乎遍布地球各处的单细胞生物。

e.en: The pond water teems with tiny {unicellular} creatures.
e.zh: 池塘水中充满了微小的单细胞生物。

unicorn.t:
n. 独角兽
n. 独角兽公司（估值超十亿的初创）

e.en: The startup became a {unicorn} after its latest funding round.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在最近一轮融资后成了独角兽企业。

e.en: Her daughter drew a pink {unicorn} on the birthday card.
e.zh: 她女儿在生日卡片上画了一只粉色独角兽。

e.en: The clown rode a {unicycle} across the circus stage.
e.zh: 小丑骑着独轮车穿过马戏团舞台。

e.en: Learning to balance on a {unicycle} took him months.
e.zh: 学会在独轮车上保持平衡花了他好几个月。

unidentifiable.t: adj. 无法识别的；辨认不出的

e.en: The blurry photo showed an {unidentifiable} object in the sky.
e.zh: 那张模糊的照片显示天空中有个无法辨认的物体。

e.en: Police found an {unidentifiable} substance at the crime scene.
e.zh: 警方在犯罪现场发现了一种无法识别的物质。

unidentified.t: adj. 身份不明的；未经确认的

e.en: An {unidentified} man was seen near the building last night.
e.zh: 昨晚有人看见一名身份不明的男子在大楼附近。

e.en: The hospital is treating several {unidentified} accident victims.
e.zh: 医院正在救治多名身份不明的事故伤者。

unidimensional.t: adj. 一维的；单一维度的

e.en: Critics called the villain a {unidimensional} character lacking depth.
e.zh: 评论家说这个反派是个缺乏深度的单一维度角色。

e.en: Don't take such a {unidimensional} view of this complex issue.
e.zh: 不要用如此单一的视角看待这个复杂问题。

e.en: The microphone has a {unidirectional} pickup pattern for clear vocals.
e.zh: 这款麦克风采用单向拾音模式，人声清晰。

e.en: Traffic on this street is strictly {unidirectional} during rush hour.
e.zh: 高峰时段这条街实行严格的单向通行。

e.en: German {unification} in 1990 reshaped the political map of Europe.
e.zh: 1990年德国的统一重塑了欧洲的政治版图。

e.en: The {unification} of the two companies created a market giant.
e.zh: 两家公司的合并造就了一个行业巨头。

e.en: The team presented a {unified} front despite their internal disagreements.
e.zh: 尽管内部有分歧，团队对外仍保持一致立场。

e.en: Slack offers a {unified} workspace for messaging and file sharing.
e.zh: Slack 提供集消息和文件共享于一体的统一工作空间。

unifier.t: n. 使统一的人或事物

e.en: Music can be a powerful {unifier} across cultures and languages.
e.zh: 音乐可以成为跨越文化和语言的强大凝聚力量。

e.en: The new coach was seen as a {unifier} of the divided locker room.
e.zh: 新教练被视为能凝聚分裂更衣室的人。

unifies.t: v. 统一；使一体化（unify 的第三人称单数）

e.en: This framework {unifies} authentication across all our microservices.
e.zh: 这个框架将我们所有微服务的身份验证统一起来。

e.en: A common goal {unifies} the otherwise quarrelsome committee members.
e.zh: 共同的目标让原本爱争吵的委员会成员团结一致。

uniform.t:
n. 制服；校服
adj. 一致的；均匀的

e.en: All employees must wear a {uniform} during their shifts.
e.zh: 所有员工上班期间必须穿制服。

e.en: Spread the icing in a {uniform} layer across the cake.
e.zh: 把糖霜均匀地涂抹在蛋糕表面。

e.en: Two {uniformed} officers stood at the entrance to the courthouse.
e.zh: 两名身穿制服的警官站在法院入口处。

e.en: A {uniformed} doorman greeted guests at the hotel lobby.
e.zh: 一位身穿制服的门童在酒店大堂迎接客人。

e.en: Geologists adopted the {uniformitarian} view that present processes shaped the past.
e.zh: 地质学家采纳了均变论观点，认为现今过程塑造了过去。

e.en: Lyell's {uniformitarian} ideas revolutionized nineteenth-century earth science.
e.zh: 莱伊尔的均变论思想彻底改变了十九世纪的地球科学。

uniformities.t: n. 一致性；均匀性（uniformity 的复数）

e.en: The study revealed surprising {uniformities} in consumer behavior across regions.
e.zh: 研究揭示了各地区消费者行为中出人意料的一致性。

e.en: Statistical {uniformities} often hide important individual differences.
e.zh: 统计上的一致性常常掩盖了重要的个体差异。

e.en: The factory aims for strict {uniformity} in every product batch.
e.zh: 工厂力求每批产品都严格保持一致性。

e.en: Too much {uniformity} in design can feel boring to users.
e.zh: 设计过于统一会让用户觉得乏味。

e.en: The reviews were {uniformly} positive about the new restaurant.
e.zh: 对这家新餐厅的评价无一例外都很正面。

e.en: Spread the seeds {uniformly} across the prepared soil.
e.zh: 把种子均匀地撒在整理好的土壤上。

e.en: The school requires students to wear navy blue {uniforms}.
e.zh: 学校要求学生穿藏青色校服。

e.en: New {uniforms} arrived for the entire nursing staff yesterday.
e.zh: 昨天全体护理人员的新制服到货了。

e.en: The CEO hopes to {unify} the company after the merger.
e.zh: 首席执行官希望在合并后整合公司。

e.en: A clear vision can {unify} a team behind a common goal.
e.zh: 清晰的愿景能让团队为共同目标团结起来。

unifying.t:
adj. 起统合作用的
v. 统一（unify 的现在分词）

e.en: Climate change is becoming a {unifying} concern for young voters.
e.zh: 气候变化正成为年轻选民共同关心的议题。

e.en: Music has a {unifying} power that crosses cultural boundaries.
e.zh: 音乐具有跨越文化界限的凝聚力。

e.en: The president took {unilateral} action without consulting Congress.
e.zh: 总统在未与国会协商的情况下采取了单边行动。

e.en: Their {unilateral} decision angered the other partners.
e.zh: 他们单方面的决定激怒了其他合作伙伴。

e.en: Critics warned that {unilateralism} would isolate the country diplomatically.
e.zh: 批评者警告称单边主义将使该国在外交上陷入孤立。

e.en: The new administration rejected the {unilateralism} of its predecessor.
e.zh: 新政府摒弃了前任的单边主义做法。

e.en: Her {unilateralist} approach alienated traditional allies in Europe.
e.zh: 她的单边主义做法疏远了欧洲的传统盟友。

e.en: The senator was known for his hawkish, {unilateralist} foreign policy views.
e.zh: 那位参议员以鹰派的单边主义外交政策观点著称。

e.en: The company {unilaterally} canceled the contract without prior notice.
e.zh: 公司未经事先通知便单方面取消了合同。

e.en: You can't {unilaterally} change the terms of our agreement.
e.zh: 你不能单方面改变我们协议的条款。

unilever.t: n. 联合利华（跨国消费品公司）

e.en: {Unilever} owns brands like Dove, Lipton, and Ben & Jerry's.
e.zh: 联合利华旗下拥有多芬、立顿和本杰瑞等品牌。

e.en: She landed a marketing internship at {Unilever} this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天她在联合利华拿到了一份市场营销实习。

unilinear.t: adj. 单线发展的；单线性的

e.en: Anthropologists abandoned the {unilinear} model of cultural evolution decades ago.
e.zh: 人类学家几十年前就摒弃了文化演化的单线模型。

e.en: History rarely follows a {unilinear} path from primitive to advanced.
e.zh: 历史很少沿着从原始到先进的单一线性路径发展。

unimaginable.t: adj. 无法想象的；难以置信的

e.en: The refugees endured {unimaginable} hardships during their long journey.
e.zh: 难民们在漫长的旅途中忍受了难以想象的苦难。

e.en: Smartphones offer computing power that was {unimaginable} thirty years ago.
e.zh: 智能手机提供的算力在三十年前是难以想象的。

e.en: The new telescope can see {unimaginably} distant galaxies.
e.zh: 这架新望远镜能看到遥不可及的星系。

e.en: Living without internet now seems {unimaginably} difficult to many people.
e.zh: 对许多人来说，没有网络的生活如今难以想象。

unimaginative.t: adj. 缺乏想象力的；平庸的

e.en: The reviewer called the menu safe and {unimaginative}.
e.zh: 评论员说这份菜单中规中矩，缺乏想象力。

e.en: His {unimaginative} solution failed to impress the design judges.
e.zh: 他缺乏想象力的方案未能打动设计评委。

unimagined.t: adj. 未曾想到的；意想不到的

e.en: AI is opening up {unimagined} possibilities in medical research.
e.zh: 人工智能正在医学研究中开启前所未想的可能性。

e.en: The trip brought joys she had previously {unimagined}.
e.zh: 这次旅行带给她从未想象过的快乐。

e.en: Despite his age, his memory remains remarkably {unimpaired}.
e.zh: 尽管年事已高，他的记忆力依然保持得相当好。

e.en: The driver's vision was {unimpaired} at the time of the accident.
e.zh: 事故发生时司机的视力没有受到任何损害。

e.en: She delivered a calm, {unimpassioned} analysis of the controversial ruling.
e.zh: 她对这一争议判决作出了冷静、不带感情的分析。

e.en: His {unimpassioned} tone made the eulogy feel oddly distant.
e.zh: 他不动声色的语调让悼词显得格外疏离。

unimpeachable.t: adj. 无可指责的；无懈可击的

e.en: The witness has an {unimpeachable} reputation in the community.
e.zh: 这位证人在社区中声誉无可指摘。

e.en: Her sources are {unimpeachable}, so the story will hold up.
e.zh: 她的消息来源无可质疑，所以这则报道经得起推敲。

unimpeded.t: adj. 未受阻碍的；畅通的

e.en: The new highway allows {unimpeded} traffic flow into the city.
e.zh: 新高速公路让进城的车流畅通无阻。

e.en: Sunlight streamed {unimpeded} through the freshly cleaned windows.
e.zh: 阳光透过刚擦干净的窗户毫无阻挡地洒进来。

e.en: He dismissed the rumor with a wave, signaling its {unimportance}.
e.zh: 他挥手打发了那个传闻，表示它无关紧要。

e.en: The relative {unimportance} of that meeting became clear later.
e.zh: 那次会议的相对无足轻重后来才显现出来。

e.en: Don't waste time on {unimportant} details before the deadline.
e.zh: 截止日期前不要在无关紧要的细节上浪费时间。

e.en: What you wear to the casual meetup is totally {unimportant}.
e.zh: 你参加这种轻松聚会穿什么完全不重要。

unimposing.t: adj. 不起眼的；不令人印象深刻的

e.en: The building's {unimposing} entrance hides a stunning interior courtyard.
e.zh: 这栋建筑朴素的入口藏着一个令人惊艳的内庭。

e.en: He was a quiet, {unimposing} man with surprising authority.
e.zh: 他是个沉静而不张扬却出奇有威信的人。

unimpressed.t: adj. 无动于衷的；不为所动的

e.en: The judges seemed {unimpressed} by his rehearsed speech.
e.zh: 评委们似乎对他排练好的演讲并不买账。

e.en: My cat was utterly {unimpressed} by the expensive new toy.
e.zh: 我家猫对那个昂贵的新玩具完全不感冒。

unimpressive.t: adj. 平平无奇的；不出彩的

e.en: The phone's battery life was honestly pretty {unimpressive}.
e.zh: 这部手机的电池续航说实话相当一般。

e.en: Despite the hype, the movie's special effects were {unimpressive}.
e.zh: 尽管宣传热烈，这部电影的特效却乏善可陈。

unimproved.t: adj. 未改良的；未开发的

e.en: The cabin sits on three acres of {unimproved} woodland.
e.zh: 这间小木屋坐落在三英亩未开发的林地上。

e.en: Her grades remain {unimproved} despite weeks of tutoring.
e.zh: 尽管补习了好几周，她的成绩仍没有起色。

unincorporated.t:
adj. 未注册的（公司）
adj. 未划入市政的（地区）

e.en: They live in an {unincorporated} area just outside the city limits.
e.zh: 他们住在市区边界外一片未划入建制的地区。

e.en: The business operates as an {unincorporated} sole proprietorship.
e.zh: 该企业以未注册成立公司的独资形式运营。

e.en: He was named an {unindicted} co-conspirator in the federal case.
e.zh: 他在联邦案件中被列为未被起诉的同谋。

e.en: Several executives remain {unindicted} despite the ongoing investigation.
e.zh: 尽管调查仍在进行，几名高管至今未被起诉。

uninflected.t: adj. 无词形变化的（语法）

e.en: Chinese is largely an {uninflected} language without verb conjugations.
e.zh: 汉语基本上是一种没有动词变位的非屈折语言。

e.en: She read the lines in a flat, {uninflected} voice.
e.zh: 她用平淡、毫无语调起伏的声音念出台词。

e.en: {Unitarianism} emphasizes reason and individual conscience.
e.zh: 一位论派强调理性和个人良知。

e.en: She wrote her thesis on the history of {Unitarianism}.
e.zh: 她的论文写的是一位论派的历史。

e.en: France operates as a {unitary} state, not a federation.
e.zh: 法国是一个单一制国家,而非联邦制。

e.en: The team adopted a {unitary} approach to product design.
e.zh: 团队对产品设计采取了统一的一体化方法。

e.en: The tragedy seemed to {unite} the entire community.
e.zh: 这场悲剧似乎让整个社区团结了起来。

e.en: Leaders called on citizens to {unite} against corruption.
e.zh: 领导人呼吁公民团结起来反对腐败。

e.en: The two companies {united} to form a global tech giant.
e.zh: 两家公司合并成立了一个全球科技巨头。

e.en: A {united} team can overcome almost any challenge.
e.zh: 一个团结的团队几乎能克服任何挑战。

unites.t: v. unite 的第三人称单数

e.en: Music {unites} people across cultures and languages.
e.zh: 音乐让不同文化和语言的人团结在一起。

e.en: This app {unites} all your messages in one inbox.
e.zh: 这个应用把你所有的消息整合到一个收件箱。

e.en: The crisis is slowly {uniting} the divided community.
e.zh: 这场危机正慢慢让分裂的社区团结起来。

e.en: She gave a speech {uniting} the staff behind the new vision.
e.zh: 她发表演讲,让员工团结在新愿景之下。

e.en: Marriage has both a {unitive} and a procreative purpose.
e.zh: 婚姻既有结合的目的,也有生育的目的。

e.en: The therapist used a {unitive} approach to family healing.
e.zh: 治疗师采用了一种促进结合的家庭疗愈方法。

unitized.t: adj. 单元化的；整体式的

e.en: The warehouse stores goods on {unitized} pallets for easy loading.
e.zh: 仓库把货物放在统一规格的托盘上以便装卸。

e.en: Investors prefer {unitized} funds with transparent pricing.
e.zh: 投资者更喜欢定价透明的单位化基金。

e.en: The apartment complex has 240 residential {units}.
e.zh: 这个公寓楼共有240个住宅单元。

e.en: Please convert the measurements into metric {units}.
e.zh: 请把测量结果换算成公制单位。

e.en: The coach emphasized team {unity} before the championship.
e.zh: 教练在冠军赛前强调球队的团结。

e.en: National {unity} is hard to maintain during economic crises.
e.zh: 经济危机时国家团结很难维持。

e.en: His resume listed Stanford {Univ} as his graduate school.
e.zh: 他的简历上把斯坦福大学列为研究生院。

e.en: The address abbreviates university as {Univ}. on the form.
e.zh: 表格上把university缩写为Univ.。

e.en: Smiling is a {universal} sign of friendliness.
e.zh: 微笑是表达友好的通用信号。

e.en: The charger has a {universal} adapter for every country.
e.zh: 这个充电器配有适用于各国的万能转换头。

e.en: The philosopher defended moral {universalism} against relativism.
e.zh: 这位哲学家为道德普世主义辩护,反对相对主义。

e.en: {Universalism} holds that core human rights apply everywhere.
e.zh: 普世主义认为基本人权适用于任何地方。

universalist.t: n. 普救论者；普遍主义者

e.en: She takes a {universalist} view of human dignity.
e.zh: 她对人的尊严持普世主义的观点。

e.en: The church became known for its {universalist} teachings.
e.zh: 这座教堂以其普救论教义而闻名。

e.en: The policy reflects a {universalistic} approach to welfare.
e.zh: 该政策体现了一种普惠式的福利取向。

e.en: His ethics class explored {universalistic} moral theories.
e.zh: 他的伦理课探讨了普世主义的道德理论。

e.en: The film's appeal lies in the {universality} of its themes.
e.zh: 这部电影的魅力在于其主题的普世性。

e.en: Scientists value the {universality} of mathematical laws.
e.zh: 科学家重视数学定律的普遍性。

e.en: The {universalization} of healthcare is a long-term goal.
e.zh: 医疗保健的全民化是一个长期目标。

e.en: Critics question the {universalization} of Western values.
e.zh: 批评者质疑将西方价值观普世化的做法。

e.en: The party hopes to {universalize} access to childcare.
e.zh: 该党希望让所有人都能享有托儿服务。

e.en: It's risky to {universalize} from a single experience.
e.zh: 从单一经历推广出普遍结论是有风险的。

e.en: The internet has {universalized} access to information.
e.zh: 互联网让获取信息变得普及化。

e.en: Smartphones {universalized} mobile photography overnight.
e.zh: 智能手机一夜之间让手机摄影普及到所有人。

e.en: The author warns against {universalizing} one culture's norms.
e.zh: 作者警告不要把某一文化的规范普世化。

e.en: Streaming is {universalizing} access to global cinema.
e.zh: 流媒体正让人们普遍能看到全球电影。

e.en: The new feature was {universally} praised by users.
e.zh: 这项新功能受到用户的一致好评。

e.en: His name is {universally} recognized in the tech world.
e.zh: 他的名字在科技界无人不知。

e.en: The {universe} contains billions of galaxies.
e.zh: 宇宙中包含着数十亿个星系。

e.en: Marvel keeps expanding its cinematic {universe}.
e.zh: 漫威不断扩展它的电影宇宙。

e.en: Some physicists believe parallel {universes} may exist.
e.zh: 一些物理学家相信可能存在平行宇宙。

e.en: The novel jumps between two fictional {universes}.
e.zh: 这本小说在两个虚构宇宙之间来回切换。

e.en: Top {universities} are competing to attract AI researchers.
e.zh: 顶尖大学正在争相吸引人工智能研究人员。

e.en: Many {universities} now offer fully online degrees.
e.zh: 许多大学现在都提供完全在线的学位课程。

e.en: She's applying to {university} in the fall.
e.zh: 她准备秋天申请大学。

e.en: The {university} library stays open until midnight.
e.zh: 这所大学的图书馆开到午夜。

e.en: The contract uses {univocal} language to avoid disputes.
e.zh: 这份合同使用单义的措辞以避免争议。

e.en: His response was clear and {univocal}: no.
e.zh: 他的回答清晰且没有歧义:不。

e.en: Most servers still run some flavor of {Unix}.
e.zh: 大多数服务器仍然运行某种Unix系统。

e.en: Learning basic {Unix} commands is essential for developers.
e.zh: 学习基础的Unix命令对开发者来说必不可少。

e.en: Some banks still run legacy software on {UnixWare} servers.
e.zh: 一些银行仍在 UnixWare 服务器上运行老旧软件。

e.en: The administrator migrated databases off the old {UnixWare} system.
e.zh: 管理员将数据库从旧的 UnixWare 系统迁移了出来。

unjust.t: adj. 不公正的；不公平的

e.en: Activists protested the {unjust} treatment of refugees.
e.zh: 活动人士抗议对难民的不公正待遇。

e.en: He felt the punishment was harsh and {unjust}.
e.zh: 他觉得这个处罚既严厉又不公正。

e.en: The civilian casualties were {unjustifiable} under any standard.
e.zh: 无论以何种标准衡量,平民伤亡都是不可原谅的。

e.en: Charging that much for water seems entirely {unjustifiable}.
e.zh: 对水收取那么高的价格似乎完全说不过去。

e.en: The fees were {unjustifiably} high for such basic service.
e.zh: 对于这么基础的服务,收费高得毫无道理。

e.en: Critics say the law {unjustifiably} targets minorities.
e.zh: 批评者称这项法律毫无理由地针对少数群体。

e.en: Her fears about flying turned out to be {unjustified}.
e.zh: 她对坐飞机的担忧后来证明是没必要的。

e.en: The manager's harsh criticism felt completely {unjustified}.
e.zh: 经理严厉的批评显得毫无道理。

e.en: He was {unjustly} fired after reporting safety violations.
e.zh: 他在举报安全违规后被不公正地解雇了。

e.en: Many innocent people have been {unjustly} convicted.
e.zh: 许多无辜者被冤枉定罪。

unkempt.t: adj. 蓬乱的；不修边幅的

e.en: His hair was {unkempt} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后他的头发凌乱不堪。

e.en: The garden looked {unkempt} and overgrown with weeds.
e.zh: 花园显得无人打理,杂草丛生。

e.en: It was {unkind} of him to mock her accent.
e.zh: 他嘲笑她的口音真是不友善。

e.en: Don't say {unkind} things about people behind their backs.
e.zh: 不要在背后说人坏话。

e.en: She spoke {unkindly} about her former colleague.
e.zh: 她对以前的同事说话很刻薄。

e.en: The old dog was treated {unkindly} by its previous owner.
e.zh: 这只老狗被前任主人苛待过。

e.en: I was hurt by the {unkindness} of his words.
e.zh: 他言语中的刻薄让我很受伤。

e.en: There's no excuse for such {unkindness} toward strangers.
e.zh: 对陌生人如此冷漠刻薄毫无借口。

e.en: It took ten minutes to {unknot} the tangled headphones.
e.zh: 花了十分钟才把缠在一起的耳机解开。

e.en: A hot bath helped {unknot} her tense shoulders.
e.zh: 热水澡帮她放松了紧绷的肩膀。

e.en: The exact cause of the crash may be {unknowable}.
e.zh: 这场坠机的确切原因可能永远无法得知。

e.en: Some things about consciousness remain fundamentally {unknowable}.
e.zh: 关于意识的某些事情根本无法被认知。

e.en: She was the {unknowing} subject of a research study.
e.zh: 她在不知情的情况下成为了一项研究的对象。

e.en: He became an {unknowing} accomplice to the fraud.
e.zh: 他在不知情中成了这场欺诈的同谋。

e.en: I {unknowingly} downloaded a virus from that website.
e.zh: 我在不知情的情况下从那个网站下载了病毒。

e.en: She {unknowingly} sat next to a famous actor.
e.zh: 她不知不觉中坐在了一位著名演员旁边。

unknown.t:
adj. 未知的
n. 未知的人或事

e.en: The cause of the outage is still {unknown}.
e.zh: 故障的原因目前仍然未知。

e.en: She traveled to a remote, {unknown} corner of the country.
e.zh: 她去了这个国家一个偏远而鲜为人知的角落。

unlabeled.t: adj. 未标记的；无标签的

e.en: Don't eat anything from {unlabeled} containers in the fridge.
e.zh: 不要吃冰箱里没有标签的容器中的东西。

e.en: The dataset had thousands of {unlabeled} images to sort.
e.zh: 该数据集有数千张未标注的图片需要分类。

unlabelled.t: adj. 未标记的（英式拼写）

e.en: Researchers trained the model on {unlabelled} text data.
e.zh: 研究人员用未标注的文本数据训练了模型。

e.en: The {unlabelled} bottle on the shelf looked suspicious.
e.zh: 架子上那个没有标签的瓶子看起来可疑。

e.en: He sat down to {unlace} his muddy hiking boots.
e.zh: 他坐下来解开沾满泥巴的登山靴的鞋带。

e.en: She bent over to {unlace} her sneakers after the run.
e.zh: 跑完步后她弯腰解开运动鞋的鞋带。

e.en: His sneakers were {unlaced} as he ran for the bus.
e.zh: 他赶公交车时运动鞋的鞋带是松开的。

e.en: She {unlaced} her boots and sighed with relief.
e.zh: 她解开靴子的鞋带,如释重负地叹了口气。

e.en: The truck weighs three tons when completely {unladen}.
e.zh: 这辆卡车在完全没有装货时重三吨。

e.en: What's the airspeed velocity of an {unladen} swallow?
e.zh: 一只没载货的燕子的飞行速度是多少?

e.en: Grandma considered loud laughter quite {unladylike}.
e.zh: 奶奶认为大声笑很不淑女。

e.en: She let out an {unladylike} burp after dinner.
e.zh: 她晚饭后毫不淑女地打了个嗝。

e.en: The corrupt official's resignation went largely {unlamented}.
e.zh: 这位腐败官员的辞职几乎没人感到惋惜。

e.en: His departure from the company was {unlamented} by colleagues.
e.zh: 他从公司离职,同事们都没觉得可惜。

e.en: She reached over to {unlatch} the garden gate.
e.zh: 她伸手过去打开花园门的插销。

e.en: Press the button to {unlatch} the trunk automatically.
e.zh: 按下按钮可自动打开后备箱锁扣。

undimmed.t: adj. 未变暗的；未减弱的

e.en: His enthusiasm for science remained {undimmed} into old age.
e.zh: 他对科学的热情直到晚年依然不减。

e.en: The stars shone {undimmed} above the quiet desert.
e.zh: 星星在寂静的沙漠上空明亮地闪耀着。

undiplomatic.t: adj. 不圆滑的；不得体的

e.en: His {undiplomatic} reply offended several guests at the dinner.
e.zh: 他不圆滑的回答冒犯了晚宴上的好几位客人。

e.en: Telling the boss she was wrong was rather {undiplomatic}.
e.zh: 直接告诉老板她错了实在不太得体。

undirected.t: adj. 无方向的；无目标的

e.en: The students wasted hours on {undirected} research without a clear goal.
e.zh: 学生们在没有明确目标的研究上浪费了好几个小时。

e.en: Her anger felt {undirected}, just bouncing around the room.
e.zh: 她的怒火显得漫无目标,只在房间里乱窜。

undischarged.t: adj. 未履行的；未偿清的

e.en: He still has several {undischarged} debts from college.
e.zh: 他大学时期还有几笔未偿清的债务。

e.en: The {undischarged} bankrupt cannot legally run a company.
e.zh: 未解除破产身份的人不能合法经营公司。

e.en: The team played in an {undisciplined} way and lost badly.
e.zh: 球队打得毫无纪律,结果输得很惨。

e.en: Her {undisciplined} writing habits made finishing the novel impossible.
e.zh: 她散漫的写作习惯让她根本写不完这本小说。

e.en: The startup was sold for an {undisclosed} amount last week.
e.zh: 这家初创公司上周以未公开的金额被收购。

e.en: She left the company for {undisclosed} personal reasons.
e.zh: 她因未公开的个人原因离开了公司。

e.en: Many species in the deep ocean remain {undiscovered} today.
e.zh: 深海中仍有许多物种至今未被发现。

e.en: The bug stayed {undiscovered} in production for almost a year.
e.zh: 这个 bug 在生产环境潜伏了将近一年都没被发现。

undiscriminating.t: adj. 不加区分的；无鉴别力的

e.en: He has an {undiscriminating} appetite and eats almost anything.
e.zh: 他口味不挑,几乎什么都吃。

e.en: The algorithm is {undiscriminating} and recommends low-quality videos too.
e.zh: 这个算法不加甄别,连低质量视频也会推荐。

e.en: Several important issues remained {undiscussed} at the meeting.
e.zh: 会议上有几个重要议题没有被讨论。

e.en: Salary expectations are often left {undiscussed} until later interviews.
e.zh: 薪资期望通常要到后面几轮面试才会谈。

undisguised.t: adj. 不加掩饰的；公然的

e.en: She watched the show with {undisguised} delight on her face.
e.zh: 她看节目时脸上写满了毫不掩饰的喜悦。

e.en: His {undisguised} contempt for the proposal was obvious to everyone.
e.zh: 他对这个提案毫不掩饰的鄙视谁都看得出来。

e.en: She remained {undismayed} despite the harsh online criticism.
e.zh: 尽管网上批评声不断,她依然毫不气馁。

e.en: The startup founder seemed {undismayed} by the funding rejection.
e.zh: 这位创业者对融资被拒似乎并不沮丧。

e.en: The data showed an {undisputable} link between sleep and mood.
e.zh: 数据显示睡眠与情绪之间有着不可争辩的关联。

e.en: Her talent at the piano is {undisputable}.
e.zh: 她在钢琴上的天赋是无可争辩的。

e.en: She is the {undisputed} champion of the regional chess league.
e.zh: 她是该地区国际象棋联赛公认的冠军。

e.en: Tokyo remains the {undisputed} capital of Japanese pop culture.
e.zh: 东京依然是日本流行文化无可争议的中心。

e.en: He had a long but {undistinguished} career at the bank.
e.zh: 他在银行工作了很久,但表现平平,毫无建树。

e.en: The food was decent but the service was {undistinguished}.
e.zh: 食物还不错,但服务平平无奇。

undistorted.t: adj. 未失真的；未扭曲的

e.en: This microphone captures {undistorted} audio even at high volumes.
e.zh: 这款麦克风即使在大音量下也能录下不失真的声音。

e.en: We need an {undistorted} view of the actual user data.
e.zh: 我们需要看到真实用户数据未经扭曲的样子。

undistributed.t: adj. 未分配的；未分发的

e.en: The company holds millions in {undistributed} profits from last year.
e.zh: 公司持有去年数百万美元尚未分配的利润。

e.en: Several {undistributed} flyers were still sitting in the office.
e.zh: 还有一些未派发的传单堆在办公室里。

undisturbed.t: adj. 未被打扰的；平静的

e.en: The cat slept {undisturbed} on the warm windowsill all afternoon.
e.zh: 猫整个下午都安然无恙地睡在温暖的窗台上。

e.en: Please leave the documents on my desk {undisturbed}.
e.zh: 请别动我桌上的那些文件。

e.en: Please give me your {undivided} attention for five minutes.
e.zh: 请你专心听我说五分钟。

e.en: The team showed {undivided} support for the new strategy.
e.zh: 团队对新策略表现出毫无保留的支持。

e.en: Press Ctrl+Z to {undo} your last action.
e.zh: 按 Ctrl+Z 可以撤销上一步操作。

e.en: Years of trust can be hard to {undo} in one mistake.
e.zh: 多年的信任很难因为一次失误就一笔勾销。

undocumented.t: adj. 无证件的；无文档的

e.en: The API has many {undocumented} features that developers discover by accident.
e.zh: 这个 API 有许多未写进文档的功能,开发者都是偶然发现的。

e.en: Many {undocumented} workers face difficult conditions in the agriculture industry.
e.zh: 许多无证劳工在农业领域面临艰难的工作环境。

undoes.t: v. undo 的第三人称单数

e.en: This button {undoes} the most recent edit instantly.
e.zh: 这个按钮会立即撤销最近一次编辑。

e.en: One careless tweet sometimes {undoes} years of brand building.
e.zh: 一条不慎发出的推文有时会毁掉多年的品牌经营。

undoing.t:
n. 毁灭的原因
v. undo 的现在分词

e.en: Greed turned out to be his {undoing} in the end.
e.zh: 贪婪最终成了他垮台的原因。

e.en: She kept {undoing} and redoing the same paragraph.
e.zh: 她一直反复修改同一段话。

e.en: Wolves are {undomesticated} animals and should not be kept as pets.
e.zh: 狼是未驯化的动物,不应当宠物养。

e.en: His {undomesticated} lifestyle meant his apartment was always a mess.
e.zh: 他不爱料理生活,公寓里总是乱糟糟的。

e.en: Half the chores on the list are still {undone}.
e.zh: 清单上的家务还有一半没做。

e.en: His shoelaces came {undone} as he ran for the bus.
e.zh: 他追公车时鞋带松开了。

e.en: Her {undoubted} skill as a coder earned her quick promotions.
e.zh: 她无可置疑的编程能力让她很快获得晋升。

e.en: The film's {undoubted} success surprised even the director.
e.zh: 这部电影毋庸置疑的成功连导演自己都感到意外。

e.en: This is {undoubtedly} the best ramen I've ever had.
e.zh: 这毫无疑问是我吃过最好吃的拉面。

e.en: AI will {undoubtedly} change how we work in the next decade.
e.zh: 未来十年人工智能无疑将改变我们的工作方式。

e.en: The {undrained} field flooded again after the heavy rain.
e.zh: 那块没排水的田地大雨过后又被淹了。

e.en: Cooking pasta in {undrained} water makes it soggy.
e.zh: 煮意面时不沥水,面条会变得软烂。

undramatic.t: adj. 平淡的；不戏剧化的

e.en: Their breakup was surprisingly quiet and {undramatic}.
e.zh: 他们分手出乎意料地平静,没什么风波。

e.en: The movie's ending felt flat and {undramatic}.
e.zh: 这部电影的结尾显得平淡,没有戏剧张力。

undreamed.t: adj. 未曾梦想的；意想不到的

e.en: The internet brought {undreamed} of opportunities to small businesses.
e.zh: 互联网为小企业带来了从前难以想象的机遇。

e.en: She achieved success {undreamed} of by her parents' generation.
e.zh: 她取得了父辈那一代人做梦也想不到的成就。

undreamt.t: adj. 未曾梦想的（undreamed 变体）

e.en: Smartphones gave us powers {undreamt} of fifty years ago.
e.zh: 智能手机让我们拥有了五十年前难以想象的能力。

e.en: The startup reached scales {undreamt} of in its early days.
e.zh: 这家初创公司发展到了创立初期想都不敢想的规模。

e.en: The toddler learned to {undress} herself before bath time.
e.zh: 这个小女孩学会了在洗澡前自己脱衣服。

e.en: Please {undress} behind the curtain for the examination.
e.zh: 请到帘子后面脱衣服准备检查。

undressed.t:
adj. 未穿衣的
v. undress 的过去式

e.en: He {undressed} quickly and jumped into the shower.
e.zh: 他迅速脱下衣服跳进了淋浴间。

e.en: She prefers her salad {undressed} with just olive oil.
e.zh: 她喜欢沙拉不加酱汁,只淋一点橄榄油。

undresses.t: v. undress 的第三人称单数

e.en: He always {undresses} in the dark to avoid waking his partner.
e.zh: 他总是摸黑脱衣服,免得吵醒伴侣。

e.en: The toddler {undresses} her doll over and over again.
e.zh: 那个小女孩反复给娃娃脱衣服玩。

e.en: She caught him {undressing} the mannequin in the store window.
e.zh: 她撞见他在橱窗里给模特脱衣服。

e.en: He started {undressing} the moment he got home from work.
e.zh: 他下班一进门就开始脱衣服。

e.en: The tap water in that town is basically {undrinkable}.
e.zh: 那个镇上的自来水基本上不能喝。

e.en: This coffee is cold and totally {undrinkable} now.
e.zh: 这咖啡已经凉了,完全没法喝。

e.en: The contract places {undue} burden on the freelancer.
e.zh: 这份合同给自由职业者带来了过分的负担。

e.en: Don't put {undue} pressure on yourself before the exam.
e.zh: 考试前别给自己施加过多的压力。

e.en: The dancer moved with slow, {undulant} grace across the stage.
e.zh: 舞者在舞台上以缓慢起伏的优雅姿态移动。

e.en: We drove through the {undulant} hills of the wine country.
e.zh: 我们开车穿过葡萄酒产区那片绵延起伏的丘陵。

e.en: The flag began to {undulate} gently in the morning breeze.
e.zh: 旗帜在晨风中开始轻轻飘动起伏。

e.en: Watch the wheat fields {undulate} like waves in the wind.
e.zh: 看那麦田在风中像波浪般起伏。

e.en: The road wound through {undulating} hills covered in vineyards.
e.zh: 道路蜿蜒穿过种满葡萄园的连绵起伏的山丘。

e.en: Her {undulating} voice held the audience completely captive.
e.zh: 她抑扬顿挫的嗓音让全场观众听得入神。

e.en: The boat rocked with the gentle {undulation} of the lake.
e.zh: 小船随着湖面轻柔的波动摇晃着。

e.en: Each {undulation} of the dancer's arms told part of the story.
e.zh: 舞者手臂的每一次起伏都在讲述故事的一部分。

e.en: Don't worry {unduly} about a few negative reviews online.
e.zh: 不必为网上几条负面评价过度担心。

e.en: The new policy {unduly} favors larger corporations over startups.
e.zh: 新政策过分偏袒大公司而对初创企业不利。

unduplicated.t: adj. 未重复的；独一无二的

e.en: The report counts only {unduplicated} users across all platforms.
e.zh: 该报告只统计所有平台去重后的用户数。

e.en: Each handmade vase has an {unduplicated} pattern of glaze.
e.zh: 每只手工花瓶上的釉彩图案都独一无二。

e.en: She prefers {undyed} cotton clothes for their natural texture.
e.zh: 她喜欢未经染色的棉质衣物,因为质感天然。

e.en: His {undyed} gray hair gave him a distinguished look.
e.zh: 他那头未染过的灰发让他显得颇有气质。

e.en: She has an {undying} love for old French films.
e.zh: 她对老式法国电影怀有不灭的热爱。

e.en: The fans showed {undying} loyalty to the band for decades.
e.zh: 几十年来粉丝们对乐队展现出始终不渝的忠诚。

unearned.t: adj. 非劳动所得的；不该得的

e.en: He felt his praise was {unearned} and made him uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他觉得这些赞美自己受之有愧,让他很不自在。

e.en: The book criticizes systems built on {unearned} privilege.
e.zh: 这本书批判了那些建立在不劳而获的特权之上的体制。

e.en: Reporters managed to {unearth} new evidence about the scandal.
e.zh: 记者们成功挖出了关于这起丑闻的新证据。

e.en: Archaeologists hope to {unearth} ancient pottery at the site.
e.zh: 考古学家希望在该遗址挖掘出古代陶器。

unearthed.t: v. unearth 的过去式；被挖出

e.en: Workers {unearthed} a Roman coin while digging the foundation.
e.zh: 工人们在挖地基时挖出了一枚罗马钱币。

e.en: The journalist {unearthed} emails proving the company knew about the risk.
e.zh: 记者挖出了证明公司早知风险的邮件。

e.en: The team is {unearthing} dinosaur bones in the Gobi Desert.
e.zh: 团队正在戈壁沙漠挖掘恐龙化石。

e.en: The audit is {unearthing} financial irregularities in several departments.
e.zh: 这次审计正在揭露好几个部门的财务违规问题。

e.en: The cave glowed with an {unearthly} blue light.
e.zh: 洞穴中闪烁着一种诡异超凡的蓝光。

e.en: Why are you calling me at this {unearthly} hour?
e.zh: 你为什么在这么离谱的时间打电话给我?

e.en: Recording private conversations is {unlawful} in many states.
e.zh: 在许多州,录制私人谈话是非法的。

e.en: The court ruled the search was {unlawful}.
e.zh: 法庭裁定该搜查行为违法。

e.en: The company was accused of {unlawfully} firing whistleblowers.
e.zh: 该公司被指控非法解雇举报人。

e.en: He had {unlawfully} entered the building after hours.
e.zh: 他在下班后非法进入了大楼。

e.en: Most modern cars require {unleaded} gasoline only.
e.zh: 大多数现代汽车只能加无铅汽油。

e.en: The station was out of regular {unleaded} fuel.
e.zh: 加油站的普通无铅汽油用完了。

unlearn.t: v. 摒弃（已学的知识或习惯）

e.en: It's hard to {unlearn} bad habits formed in childhood.
e.zh: 摆脱童年养成的坏习惯很难。

e.en: Coaches help athletes {unlearn} flawed techniques before competition.
e.zh: 教练帮助运动员在比赛前改掉错误的技术动作。

unlearned.t: adj. 未经学习的；无学识的

e.en: She had {unlearned} years of poor posture through therapy.
e.zh: 她通过治疗改掉了多年的不良姿势。

e.en: Some lessons remain {unlearned} no matter how often repeated.
e.zh: 有些教训无论重复多少次都没人吸取。

unleash.t: v. 释放，激发（情绪、力量）

e.en: The new update will {unleash} powerful editing features.
e.zh: 新版更新将释放强大的编辑功能。

e.en: Don't {unleash} your dog in the public park.
e.zh: 不要在公共公园里把狗放开。

unleashed.t:
v. unleash 的过去式
adj. 被释放的

e.en: The storm {unleashed} heavy floods across the coastal towns.
e.zh: 风暴在沿海城镇引发了严重洪水。

e.en: Her speech {unleashed} a wave of online debate.
e.zh: 她的演讲在网上掀起了一波讨论热潮。

unleashing.t:
v. unleash 的现在分词
n. 释放

e.en: AI is {unleashing} a wave of new productivity tools.
e.zh: 人工智能正在催生一波新的生产力工具。

e.en: The volcano kept {unleashing} ash for several days.
e.zh: 火山持续喷发火山灰好几天。

e.en: They eat {unleavened} bread during the religious festival.
e.zh: 他们在宗教节日期间食用无酵饼。

e.en: The recipe calls for thin, {unleavened} flatbread.
e.zh: 这道食谱需要薄薄的无酵饼。

e.en: I won't go {unless} you come with me.
e.zh: 除非你跟我一起去,否则我不去。

e.en: The meeting starts at nine {unless} something changes.
e.zh: 除非有变动,否则会议九点开始。

unlettered.t: adj. 未受教育的，文盲的

e.en: Many {unlettered} villagers rely on radio for news.
e.zh: 许多不识字的村民依靠广播获取新闻。

e.en: He was {unlettered} but extremely wise about people.
e.zh: 他没读过书,却极懂人情世故。

unlicensed.t: adj. 无执照的，未经许可的

e.en: Driving an {unlicensed} vehicle can lead to heavy fines.
e.zh: 驾驶无牌车辆可能会被处以重罚。

e.en: Avoid {unlicensed} contractors when renovating your home.
e.zh: 装修房屋时要避开无证承包商。

unlighted.t: adj. 未点燃的；无照明的

e.en: She walked carefully down the {unlighted} alley at night.
e.zh: 夜里她小心翼翼地走过那条没有灯的小巷。

e.en: An {unlighted} candle sat on the dusty windowsill.
e.zh: 一支未点燃的蜡烛立在落满灰的窗台上。

unlikable.t: adj. 讨人厌的，不招人喜欢的

e.en: The villain was deliberately written as deeply {unlikable}.
e.zh: 这个反派被刻意写得十分讨人厌。

e.en: Her cold tone made her seem {unlikable} at first.
e.zh: 她冷淡的语气让人一开始觉得她不讨喜。

unlike.t:
prep. 不像，和…不同
adj. 不同的

e.en: {Unlike} her brother, she enjoys spicy food.
e.zh: 和哥哥不同,她喜欢吃辣。

e.en: This phone is {unlike} anything on the market.
e.zh: 这款手机和市面上任何产品都不同。

unlikelihood.t: n. 不太可能，不大可能发生

e.en: Despite the {unlikelihood} of success, the team kept trying.
e.zh: 尽管成功的可能性极小,团队仍坚持尝试。

e.en: Investors worried about the {unlikelihood} of timely repayment.
e.zh: 投资者担心按时还款的可能性渺茫。

unlikely.t: adj. 不太可能的，未必的

e.en: It's {unlikely} to rain during our trip next week.
e.zh: 我们下周旅行期间不太可能下雨。

e.en: They formed an {unlikely} friendship at summer camp.
e.zh: 他们在夏令营结下了一段意想不到的友谊。

e.en: The {unlikeness} between the twins surprised everyone.
e.zh: 这对双胞胎的差异让所有人都很意外。

e.en: Critics noted the {unlikeness} of the portrait to its subject.
e.zh: 评论家指出这幅肖像与本人并不相像。

e.en: The plan offers {unlimited} data for streaming videos.
e.zh: 该套餐提供无限流量用于视频观看。

e.en: Children seem to have {unlimited} energy on weekends.
e.zh: 孩子们周末似乎有用不完的精力。

unlined.t: adj. 无衬里的；无皱纹的

e.en: Despite his age, his face remained smooth and {unlined}.
e.zh: 尽管上了年纪,他的脸依旧光滑没有皱纹。

e.en: She prefers an {unlined} jacket for warmer weather.
e.zh: 天气暖和时她更喜欢没有内衬的外套。

unlisted.t: adj. 未列入名单的；未上市的

e.en: His phone number is {unlisted} for privacy reasons.
e.zh: 出于隐私考虑,他的电话号码未公开。

e.en: Share the link only as an {unlisted} video.
e.zh: 只以不公开视频的形式分享链接。

unlit.t: adj. 未点燃的，无灯光的

e.en: An {unlit} cigarette dangled from his lips.
e.zh: 一支没点燃的香烟叼在他嘴边。

e.en: The hikers crossed an {unlit} bridge after sunset.
e.zh: 日落后徒步者走过一座没有灯光的桥。

e.en: Rising rents have made the city nearly {unlivable}.
e.zh: 不断上涨的房租让这座城市几乎无法居住。

e.en: The damaged apartment was declared {unlivable} by inspectors.
e.zh: 检查员判定这套受损公寓不适合居住。

unload.t: v. 卸货；卸载（程序、内存）

e.en: Help me {unload} the groceries from the car.
e.zh: 帮我把杂货从车里搬下来。

e.en: She needed to {unload} her worries on a friend.
e.zh: 她需要向朋友倾诉一下心中的烦恼。

unloaded.t:
v. unload 的过去式
adj. 已卸下的

e.en: The workers {unloaded} crates from the truck all morning.
e.zh: 工人们整个上午都在从卡车上卸货。

e.en: He {unloaded} his frustrations during the long phone call.
e.zh: 他在那通长电话里一股脑发泄了所有不满。

unloading.t:
v. unload 的现在分词
n. 卸货

e.en: Crew members were {unloading} luggage onto the platform.
e.zh: 工作人员正在把行李卸到站台上。

e.en: Be careful when {unloading} fragile items from the box.
e.zh: 从箱子里取出易碎物品时要小心。

unloads.t: v. unload 的第三人称单数

e.en: The ferry {unloads} passengers every twenty minutes.
e.zh: 渡轮每二十分钟卸下一批乘客。

e.en: He often {unloads} his stress by going for a run.
e.zh: 他常常通过跑步来释放压力。

unlock.t: v. 解锁（手机、成就、功能）

e.en: Use your fingerprint to {unlock} the phone instantly.
e.zh: 用指纹可以即时解锁手机。

e.en: Reading widely can {unlock} your creative potential.
e.zh: 广泛阅读能激发你的创造潜能。

unlocked.t:
v. unlock 的过去式
adj. 未上锁的

e.en: She {unlocked} the door and stepped inside quietly.
e.zh: 她打开门,悄悄走了进去。

e.en: Completing the level {unlocked} a hidden bonus character.
e.zh: 通关该关卡解锁了一个隐藏的奖励角色。

unlocking.t:
v. unlock 的现在分词
n. 解锁

e.en: He spent ten minutes {unlocking} his bike from the rack.
e.zh: 他花了十分钟才把自行车从车架上解开。

e.en: The course focuses on {unlocking} hidden iPhone features.
e.zh: 这门课程专注于挖掘 iPhone 的隐藏功能。

unlocks.t: v. unlock 的第三人称单数

e.en: This card {unlocks} every door in the office building.
e.zh: 这张卡可以打开办公楼里的每一扇门。

e.en: Practice {unlocks} skills you never knew you had.
e.zh: 练习能让你发现自己从未察觉的能力。

e.en: Trauma can make people feel {unlovable} as adults.
e.zh: 创伤可能让人成年后觉得自己不值得被爱。

e.en: No child should ever be made to feel {unlovable}.
e.zh: 不应让任何孩子觉得自己不被爱。

unlove.t: v. 不再爱；（应用）取消喜欢

e.en: You can't simply {unlove} someone after years together.
e.zh: 在一起多年后,你无法说不爱就不爱。

e.en: She wished she could {unlove} him and move on.
e.zh: 她真希望能不再爱他,然后继续生活。

unloved.t: adj. 不被爱的，无人疼爱的

e.en: The stray dog looked sad and {unloved} in the rain.
e.zh: 那只流浪狗在雨中显得悲伤又无人疼爱。

e.en: Many old buildings sit {unloved} and slowly decay.
e.zh: 许多老建筑无人问津,慢慢破败。

unlovely.t: adj. 不好看的，不讨人喜欢的

e.en: The factory district is functional but rather {unlovely}.
e.zh: 工厂区虽然实用,但相当不美观。

e.en: Her {unlovely} remarks ruined the dinner mood.
e.zh: 她那些难听的话毁了晚餐的气氛。

e.en: {Unluckily}, the train was canceled due to heavy snow.
e.zh: 不巧的是,火车因大雪被取消了。

e.en: He {unluckily} missed the deadline by just one minute.
e.zh: 他很不幸地只差一分钟就错过了截止时间。

e.en: Some people consider thirteen an {unlucky} number.
e.zh: 有些人认为十三是个不吉利的数字。

e.en: She felt {unlucky} after losing her keys again.
e.zh: 又一次弄丢钥匙后,她觉得自己真倒霉。

unmade.t: adj. 未整理的（床）；未制成的

e.en: His {unmade} bed was a sign of a rushed morning.
e.zh: 他没整理的床显示出早晨匆忙出门。

e.en: The decision could be quickly {unmade} if needed.
e.zh: 如有需要,这项决定可以迅速被推翻。

e.en: You can't {unmake} a promise once it's broken.
e.zh: 承诺一旦被打破就无法收回。

e.en: The ruling party tried to {unmake} the previous reforms.
e.zh: 执政党试图推翻先前的改革。

unmaking.t:
v. unmake 的现在分词
n. 废除

e.en: The scandal was slowly {unmaking} his political career.
e.zh: 这场丑闻正在慢慢毁掉他的政治生涯。

e.en: Climate change is {unmaking} ecosystems around the world.
e.zh: 气候变化正在瓦解世界各地的生态系统。

unmanageable.t: adj. 难以控制的，难管理的

e.en: Her inbox had grown completely {unmanageable} over the year.
e.zh: 她的邮箱在过去一年里已经完全管不过来了。

e.en: The crowd became {unmanageable} after the concert ended.
e.zh: 演唱会结束后人群变得难以控制。

unmanaged.t: adj. 未经管理的，无托管的

e.en: {Unmanaged} stress can lead to serious health problems.
e.zh: 得不到管理的压力可能引发严重的健康问题。

e.en: The forest sat {unmanaged} for decades and grew wild.
e.zh: 那片森林几十年无人打理,长得十分野蛮。

unmanly.t: adj. 不像男子汉的，懦弱的

e.en: Outdated stereotypes label crying as somehow {unmanly}.
e.zh: 过时的刻板印象把哭泣视为不够男子气。

e.en: He refused to see asking for help as {unmanly}.
e.zh: 他不认为求助是件有失男子气概的事。

unmanned.t: adj. 无人操控的（飞机、车辆）

e.en: The {unmanned} drone surveyed the disaster area from above.
e.zh: 无人机从空中勘察了灾区。

e.en: Many gas stations now operate as {unmanned} self-service.
e.zh: 许多加油站现在以无人自助方式运营。

e.en: It's quite {unmannerly} to interrupt people while they speak.
e.zh: 在别人说话时打断他人是很没礼貌的。

e.en: His {unmannerly} behavior embarrassed his parents at dinner.
e.zh: 他在晚餐上的粗鲁行为让父母十分尴尬。

unmapped.t: adj. 未绘图的；未映射的（内存）

e.en: Explorers ventured into the {unmapped} regions of the jungle.
e.zh: 探险者深入丛林中尚未被绘制的区域。

e.en: The deep ocean remains largely {unmapped} even today.
e.zh: 即使在今天,深海仍大部分未被测绘。

unmarked.t: adj. 没有标记的；未标注的

e.en: An {unmarked} police car followed the suspect quietly.
e.zh: 一辆没有标识的警车悄悄跟着嫌疑人。

e.en: His grave lay {unmarked} in the small country cemetery.
e.zh: 他的坟墓在乡村小墓园里没有任何墓碑。

unmarketable.t: adj. 卖不出去的，无市场的

e.en: The damaged fruit was deemed {unmarketable} by the buyer.
e.zh: 这些受损水果被买家判定为无法销售。

e.en: Outdated technology quickly becomes {unmarketable} in this industry.
e.zh: 过时的技术在这个行业很快就卖不出去。

unmarred.t: adj. 完好无损的，未被破坏的

e.en: Her record remained {unmarred} after twenty years of service.
e.zh: 她服务二十年来履历依然完美无瑕。

e.en: The valley was beautiful and {unmarred} by development.
e.zh: 山谷美丽,未被开发破坏。

e.en: More adults are choosing to remain {unmarried} these days.
e.zh: 如今越来越多的成年人选择保持单身。

e.en: Her {unmarried} aunt traveled the world for decades.
e.zh: 她未婚的姑妈环游世界几十年。

e.en: Journalists worked hard to {unmask} the corrupt official.
e.zh: 记者努力揭露那位腐败官员的真面目。

e.en: The detective vowed to {unmask} the real culprit.
e.zh: 侦探发誓要揭穿真正的罪犯。

e.en: The documentary focused on {unmasking} corporate greed.
e.zh: 这部纪录片致力于揭露企业的贪婪。

e.en: His memoir is an {unmasking} of fashion industry secrets.
e.zh: 他的回忆录揭露了时尚行业的种种内幕。

e.en: The chef's signature dish has an {unmatchable} flavor.
e.zh: 这位厨师的招牌菜风味无可匹敌。

e.en: Her dedication to students is truly {unmatchable}.
e.zh: 她对学生的付出无人能及。

unmatched.t:
adj. 无可比拟的
adj. 未配对的

e.en: Her skill in negotiation remains {unmatched} in the industry.
e.zh: 她的谈判技巧在业内无人能及。

e.en: The shipment arrived with several {unmatched} socks inside.
e.zh: 包裹到达时里面有几只不成对的袜子。

e.en: The damage to her reputation is almost {unmeasurable}.
e.zh: 她名誉所受的损害几乎无法估量。

e.en: Grief is often an {unmeasurable} weight on the heart.
e.zh: 悲伤往往是心头难以衡量的重负。

unmeasured.t: adj. 未经测量的；无节制的

e.en: He poured an {unmeasured} amount of soy sauce into the pan.
e.zh: 他随手往锅里倒了一些酱油,没有计量。

e.en: Her response was full of {unmeasured} enthusiasm.
e.zh: 她的回应充满了毫无节制的热情。

unmediated.t: adj. 未经中介的、直接的

e.en: Social media offers {unmediated} access to public figures.
e.zh: 社交媒体让人们能直接接触公众人物。

e.en: The film captures the {unmediated} reality of street life.
e.zh: 这部影片呈现了未经修饰的街头真实生活。

unmemorable.t: adj. 平淡无奇、不值得记住的

e.en: The movie was pleasant but ultimately {unmemorable}.
e.zh: 那部电影还算愉快,但终究让人印象不深。

e.en: Most hotel breakfasts are sadly {unmemorable}.
e.zh: 大多数酒店早餐都平淡无奇,令人遗憾。

e.en: At dinner, politics was an {unmentionable} topic.
e.zh: 在饭桌上,政治是不可提起的话题。

e.en: She blushed at the {unmentionable} stain on his shirt.
e.zh: 看到他衬衫上那块难以启齿的污渍,她脸红了。

e.en: Several key risks went {unmentioned} in the report.
e.zh: 报告中没有提到几个关键风险。

e.en: His earlier promise remained {unmentioned} during the meeting.
e.zh: 会议期间他早先的承诺一直没被提起。

e.en: The summer sun was {unmerciful} on the construction crew.
e.zh: 夏日的烈日对施工队毫不留情。

e.en: Critics were {unmerciful} about her debut album.
e.zh: 评论家对她的首张专辑毫不留情。

e.en: The kids teased him {unmercifully} about his haircut.
e.zh: 孩子们对他的发型毫不留情地取笑。

e.en: The coach drove the team {unmercifully} before the finals.
e.zh: 决赛前教练对球队进行了无情的高强度训练。

e.en: He received {unmerited} praise for someone else's work.
e.zh: 他因别人的工作得到了不应得的赞美。

e.en: The harsh punishment seemed entirely {unmerited}.
e.zh: 那严厉的惩罚看起来完全不应得。

unmet.t: adj. (需求等) 未得到满足的

e.en: The app addresses a clear {unmet} need in the market.
e.zh: 这款应用满足了市场上一项明显未被满足的需求。

e.en: Several deadlines went {unmet} this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度有好几个截止期限未能达成。

e.en: He walked into traffic, {unmindful} of the danger.
e.zh: 他走进车流,完全没注意到危险。

e.en: She kept typing, {unmindful} of the chatter around her.
e.zh: 她继续打字,丝毫不在意周围的闲聊。

e.en: The new exhibition is absolutely {unmissable} for art lovers.
e.zh: 对于艺术爱好者来说,这个新展览绝对不容错过。

e.en: His bright orange jacket made him {unmissable} in the crowd.
e.zh: 他那件亮橙色外套让他在人群中无比醒目。

unmistakable.t: adj. 不会弄错的、明显的

e.en: There was an {unmistakable} smell of burning toast.
e.zh: 空气中有一股明显的烤面包焦味。

e.en: Her accent was the {unmistakable} sound of east London.
e.zh: 她的口音一听就是东伦敦的腔调。

e.en: The handwriting was {unmistakably} her grandfather's.
e.zh: 那笔迹一眼就能认出是她爷爷的。

e.en: His tone was {unmistakably} sarcastic during the call.
e.zh: 他通话时的语气明显带着讽刺。

e.en: The launch was an {unmitigated} disaster for the startup.
e.zh: 那次发布对这家初创公司来说是一场彻底的灾难。

e.en: She watched the show with {unmitigated} delight.
e.zh: 她带着毫不掩饰的喜悦看完了那场演出。

e.en: The news brought her {unmixed} joy for once.
e.zh: 这次的消息给她带来了难得的纯粹喜悦。

e.en: Stir well, since the powder is still {unmixed} at the bottom.
e.zh: 好好搅一搅,粉末还沉在底部没有混匀。

e.en: The script runs fine on the {unmodified} default settings.
e.zh: 脚本在未修改的默认设置下运行正常。

e.en: She prefers her coffee {unmodified} by sugar or cream.
e.zh: 她喜欢喝不加糖也不加奶的原味咖啡。

e.en: His {unmodulated} voice droned through the entire lecture.
e.zh: 他毫无起伏的声音贯穿了整场讲座。

e.en: The {unmodulated} signal sounded flat over the radio.
e.zh: 未经调制的信号在无线电里听起来很平。

e.en: The package sat {unmolested} on the porch all afternoon.
e.zh: 那个包裹整个下午都安然无恙地放在门廊上。

e.en: Wildlife thrives here, {unmolested} by human activity.
e.zh: 野生动物在这里不受人类活动干扰,繁衍生息。

unmotivated.t: adj. 缺乏动力的；无端的

e.en: She felt completely {unmotivated} after weeks of overtime.
e.zh: 连续加班数周后,她感到完全提不起干劲。

e.en: The sudden plot twist seemed {unmotivated} and forced.
e.zh: 剧情突然反转显得毫无铺垫,十分牵强。

unmounted.t: adj. 未挂载的、未安装的

e.en: The hard drive shows up as {unmounted} in the file manager.
e.zh: 硬盘在文件管理器中显示为未挂载状态。

e.en: Several photos lay {unmounted} on the studio table.
e.zh: 几张照片还没装裱,摊在工作室的桌上。

e.en: The corrupt regime fell, largely {unmourned} by its citizens.
e.zh: 那个腐败政权倒台了,几乎没人为它惋惜。

e.en: His departure from the company went {unmourned}.
e.zh: 他离开公司一事并未引起任何不舍。

unmovable.t: adj. 无法移动的；不动摇的

e.en: The boulder proved {unmovable} despite their efforts.
e.zh: 尽管他们使尽全力,那块巨石依然纹丝不动。

e.en: On this issue, her stance is completely {unmovable}.
e.zh: 在这个问题上,她的立场坚定不可动摇。

e.en: The judge remained {unmoved} by the emotional plea.
e.zh: 法官对那番充满感情的恳求无动于衷。

e.en: She was {unmoved} by his repeated apologies.
e.zh: 对他一再的道歉她毫不动容。

e.en: The cat sat {unmoving} on the windowsill for hours.
e.zh: 那只猫一动不动地在窗台上坐了几个小时。

e.en: Traffic was completely {unmoving} on the highway this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上高速公路上的车流完全停滞。

unmusical.t: adj. 不悦耳的；不懂音乐的

e.en: His singing voice was painfully {unmusical} but enthusiastic.
e.zh: 他的歌声虽不悦耳，却充满热情。

e.en: The construction noise made an {unmusical} backdrop to dinner.
e.zh: 施工噪音成了晚餐时刺耳的背景音。

e.en: The choir hummed {unmusically} during the rehearsal warm-up.
e.zh: 合唱团在彩排热身时哼得毫无乐感。

e.en: He whistled {unmusically} as he walked down the hall.
e.zh: 他走过走廊时口哨吹得不成调。

e.en: She felt an {unnamable} dread as the door opened.
e.zh: 门打开时，她感到一种难以名状的恐惧。

e.en: The painting evoked {unnamable} emotions in every viewer.
e.zh: 那幅画在每位观者心中都激起难以言喻的情感。

e.en: An {unnameable} sadness filled the room after the news.
e.zh: 消息传来后，房间里弥漫着一种难以言喻的悲伤。

e.en: He suffered from an {unnameable} fear in crowded places.
e.zh: 他在人多的地方会有一种说不清的恐惧。

e.en: An {unnamed} source confirmed the report to reporters.
e.zh: 一位未具名的消息人士向记者证实了这一报道。

e.en: The company's {unnamed} project has generated huge buzz online.
e.zh: 该公司尚未命名的项目在网上引起了巨大轰动。

e.en: The doll's smile looked {unnatural} and slightly creepy.
e.zh: 那个娃娃的笑容看上去不自然，还有点诡异。

e.en: It feels {unnatural} to talk to a camera all day.
e.zh: 对着摄像头说一整天话感觉很不自然。

e.en: Her skin looked {unnaturally} pale under the harsh lighting.
e.zh: 在刺眼的灯光下，她的皮肤显得异常苍白。

e.en: The room was {unnaturally} quiet during the announcement.
e.zh: 宣布消息时房间里出奇地安静。

e.en: You're worrying {unnecessarily} about a tiny issue.
e.zh: 你在为一个小问题做不必要的担心。

e.en: The contract was {unnecessarily} long and full of jargon.
e.zh: 这份合同冗长且满是术语，完全没必要。

e.en: Adding more meetings would be completely {unnecessary} right now.
e.zh: 现在再加会议完全没有必要。

e.en: She removed the {unnecessary} plugins to speed up her browser.
e.zh: 她移除了不必要的插件，让浏览器跑得更快。

e.en: I donated my {unneeded} clothes to the local shelter.
e.zh: 我把不需要的衣服捐给了当地的收容所。

e.en: Delete the {unneeded} files to free up disk space.
e.zh: 删除不需要的文件以释放磁盘空间。

unnerve.t: v. 使紧张不安、使气馁

e.en: Loud crowds can really {unnerve} first-time speakers.
e.zh: 喧闹的人群会让初次演讲者非常紧张。

e.en: His blank stare was enough to {unnerve} anyone.
e.zh: 他那空洞的眼神足以让任何人心里发毛。

e.en: She felt completely {unnerved} after the strange phone call.
e.zh: 接完那通奇怪的电话后，她感到非常不安。

e.en: The eerie silence in the house {unnerved} him.
e.zh: 屋里诡异的寂静让他心神不宁。

unnerves.t: v. 使紧张 (unnerve 第三人称单数)

e.en: Public speaking still {unnerves} her after years of practice.
e.zh: 练习多年后，公开演讲仍然让她紧张。

e.en: Nothing {unnerves} a goalkeeper more than a shootout.
e.zh: 没有什么比点球大战更让守门员心慌的了。

e.en: There was something {unnerving} about the empty hallway.
e.zh: 那条空荡荡的走廊让人毛骨悚然。

e.en: She found his constant smiling deeply {unnerving}.
e.zh: 她觉得他一直微笑的样子非常令人不安。

e.en: The robot moved {unnervingly} like a real human.
e.zh: 那个机器人动起来像真人一样令人发毛。

e.en: The forest was {unnervingly} silent that evening.
e.zh: 那天傍晚的森林安静得让人心慌。

e.en: The scratch on the screen is almost {unnoticeable}.
e.zh: 屏幕上的划痕几乎看不出来。

e.en: He made small, {unnoticeable} edits to the document.
e.zh: 他对文档做了一些不易察觉的小改动。

e.en: Her hard work went largely {unnoticed} by management.
e.zh: 她的辛勤工作基本上被管理层忽视了。

e.en: The typo slipped {unnoticed} into the final report.
e.zh: 那个错字悄无声息地溜进了最终报告。

e.en: The pages of the manuscript were still {unnumbered}.
e.zh: 手稿的页面还没有编号。

e.en: {Unnumbered} stars filled the desert sky that night.
e.zh: 那晚无数颗星星点缀着沙漠的夜空。

uno.t:
n. Uno 纸牌游戏
adj. 第一的 (西班牙语)

e.en: The proposed changes seem entirely {unobjectionable} to me.
e.zh: 在我看来，提议的修改完全无可挑剔。

e.en: He chose an {unobjectionable} tie for the job interview.
e.zh: 他面试时选了一条中规中矩的领带。

e.en: Dark matter remains largely {unobservable} with current technology.
e.zh: 以现有技术，暗物质基本上无法被观测到。

e.en: The variable is {unobservable} but can be inferred statistically.
e.zh: 该变量无法直接观测，但可以通过统计推断。

unquestioned.t: adj. 未受质疑的；公认的

e.en: For years, his authority in the company went {unquestioned}.
e.zh: 多年来,他在公司中的权威无人质疑。

e.en: Some old assumptions should not be left {unquestioned}.
e.zh: 一些陈旧的假设不应该被默认接受、不加质疑。

unquestioning.t: adj. 毫不怀疑的；盲从的

e.en: The cult demanded {unquestioning} loyalty from its members.
e.zh: 这个邪教要求成员绝对服从、不容质疑。

e.en: She gave her parents her {unquestioning} trust as a child.
e.zh: 小时候她对父母毫无保留地信任。

unquestioningly.t: adv. 毫无疑问地；无条件地

e.en: Soldiers are trained to follow orders {unquestioningly}.
e.zh: 士兵被训练成毫无质疑地服从命令。

e.en: Don't accept everything you read online {unquestioningly}.
e.zh: 不要对网上读到的一切都不加质疑地全盘接受。

e.en: The crowd grew {unquiet} as the verdict was delayed.
e.zh: 判决推迟时，人群变得骚动不安。

e.en: His {unquiet} mind kept him awake all night.
e.zh: 他烦躁不安的心绪让他整夜无眠。

unquote.t: v. 引文结束（口语标记）

e.en: She said, and I {unquote}, the deal is final.
e.zh: 她说，引用结束，这笔交易已成定局。

e.en: Please {unquote} the variable name in your code.
e.zh: 请去掉代码中变量名两边的引号。

unquoted.t: adj. 未被引用的；(股票) 未上市的

e.en: The {unquoted} string caused a syntax error in the script.
e.zh: 未加引号的字符串导致脚本出现语法错误。

e.en: Several {unquoted} sources contributed to the article.
e.zh: 几位未具名的消息源为这篇文章提供了材料。

unrated.t: adj. 未评级的；未分级的

e.en: The film was released in an {unrated} director's cut.
e.zh: 这部电影发行了未分级的导演剪辑版。

e.en: Most products on the page are still {unrated}.
e.zh: 页面上大多数商品还没有评分。

unravel.t:
v. 解开（谜团）；拆散
v. 瓦解

e.en: Detectives worked hard to {unravel} the mystery.
e.zh: 侦探们努力解开这个谜团。

e.en: Pull this thread and the whole sweater will {unravel}.
e.zh: 拉这根线，整件毛衣就会散开。

unraveled.t: v. unravel 的过去式；已破解

e.en: Her carefully laid plans {unraveled} within a week.
e.zh: 她精心制定的计划一周内就崩溃了。

e.en: He {unraveled} the tangled cables behind the desk.
e.zh: 他理清了书桌后缠成一团的电线。

unraveling.t: v. 正在解开；逐渐瓦解

e.en: The economy is slowly {unraveling} under heavy debt.
e.zh: 经济在沉重债务下正在慢慢瓦解。

e.en: Scientists are {unraveling} the secrets of the human genome.
e.zh: 科学家正在揭开人类基因组的奥秘。

unravelling.t: v. 正在解开；逐渐瓦解（英式拼写）

e.en: The mystery is finally {unravelling} after years of research.
e.zh: 经过多年研究，这个谜团终于在揭开。

e.en: I noticed the hem of my coat {unravelling}.
e.zh: 我注意到外套的下摆开始脱线。

unravels.t: v. unravel 的第三人称单数

e.en: The plot {unravels} beautifully in the final chapter.
e.zh: 故事情节在最后一章精彩地展开。

e.en: Without proper leadership, the team quickly {unravels}.
e.zh: 没有得力的领导，团队很快就会瓦解。

unreachable.t: adj. 无法到达的；联系不上的

e.en: The server is currently {unreachable}, please try again later.
e.zh: 服务器目前无法连接，请稍后再试。

e.en: That goal feels {unreachable} without more funding.
e.zh: 没有更多资金，那个目标感觉遥不可及。

e.en: I have over a thousand {unread} emails in my inbox.
e.zh: 我的收件箱里有一千多封未读邮件。

e.en: The book sat {unread} on her nightstand for months.
e.zh: 那本书在她的床头柜上几个月没人翻过。

unreadable.t: adj. 难以阅读的；难懂的

e.en: His handwriting was completely {unreadable} on the form.
e.zh: 他在表格上的字迹完全无法辨认。

e.en: The file is corrupted and now {unreadable}.
e.zh: 这个文件已损坏，现在无法读取。

e.en: The team felt {unready} for the championship match.
e.zh: 球队觉得自己还没准备好打冠军赛。

e.en: She was {unready} to share the news publicly.
e.zh: 她还没有准备好公开这个消息。

e.en: That sunset looks absolutely {unreal} in the photo.
e.zh: 照片里那个日落简直美得不真实。

e.en: Winning the lottery felt completely {unreal} to him.
e.zh: 中彩票对他来说感觉完全不真实。

e.en: Setting that deadline is totally {unrealistic} for our team.
e.zh: 对我们团队来说，定那个截止日期完全不切实际。

e.en: Movies often give people {unrealistic} expectations about love.
e.zh: 电影常让人们对爱情产生不切实际的期待。

e.en: The budget was {unrealistically} low from the start.
e.zh: 预算从一开始就低得不切实际。

e.en: He {unrealistically} expected results within a single day.
e.zh: 他不切实际地期望一天之内就有结果。

e.en: Jet lag gave the city a strange sense of {unreality}.
e.zh: 时差让这座城市笼罩着一种奇怪的虚幻感。

e.en: Social media often blurs reality and {unreality}.
e.zh: 社交媒体常常模糊现实与虚幻的界限。

e.en: His ambitious dream proved completely {unrealizable} in practice.
e.zh: 他雄心勃勃的梦想在现实中完全无法实现。

e.en: The company holds {unrealizable} gains on paper assets.
e.zh: 公司持有的纸面资产存在尚未实现的收益。

unrealized.t: adj. 未实现的；未兑现的

e.en: His potential remained largely {unrealized} during his career.
e.zh: 他的潜力在职业生涯中大多未能发挥出来。

e.en: The fund reported significant {unrealized} losses this quarter.
e.zh: 该基金本季度报告了大量未实现的亏损。

e.en: The crowd descended into pure {unreason} after the announcement.
e.zh: 宣布消息后，人群陷入了纯粹的疯狂。

e.en: Fear often leads to {unreason} and bad decisions.
e.zh: 恐惧常常导致丧失理智和错误决定。

e.en: Charging that much for shipping is completely {unreasonable}.
e.zh: 运费收那么多完全不合理。

e.en: My boss made an {unreasonable} demand at the meeting.
e.zh: 我的老板在会议上提出了一个无理的要求。

e.en: The court noted the clear {unreasonableness} of the contract.
e.zh: 法院指出该合同明显不合理。

e.en: She finally saw the {unreasonableness} of her own demands.
e.zh: 她终于意识到自己要求的不合理之处。

e.en: The line at the airport was {unreasonably} long today.
e.zh: 机场今天的队伍长得离谱。

e.en: He behaved {unreasonably} when his order arrived late.
e.zh: 订单晚到时，他的反应非常不讲理。

e.en: She felt an {unreasoning} fear of open spaces.
e.zh: 她对空旷的地方有一种莫名的恐惧。

e.en: His {unreasoning} hatred of strangers worried his family.
e.zh: 他对陌生人毫无理由的憎恨让家人担忧。

unreceptive.t: adj. 不愿接受的；排斥的

e.en: The board was {unreceptive} to any changes in strategy.
e.zh: 董事会对任何策略上的改变都不愿接受。

e.en: He seemed {unreceptive} to feedback during the meeting.
e.zh: 会议中他似乎对反馈意见毫不接受。

unrecognisable.t: adj. 认不出的（英式拼写）

e.en: After the renovation, the old café was {unrecognisable}.
e.zh: 翻修之后,那家老咖啡馆已经完全认不出来了。

e.en: His voice was {unrecognisable} over the bad phone connection.
e.zh: 电话信号太差,他的声音根本听不出来。

unrecognizable.t: adj. 认不出的；面目全非的

e.en: The town was {unrecognizable} after the flood swept through.
e.zh: 洪水过后,这个小镇已经面目全非。

e.en: She's {unrecognizable} in her old high school photos.
e.zh: 她在高中老照片里完全认不出来。

unrecognized.t: adj. 未被识别的；未获承认的

e.en: Her contributions to the project went largely {unrecognized}.
e.zh: 她对项目的贡献在很大程度上没有得到承认。

e.en: The app blocked an {unrecognized} login attempt from overseas.
e.zh: 该应用拦截了一次来自海外的不明登录尝试。

unreconciled.t: adj. 未和解的；未协调的

e.en: The brothers remained {unreconciled} for the rest of their lives.
e.zh: 兄弟俩此后一辈子都没能重归于好。

e.en: Several bank transactions are still {unreconciled} in the report.
e.zh: 报告中仍有几笔银行交易尚未对账。

unreconstructed.t: adj. 顽固守旧的；未改造的

e.en: He's an {unreconstructed} fan of vinyl records and old radios.
e.zh: 他是个死忠的黑胶唱片和老收音机迷。

e.en: Her father held {unreconstructed} views about gender roles.
e.zh: 她父亲对性别角色持着顽固守旧的看法。

e.en: Many of his early performances went completely {unrecorded}.
e.zh: 他早期的许多演出都没有被录下来。

e.en: The meeting's most important decisions remain {unrecorded}.
e.zh: 会议中最重要的几项决定没有被记录在案。

unrecoverable.t: adj. 无法恢复的；不可挽回的

e.en: The hard drive crashed and the files were {unrecoverable}.
e.zh: 硬盘崩溃了,文件已经无法恢复。

e.en: After the breach, customer trust seemed almost {unrecoverable}.
e.zh: 数据泄露之后,客户的信任似乎几乎无法挽回。

unredeemable.t: adj. 无可救药的；无法兑现的

e.en: These expired coupons are now {unredeemable} at any store.
e.zh: 这些过期的优惠券现在在任何店都不能兑换了。

e.en: He didn't believe anyone was truly {unredeemable}.
e.zh: 他不相信有人是真的无可救药的。

unredeemed.t: adj. 未兑现的；未赎回的

e.en: Millions of frequent flyer miles go {unredeemed} each year.
e.zh: 每年都有数百万常旅客积分未被兑换。

e.en: The villain dies {unredeemed} at the end of the film.
e.zh: 反派在影片结尾死去,始终没有获得救赎。

unreel.t: v. 从卷轴上放出；展开

e.en: Watch the fisherman slowly {unreel} the line into the river.
e.zh: 看那渔夫慢慢把鱼线放入河中。

e.en: Old memories began to {unreel} like a film in his mind.
e.zh: 往日的回忆像电影一样在他脑海中徐徐展开。

e.en: {Unrefined} sugar retains more nutrients than the white kind.
e.zh: 未精制的糖比白糖保留了更多营养。

e.en: His writing style is energetic but still a bit {unrefined}.
e.zh: 他的文风很有活力,但还略显粗糙。

unreflective.t: adj. 不加思考的；草率的

e.en: She gave an {unreflective} answer without considering the consequences.
e.zh: 她不假思索地回答,没考虑后果。

e.en: An {unreflective} life rarely leads to real growth.
e.zh: 不加反思的人生很少能带来真正的成长。

unreformed.t: adj. 未改革的；本性难移的

e.en: He left prison an {unreformed} criminal and reoffended within weeks.
e.zh: 他出狱时本性未改,几周后又再次犯案。

e.en: The agency remains {unreformed} despite years of public criticism.
e.zh: 尽管多年来饱受公众批评,该机构仍未进行改革。

unregarded.t: adj. 被忽视的；不受重视的

e.en: Her warnings went {unregarded} until disaster finally struck.
e.zh: 她的警告一直被忽视,直到灾难最终发生。

e.en: Many small streaming artists remain talented but {unregarded}.
e.zh: 许多小众流媒体艺人很有才华,却始终不受关注。

unregenerate.t: adj. 冥顽不化的；不悔改的

e.en: He remained an {unregenerate} smoker despite his doctor's pleas.
e.zh: 尽管医生苦苦相劝,他仍是个死不悔改的烟民。

e.en: She was an {unregenerate} optimist, even in dark times.
e.zh: 即使在黑暗时期,她也是个本性难移的乐观主义者。

e.en: {Unregistered} users can only browse three articles per day.
e.zh: 未注册的用户每天只能浏览三篇文章。

e.en: Police seized an {unregistered} firearm during the raid.
e.zh: 警方在突击搜查中查获了一把未登记的枪支。

e.en: The crypto market was largely {unregulated} in its early years.
e.zh: 加密货币市场在早期基本上不受监管。

e.en: {Unregulated} ride-share services worry many city officials.
e.zh: 不受监管的网约车服务让许多市政官员感到担忧。

unrehearsed.t: adj. 未经排练的；即兴的

e.en: Her speech sounded {unrehearsed} but was surprisingly moving.
e.zh: 她的演讲听起来没有彩排过,却出乎意料地感人。

e.en: The actors gave an {unrehearsed} response to the audience question.
e.zh: 演员们对观众的提问作出了未经排练的回应。

unreinforced.t: adj. 未加固的；未强化的

e.en: {Unreinforced} brick buildings often collapse during major earthquakes.
e.zh: 未加固的砖砌建筑在大地震中常常会倒塌。

e.en: Habits left {unreinforced} tend to fade within a few weeks.
e.zh: 得不到强化的习惯往往几周内就会消失。

e.en: The two crashes happened on the same day but were {unrelated}.
e.zh: 两起车祸虽发生在同一天,但彼此并无关联。

e.en: Please don't bring up {unrelated} issues during this meeting.
e.zh: 开会时请不要提起与议题无关的问题。

unreleased.t: adj. 未发布的；未公开的

e.en: Fans were thrilled to hear an {unreleased} track from her album.
e.zh: 粉丝们非常兴奋地听到了她专辑里一首未发行的曲子。

e.en: The studio is sitting on dozens of {unreleased} films.
e.zh: 这家制片厂积压着几十部尚未上映的电影。

unrelenting.t: adj. 持续不断的；不松懈的

e.en: Her {unrelenting} work ethic eventually got her promoted to director.
e.zh: 她坚持不懈的工作态度最终让她升任了总监。

e.en: The summer heat has been absolutely {unrelenting} this week.
e.zh: 这周的夏日酷热真是没完没了。

unobservant.t: adj. 观察力差的；不留心的

e.en: He was so {unobservant} he missed her new haircut.
e.zh: 他粗心得连她剪了新发型都没注意到。

e.en: Tourists are often {unobservant} of local customs.
e.zh: 游客常常不太留意当地的习俗。

unobserved.t: adj. 未被注意到的；未被观察到的

e.en: She slipped out of the party {unobserved} by anyone.
e.zh: 她悄悄从派对溜走，没有被任何人发现。

e.en: The thief entered the building {unobserved} by guards.
e.zh: 小偷在没被警卫察觉的情况下进入了大楼。

unobstructed.t: adj. 无阻碍的；畅通无阻的

e.en: The hotel room offered an {unobstructed} view of the ocean.
e.zh: 酒店房间可以毫无遮挡地看到大海。

e.en: Please keep emergency exits completely {unobstructed} at all times.
e.zh: 请始终保持紧急出口完全畅通无阻。

unobtainable.t: adj. 无法获得的；弄不到手的

e.en: Tickets to the concert proved {unobtainable} within minutes.
e.zh: 演唱会的门票几分钟内就买不到了。

e.en: That rare book is now virtually {unobtainable} anywhere.
e.zh: 那本珍稀书籍现在几乎在哪里都买不到。

unobtrusive.t: adj. 不招摇的；不碍眼的

e.en: The app uses {unobtrusive} notifications that don't interrupt your workflow.
e.zh: 这款应用使用不打扰用户的通知，不会中断你的工作。

e.en: She prefers {unobtrusive} jewelry for the office.
e.zh: 她在办公室喜欢佩戴低调不张扬的首饰。

unobtrusively.t: adv. 低调地；不引人注目地

e.en: The waiter refilled our glasses {unobtrusively}.
e.zh: 服务员悄无声息地为我们续上了酒。

e.en: Good ads should fit {unobtrusively} into the page layout.
e.zh: 好的广告应不动声色地融入页面布局。

e.en: The {unobtrusiveness} of the new design is its biggest strength.
e.zh: 新设计最大的优点就是它的低调不抢眼。

e.en: Reviewers praised the headphones for their comfort and {unobtrusiveness}.
e.zh: 评测人称赞这款耳机佩戴舒适且毫不显眼。

e.en: The essay compared the {unobtrusivenesses} of various minimalist interfaces.
e.zh: 这篇文章比较了各种极简界面的低调程度。

e.en: Designers debated the {unobtrusivenesses} of different notification styles.
e.zh: 设计师们讨论了不同通知样式的低调程度。

unoccupied.t: adj. 无人使用的；空闲的

e.en: All the meeting rooms on this floor are {unoccupied}.
e.zh: 这一层的所有会议室都没有人在用。

e.en: The house has been {unoccupied} for over a year.
e.zh: 这栋房子已经空置一年多了。

unofficial.t: adj. 非正式的；非官方的

e.en: According to {unofficial} sources, the deal closed last night.
e.zh: 据非官方消息，这笔交易昨晚已敲定。

e.en: He's the {unofficial} leader of the group.
e.zh: 他是这个团队事实上的领导者。

e.en: {Unofficially}, the merger has already been approved.
e.zh: 非正式地说，这次合并已经获得批准。

e.en: She {unofficially} runs the entire department.
e.zh: 她实际上负责整个部门的运作。

unoiled.t: adj. 未加油的；未润滑的

e.en: The {unoiled} hinges squeaked every time we opened the door.
e.zh: 没上油的合页每次开门都吱吱作响。

e.en: An {unoiled} chain will wear out your bike quickly.
e.zh: 未上油的链条会让自行车很快磨损。

unopened.t: adj. 未打开的；未开封的

e.en: There's still an {unopened} bottle of wine in the fridge.
e.zh: 冰箱里还有一瓶没开封的红酒。

e.en: Her inbox had hundreds of {unopened} emails.
e.zh: 她的收件箱里有几百封未读邮件。

unopposed.t: adj. 未遭反对的；无对手的

e.en: She ran {unopposed} for class president.
e.zh: 她在班长选举中没有竞争对手。

e.en: The bill passed {unopposed} in the senate.
e.zh: 该法案在参议院无人反对地通过了。

unordered.t: adj. 未排序的；未订购的

e.en: The function returns an {unordered} list of results.
e.zh: 该函数返回一个无序的结果列表。

e.en: Use an {unordered} set when sequence doesn't matter.
e.zh: 当顺序不重要时使用无序集合。

unorganized.t: adj. 没有组织的；杂乱的

e.en: His desk is completely {unorganized} and full of papers.
e.zh: 他的桌子毫无条理，堆满了文件。

e.en: The notes were {unorganized}, making the lecture hard to follow.
e.zh: 笔记杂乱无章，让讲座很难跟上。

unoriginal.t: adj. 缺乏独创性的；老套的

e.en: Critics called the film derivative and {unoriginal}.
e.zh: 评论家说这部电影模仿别人，毫无新意。

e.en: The slogan feels {unoriginal} and forgettable.
e.zh: 这句标语显得老套，让人记不住。

e.en: Her {unorthodox} teaching methods produced great results.
e.zh: 她非传统的教学方法取得了很好的效果。

e.en: He took an {unorthodox} approach to solving the puzzle.
e.zh: 他用了一种非常规的方法来解这道谜题。

e.en: The startup's success came from its sheer {unorthodoxy}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司的成功源于其彻底的非传统作风。

e.en: His {unorthodoxy} made him both admired and feared.
e.zh: 他不墨守成规的作风让他既受人敬佩又令人畏惧。

unpack.t: v. 打开（行李）；解压、拆解

e.en: Let me {unpack} that idea a little more for you.
e.zh: 让我再为你详细解释一下这个想法。

e.en: I'll {unpack} my suitcase after dinner.
e.zh: 我吃完晚饭再整理行李箱。

unpacked.t: v. unpack 的过去式；已拆箱的

e.en: She {unpacked} her bags as soon as she arrived.
e.zh: 她一到就把行李箱里的东西拿出来了。

e.en: The professor {unpacked} the theory in plain language.
e.zh: 教授用通俗的语言解释了这个理论。

unpacking.t: v. 正在拆箱；正在解压

e.en: We're still {unpacking} boxes from the move last week.
e.zh: 我们还在整理上周搬家时的箱子。

e.en: This chapter is worth {unpacking} carefully.
e.zh: 这一章值得仔细分析解读。

unpacks.t: v. unpack 的第三人称单数

e.en: The article {unpacks} the new tax policy in detail.
e.zh: 这篇文章详细解读了新的税收政策。

e.en: He always {unpacks} immediately after a trip.
e.zh: 他每次出差回来都会立刻整理行李。

e.en: The manuscript was {unpaged}, making citations difficult.
e.zh: 这份手稿没有页码，引用起来很麻烦。

e.en: Old pamphlets are often {unpaged} and hard to reference.
e.zh: 老式小册子常常没有页码，不便引用。

e.en: She has several {unpaid} invoices from last month.
e.zh: 她还有几张上个月没付款的账单。

e.en: He took {unpaid} leave to care for his mother.
e.zh: 他请了无薪假来照顾母亲。

unpainted.t: adj. 未涂漆的；未上色的

e.en: The fence is still {unpainted} after all these years.
e.zh: 这道篱笆这么多年了还没刷漆。

e.en: They left the back wall {unpainted} for now.
e.zh: 他们暂时没有给后墙刷漆。

unpaired.t: adj. 未成对的；未配对的

e.en: My headphones are {unpaired} from the phone.
e.zh: 我的耳机和手机断开配对了。

e.en: There's an {unpaired} sock in every laundry load.
e.zh: 每次洗衣服总会出现一只落单的袜子。

unpalatable.t: adj. 难以下咽的；令人难以接受的

e.en: The truth was {unpalatable} but had to be told.
e.zh: 真相虽然令人难以接受,但必须说出来。

e.en: The cafeteria food was bland and {unpalatable}.
e.zh: 食堂的饭菜清淡得难以下咽。

unparalleled.t: adj. 空前的；无可比拟的

e.en: The new chip offers {unparalleled} performance for the price.
e.zh: 这款新芯片在同价位中性能无可匹敌。

e.en: She showed {unparalleled} dedication to her students.
e.zh: 她对学生表现出无与伦比的奉献精神。

e.en: Lying to your closest friend is an {unpardonable} betrayal.
e.zh: 对最亲近的朋友撒谎是不可原谅的背叛。

e.en: In chess, that blunder was simply {unpardonable}.
e.zh: 在国际象棋中,那个失误简直不可饶恕。

e.en: Some cheeses are made from {unpasteurized} milk.
e.zh: 有些奶酪是用未经巴氏消毒的牛奶制作的。

e.en: Pregnant women should avoid {unpasteurized} dairy products.
e.zh: 孕妇应避免食用未经巴氏消毒的乳制品。

e.en: Critics called the protest {unpatriotic} and divisive.
e.zh: 批评者称这次抗议不爱国且具有分裂性。

e.en: Questioning a war is not necessarily {unpatriotic}.
e.zh: 质疑一场战争未必就是不爱国。

e.en: The cabin sits at the end of an {unpaved} road.
e.zh: 那间小木屋位于一条没铺砌路的尽头。

e.en: The bike struggled on the rough, {unpaved} trail.
e.zh: 自行车在崎岖未铺设的小路上颠簸前行。

e.en: Leave the apples {unpeeled} for extra fiber.
e.zh: 苹果不削皮可以多摄入纤维。

e.en: She bit into the {unpeeled} cucumber straight from the garden.
e.zh: 她直接从菜园里拿起未削皮的黄瓜咬了一口。

unpeopled.t: adj. 无人居住的；荒无人烟的

e.en: The photographer captured the {unpeopled} streets at dawn.
e.zh: 摄影师拍下了黎明时分空无一人的街道。

e.en: After the storm, the beach was eerily {unpeopled}.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后,海滩空无一人,显得格外诡异。

e.en: The change happened gradually and went {unperceived}.
e.zh: 这种变化是渐进发生的,没有被察觉到。

e.en: Her quiet kindness often goes {unperceived} by strangers.
e.zh: 她安静的善意常常不被陌生人察觉。

e.en: The lawyer's closing argument was weak and {unpersuasive}.
e.zh: 律师的结案陈词软弱无力,缺乏说服力。

e.en: His excuses sounded rehearsed and {unpersuasive}.
e.zh: 他的借口听起来像是事先排练过的,不具说服力。

unperturbed.t: adj. 泰然自若的；不受干扰的

e.en: She remained {unperturbed} despite the angry crowd.
e.zh: 尽管人群愤怒,她依然泰然自若。

e.en: The cat sat {unperturbed} as the dog barked nearby.
e.zh: 狗在旁边狂吠,猫却坐着泰然不动。

e.en: It took hours to {unpick} the tangled logic of the code.
e.zh: 花了好几个小时才理清这段代码混乱的逻辑。

e.en: She had to {unpick} the seam and resew it carefully.
e.zh: 她不得不拆开缝线,再小心地重新缝好。

unpicked.t: v. unpick 的过去式；已拆开的

e.en: The detective {unpicked} every detail of the suspect's alibi.
e.zh: 侦探一一拆解了嫌疑人不在场证明的每个细节。

e.en: She {unpicked} the stitches and started the embroidery again.
e.zh: 她拆掉针脚,重新开始绣花。

unplaced.t: adj. 未获名次的；未安置的

e.en: His horse finished the race {unplaced}.
e.zh: 他的马在比赛中没有进入名次。

e.en: Several boxes remained {unplaced} after the move.
e.zh: 搬家后还有几个箱子没找到地方放。

unplanned.t: adj. 未经计划的；意外的

e.en: The {unplanned} road trip turned into our best vacation.
e.zh: 那次没计划的公路旅行成了我们最棒的假期。

e.en: An {unplanned} outage took the website down for hours.
e.zh: 一次计划外的故障让网站宕机了好几个小时。

unplayable.t: adj. 无法播放的；无法演奏的

e.en: The lag made the online game completely {unplayable}.
e.zh: 延迟让这款网游完全没法玩。

e.en: The old DVD was scratched and {unplayable}.
e.zh: 那张旧DVD有划痕,放不出来了。

unpleasant.t: adj. 令人不快的；讨厌的

e.en: There was an {unpleasant} smell coming from the fridge.
e.zh: 冰箱里飘出一股难闻的气味。

e.en: The meeting took an {unpleasant} turn after the announcement.
e.zh: 宣布消息后,会议气氛变得很不愉快。

e.en: The room was {unpleasantly} warm and stuffy.
e.zh: 房间里热得让人不舒服,又很闷。

e.en: He was {unpleasantly} surprised by the bill.
e.zh: 看到账单时他感到不快的惊讶。

e.en: Let's avoid any further {unpleasantness} at dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时我们就别再闹不愉快了。

e.en: There was some {unpleasantness} between the two coworkers.
e.zh: 那两个同事之间有些不愉快。

e.en: He muttered an {unpleasantry} under his breath.
e.zh: 他低声嘟囔了一句不中听的话。

e.en: The interview ended with a brief {unpleasantry}.
e.zh: 采访以一段简短的不愉快交锋告终。

e.en: The building's facade was oddly {unpleasing} to the eye.
e.zh: 这栋楼的外立面看起来怪怪的,不太顺眼。

e.en: She found the soundtrack repetitive and {unpleasing}.
e.zh: 她觉得这部配乐重复又难听。

e.en: The {unplowed} field was covered in deep snow.
e.zh: 那片没耕的田地被厚厚的积雪覆盖。

e.en: Side streets remained {unplowed} after the blizzard.
e.zh: 暴风雪过后,小街上的雪还没被铲走。

unplug.t: v. 拔下插头；断开连接

e.en: Remember to {unplug} the iron before you leave.
e.zh: 出门前记得把熨斗的插头拔掉。

e.en: I try to {unplug} from social media on weekends.
e.zh: 我尽量在周末远离社交媒体放空一下。

unplugged.t:
adj. 拔掉插头的
v. unplug 的过去式

e.en: The router is {unplugged}—that's why the WiFi is down.
e.zh: 路由器被拔掉了,所以无线网才没信号。

e.en: She {unplugged} for a week and felt much calmer.
e.zh: 她断网休息了一周,感觉平静了许多。

unplugging.t: v. 拔掉（插头）的现在分词

e.en: {Unplugging} your devices can save energy at night.
e.zh: 晚上拔掉设备插头可以节省能源。

e.en: He swears by {unplugging} from work after 6 p.m.
e.zh: 他坚信晚上六点后就该从工作中抽离出来。

unplugs.t: v. 拔掉（插头）（第三人称单数）

e.en: My dad always {unplugs} the toaster after breakfast.
e.zh: 我爸早餐后总会把烤面包机的插头拔掉。

e.en: She {unplugs} her laptop whenever a thunderstorm hits.
e.zh: 每次有雷暴她就会把笔记本电脑的电源拔掉。

e.en: His {unpolished} manners surprised the guests at the formal dinner.
e.zh: 他粗糙的举止让正式晚宴上的宾客感到惊讶。

e.en: The demo was {unpolished} but showed real promise.
e.zh: 这个演示虽然粗糙,但展现出真正的潜力。

unpolitical.t: adj. 非政治的；不关心政治的

e.en: She kept her social media feed deliberately {unpolitical}.
e.zh: 她刻意让自己的社交媒体内容不涉及政治。

e.en: The novel takes an {unpolitical} look at small-town life.
e.zh: 这部小说以非政治的视角描绘小镇生活。

e.en: They camped beside an {unpolluted} mountain stream.
e.zh: 他们在一条未受污染的山间溪流旁露营。

e.en: Few cities still enjoy truly {unpolluted} air.
e.zh: 很少有城市还能享有真正未受污染的空气。

e.en: Raising taxes is always an {unpopular} decision.
e.zh: 加税从来都是不受欢迎的决定。

e.en: His honest opinions made him {unpopular} at work.
e.zh: 他坦诚的看法让他在公司不受欢迎。

unpopularity.t: n. 不受欢迎；不得人心

e.en: The mayor's {unpopularity} grew after the budget cuts.
e.zh: 预算削减后,市长的不受欢迎程度加剧了。

e.en: The app's {unpopularity} forced the team to redesign it.
e.zh: 该应用不受欢迎,迫使团队重新设计。

e.en: They hiked through vast, {unpopulated} stretches of desert.
e.zh: 他们徒步穿越大片无人居住的沙漠。

e.en: The map showed several {unpopulated} islands offshore.
e.zh: 地图显示离岸有几座无人居住的岛屿。

unpractical.t: adj. 不实际的；不切实际的

e.en: Wearing heels on a hike is completely {unpractical}.
e.zh: 徒步时穿高跟鞋完全不切实际。

e.en: His ideas were brilliant but {unpractical} for small budgets.
e.zh: 他的想法很出色,但对小预算来说不切实际。

unpracticed.t: adj. 不熟练的；缺乏经验的

e.en: Her {unpracticed} hands fumbled with the guitar strings.
e.zh: 她不熟练的双手笨拙地拨弄着吉他弦。

e.en: He gave an {unpracticed} but heartfelt speech at the wedding.
e.zh: 他在婚礼上发表了一段未经排练却真挚的讲话。

unpractised.t: adj. 不熟练的（英式拼写）

e.en: The {unpractised} skater wobbled across the ice.
e.zh: 这位不熟练的滑冰者在冰面上摇摇晃晃地滑过。

e.en: Her {unpractised} French still charmed the locals.
e.zh: 她不太熟练的法语依然让当地人感到亲切。

unprecedented.t: adj. 史无前例的；空前的

e.en: The pandemic caused {unprecedented} disruption to global travel.
e.zh: 这场疫情对全球旅行造成了前所未有的冲击。

e.en: The startup raised an {unprecedented} amount in its first round.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在首轮融资中筹集到了前所未有的金额。

unprecedentedly.t: adv. 空前地；史无前例地

e.en: Housing prices rose {unprecedentedly} fast last year.
e.zh: 去年房价以前所未有的速度飙升。

e.en: The summer was {unprecedentedly} hot across Europe.
e.zh: 今年夏天整个欧洲热得史无前例。

e.en: The {unpredictability} of the weather ruined our picnic plans.
e.zh: 天气的不可预测性打乱了我们的野餐计划。

e.en: Investors hate the {unpredictability} of emerging markets.
e.zh: 投资者讨厌新兴市场的不可预测性。

unpredictable.t: adj. 难以预料的；无常的

e.en: The toddler's mood is completely {unpredictable}.
e.zh: 这个小朋友的情绪完全无法预测。

e.en: Stock prices can be wildly {unpredictable} in a crisis.
e.zh: 危机中股价可能极其难以预测。

e.en: The old engine sometimes stalls {unpredictably}.
e.zh: 这台旧引擎有时会毫无征兆地熄火。

e.en: Prices have been moving {unpredictably} all month.
e.zh: 整整一个月物价的波动都难以预测。

e.en: An {unpredicted} storm forced the airport to close.
e.zh: 一场未被预报到的风暴迫使机场关闭。

e.en: The model captured several previously {unpredicted} effects.
e.zh: 该模型捕捉到了几种此前未被预测到的效应。

e.en: A good judge must give an {unprejudiced} hearing to both sides.
e.zh: 好的法官必须不带偏见地听取双方陈述。

e.en: She offered an {unprejudiced} review of the new film.
e.zh: 她对这部新电影给出了不带偏见的评价。

unpremeditated.t: adj. 非预谋的；无预谋的

e.en: The lawyer argued the attack was {unpremeditated}.
e.zh: 律师辩称这次袭击并非预谋。

e.en: His apology felt genuine and entirely {unpremeditated}.
e.zh: 他的道歉显得真诚,完全不是事先想好的。

e.en: I walked into the meeting completely {unprepared}.
e.zh: 我毫无准备地走进了会议室。

e.en: The city was {unprepared} for such heavy snowfall.
e.zh: 这座城市对如此大的降雪毫无准备。

e.en: The report criticized the agency's {unpreparedness} for the flood.
e.zh: 报告批评了该机构对洪灾的毫无准备。

e.en: Her {unpreparedness} for the interview was painfully obvious.
e.zh: 她对面试的毫无准备显而易见。

unprepossessing.t: adj. 不讨人喜欢的；其貌不扬的

e.en: The restaurant has an {unprepossessing} exterior but amazing food.
e.zh: 这家餐厅外表不起眼,菜却非常好吃。

e.en: He was an {unprepossessing} man with a brilliant mind.
e.zh: 他相貌平平,头脑却极其聪明。

e.en: I love this {unpretentious} little café down the street.
e.zh: 我很喜欢街角这家不做作的小咖啡馆。

e.en: Despite her fame, she remained warm and {unpretentious}.
e.zh: 尽管成名了,她依然温暖而不做作。

unprincipled.t: adj. 无原则的；不择手段的

e.en: The journalist exposed several {unprincipled} business practices.
e.zh: 那位记者揭露了几种没有底线的商业行为。

e.en: He's an {unprincipled} politician who will say anything to win.
e.zh: 他是个毫无原则的政客,为了胜选什么都说得出口。

unprintable.t: adj. 不宜刊印的（过于粗俗）

e.en: The angry customer used several {unprintable} words.
e.zh: 那位愤怒的顾客说了好几句不堪入目的脏话。

e.en: His reaction to the news was frankly {unprintable}.
e.zh: 老实说,他对这消息的反应根本没法见报。

e.en: The migration to the new server was surprisingly {unproblematic}.
e.zh: 迁移到新服务器的过程出乎意料地顺利。

e.en: Few historical figures are entirely {unproblematic}.
e.zh: 几乎没有哪位历史人物是完全没有争议的。

unprocessed.t: adj. 未加工的；未处理的

e.en: Doctors recommend eating more {unprocessed} foods.
e.zh: 医生建议多吃未加工的食物。

e.en: The queue still has thousands of {unprocessed} requests.
e.zh: 队列里还有数千个未处理的请求。

unproductive.t: adj. 没有成效的；低产的

e.en: Endless meetings make the whole afternoon {unproductive}.
e.zh: 没完没了的会议让整个下午都毫无产出。

e.en: Arguing on social media is usually {unproductive}.
e.zh: 在社交媒体上争吵通常毫无意义。

unprofessional.t: adj. 不专业的；违反职业道德的

e.en: Showing up late to a client meeting looks {unprofessional}.
e.zh: 开客户会议迟到会显得很不专业。

e.en: Her email tone was rude and deeply {unprofessional}.
e.zh: 她邮件的语气很无礼,十分不专业。

e.en: The manager behaved {unprofessionally} during the dispute.
e.zh: 经理在争执中的表现很不专业。

e.en: He dressed {unprofessionally} for the important pitch.
e.zh: 在这场重要的提案中,他穿得很不得体。

e.en: The company shut down its {unprofitable} overseas branches.
e.zh: 公司关闭了那些不盈利的海外分公司。

e.en: Streaming originals proved {unprofitable} for several studios.
e.zh: 对几家工作室来说,流媒体原创内容并没有带来盈利。

unpromising.t: adj. 没有希望的；前景黯淡的

e.en: The project had an {unpromising} start but ended up succeeding.
e.zh: 这个项目起步并不被看好,最终却获得了成功。

e.en: Despite her {unpromising} grades, she got into a top university.
e.zh: 尽管成绩并不亮眼,她还是考进了一所顶尖大学。

unprompted.t: adj. 主动的；未经提示的

e.en: She offered help, completely {unprompted}, when I was struggling.
e.zh: 在我焦头烂额时,她主动提出帮忙,完全没人开口。

e.en: The child gave an {unprompted} apology to his sister.
e.zh: 这个孩子主动向妹妹道了歉,根本没人提醒。

e.en: The menu was full of {unpronounceable} French dishes.
e.zh: 菜单上全是叫不出名字的法国菜。

e.en: His new password is an {unpronounceable} string of symbols.
e.zh: 他的新密码是一串没法念出来的符号。

e.en: The economy made it an {unpropitious} time to launch a startup.
e.zh: 经济形势让此时创业并不是好时机。

e.en: Heavy rain made the conditions {unpropitious} for the wedding.
e.zh: 大雨让婚礼的天气条件很不理想。

unprotected.t: adj. 无保护的；无防护的

e.en: Don't leave your laptop {unprotected} on public Wi-Fi.
e.zh: 不要让你的笔记本在公共 Wi-Fi 下毫无防护地连接。

e.en: The endpoint was left {unprotected} without any authentication.
e.zh: 这个接口没有任何鉴权,完全暴露在外。

e.en: His alibi turned out to be entirely {unprovable}.
e.zh: 他的不在场证明结果完全无法证实。

e.en: Some mathematical statements are famously {unprovable}.
e.zh: 有些数学命题以无法被证明而闻名。

e.en: The drug remains {unproved} in large clinical trials.
e.zh: 这种药在大规模临床试验中尚未得到证实。

e.en: Her theory is interesting but still {unproved}.
e.zh: 她的理论很有意思,但仍未得到证实。

e.en: The startup is betting on an {unproven} technology.
e.zh: 这家初创公司正押注在一项尚未被验证的技术上。

e.en: The coach took a chance on an {unproven} rookie.
e.zh: 教练大胆启用了一名尚未证明实力的新人。

unprovoked.t: adj. 无端的；未受挑衅的

e.en: The dog launched an {unprovoked} attack on the mailman.
e.zh: 那只狗在毫无挑衅的情况下袭击了邮递员。

e.en: He was arrested for an {unprovoked} assault on a stranger.
e.zh: 他因无故袭击一名陌生人而被捕。

e.en: The {unpruned} rose bushes had grown into a tangled mess.
e.zh: 这些没修剪过的玫瑰丛已经长得乱成一团。

e.en: An {unpruned} apple tree produces smaller, lower-quality fruit.
e.zh: 未经修剪的苹果树结出的果实更小、品质更差。

e.en: The CEO's resignation was deliberately kept {unpublicized}.
e.zh: CEO 的辞职被刻意没有对外公开。

e.en: Many of her donations remain {unpublicized}.
e.zh: 她的许多捐款至今都没有对外公开。

unpublished.t: adj. 未发表的；未出版的

e.en: The author left several {unpublished} novels in her drawer.
e.zh: 这位作家在抽屉里留下了几部未出版的小说。

e.en: He cited an {unpublished} study from a friend's lab.
e.zh: 他引用了朋友实验室一项尚未发表的研究。

e.en: The crime cannot be allowed to go {unpunished}.
e.zh: 这起罪行绝不能不受惩罚。

e.en: Many corporate scandals go essentially {unpunished}.
e.zh: 许多企业丑闻基本上都没有受到惩处。

unqualified.t: adj. 不合格的；无条件的

e.en: The proposal received the team's {unqualified} support.
e.zh: 这项提议得到了团队毫无保留的支持。

e.en: He was completely {unqualified} for the senior engineering role.
e.zh: 他完全没有资格胜任这个高级工程师的职位。

e.en: Trust between teammates is valuable but largely {unquantifiable}.
e.zh: 队友之间的信任很宝贵,却基本无法量化。

e.en: The emotional cost of the layoffs is {unquantifiable}.
e.zh: 这次裁员带来的情感代价难以量化。

unquenchable.t: adj. 无法满足的；难以抑制的

e.en: She has an {unquenchable} thirst for new books.
e.zh: 她对新书有一种难以满足的渴望。

e.en: His {unquenchable} curiosity led him into many fields.
e.zh: 他无法平息的好奇心把他带进了许多领域。

unquestionable.t: adj. 毋庸置疑的；确定无疑的

e.en: Her dedication to the team is {unquestionable}.
e.zh: 她对团队的投入是毋庸置疑的。

e.en: The evidence of climate change is by now {unquestionable}.
e.zh: 气候变化的证据如今已经毋庸置疑。

e.en: This is {unquestionably} the best ramen in town.
e.zh: 这家无疑是全城最好吃的拉面。

e.en: She is {unquestionably} the most talented designer here.
e.zh: 她毫无疑问是这里最有才华的设计师。

e.en: He pursued the truth {unrelentingly}, no matter the cost.
e.zh: 他坚持不懈地追寻真相,不惜任何代价。

e.en: The news cycle has been {unrelentingly} negative all month.
e.zh: 整整一个月,新闻报道一直在持续不断地传递负面消息。

e.en: The {unreliability} of the old server frustrated the entire team.
e.zh: 那台旧服务器的不稳定让整个团队都很头疼。

e.en: Witnesses are known for the {unreliability} of their memories.
e.zh: 目击者的记忆以不可靠著称。

unreliable.t: adj. 不可靠的；靠不住的

e.en: My old laptop has become too {unreliable} for serious work.
