e.zh: 我那台旧笔记本电脑已经太不靠谱,做不了正经工作了。

e.en: He's an {unreliable} narrator, so question everything he says.
e.zh: 他是个不可靠的叙述者,他说的每句话都要打个问号。

e.en: The wifi connects {unreliably} in the back bedroom.
e.zh: 后面那间卧室的无线网络连得很不稳定。

e.en: The app syncs {unreliably} when the battery is low.
e.zh: 电池电量低时,这个应用同步起来很不稳定。

e.en: The novel is dark, with {unrelieved} grief on every page.
e.zh: 这部小说基调沉郁,每一页都弥漫着无法消解的悲伤。

e.en: Her chronic pain has been {unrelieved} by any medication.
e.zh: 她的慢性疼痛吃任何药都没能缓解。

unremarkable.t: adj. 平淡无奇的；不起眼的

e.en: The food was decent but otherwise {unremarkable}.
e.zh: 那食物还行,但没什么特别之处。

e.en: He lived an {unremarkable} life in a quiet town.
e.zh: 他在一个安静的小镇过着平淡无奇的生活。

unremarked.t: adj. 未被注意的；无人提及的

e.en: Her contribution went largely {unremarked} by the press.
e.zh: 她的贡献基本没被媒体提及。

e.en: The change passed {unremarked} for several weeks.
e.zh: 这项改动好几周都没人留意。

unremembered.t: adj. 被遗忘的；无人记得的

e.en: Many soldiers died {unremembered} on the battlefield.
e.zh: 许多士兵在战场上死去,无人铭记。

e.en: The old song faded into an {unremembered} past.
e.zh: 那首老歌渐渐消逝在被遗忘的过去里。

e.en: She faced {unremitting} pressure from her boss all month.
e.zh: 她整个月都承受着老板不间断的压力。

e.en: The {unremitting} rain flooded the entire valley.
e.zh: 连绵不断的雨水淹没了整个山谷。

unremittingly.t: adv. 不间断地；坚持不懈地

e.en: He worked {unremittingly} to finish the project on time.
e.zh: 他不停地工作,以按时完成项目。

e.en: The wind blew {unremittingly} across the open plain.
e.zh: 风毫不停歇地吹过开阔的平原。

e.en: The damaged roof remained {unrepaired} for months.
e.zh: 那处损坏的屋顶好几个月都没修。

e.en: Many potholes are still {unrepaired} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后许多坑洼至今未修。

unrepeatable.t: adj. 无法重复的；独一无二的

e.en: That concert was a truly {unrepeatable} experience.
e.zh: 那场演唱会真是一次无法重现的体验。

e.en: He muttered something {unrepeatable} under his breath.
e.zh: 他低声嘀咕了一句不堪入耳的话。

unrepentant.t: adj. 不悔改的；执迷不悟的

e.en: The hacker remained {unrepentant} during the trial.
e.zh: 那名黑客在庭审中毫无悔意。

e.en: She is an {unrepentant} fan of cheesy pop songs.
e.zh: 她是个毫不羞愧的俗气流行歌迷。

unreported.t: adj. 未报道的；未上报的

e.en: Many cybercrimes go {unreported} every year.
e.zh: 每年都有许多网络犯罪未被举报。

e.en: The leak remained {unreported} until a whistleblower spoke out.
e.zh: 在举报人发声前,那次泄露一直无人报道。

e.en: The small survey is {unrepresentative} of the whole population.
e.zh: 这次小规模调查无法代表整体人群。

e.en: Critics called the panel {unrepresentative} of women in tech.
e.zh: 批评者认为这个小组未能代表科技界的女性。

unrepresented.t: adj. 无代表的；未被代理的

e.en: Rural voters feel {unrepresented} in the new policy.
e.zh: 农村选民觉得新政策没有代表他们。

e.en: The defendant appeared in court {unrepresented} by counsel.
e.zh: 被告出庭时没有律师代理。

unrequited.t: adj. 单相思的；得不到回应的

e.en: The novel explores his {unrequited} love for a coworker.
e.zh: 小说描写了他对同事单相思的爱。

e.en: She wrote sad poems about {unrequited} affection.
e.zh: 她写了许多关于单恋的伤感诗。

unreserved.t: adj. 毫无保留的；未预订的

e.en: He gave the plan his {unreserved} support.
e.zh: 他对这个计划给予了毫无保留的支持。

e.en: There are still {unreserved} seats near the back.
e.zh: 后排还有一些未预订的座位。

unreservedly.t: adv. 毫无保留地；坦率地

e.en: The CEO apologized {unreservedly} for the data breach.
e.zh: 首席执行官就数据泄露毫无保留地道了歉。

e.en: I {unreservedly} recommend this restaurant to everyone.
e.zh: 我毫无保留地把这家餐厅推荐给每个人。

unresolvable.t: adj. 无法解决的；无法解析的

e.en: Their differences turned out to be {unresolvable}.
e.zh: 他们的分歧最终被证明无法调和。

e.en: The bug seemed {unresolvable} until we rewrote the module.
e.zh: 这个 bug 似乎无解,直到我们重写了模块。

unresolved.t: adj. 未解决的；悬而未决的

e.en: Several issues from last meeting remain {unresolved}.
e.zh: 上次会议遗留的几个问题仍未解决。

e.en: The mystery of the missing files is still {unresolved}.
e.zh: 文件失踪之谜至今未解。

unresponsive.t: adj. 无响应的；反应迟钝的

e.en: My laptop became {unresponsive} after the update.
e.zh: 更新之后我的笔记本就卡死没反应了。

e.en: Customer support has been {unresponsive} all week.
e.zh: 客服整整一周都没回复。

e.en: Users complained about the app's {unresponsiveness} during peak hours.
e.zh: 用户抱怨应用在高峰时段反应迟钝。

e.en: Her {unresponsiveness} to messages worried her friends.
e.zh: 她对消息的不回应让朋友们很担心。

e.en: Political {unrest} forced the airline to cancel flights.
e.zh: 政治动荡迫使航空公司取消了航班。

e.en: There is growing {unrest} among workers over low wages.
e.zh: 工人因低工资而日益不满。

e.en: The crowd cheered with {unrestrained} enthusiasm.
e.zh: 人群以毫不掩饰的热情欢呼。

e.en: His {unrestrained} spending eventually drained the account.
e.zh: 他毫无节制的花销最终掏空了账户。

unrestricted.t: adj. 无限制的；不受约束的

e.en: Premium members get {unrestricted} access to all videos.
e.zh: 高级会员可不受限制地观看所有视频。

e.en: The park is open to {unrestricted} public use.
e.zh: 公园对公众开放,无任何限制。

e.en: A series of social {unrests} swept across the region.
e.zh: 一连串社会动荡席卷了整个地区。

e.en: Historians studied the labor {unrests} of the 1920s.
e.zh: 历史学家研究了1920年代的劳工动乱。

unrevealed.t: adj. 未透露的；未公开的

e.en: The ending leaves several mysteries {unrevealed}.
e.zh: 结局留下了几个未揭开的谜团。

e.en: Her true motives remain {unrevealed} to this day.
e.zh: 她真正的动机至今仍未公开。

unrevealing.t: adj. 未透露信息的；不显山露水的

e.en: His answers were polite but {unrevealing}.
e.zh: 他的回答虽客气，却没透露任何信息。

e.en: The interview was disappointingly {unrevealing}.
e.zh: 这次采访令人失望，没有透露任何内幕。

e.en: Her years of hard work went largely {unrewarded}.
e.zh: 她多年的辛勤付出基本上没有得到回报。

e.en: Loyalty often goes {unrewarded} in big companies.
e.zh: 在大公司里，忠诚往往得不到回报。

unrewarding.t: adj. 无回报的；不值得付出的

e.en: He quit because the job was {unrewarding} and stressful.
e.zh: 他辞职是因为这份工作压力大又没成就感。

e.en: Volunteering shouldn't feel {unrewarding}.
e.zh: 做志愿者不应该让人觉得毫无意义。

e.en: The preacher warned against {unrighteous} behavior.
e.zh: 牧师警告人们不要做不正当的事。

e.en: He condemned the company's {unrighteous} business practices.
e.zh: 他谴责该公司不道德的商业行为。

e.en: These bananas are still {unripe} and very firm.
e.zh: 这些香蕉还没熟，硬邦邦的。

e.en: Don't pick the tomatoes while they're {unripe}.
e.zh: 番茄还没熟的时候不要摘下来。

unrivaled.t: adj. 无与伦比的；无敌的

e.en: This restaurant has {unrivaled} dim sum in the city.
e.zh: 这家餐厅的点心在全市无人能及。

e.en: Her expertise in machine learning is {unrivaled}.
e.zh: 她在机器学习方面的造诣无人可比。

unrivalled.t: adj. 无与伦比的（英式拼写）

e.en: The view from the summit is {unrivalled}.
e.zh: 从山顶望出去的景色无与伦比。

e.en: He has an {unrivalled} record in international tennis.
e.zh: 他在国际网坛有着无可匹敌的战绩。

e.en: Please {unroll} the yoga mat before class starts.
e.zh: 请在课程开始前把瑜伽垫展开。

e.en: The carpet is too heavy to {unroll} alone.
e.zh: 这块地毯太重了，一个人展不开。

unrolled.t:
adj. 展开的
v. unroll 的过去式

e.en: He {unrolled} the blueprints across the table.
e.zh: 他把蓝图在桌上铺展开来。

e.en: The company {unrolled} its new logo last week.
e.zh: 该公司上周公布了新的标志。

e.en: Eating leftovers on the couch is pretty {unromantic}.
e.zh: 窝在沙发上吃剩饭挺没情调的。

e.en: He's practical but completely {unromantic}.
e.zh: 他很务实，但一点也不浪漫。

unruffled.t: adj. 镇定的；不慌不忙的

e.en: She remained {unruffled} despite the angry crowd.
e.zh: 面对愤怒的人群，她依然镇定自若。

e.en: The CEO stayed {unruffled} during the tough questions.
e.zh: 面对尖锐的提问，CEO 始终从容不迫。

unruliness.t: n. 难以管束；不守规矩

e.en: The teacher complained about the class's {unruliness}.
e.zh: 老师抱怨这个班的学生不守纪律。

e.en: Her hair's {unruliness} drove her crazy every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都被自己乱糟糟的头发烦透了。

unruly.t: adj. 难以管束的；任性的

e.en: The bouncers escorted the {unruly} fans out of the stadium.
e.zh: 保安把不守规矩的球迷带出了体育场。

e.en: My hair is especially {unruly} on humid days.
e.zh: 潮湿的天气里我的头发特别乱。

unsaddled.t: v. 卸下马鞍；使人措手不及

e.en: She {unsaddled} the horse after the long ride.
e.zh: 长途骑行后，她把马鞍卸了下来。

e.en: The groom quickly {unsaddled} the tired pony.
e.zh: 马夫迅速把那匹疲惫的小马卸了鞍。

e.en: Drinking the tap water here is {unsafe}.
e.zh: 这里的自来水不安全，不能直接喝。

e.en: The bridge was declared {unsafe} after the inspection.
e.zh: 经过检查，这座桥被认定不安全。

unsaid.t: adj. 未说出口的；心照不宣的

e.en: Some things are better left {unsaid}.
e.zh: 有些话还是不说为好。

e.en: His disappointment was clear, though it remained {unsaid}.
e.zh: 他虽没明说，但失望之情显而易见。

e.en: The damaged inventory was deemed {unsalable}.
e.zh: 这批受损的存货被认定无法出售。

e.en: Outdated stock often becomes {unsalable} within months.
e.zh: 过时的库存往往几个月内就卖不出去了。

unsaleable.t: adj. 卖不掉的（英式拼写）

e.en: The torn books were marked as {unsaleable}.
e.zh: 那些破损的书被标记为无法出售。

e.en: Without permits, the property is essentially {unsaleable}.
e.zh: 没有许可证，这处房产基本上卖不出去。

e.en: The recipe calls for {unsalted} butter.
e.zh: 这个食谱要用无盐黄油。

e.en: I prefer {unsalted} nuts as a snack.
e.zh: 我更喜欢吃不加盐的坚果当零食。

unsalvageable.t: adj. 无法挽救的；无法回收的

e.en: After the flood, most of the furniture was {unsalvageable}.
e.zh: 洪水过后，大部分家具都没法再用了。

e.en: Their relationship seemed {unsalvageable} at that point.
e.zh: 他们的关系到那时候似乎已经无法挽回。

unsanctioned.t: adj. 未经批准的；未授权的

e.en: The {unsanctioned} race was shut down by police.
e.zh: 这场未经批准的比赛被警方叫停了。

e.en: Employees were warned against {unsanctioned} use of company data.
e.zh: 员工被警告不得擅自使用公司数据。

e.en: The kitchen was shut down for {unsanitary} conditions.
e.zh: 这家厨房因卫生条件不达标被关停了。

e.en: Sharing towels is {unsanitary} and risky.
e.zh: 共用毛巾既不卫生又有风险。

e.en: The issue was resolved {unsatisfactorily} for both parties.
e.zh: 这件事的处理结果让双方都不满意。

e.en: He answered the question {unsatisfactorily} and moved on.
e.zh: 他敷衍地回答了问题就跳过了。

unsatisfactory.t: adj. 不令人满意的，不够好的

e.en: His performance this quarter was deemed {unsatisfactory}.
e.zh: 他这个季度的表现被评为不合格。

e.en: The hotel offered an {unsatisfactory} response to our complaint.
e.zh: 酒店对我们的投诉回应得很不令人满意。

unsatisfied.t: adj. 不满足的，未得到满足的

e.en: Many customers remain {unsatisfied} with the new update.
e.zh: 许多用户对新版本仍然不满意。

e.en: She felt {unsatisfied} with her own answer.
e.zh: 她对自己的回答感到不满意。

e.en: Cheap imitations always {unsatisfy} true fans.
e.zh: 廉价的仿制品总是让真正的粉丝失望。

e.en: Quick fixes tend to {unsatisfy} in the long run.
e.zh: 临时凑合的办法长远来看总让人不满意。

unsatisfying.t: adj. 不令人满足的，差强人意的

e.en: The ending of the movie felt rushed and {unsatisfying}.
e.zh: 这部电影的结局显得仓促,令人不满意。

e.en: He left the meeting with an {unsatisfying} answer to his question.
e.zh: 他带着一个不令人满意的答复离开了会议。

unsaturated.t: adj. 不饱和的（脂肪、溶液）

e.en: Olive oil is rich in {unsaturated} fats that benefit heart health.
e.zh: 橄榄油富含有益心脏健康的不饱和脂肪。

e.en: The market remains {unsaturated}, leaving room for new competitors.
e.zh: 市场尚未饱和,新竞争者仍有发展空间。

unsaved.t: adj. 未保存的（文件、数据）

e.en: A power outage wiped out hours of {unsaved} work.
e.zh: 一次停电让我几个小时未保存的工作全没了。

e.en: The editor warns you before closing an {unsaved} document.
e.zh: 编辑器在关闭未保存的文档前会发出警告。

unsavory.t: adj. 令人反感的；难吃的

e.en: He has a reputation for keeping {unsavory} business contacts.
e.zh: 他以结交一些不三不四的生意伙伴而出名。

e.en: The deal collapsed after {unsavory} details came to light.
e.zh: 在一些令人反感的细节曝光后,这笔交易告吹了。

unsavoury.t: adj. 令人反感的；难吃的（英式拼写）

e.en: The neighborhood has an {unsavoury} reputation after dark.
e.zh: 这个街区入夜后名声不太好。

e.en: Reporters uncovered the politician's {unsavoury} financial dealings.
e.zh: 记者揭露了这位政客不光彩的财务往来。

e.en: Once the words are out, you cannot {unsay} them.
e.zh: 话一出口,就再也收不回来了。

e.en: She wished she could {unsay} her angry comment to her friend.
e.zh: 她真希望能收回对朋友说的那句气话。

unsayable.t: adj. 难以启齿的，说不出口的

e.en: Some grief feels truly {unsayable}, no matter how you try.
e.zh: 有些悲痛无论怎么努力都难以言说。

e.en: Poetry often reaches for what is otherwise {unsayable}.
e.zh: 诗歌常常试图触及那些难以言说的事物。

unscarred.t: adj. 没有伤痕的；未受创伤的

e.en: He emerged from the accident remarkably {unscarred}.
e.zh: 他从事故中走出来,身上几乎毫发无损。

e.en: Few children grow up entirely {unscarred} by their family history.
e.zh: 很少有孩子能完全不受家庭过往影响地长大。

unscathed.t: adj. 毫发无损的，安然无恙的

e.en: The driver walked away {unscathed} from the wrecked car.
e.zh: 司机从撞毁的车里走出来,毫发无伤。

e.en: The company emerged {unscathed} from the recent market crash.
e.zh: 该公司在近期的市场崩盘中安然无恙。

e.en: Her review was thorough yet surprisingly {unscathing} of the author.
e.zh: 她的评论很详尽,却出乎意料地没有抨击作者。

e.en: The critic offered an honest but {unscathing} take on the film.
e.zh: 这位影评人对该片给出了诚恳但不刻薄的评价。

unscented.t: adj. 无香味的，无香精的

e.en: I prefer {unscented} lotion because perfumes irritate my skin.
e.zh: 我更喜欢无香味的护肤乳,因为香精会刺激我的皮肤。

e.en: The hotel offers {unscented} soap for sensitive guests.
e.zh: 酒店为敏感肌客人提供无香皂。

e.en: The pilot announced an {unscheduled} stop in Denver.
e.zh: 机长宣布将在丹佛进行一次计划外的停留。

e.en: An {unscheduled} meeting popped up on my calendar this morning.
e.zh: 今早我的日历上突然冒出一个计划外的会议。

unschooled.t: adj. 未受正规教育的；未经训练的

e.en: She is {unschooled} in formal music theory but plays beautifully.
e.zh: 她没受过正规的乐理训练,但弹得很美。

e.en: The villagers were largely {unschooled} but deeply wise.
e.zh: 村民们大多没受过正规教育,却饱含智慧。

e.en: Drawing conclusions from one example is highly {unscientific}.
e.zh: 仅凭一个例子下结论是非常不科学的。

e.en: The study was criticized for using {unscientific} methods.
e.zh: 这项研究因采用不科学的方法而受到批评。

unscramble.t: v. 解码，整理；理清（信号或混乱信息）

e.en: Can you {unscramble} these letters to form a word?
e.zh: 你能把这些字母重新排列成一个单词吗?

e.en: It took hours to {unscramble} the corrupted data file.
e.zh: 花了好几个小时才把损坏的数据文件还原过来。

unscreened.t: adj. 未经筛查的；未加遮挡的

e.en: The film was {unscreened} in most theaters due to controversy.
e.zh: 由于争议,这部电影在多数影院都没有放映。

e.en: Hiring {unscreened} candidates can pose serious security risks.
e.zh: 雇用未经审查的求职者可能带来严重的安全风险。

unscrew.t: v. 拧开，旋下（螺丝、盖子）

e.en: You'll need a Phillips screwdriver to {unscrew} the back panel.
e.zh: 你需要一把十字螺丝刀才能拧开后盖。

e.en: She struggled to {unscrew} the tight jar lid.
e.zh: 她费力地拧开那个紧紧的罐盖。

unscripted.t: adj. 即兴的，非事先写好的

e.en: The most touching moment of the show was completely {unscripted}.
e.zh: 节目中最感人的一刻完全是即兴发挥的。

e.en: Reality TV thrives on {unscripted} drama between contestants.
e.zh: 真人秀靠选手间未经剧本设计的戏剧冲突而走红。

unscrupulous.t: adj. 不择手段的，无良的

e.en: {Unscrupulous} sellers often hide defects from online buyers.
e.zh: 无良卖家常常向网购买家隐瞒商品缺陷。

e.en: He built his fortune through {unscrupulous} business practices.
e.zh: 他靠不择手段的商业行为积累了财富。

unscrupulously.t: adv. 不择手段地，无良地

e.en: The company {unscrupulously} marketed the product to children.
e.zh: 该公司毫无道德地把这款产品推销给儿童。

e.en: He {unscrupulously} took credit for his teammate's work.
e.zh: 他厚颜无耻地把队友的功劳据为己有。

unscrupulousness.t: n. 不择手段，肆无忌惮

e.en: The CEO's {unscrupulousness} eventually caught up with him in court.
e.zh: 这位CEO的不择手段最终让他在法庭上付出了代价。

e.en: Voters were shocked by the campaign's blatant {unscrupulousness}.
e.zh: 选民们对这场竞选的露骨无耻深感震惊。

e.en: The judge agreed to {unseal} the court documents next week.
e.zh: 法官同意下周公开这些封存的法庭文件。

e.en: Carefully {unseal} the envelope without tearing the contents.
e.zh: 小心地把信封拆开,别把里面的东西撕坏。

e.en: The package arrived {unsealed} and missing several items.
e.zh: 包裹送到时是开着的,而且少了好几样东西。

e.en: Court records were finally {unsealed} after twenty years.
e.zh: 法庭记录在二十年后终于被公开。

e.en: We had {unseasonable} snow in early May this year.
e.zh: 今年五月初竟下了不合时令的雪。

e.en: The {unseasonable} heat ruined the spring tulip festival.
e.zh: 反常的高温毁了春季的郁金香节。

unseasonably.t: adv. 不合时令地，反常地

e.en: It has been {unseasonably} warm for November in Boston.
e.zh: 波士顿这个十一月暖得不合时令。

e.en: The {unseasonably} cold spring delayed the cherry blossoms.
e.zh: 反常寒冷的春天推迟了樱花的开放。

unseasonal.t: adj. 反季节的，不合季节的

e.en: Farmers worry about {unseasonal} rain damaging the harvest.
e.zh: 农民们担心反季节的降雨会损害收成。

e.en: The {unseasonal} cold snap killed many young plants.
e.zh: 反季节的寒潮冻死了许多幼苗。

unseasoned.t: adj. 未调味的；没经验的

e.en: The chicken tasted bland because it was completely {unseasoned}.
e.zh: 这只鸡完全没调味,所以吃起来淡而无味。

e.en: {Unseasoned} recruits often struggle during their first deployment.
e.zh: 没经验的新兵在第一次部署时常常很吃力。

unseat.t: v. 使下台，罢免；使落马

e.en: The challenger hopes to {unseat} the long-serving senator.
e.zh: 挑战者希望能把这位资深参议员赶下台。

e.en: A sudden jolt nearly {unseat} the rider from her horse.
e.zh: 突如其来的颠簸差点把骑手从马背上摔下来。

unsecured.t: adj. 无担保的（贷款）；未加固的

e.en: Avoid logging into your bank on {unsecured} public Wi-Fi.
e.zh: 不要在不安全的公共Wi-Fi上登录网银。

e.en: The loan is {unsecured}, so the interest rate is higher.
e.zh: 这笔贷款是无担保的,所以利率较高。

unseeable.t: adj. 看不见的，不可见的

e.en: The smallest particles are {unseeable} without a powerful microscope.
e.zh: 最小的粒子若不借助高倍显微镜是看不见的。

e.en: Some truths feel {unseeable} until experience finally reveals them.
e.zh: 有些真相要等到亲身经历才会显现出来。

unseeded.t: adj. 非种子选手的（体育）

e.en: The {unseeded} player shocked everyone by reaching the final.
e.zh: 这位非种子选手一路杀进决赛,震惊众人。

e.en: As an {unseeded} entrant, she had nothing to lose.
e.zh: 作为非种子选手,她毫无心理负担。

unseeing.t: adj. 视而不见的，茫然的

e.en: He stared with {unseeing} eyes at the rain outside.
e.zh: 他双眼茫然地望着窗外的雨。

e.en: Her {unseeing} gaze suggested her mind was far away.
e.zh: 她那茫然的眼神说明她的思绪飘到了远方。

unseeingly.t: adv. 视而不见地，茫然地

e.en: She walked {unseeingly} past her old friend on the street.
e.zh: 她在街上视而不见地从老朋友身边走过。

e.en: He stared {unseeingly} at the report, lost in thought.
e.zh: 他茫然地盯着那份报告,陷入了沉思。

unseemly.t: adj. 不得体的，不合礼仪的

e.en: Arguing loudly at the funeral was considered {unseemly}.
e.zh: 在葬礼上大声争吵被认为是不得体的。

e.en: The minister resigned after his {unseemly} behavior went public.
e.zh: 这位部长在不雅行为曝光后辞职了。

unseen.t: adj. 看不见的，未曾见过的

e.en: An {unseen} bug in the code crashed the whole server.
e.zh: 代码里一个未被发现的bug让整台服务器崩了。

e.en: Many heroes do their best work {unseen} by the public.
e.zh: 许多英雄都在公众看不见的地方做着最了不起的事。

e.en: Click the box to delete all {unselected} files automatically.
e.zh: 点击该方框可自动删除所有未选中的文件。

e.en: {Unselected} candidates received a polite rejection email.
e.zh: 未被选中的候选人收到了一封礼貌的拒绝邮件。

unselfconscious.t: adj. 不拘谨的，自然大方的

e.en: Children dance with an {unselfconscious} joy that adults often lose.
e.zh: 孩子们跳起舞来毫无拘束,而大人往往失去了这份纯真。

e.en: Her {unselfconscious} laugh filled the entire café.
e.zh: 她毫不做作的笑声响彻了整个咖啡馆。

unselfconsciously.t: adv. 毫不拘谨地，自然地

e.en: He sang {unselfconsciously} along with the radio in the car.
e.zh: 他在车里毫不在意地跟着收音机唱起来。

e.en: The toddler {unselfconsciously} hugged every dog she saw.
e.zh: 那小娃娃毫不害羞地拥抱她见到的每一只狗。

e.en: Her {unselfish} care for the elderly neighbors touched everyone.
e.zh: 她对邻家老人无私的照顾感动了所有人。

e.en: He made an {unselfish} pass that led to the winning goal.
e.zh: 他无私地传出一脚妙球,促成了制胜进球。

e.en: She {unselfishly} gave up her seat for the pregnant woman.
e.zh: 她无私地把座位让给了那位孕妇。

e.en: Volunteers worked {unselfishly} through the night after the storm.
e.zh: 志愿者们在风暴过后无私地通宵奋战。

e.en: His {unselfishness} on the team made everyone play better.
e.zh: 他在队里的无私让所有人都打得更好。

e.en: The award honored a lifetime of quiet {unselfishness}.
e.zh: 这一奖项是为表彰他一生默默无私的奉献。

unsentimental.t: adj. 不感情用事的，理性的

e.en: She gave a clear, {unsentimental} account of the war years.
e.zh: 她对战争岁月作了清晰、不带感伤的叙述。

e.en: His {unsentimental} approach to business surprised many investors.
e.zh: 他对商业那种不带感情的态度让许多投资人感到意外。

unserious.t: adj. 不严肃的，不认真的

e.en: His {unserious} attitude during the meeting annoyed the team.
e.zh: 他在会议上不正经的态度惹恼了团队。

e.en: The proposal was dismissed as an {unserious} attempt at reform.
e.zh: 这项提案被视为一次不严肃的改革尝试而遭否决。

unserviceable.t: adj. 不能使用的，失修的

e.en: The mechanic declared the old engine completely {unserviceable}.
e.zh: 机修工认定这台旧发动机已经完全没法用了。

e.en: Several rifles were marked {unserviceable} after the inspection.
e.zh: 检验之后,有几支步枪被标记为无法使用。

e.en: Sudden changes in routine can {unsettle} young children.
e.zh: 日常生活的突然变化会让小孩感到不安。

e.en: The leaked memo will {unsettle} investors when it goes public.
e.zh: 泄露的备忘录公开后会让投资者人心惶惶。

unsettled.t: adj. 不安的；未解决的；动荡的

e.en: She felt {unsettled} after reading the strange email.
e.zh: 读完那封奇怪的邮件后,她心里很不安。

e.en: The lawsuit has been {unsettled} for over three years.
e.zh: 这起诉讼悬而未决已经超过三年了。

unsettles.t: v. 使不安；扰乱（unsettle 第三人称单数）

e.en: The eerie silence of the empty house {unsettles} her.
e.zh: 空房子里诡异的寂静让她心神不宁。

e.en: Nothing {unsettles} him more than unexpected changes to the schedule.
e.zh: 没有什么比日程突变更让他不安的了。

unsettling.t: adj. 令人不安的；扰乱人心的

e.en: The documentary asked some deeply {unsettling} questions about AI.
e.zh: 这部纪录片提出了一些关于人工智能的令人不安的深刻问题。

e.en: There was something {unsettling} about the stranger's smile.
e.zh: 那个陌生人的笑容里有种令人不安的感觉。

unshackled.t:
adj. 不受束缚的；获自由的
v. 解开镣铐

e.en: The new policy left small businesses {unshackled} from heavy regulation.
e.zh: 新政策让小企业摆脱了繁重监管的束缚。

e.en: Working remotely, she felt creatively {unshackled} for the first time.
e.zh: 远程工作让她第一次感到创作上自由无拘。

unshaded.t: adj. 无遮蔽的；无阴影的

e.en: Walking on the {unshaded} path quickly became unbearable in summer.
e.zh: 夏天走在没有遮荫的小路上很快就让人受不了。

e.en: The {unshaded} lamp cast a harsh light across the room.
e.zh: 那盏没罩灯罩的灯把屋里照得刺眼。

unshakable.t: adj. 坚定不移的；不可动摇的

e.en: She has an {unshakable} belief in her team's ability to win.
e.zh: 她对自己团队获胜的能力有着坚定不移的信念。

e.en: His {unshakable} calm helped everyone through the crisis.
e.zh: 他那不可动摇的冷静帮助大家渡过了危机。

unshakably.t: adv. 坚定不移地；不可动摇地

e.en: She remained {unshakably} loyal to her best friend.
e.zh: 她始终如一地忠于她最好的朋友。

e.en: He stood {unshakably} firm on his decision to resign.
e.zh: 他坚定不移地坚持辞职的决定。

unshakeable.t: adj. 坚定不移的（unshakable 的变体）

e.en: The coach has an {unshakeable} confidence in his young players.
e.zh: 教练对他的年轻球员有着不可动摇的信心。

e.en: Her faith in justice remained {unshakeable} throughout the trial.
e.zh: 在整个审判过程中,她对正义的信念始终坚定不移。

e.en: He remained {unshaken} despite the harsh criticism online.
e.zh: 尽管网上批评激烈,他依然不为所动。

e.en: Her commitment to the cause was {unshaken} after years of struggle.
e.zh: 经过多年的奋斗,她对这项事业的承诺依然坚定。

unshaped.t: adj. 未成形的；未定型的

e.en: The clay sat {unshaped} on the potter's wheel all morning.
e.zh: 那团黏土整个上午都未成形地放在陶轮上。

e.en: His ideas are still raw and {unshaped} at this stage.
e.zh: 现阶段他的想法还很粗糙,尚未成形。

e.en: Many of her best memories remained {unshared} for decades.
e.zh: 她许多最美好的回忆几十年来都未曾与人分享。

e.en: The document is private and {unshared} with anyone outside the team.
e.zh: 该文件是私密的,未与团队外的任何人共享。

e.en: He showed up to the meeting tired and {unshaved}.
e.zh: 他疲惫且未刮胡子地出现在会议上。

e.en: His {unshaved} face made him look older than he was.
e.zh: 他没刮胡子的脸让他看起来比实际年龄大。

e.en: He answered the door {unshaven} and still in pajamas.
e.zh: 他没刮胡子,还穿着睡衣去开门。

e.en: The detective's {unshaven} look suited his rugged style.
e.zh: 那位侦探未刮胡子的样子很配他粗犷的风格。

e.en: The knight prepared to {unsheathe} his sword before the duel.
e.zh: 骑士在决斗前准备拔出他的剑。

e.en: Cats {unsheathe} their claws when they feel threatened.
e.zh: 猫感到受威胁时会伸出它们的爪子。

e.en: He {unsheathed} his blade with a swift, practiced motion.
e.zh: 他以娴熟而迅速的动作拔出了剑。

e.en: The warrior stood ready, sword {unsheathed} and gleaming.
e.zh: 那名战士已准备就绪,剑已出鞘,寒光闪闪。

e.en: Her eyes glistened with {unshed} tears as she said goodbye.
e.zh: 她道别时眼里闪烁着未流下的泪水。

e.en: He turned away to hide the {unshed} tears in his eyes.
e.zh: 他转过身去,藏起眼中未落的泪。

e.en: She bought a bag of {unshelled} peanuts at the market.
e.zh: 她在市场买了一袋带壳的花生。

e.en: The {unshelled} walnuts take longer to prepare for baking.
e.zh: 带壳的核桃为烘焙做准备需要更长时间。

unshielded.t: adj. 无屏蔽的；无防护的

e.en: The cables were {unshielded}, causing constant signal interference.
e.zh: 这些电缆没有屏蔽,导致信号持续受到干扰。

e.en: Workers should never stand {unshielded} near the radiation source.
e.zh: 工人们绝不应在辐射源附近无防护地站立。

unsighted.t: adj. 视线受阻的；看不见的

e.en: The goalkeeper was {unsighted} when the shot flew past him.
e.zh: 球射入时守门员视线被挡住,看不见来球。

e.en: A defender stood in front of him, leaving him completely {unsighted}.
e.zh: 一名后卫站在他面前,使他完全看不见目标。

e.en: The construction site left an {unsightly} mess on the street.
e.zh: 工地在街上留下一片难看的脏乱。

e.en: She covered the {unsightly} stain on the couch with a blanket.
e.zh: 她用毯子盖住了沙发上那块难看的污渍。

unsigned.t: adj. 未签名的；无符号的（数值类型）

e.en: The contract is still {unsigned} and waiting for her approval.
e.zh: 合同仍未签署,正等着她批准。

e.en: The band remained {unsigned} despite their growing online following.
e.zh: 尽管网上粉丝不断增加,这支乐队仍未签约唱片公司。

unsinkable.t: adj. 不会沉没的；不屈不挠的

e.en: The Titanic was famously called {unsinkable} before its tragic voyage.
e.zh: 泰坦尼克号在那次悲剧性航行前曾被称为永不沉没的巨轮。

e.en: Her optimism made her seem completely {unsinkable} during hard times.
e.zh: 她的乐观让她在艰难时期显得无可击垮。

unskilled.t: adj. 无技能的；非熟练的

e.en: Many {unskilled} workers struggle to find stable jobs today.
e.zh: 如今许多无技能的工人很难找到稳定的工作。

e.en: He was {unskilled} at cooking but eager to learn.
e.zh: 他不擅长做饭,但很想学。

unsmiling.t: adj. 不苟言笑的；严肃的

e.en: The {unsmiling} guard watched every visitor enter the building.
e.zh: 那位面无笑容的保安注视着每一位进入大楼的访客。

e.en: She delivered the bad news with an {unsmiling} expression.
e.zh: 她面无笑容地传达了那个坏消息。

e.en: He's a quiet, somewhat {unsociable} guy who prefers reading alone.
e.zh: 他是个安静、不太合群的人,更喜欢独自看书。

e.en: The cat became {unsociable} after moving to the new house.
e.zh: 那只猫搬到新家后变得不爱与人亲近。

unsocial.t: adj. 不合群的；反社交的

e.en: Working {unsocial} hours has affected his family life.
e.zh: 上班时间不合常规已经影响了他的家庭生活。

e.en: Nurses often work {unsocial} shifts during nights and weekends.
e.zh: 护士经常要在夜间和周末上不合常规的班。

e.en: Several copies of the book remained {unsold} after the sale.
e.zh: 促销结束后,这本书还有几本没卖出去。

e.en: The store donates {unsold} bread to local shelters every night.
e.zh: 这家店每晚把没卖完的面包捐给当地收容所。

unsolicited.t: adj. 未经请求的；主动送上的

e.en: He keeps sending me {unsolicited} advice about my career.
e.zh: 他老是主动给我一些没人想听的职业建议。

e.en: Most {unsolicited} emails end up in the spam folder.
e.zh: 大多数未经请求的邮件都会进垃圾箱。

unsolvable.t: adj. 无法解决的；无解的

e.en: The puzzle seemed {unsolvable} until she spotted the trick.
e.zh: 那道谜题看似无解,直到她看出其中的窍门。

e.en: Climate change is complex but not {unsolvable}.
e.zh: 气候变化虽复杂,但并非无法解决。

unsolved.t: adj. 未解决的；悬而未决的

e.en: The murder case has remained {unsolved} for thirty years.
e.zh: 这宗凶杀案三十年来一直悬而未破。

e.en: Several math problems are still {unsolved} today.
e.zh: 如今仍有几道数学难题悬而未解。

unsophisticated.t: adj. 单纯的；不老练的；朴素的

e.en: The app's interface looks a bit {unsophisticated} compared to competitors.
e.zh: 和竞品相比,这款应用的界面显得有些粗糙简陋。

e.en: He prefers simple, {unsophisticated} home-cooked meals.
e.zh: 他喜欢简单朴素的家常菜。

unsorted.t: adj. 未排序的；未分类的

e.en: My inbox is full of {unsorted} emails from last month.
e.zh: 我的收件箱里满是上个月没整理的邮件。

e.en: She handed me a pile of {unsorted} receipts to file.
e.zh: 她递给我一叠未整理的收据让我归档。

unsought.t: adj. 非主动寻求的；未请自来的

e.en: Fame came {unsought} after his viral TikTok video.
e.zh: 那条 TikTok 走红后,名气不请自来。

e.en: He offered {unsought} opinions at every team meeting.
e.zh: 他在每次团队会议上都发表没人征求的意见。

unsound.t: adj. 不健全的；不可靠的

e.en: The bridge was declared structurally {unsound} after the inspection.
e.zh: 经过检查,这座桥被认定结构不安全。

e.en: Her argument is logically {unsound} on several points.
e.zh: 她的论点在几个地方逻辑上站不住脚。

unsparing.t: adj. 毫不吝啬的；严厉的

e.en: The critic was {unsparing} in his review of the film.
e.zh: 那位评论家对这部电影的批评毫不留情。

e.en: She is {unsparing} with her time when friends need help.
e.zh: 朋友需要帮忙时,她总是不吝惜自己的时间。

unspeakable.t: adj. 难以言喻的；糟糕透顶的

e.en: The refugees endured {unspeakable} suffering during the war.
e.zh: 那些难民在战争中经历了难以言喻的苦难。

e.en: What he did to that dog was simply {unspeakable}.
e.zh: 他对那只狗做的事简直令人发指。

unspeakably.t: adv. 难以言喻地；极其糟糕地

e.en: The hotel room was {unspeakably} dirty when we arrived.
e.zh: 我们到达时,酒店房间脏得难以形容。

e.en: She felt {unspeakably} grateful for the surprise gift.
e.zh: 对这份意外的礼物,她心中感激得无以言表。

unspecialized.t: adj. 非专门化的；通用的

e.en: Entry-level roles often involve fairly {unspecialized} tasks.
e.zh: 初级岗位通常做的都是不太需要专业技能的工作。

e.en: General practitioners offer {unspecialized} medical care to families.
e.zh: 全科医生为家庭提供非专科的常规医疗服务。

e.en: His feedback was vague and {unspecific}, so I asked for examples.
e.zh: 他的反馈含糊笼统,我便请他举些具体例子。

e.en: Avoid {unspecific} job titles like 'ninja' on your résumé.
e.zh: 简历上要避免 'ninja' 之类含糊不清的职位名称。

unspecified.t: adj. 未指定的；未说明的

e.en: The company laid off staff for {unspecified} reasons.
e.zh: 公司以未明示的理由裁掉了员工。

e.en: She was paid an {unspecified} amount for the consulting work.
e.zh: 她从这次咨询工作中获得了一笔未公开金额的报酬。

e.en: His debut was solid but rather {unspectacular}.
e.zh: 他的首秀表现稳健,但并不出彩。

e.en: The view from the hotel window was {unspectacular}.
e.zh: 从酒店窗户望出去的景色平平无奇。

unspent.t: adj. 未花费的；未用尽的

e.en: She returned the {unspent} portion of the travel budget.
e.zh: 她把出差预算中没花完的部分退了回去。

e.en: There was still energy {unspent} after the long hike.
e.zh: 长途徒步之后,体力还没完全耗尽。

unspoiled.t: adj. 未被破坏的；原始的

e.en: The island remains an {unspoiled} paradise for divers.
e.zh: 这座岛仍是潜水者心中未被破坏的天堂。

e.en: Despite his fame, he stayed remarkably {unspoiled}.
e.zh: 尽管成名了,他依然难得地没被名利冲昏头脑。

unspoilt.t: adj. 未被破坏的（unspoiled 的英式拼写）

e.en: They hiked through miles of {unspoilt} countryside.
e.zh: 他们徒步穿过了数英里未受破坏的乡野。

e.en: The village retains its {unspoilt} charm despite tourism.
e.zh: 尽管旅游业发展,这个村子仍保有原汁原味的魅力。

unspoken.t: adj. 未说出口的；心照不宣的

e.en: There was an {unspoken} tension between the two coworkers.
e.zh: 两位同事之间存在一种心照不宣的紧张气氛。

e.en: Their {unspoken} agreement was to never mention the past.
e.zh: 他们之间有个不言而喻的默契:绝口不提过去。

unsportsmanlike.t: adj. 违反体育精神的；不公道的

e.en: The referee penalized him for {unsportsmanlike} conduct.
e.zh: 裁判因他行为不符合体育精神而判罚了他。

e.en: Trash-talking opponents is considered {unsportsmanlike} behavior.
e.zh: 言语侮辱对手被视为缺乏体育精神的行为。

unspotted.t: adj. 无污点的；未被发现的

e.en: The thief slipped out of the store completely {unspotted}.
e.zh: 小偷悄悄溜出商店,没被任何人发现。

e.en: Her white sneakers stayed surprisingly {unspotted} all day.
e.zh: 她那双白球鞋一整天竟一点污渍都没沾上。

e.en: My Wi-Fi connection has been really {unstable} this week.
e.zh: 我家 Wi-Fi 这周一直很不稳定。

e.en: The pile of books looked dangerously {unstable}.
e.zh: 那摞书看起来摇摇欲坠,十分危险。

e.en: His reputation remained {unstained} despite the rumors.
e.zh: 尽管流言四起,他的名声依然清白无瑕。

e.en: Amazingly, the white tablecloth stayed {unstained} all evening.
e.zh: 令人惊讶的是,那块白桌布一整晚都没被弄脏。

unstandardized.t: adj. 非标准化的；未统一的

e.en: Pricing across the platform is still largely {unstandardized}.
e.zh: 该平台上的定价目前在很大程度上仍未统一。

e.en: The data was messy and {unstandardized} across regions.
e.zh: 各地区的数据杂乱无章,缺乏统一标准。

untraveled.t: adj. 未被游历过的；未旅行的

e.en: She loves exploring {untraveled} mountain paths.
e.zh: 她喜欢探索人迹罕至的山间小路。

e.en: That section of the road is largely {untraveled} at night.
e.zh: 那段路晚上几乎没有车辆经过。

untreatable.t: adj. 无法治疗的；难处理的

e.en: Doctors warned that the infection could become {untreatable}.
e.zh: 医生警告说这种感染可能变得无法治疗。

e.en: Some rare cancers are still {untreatable} today.
e.zh: 有些罕见癌症至今仍无法治愈。

untreated.t: adj. 未经治疗的；未经处理的

e.en: {Untreated} sewage was flowing into the river.
e.zh: 未经处理的污水正流入河中。

e.en: If left {untreated}, the wound could get infected.
e.zh: 伤口若不处理可能会感染。

untried.t: adj. 未尝试过的；未经考验的

e.en: They decided to test the {untried} algorithm in production.
e.zh: 他们决定在生产环境中测试这套未经验证的算法。

e.en: The defendants were held for years {untried}.
e.zh: 那些被告被关押多年都未受审。

untrimmed.t: adj. 未修剪的；未装饰的

e.en: The {untrimmed} hedge nearly blocked the sidewalk.
e.zh: 未修剪的树篱几乎挡住了人行道。

e.en: He uploaded the {untrimmed} video by mistake.
e.zh: 他不小心上传了未剪辑的视频。

untroubled.t: adj. 平静的；不受打扰的

e.en: The baby slept {untroubled} through the thunderstorm.
e.zh: 婴儿在雷雨中安然无忧地睡着。

e.en: She lived an {untroubled} life in the countryside.
e.zh: 她在乡下过着无忧无虑的生活。

e.en: The rumor about the merger turned out to be {untrue}.
e.zh: 关于合并的传言最终被证明是不实的。

e.en: He felt guilty for being {untrue} to his promise.
e.zh: 他因没有信守诺言而感到内疚。

e.en: That website looks {untrustworthy}, so don't enter your password.
e.zh: 那个网站看起来不可信,别输入你的密码。

e.en: Investors quickly avoid {untrustworthy} brokers in volatile markets.
e.zh: 在动荡的市场中,投资者会迅速远离不可信的经纪人。

e.en: The politician was caught telling an obvious {untruth}.
e.zh: 那位政客被抓到说了一个明显的谎言。

e.en: She refused to spread any {untruth} about her colleague.
e.zh: 她拒绝散布任何关于同事的谣言。

e.en: His answers on the form were clearly {untruthful}.
e.zh: 他在表格上的回答显然是不实的。

e.en: Being {untruthful} with your doctor can be dangerous.
e.zh: 对医生不说实话可能会很危险。

e.en: The witness answered {untruthfully} and was charged with perjury.
e.zh: 该证人作了不实陈述,因此被控伪证罪。

e.en: He spoke {untruthfully} about his work experience in the interview.
e.zh: 他在面试中谎报了自己的工作经历。

untucked.t: adj. 衣摆未塞进（裤子里）的

e.en: His shirt was {untucked} after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后他的衬衫下摆露在外面。

e.en: Casual Fridays mean {untucked} shirts are totally fine.
e.zh: 周五便装日穿衬衫不扎进去也完全没问题。

unturned.t: adj. 未翻动的；未翻转的

e.en: Detectives left no stone {unturned} in the investigation.
e.zh: 侦探们在调查中不放过任何蛛丝马迹。

e.en: Several pages of the old book remained {unturned}.
e.zh: 那本旧书还有几页没有被翻开。

untutored.t: adj. 未受教育的；无师自通的

e.en: To the {untutored} eye, the two paintings look identical.
e.zh: 在外行人看来,这两幅画看起来一模一样。

e.en: She has an {untutored} but powerful singing voice.
e.zh: 她的歌声未经训练,却极富感染力。

untwisted.t:
adj. 解开的；未扭曲的
v. 解开（untwist 的过去式）

e.en: He carefully {untwisted} the tangled headphone cable.
e.zh: 他小心地把缠在一起的耳机线解开。

e.en: The rope finally lay {untwisted} on the deck.
e.zh: 绳子终于平整地摊在甲板上。

untying.t: v. 解开（untie 的现在分词）

e.en: She struggled with {untying} the knot in her shoelace.
e.zh: 她费力地解开鞋带上的结。

e.en: The dog kept {untying} its leash from the post.
e.zh: 那只狗不停地把拴在柱子上的绳子弄开。

untypical.t: adj. 非典型的；不寻常的

e.en: Heavy snow in April is {untypical} for this region.
e.zh: 这个地区四月下大雪并不常见。

e.en: His quiet behavior was {untypical} of him today.
e.zh: 他今天安静的样子和平时不太一样。

unusable.t: adj. 无法使用的；不能用的

e.en: The flooding made the basement {unusable} for months.
e.zh: 洪水让地下室好几个月都没法使用。

e.en: After the update, the old app is completely {unusable}.
e.zh: 更新之后,这个旧应用完全没法用了。

unused.t: adj. 未使用的；不习惯的

e.en: There's an {unused} meeting room on the third floor.
e.zh: 三楼有一间没人用的会议室。

e.en: She returned the {unused} portion of her gift card.
e.zh: 她把礼品卡里没用完的部分退了回去。

e.en: It's {unusual} for him to be late to meetings.
e.zh: 他开会迟到是很少见的事。

e.en: The café serves an {unusual} blend of Ethiopian coffee.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆提供一种独特的埃塞俄比亚混合咖啡。

e.en: The streets were {unusually} quiet on Sunday morning.
e.zh: 周日早上街道异常安静。

e.en: She was {unusually} talkative during dinner last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚吃饭时话特别多,很反常。

e.en: The {unusualness} of the weather pattern surprised meteorologists.
e.zh: 这种天气模式的反常让气象学家感到惊讶。

e.en: Critics praised the film for its {unusualness} and creativity.
e.zh: 影评人称赞这部电影别具一格,富有创意。

unusualnesses.t: n. 不寻常（unusualness 的复数）

e.en: The report catalogued the {unusualnesses} of each rare specimen.
e.zh: 报告记录了每件稀有标本的各种奇特之处。

e.en: Linguists studied the {unusualnesses} found across regional dialects.
e.zh: 语言学家研究了各地方言中出现的种种异常现象。

unutterable.t: adj. 难以言喻的；说不出的

e.en: She felt an {unutterable} sadness after hearing the news.
e.zh: 听到那个消息后,她心中涌起难以言表的悲伤。

e.en: The view from the summit had an {unutterable} beauty.
e.zh: 山顶的景色美得无法形容。

e.en: The lecture was {unutterably} dull from start to finish.
e.zh: 那场讲座从头到尾乏味得难以形容。

e.en: He looked {unutterably} tired after the overnight shift.
e.zh: 上完夜班后他显得疲惫得难以言喻。

unvarnished.t: adj. 朴实无华的；未加修饰的

e.en: I want the {unvarnished} truth about our company's finances.
e.zh: 我想听到关于公司财务状况的实话。

e.en: Her {unvarnished} review of the restaurant went viral online.
e.zh: 她对那家餐厅毫不修饰的点评在网上走红。

unvarying.t: adj. 不变的；始终如一的

e.en: He follows an {unvarying} routine every weekday morning.
e.zh: 他每个工作日早晨都遵循一成不变的作息。

e.en: The machine produces parts of {unvarying} quality and size.
e.zh: 这台机器生产的零件质量和尺寸始终如一。

unveil.t: v. 揭幕；公开发布（产品）

e.en: Apple will {unveil} its new iPhone next Tuesday.
e.zh: 苹果公司将在下周二发布新款 iPhone。

e.en: The mayor came to {unveil} the statue downtown.
e.zh: 市长前来为市中心的雕像揭幕。

unveiled.t: v. 揭晓；发布（unveil 的过去式）

e.en: The startup {unveiled} its first product at the conference.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在大会上首次发布了它的产品。

e.en: Researchers {unveiled} surprising findings about ocean currents yesterday.
e.zh: 研究人员昨天公布了关于洋流的惊人发现。

unveiling.t:
n. 揭幕；新品发布
v. 揭开（unveil 的现在分词）

e.en: The grand {unveiling} of the new museum drew huge crowds.
e.zh: 新博物馆的盛大揭幕仪式吸引了大批人群。

e.en: Tesla is {unveiling} a redesigned Model 3 next week.
e.zh: 特斯拉将于下周发布重新设计的 Model 3。

unveils.t: v. 揭晓；发布（unveil 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Google {unveils} new AI features at its annual conference.
e.zh: 谷歌在年度大会上发布了多项全新的 AI 功能。

e.en: The author {unveils} her latest novel in a livestream.
e.zh: 这位作家在直播中公布了她的最新小说。

unvented.t: adj. 无通风口的；密闭的

e.en: An {unvented} dryer can release moisture into your home.
e.zh: 没有排气管的烘干机会把水汽排到家里。

e.en: Installing an {unvented} water heater saves significant attic space.
e.zh: 安装无排气热水器能节省阁楼大量空间。

e.en: Working in an {unventilated} room can cause headaches quickly.
e.zh: 在不通风的房间里工作很快就会让人头痛。

e.en: The {unventilated} basement smelled strongly of mold.
e.zh: 那间不通风的地下室散发着浓重的霉味。

e.en: The article relies on {unverifiable} claims from anonymous sources.
e.zh: 那篇文章依赖于匿名来源无法核实的说法。

e.en: Many viral videos contain {unverifiable} stories about celebrities.
e.zh: 许多疯传的视频里都是关于名人的不可证实的故事。

e.en: Don't share {unverified} news posts on social media.
e.zh: 不要在社交媒体上转发未经核实的新闻帖子。

e.en: The account was suspended for spreading {unverified} information.
e.zh: 该账号因传播未经核实的信息被封禁。

unviable.t: adj. 不可行的；难以存活的

e.en: The business plan turned out to be financially {unviable}.
e.zh: 事实证明那份商业计划在财务上根本行不通。

e.en: Without funding, the project is completely {unviable} long-term.
e.zh: 没有资金,这个项目长期来看完全不可行。

unvoiced.t: adj. 未说出口的；清音的

e.en: Her {unvoiced} concerns about the plan eventually surfaced.
e.zh: 她对这个计划未说出口的担忧最终还是显露了出来。

e.en: The letter 'p' is an {unvoiced} consonant in English.
e.zh: 字母 p 在英语中是一个清辅音。

e.en: The charity offers free meals to {unwaged} residents.
e.zh: 该慈善机构为没有工作收入的居民提供免费餐食。

e.en: Many caregivers do years of {unwaged} work at home.
e.zh: 许多照护者在家做着多年没有报酬的工作。

e.en: Use a spam filter to block {unwanted} emails.
e.zh: 用垃圾邮件过滤器来拦截不想要的邮件。

e.en: The shelter takes in {unwanted} pets every weekend.
e.zh: 这家救助站每个周末都会收留被遗弃的宠物。

e.en: Charging customers extra fees would be totally {unwarrantable}.
e.zh: 向顾客收取额外费用是完全没有道理的。

e.en: His rude outburst was an {unwarrantable} attack on the host.
e.zh: 他粗鲁的发作是对主持人毫无理由的攻击。

unwarranted.t: adj. 无根据的；没必要的

e.en: The criticism of her work seemed completely {unwarranted}.
e.zh: 对她工作的批评似乎完全没有道理。

e.en: Police faced lawsuits over {unwarranted} stops downtown.
e.zh: 警方因在市中心进行无理盘查而面临诉讼。

e.en: Phishing emails often trick {unwary} users into clicking links.
e.zh: 钓鱼邮件常常诱使粗心的用户点击链接。

e.en: The icy sidewalk caught many {unwary} pedestrians off guard.
e.zh: 结冰的人行道让许多没留神的行人猝不及防。

e.en: A pile of {unwashed} dishes filled the kitchen sink.
e.zh: 厨房水槽里堆满了没洗的碗碟。

e.en: Always rinse {unwashed} fruit before putting it in salads.
e.zh: 做沙拉前一定要把没洗过的水果冲洗一下。

e.en: The movie's editing was so bad it was nearly {unwatchable}.
e.zh: 这部电影的剪辑太糟糕,几乎让人看不下去。

e.en: Constant ads make the streaming service almost {unwatchable}.
e.zh: 层出不穷的广告让这个流媒体几乎无法观看。

unwatched.t: adj. 无人观看的；无人看管的

e.en: My queue is full of {unwatched} shows from last year.
e.zh: 我的待看列表里全是去年攒下还没看的剧。

e.en: Don't leave a candle {unwatched} in the bedroom.
e.zh: 不要让蜡烛在卧室里没人看着燃着。

e.en: She showed {unwavering} support for her injured teammate.
e.zh: 她对受伤的队友给予了坚定不移的支持。

e.en: His {unwavering} focus helped him pass the difficult exam.
e.zh: 他坚定专注的精神帮助他通过了那场艰难的考试。

unwaveringly.t: adv. 坚定地；毫不动摇地

e.en: He {unwaveringly} defended his sister against unfair criticism.
e.zh: 他毫不动摇地为自己的妹妹抵挡不公的批评。

e.en: The CEO {unwaveringly} pursued the company's long-term vision.
e.zh: 这位 CEO 始终坚定地追求公司的长远愿景。

e.en: Many young {unwed} couples now share apartments in cities.
e.zh: 如今许多未婚的年轻情侣在城市里合租公寓。

e.en: She raised three children as an {unwed} mother.
e.zh: 她作为未婚妈妈独自抚养了三个孩子。

unweighted.t: adj. 未加权的；未负重的

e.en: The {unweighted} GPA does not factor in honors classes.
e.zh: 未加权的 GPA 没有把荣誉课程的难度计算在内。

e.en: Use an {unweighted} average when each value matters equally.
e.zh: 当每个数值同等重要时,应使用未加权的平均值。

unwelcome.t: adj. 不受欢迎的；不合时宜的

e.en: His comments about her appearance were deeply {unwelcome}.
e.zh: 他对她外貌的那些评论让人非常不舒服。

e.en: The sudden tax hike was an {unwelcome} surprise for homeowners.
e.zh: 突如其来的加税让房主们颇感不快。

untainted.t: adj. 未受污染的；纯净的

e.en: Her reputation remained {untainted} despite the surrounding scandal.
e.zh: 尽管周围丑闻不断,她的名声依然没有被玷污。

e.en: The remote village offers air {untainted} by city pollution.
e.zh: 那个偏远村庄拥有未被城市污染玷污的空气。

untalented.t: adj. 无才能的；缺乏天赋的

e.en: He felt {untalented} compared to the other musicians in the band.
e.zh: 与乐队其他乐手相比,他觉得自己毫无天赋。

e.en: Critics dismissed the singer as {untalented} and overhyped.
e.zh: 评论家把这位歌手贬为没有才华、被过度炒作。

e.en: The documentary explores the {untamed} wilderness of Patagonia.
e.zh: 这部纪录片探索了巴塔哥尼亚未被驯服的荒野。

e.en: Her {untamed} curiosity drove her to explore every corner of the city.
e.zh: 她那不羁的好奇心驱使她探访了这座城市的每个角落。

untangle.t: v. 解开（缠结）；理清（头绪）

e.en: It took me an hour to {untangle} the headphone cables.
e.zh: 我花了一个小时才把耳机线理清楚。

e.en: The detective tried to {untangle} the web of lies surrounding the case.
e.zh: 侦探试图理清围绕这起案件的谎言之网。

untangled.t:
v. 解开、理清（过去式）
adj. 已解开的

e.en: She finally {untangled} the long necklace after twenty minutes.
e.zh: 二十分钟后她终于把那条长项链解开了。

e.en: The team {untangled} the messy code and rewrote it cleanly.
e.zh: 团队理顺了混乱的代码并将其重写得整洁清晰。

untangles.t: v. 解开、理清（第三人称单数）

e.en: This guide {untangles} the confusing rules of international shipping.
e.zh: 这本指南理清了国际运输那些令人困惑的规则。

e.en: She patiently {untangles} every knot in her daughter's hair.
e.zh: 她耐心地解开女儿头发上的每一个结。

untangling.t: v. 正在解开、理清（现在分词）

e.en: She spent the morning {untangling} the knotted headphone cables.
e.zh: 她整个上午都在解开缠成一团的耳机线。

e.en: The detective is slowly {untangling} the web of lies.
e.zh: 侦探正一步步理清这张谎言之网。

untapped.t: adj. 未开发的；未利用的

e.en: This market has huge {untapped} potential for growth.
e.zh: 这个市场有巨大的尚未开发的增长潜力。

e.en: Many students have {untapped} talents that schools never discover.
e.zh: 许多学生身上有学校从未发掘的潜在才能。

untarnished.t: adj. 无瑕疵的；声誉未损的

e.en: After thirty years, her reputation remains completely {untarnished}.
e.zh: 三十年过去了,她的声誉依然毫无瑕疵。

e.en: The silver trophy was kept {untarnished} in a glass case.
e.zh: 那座银奖杯被保存在玻璃柜里,光亮如新。

e.en: Online purchases were {untaxed} in many states for years.
e.zh: 多年来,许多州的网购都是免税的。

e.en: Offshore accounts allowed wealthy clients to keep income {untaxed}.
e.zh: 离岸账户让富有的客户得以让收入免于征税。

unteachable.t: adj. 教不会的；无法传授的

e.en: He was so arrogant that his coach called him {unteachable}.
e.zh: 他太自负了,教练说他根本教不会。

e.en: Some social skills seem almost {unteachable} in a classroom setting.
e.zh: 有些社交技能在课堂上几乎是教不会的。

untempered.t: adj. 未经调和的；未经缓和的

e.en: Her enthusiasm was {untempered} by any sense of caution.
e.zh: 她的热情丝毫没有被谨慎所抑制。

e.en: The criticism was harsh and {untempered} by kindness.
e.zh: 那些批评严厉刻薄,毫无善意可言。

untenable.t: adj. 站不住脚的；难以维持的

e.en: His position became {untenable} after the scandal broke.
e.zh: 丑闻爆发后,他的处境变得难以维持。

e.en: That argument is logically {untenable} given the new evidence.
e.zh: 鉴于新的证据,那个论点在逻辑上站不住脚。

untended.t: adj. 无人照料的；无人看管的

e.en: The garden looked wild and {untended} after years of neglect.
e.zh: 花园多年无人打理,显得杂乱荒芜。

e.en: An {untended} fire can spread through the forest in minutes.
e.zh: 无人看管的火源几分钟内就能蔓延整片森林。

untestable.t: adj. 无法测试的；不可验证的

e.en: That hypothesis is {untestable} with current scientific methods.
e.zh: 用现有的科学方法无法检验这个假设。

e.en: Legacy code without interfaces is often nearly {untestable}.
e.zh: 没有接口的遗留代码往往几乎无法测试。

untested.t: adj. 未经测试的；未经检验的

e.en: The new vaccine remained {untested} on humans last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天,这款新疫苗尚未在人体上进行测试。

e.en: He's a talented but {untested} rookie quarterback.
e.zh: 他是一名有天赋但尚未经过考验的新秀四分卫。

untethered.t: adj. 未拴住的；不受束缚的

e.en: Working remotely left her feeling {untethered} from the team.
e.zh: 远程办公让她感觉脱离了团队。

e.en: The balloon drifted away, {untethered} from its post.
e.zh: 气球脱离了系绳,飘走了。

unthinkable.t: adj. 难以想象的；不可思议的

e.en: Just ten years ago, this technology was completely {unthinkable}.
e.zh: 就在十年前,这种技术还完全不可想象。

e.en: Losing the championship at home was {unthinkable} for the fans.
e.zh: 在主场输掉冠军赛对球迷来说是不可思议的。

unthinkably.t: adv. 难以想象地；不可思议地

e.en: The cost of housing has become {unthinkably} high.
e.zh: 房价已经高得令人难以想象。

e.en: He acted {unthinkably} cruel toward his closest friends.
e.zh: 他对最亲近的朋友表现得残忍得难以想象。

unthinking.t: adj. 欠考虑的；不假思索的

e.en: Her {unthinking} comment hurt his feelings deeply.
e.zh: 她那句不假思索的话深深伤了他的心。

e.en: He gave an {unthinking} nod and kept scrolling his phone.
e.zh: 他不经思考地点了点头,继续刷手机。

unthinkingly.t: adv. 不假思索地；轻率地

e.en: She {unthinkingly} forwarded the email to the wrong group.
e.zh: 她不经思考地把邮件转发给了错误的群组。

e.en: People often {unthinkingly} repeat what they see online.
e.zh: 人们常常不假思索地重复网上看到的内容。

unthreatening.t: adj. 没有威胁的；不具威胁性的

e.en: His soft voice and smile made him seem {unthreatening}.
e.zh: 他柔和的声音和微笑让他显得毫无威胁感。

e.en: The chatbot uses {unthreatening} language to ease anxious users.
e.zh: 这款聊天机器人用不具威胁性的语言安抚焦虑的用户。

e.en: Books were piled {untidily} all over his desk.
e.zh: 书凌乱地堆在他桌子上到处都是。

e.en: She dressed {untidily} but always finished her work on time.
e.zh: 她穿着邋遢,但总能按时完成工作。

e.en: His mother often complained about the {untidiness} of his room.
e.zh: 他妈妈经常抱怨他房间的脏乱。

e.en: A little {untidiness} in the kitchen doesn't bother me.
e.zh: 厨房里有点凌乱我并不介意。

e.en: His desk is always {untidy} but he knows where everything is.
e.zh: 他的桌子总是乱糟糟的,但他知道每样东西在哪里。

e.en: She tied back her {untidy} hair before the video call.
e.zh: 视频通话前,她把凌乱的头发扎了起来。

e.en: Could you help me {untie} this stubborn knot?
e.zh: 你能帮我解开这个死结吗?

e.en: He bent down to {untie} his running shoes.
e.zh: 他弯下腰解开跑鞋的鞋带。

untied.t:
v. 解开（过去式）
adj. 已解开的

e.en: Your shoelace is {untied} — be careful not to trip.
e.zh: 你的鞋带松了,小心别绊倒。

e.en: She {untied} the ribbon and opened the gift slowly.
e.zh: 她解开丝带,慢慢打开了礼物。

unties.t: v. 解开（第三人称单数）

e.en: He always {unties} his tie the moment he gets home.
e.zh: 他一回到家就立刻解下领带。

e.en: The toddler {unties} her shoelaces every five minutes.
e.zh: 这个小孩每隔五分钟就把鞋带解开一次。

until.t:
prep. 直到……为止
conj. 直到……时

e.en: The store stays open {until} ten on weekdays.
e.zh: 工作日这家店营业到十点。

e.en: I didn't realize the truth {until} much later.
e.zh: 我直到很久之后才意识到真相。

e.en: The {untilled} field was overgrown with weeds.
e.zh: 那块未耕的田地长满了杂草。

e.en: Several acres remained {untilled} after the drought.
e.zh: 干旱之后还有几英亩地无人耕种。

untimed.t: adj. 未计时的；不限时的

e.en: This practice quiz is {untimed}, so relax.
e.zh: 这次练习测验不限时,放轻松吧。

e.en: The scientist preferred {untimed} observation over strict schedules.
e.zh: 那位科学家更喜欢不计时的观察,而非严格的时间表。

untimely.t: adj. 不合时宜的；过早的

e.en: The team mourned the coach's {untimely} death.
e.zh: 全队为教练的英年早逝而哀悼。

e.en: Her comment was both rude and {untimely}.
e.zh: 她的评论既无礼又不合时宜。

untiring.t: adj. 不知疲倦的；坚持不懈的

e.en: The volunteers showed {untiring} dedication during the flood.
e.zh: 志愿者们在洪灾期间展现了不懈的奉献精神。

e.en: She is an {untiring} advocate for animal rights.
e.zh: 她是一位不知疲倦的动物权益倡导者。

untitled.t: adj. 无标题的；未命名的

e.en: He saved the document as {untitled}.docx by mistake.
e.zh: 他不小心把文档存成了无标题.docx。

e.en: The artist exhibited an {untitled} painting in blue.
e.zh: 那位艺术家展出了一幅蓝色调的无题画作。

e.en: The old proverb says: do {unto} others as you would have done to you.
e.zh: 古老的箴言说:你愿人怎样待你,就要怎样待人。

e.en: The kingdom was given {unto} his eldest son.
e.zh: 那王国被赐予了他的长子。

untold.t: adj. 数不清的；未曾讲述的

e.en: The earthquake caused {untold} damage to the city.
e.zh: 那场地震给城市带来了难以估量的破坏。

e.en: Many stories of the war remain {untold}.
e.zh: 许多关于那场战争的故事仍未被讲述。

untouchability.t: n. 贱民身份；不可接触性

e.en: India officially abolished {untouchability} in its constitution.
e.zh: 印度在宪法中正式废除了贱民制度。

e.en: Activists campaigned to end the practice of {untouchability}.
e.zh: 活动人士发起运动,呼吁终结贱民制度。

untouchable.t:
adj. 不可触碰的
n. （印度）贱民

e.en: Top players seem {untouchable} in this season's rankings.
e.zh: 顶级选手在本赛季排名中似乎无可撼动。

e.en: Some files are marked {untouchable} by the system.
e.zh: 有些文件被系统标记为不可修改。

untouchables.t: n. 贱民（复数）；不可碰之人

e.en: The film told the story of two {untouchables} in rural India.
e.zh: 影片讲述了印度乡村两位贱民的故事。

e.en: In tech, certain founders are treated like {untouchables}.
e.zh: 在科技圈里,某些创始人被当作不可触碰的人物。

untouched.t: adj. 未动过的；未受影响的

e.en: Her dinner sat {untouched} on the table.
e.zh: 她的晚餐原封不动地摆在桌上。

e.en: The remote village remained {untouched} by tourism.
e.zh: 那个偏远村庄从未被旅游业触及。

e.en: Nothing {untoward} happened during the trip.
e.zh: 旅途中没有发生任何不愉快的事。

e.en: The audit found no {untoward} financial activity.
e.zh: 审计没有发现任何不当的财务行为。

untraceable.t: adj. 无法追踪的；查不到的

e.en: The hacker used {untraceable} cryptocurrency to receive payments.
e.zh: 那名黑客用无法追踪的加密货币收款。

e.en: The phone call came from an {untraceable} number.
e.zh: 那通电话来自一个无法追踪的号码。

untracked.t: adj. 未被追踪的；（Git）未跟踪的

e.en: Git shows several {untracked} files in this folder.
e.zh: Git 显示这个文件夹里有几个未跟踪的文件。

e.en: They hiked through {untracked} snow for hours.
e.zh: 他们在没有人踩过的雪地里走了好几个小时。

untraditional.t: adj. 非传统的；不拘泥传统的

e.en: The couple chose an {untraditional} outdoor wedding.
e.zh: 这对新人选择了一场非传统的户外婚礼。

e.en: His {untraditional} teaching style surprised the students.
e.zh: 他不拘传统的教学风格让学生们颇为意外。

untrained.t: adj. 未经训练的；外行的

e.en: To the {untrained} eye, the two paintings look identical.
e.zh: 在外行人眼里,这两幅画看起来一模一样。

e.en: The shelter rescued several {untrained} puppies.
e.zh: 收容所救助了几只未经训练的小狗。

untrammeled.t: adj. 不受限制的；自由自在的

e.en: The artist craved {untrammeled} creative freedom.
e.zh: 这位艺术家渴望不受约束的创作自由。

e.en: He wandered the {untrammeled} wilderness for weeks.
e.zh: 他在未被开发的荒野中漫游了数周。

untrammelled.t: adj. 不受约束的（untrammeled 英式拼写）

e.en: She enjoyed an {untrammelled} childhood by the sea.
e.zh: 她在海边度过了无拘无束的童年。

e.en: The market operates with {untrammelled} freedom.
e.zh: 该市场在毫无束缚的自由中运行。

untransformed.t: adj. 未经转化的；未被改变的

e.en: The raw data is stored {untransformed} for auditing.
e.zh: 原始数据未经转换地保存,以便审计。

e.en: His attitude remained {untransformed} despite the workshop.
e.zh: 尽管参加了工作坊,他的态度依旧没变。

untranslatable.t: adj. 不可翻译的；难以翻译的

e.en: Some Japanese words are virtually {untranslatable} into English.
e.zh: 有些日语词几乎无法翻译成英语。

e.en: The poem's wordplay is {untranslatable} without losing its charm.
e.zh: 这首诗的双关语翻译过来必然失去韵味。

e.en: Several chapters remain {untranslated} from the original Russian.
e.zh: 还有几章俄文原著尚未翻译。

e.en: He left the foreign quotes {untranslated} on purpose.
e.zh: 他故意没有翻译那些外语引文。

unstated.t: adj. 未说明的；未明言的

e.en: The contract had several {unstated} assumptions about delivery.
e.zh: 这份合同关于交付有若干未明说的默认前提。

e.en: His {unstated} goal was to get promoted by year-end.
e.zh: 他没说出口的目标是年底前升职。

e.en: The toddler walked {unsteadily} toward her father.
e.zh: 那个小孩摇摇晃晃地朝爸爸走过去。

e.en: He climbed {unsteadily} down the icy steps.
e.zh: 他踉踉跄跄地走下结了冰的台阶。

e.en: Sudden {unsteadiness} on his feet sent him to the doctor.
e.zh: 突然站不稳让他赶紧去看了医生。

e.en: The bridge's {unsteadiness} made tourists turn back.
e.zh: 那座桥的晃动让游客们纷纷折返。

e.en: After two beers, his hands felt a little {unsteady}.
e.zh: 喝了两杯啤酒后,他的手有点发抖。

e.en: The old wooden ladder is too {unsteady} to climb.
e.zh: 那把旧木梯太晃了,不能爬。

e.en: She gave {unstinted} praise to her team after the launch.
e.zh: 产品发布后,她对团队不吝赞美之词。

e.en: The volunteers offered {unstinted} help to the flood victims.
e.zh: 志愿者对水灾受害者倾尽全力地提供帮助。

e.en: She gave {unstinting} support to her younger brother.
e.zh: 她对弟弟给予了毫无保留的支持。

e.en: The coach offered {unstinting} praise after the win.
e.zh: 教练在胜利后毫不吝啬地给予赞扬。

unstintingly.t: adv. 慷慨地；毫不吝惜地

e.en: He gave {unstintingly} to local charities each year.
e.zh: 他每年都慷慨地捐助当地慈善机构。

e.en: She worked {unstintingly} to finish the project on time.
e.zh: 她毫不懈怠地工作以按时完成项目。

unstoppable.t: adj. 无法阻挡的；势不可挡的

e.en: The team looks {unstoppable} this season.
e.zh: 这支球队本赛季看起来势不可挡。

e.en: Once she sets a goal, she's {unstoppable}.
e.zh: 一旦她定下目标,就无人能挡。

e.en: Prices kept rising {unstoppably} throughout the year.
e.zh: 全年物价势不可挡地持续上涨。

e.en: The crowd surged {unstoppably} toward the stage.
e.zh: 人群势不可挡地涌向舞台。

e.en: Please {unstrap} your helmet before entering the cabin.
e.zh: 进入机舱前请解下你的头盔。

e.en: He bent down to {unstrap} his sandals.
e.zh: 他弯下腰解开凉鞋的带子。

unstressed.t: adj. 非重读的（音节）；无压力的

e.en: The first syllable in 'about' is {unstressed}.
e.zh: 单词about的第一个音节不重读。

e.en: She felt calm and {unstressed} after the vacation.
e.zh: 度假后她感到平静且毫无压力。

unstructured.t: adj. 无结构的；无组织的

e.en: The meeting was {unstructured} and ran way too long.
e.zh: 会议毫无组织,拖得太久了。

e.en: Kids need some {unstructured} play time every day.
e.zh: 孩子们每天需要一些自由玩耍的时间。

unstrung.t: adj. 心烦意乱的；松弦的

e.en: She was completely {unstrung} by the bad news.
e.zh: 那个坏消息让她完全崩溃了。

e.en: The old guitar lay {unstrung} in the attic.
e.zh: 那把旧吉他没装弦地躺在阁楼里。

unstuck.t: adj. 松脱的；失败的（come unstuck）

e.en: I finally got {unstuck} on that coding problem.
e.zh: 我终于在那道编程题上突破了瓶颈。

e.en: The label came {unstuck} after a few washes.
e.zh: 洗了几次之后标签就脱落了。

e.en: Her charm seemed completely natural and {unstudied}.
e.zh: 她的魅力显得自然而毫不做作。

e.en: He gave an {unstudied} laugh at the joke.
e.zh: 他听到笑话时发出一声自然的笑声。

unstuffed.t: adj. 未填充的；未塞满的

e.en: The {unstuffed} pillow lay flat on the bed.
e.zh: 那个没填充的枕头平摊在床上。

e.en: She prefers {unstuffed} mushrooms in her salad.
e.zh: 她喜欢沙拉里放未填馅的蘑菇。

e.en: Many {unsubsidized} student loans carry higher interest rates.
e.zh: 许多无补贴的学生贷款利率较高。

e.en: The bakery operates as a fully {unsubsidized} business.
e.zh: 这家面包店是完全没有补贴的企业。

unsubstantiated.t: adj. 未经证实的；无确凿证据的

e.en: The article was based on {unsubstantiated} rumors.
e.zh: 那篇文章是基于未经证实的传言。

e.en: Police dismissed the claims as {unsubstantiated}.
e.zh: 警方认为这些说法没有根据,予以驳回。

e.en: He dropped an {unsubtle} hint about wanting a raise.
e.zh: 他毫不含蓄地暗示想要加薪。

e.en: The film's message is heavy and {unsubtle}.
e.zh: 这部电影的寓意沉重而直白。

e.en: His first attempt at the exam was {unsuccessful}.
e.zh: 他第一次考试没有通过。

e.en: The startup was {unsuccessful} despite heavy marketing.
e.zh: 尽管大力营销,这家初创公司还是失败了。

e.en: She tried {unsuccessfully} to log into her account.
e.zh: 她尝试登录账号,但没有成功。

e.en: They lobbied {unsuccessfully} for changes to the law.
e.zh: 他们游说修改法律,但没有成功。

e.en: The report highlighted the {unsuitability} of the site for housing.
e.zh: 报告强调该地点不适合用于建房。

e.en: His {unsuitability} for the role became obvious quickly.
e.zh: 他不适合这个职位的事很快就显而易见了。

unsuitable.t: adj. 不合适的；不相宜的

e.en: The film is {unsuitable} for young children.
e.zh: 这部电影不适合小孩子观看。

e.en: These shoes are {unsuitable} for hiking.
e.zh: 这双鞋不适合徒步。

e.en: He arrived {unsuitably} dressed for the formal dinner.
e.zh: 他穿着不得体地出席了正式晚宴。

e.en: The room was {unsuitably} small for the conference.
e.zh: 这个房间作为会议室来说太小了,不合适。

unsuited.t: adj. 不适合的；不相称的

e.en: He's completely {unsuited} to office work.
e.zh: 他完全不适合办公室工作。

e.en: The soil is {unsuited} for growing tomatoes.
e.zh: 这土壤不适合种番茄。

unsullied.t: adj. 纯洁的；未受玷污的

e.en: Her reputation remained {unsullied} after the trial.
e.zh: 审判之后她的名声依然清白无瑕。

e.en: The fresh snow lay {unsullied} across the field.
e.zh: 新雪洁白无瑕地铺满了田野。

unsung.t: adj. 未受称颂的；默默无闻的

e.en: Nurses are the {unsung} heroes of the pandemic.
e.zh: 护士是这场疫情中默默无闻的英雄。

e.en: Many {unsung} engineers built the early internet.
e.zh: 许多默默无闻的工程师建立了早期互联网。

unsupervised.t: adj. 无人监督的；无监督的（学习）

e.en: Children should not be left {unsupervised} near the swimming pool.
e.zh: 孩子不应在泳池附近无人看管。

e.en: The intern worked {unsupervised} for most of the afternoon.
e.zh: 那位实习生整个下午基本上都在无人监管的情况下工作。

unsupportable.t: adj. 难以忍受的；站不住脚的

e.en: His claims about the data were simply {unsupportable} by evidence.
e.zh: 他对那些数据的说法根本无法用证据支持。

e.en: The argument turned out to be {unsupportable} under closer review.
e.zh: 经过更仔细的审视,这一论点被证明站不住脚。

unsupported.t: adj. 不受支持的；无依据的

e.en: That browser is {unsupported}, so please update to the latest version.
e.zh: 该浏览器已不再受支持,请更新到最新版本。

e.en: His accusation was {unsupported} by any concrete evidence.
e.zh: 他的指控没有任何具体证据支持。

unsure.t: adj. 不确定的；没把握的

e.en: I'm still {unsure} whether to accept the job offer.
e.zh: 我还不确定要不要接受这份工作。

e.en: She sounded {unsure} when answering the interviewer's questions.
e.zh: 她回答面试官的问题时听起来不太有把握。

e.en: His record in the marathon seems truly {unsurpassable} for now.
e.zh: 他在马拉松中的纪录目前看来确实无法超越。

e.en: The chef's dessert had an {unsurpassable} balance of flavors.
e.zh: 那位厨师的甜点拥有无与伦比的味道平衡。

unsurpassed.t: adj. 未被超越的；无与伦比的

e.en: Her skill at coding remains {unsurpassed} on the entire team.
e.zh: 她的编程能力在整个团队中无人能及。

e.en: This restaurant offers {unsurpassed} views of the city skyline.
e.zh: 这家餐厅拥有无与伦比的城市天际线景观。

e.en: She was {unsurprised} to learn the project had been delayed again.
e.zh: 得知项目又被推迟,她并不感到意外。

e.en: He looked {unsurprised} when the result was finally announced.
e.zh: 结果最终公布时,他显得毫不意外。

unsurprising.t: adj. 不足为奇的；意料之中的

e.en: It's {unsurprising} that the app crashed under heavy traffic.
e.zh: 这个应用在高流量下崩溃并不令人意外。

e.en: The result was {unsurprising} given how hard she had trained.
e.zh: 考虑到她训练的刻苦程度,这个结果毫不意外。

unsurprisingly.t: adv. 不出所料地；不足为奇地

e.en: {Unsurprisingly}, the new policy faced strong public criticism.
e.zh: 不出所料,这项新政策遭到了公众的强烈批评。

e.en: She passed the exam easily, {unsurprisingly}, given her preparation.
e.zh: 鉴于她的充分准备,她轻松通过了考试,这并不令人意外。

unsuspected.t: adj. 未被怀疑的；未被察觉的

e.en: The investigation revealed an {unsuspected} link between the two companies.
e.zh: 调查揭示了两家公司之间一个此前未被察觉的联系。

e.en: She had an {unsuspected} talent for playing the violin.
e.zh: 她有一种不为人知的小提琴演奏天赋。

unsuspecting.t: adj. 毫无戒心的；未起疑的

e.en: The scammer targeted {unsuspecting} elderly users online.
e.zh: 骗子在网上专门针对毫无戒心的老年用户。

e.en: An {unsuspecting} customer walked right into the surprise party.
e.zh: 一位毫无察觉的顾客径直走进了那场惊喜派对。

e.en: Experts warn about the {unsustainability} of current consumption patterns.
e.zh: 专家警告说当前的消费模式不可持续。

e.en: The report highlighted the {unsustainability} of fast fashion supply chains.
e.zh: 报告强调了快时尚供应链的不可持续性。

e.en: Working sixty hours a week is simply {unsustainable} long term.
e.zh: 长期每周工作六十小时根本无法持续。

e.en: The country's debt levels have become {unsustainable}.
e.zh: 该国的债务水平已经变得难以为继。

e.en: The forests are being logged {unsustainably} across the region.
e.zh: 该地区的森林正在以不可持续的方式被砍伐。

e.en: Many cities are growing {unsustainably} fast without proper planning.
e.zh: 许多城市在缺乏合理规划下以不可持续的速度扩张。

unswayed.t: adj. 不受影响的；不为所动的

e.en: The judge remained {unswayed} by the lawyer's emotional appeal.
e.zh: 法官没有被律师那番感性的陈述所打动。

e.en: She was {unswayed} by the negative comments on social media.
e.zh: 她没有被社交媒体上的负面评论所影响。

unsweetened.t: adj. 不加糖的；无甜味的

e.en: I prefer {unsweetened} almond milk in my morning coffee.
e.zh: 我早晨的咖啡里更喜欢加无糖杏仁奶。

e.en: The recipe calls for {unsweetened} cocoa powder, not chocolate.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要的是无糖可可粉,不是巧克力。

e.en: The {unswept} floor was covered in dust and crumbs.
e.zh: 未打扫的地板上满是灰尘和食物碎屑。

e.en: Leaves piled up on the {unswept} sidewalk after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后,落叶堆在没有清扫的人行道上。

unswerving.t: adj. 坚定不移的；不动摇的

e.en: Her {unswerving} dedication to her students inspired everyone.
e.zh: 她对学生坚定不移的奉献精神激励了每一个人。

e.en: He has shown {unswerving} loyalty to the company for decades.
e.zh: 他对公司几十年来表现出始终如一的忠诚。

e.en: She {unswervingly} pursued her dream of becoming a doctor.
e.zh: 她毫不动摇地追求成为医生的梦想。

e.en: He has {unswervingly} supported his sister through every challenge.
e.zh: 他在每一次挑战中都坚定不移地支持他的妹妹。

unsympathetic.t: adj. 无同情心的；冷漠的

e.en: The manager was completely {unsympathetic} to my schedule problems.
e.zh: 经理对我的日程问题毫不同情。

e.en: Readers found the main character cold and {unsympathetic}.
e.zh: 读者觉得主角冷漠且不讨喜。

unsympathetically.t: adv. 无同情心地；冷漠地

e.en: He spoke {unsympathetically} about the layoffs during the meeting.
e.zh: 他在会上以毫无同情心的口吻谈及裁员一事。

e.en: The article portrayed the protesters {unsympathetically} from start to finish.
e.zh: 那篇文章自始至终对抗议者的描写都缺乏同情。

unsystematic.t: adj. 无系统的；无条理的

e.en: His {unsystematic} approach to studying made the exam much harder.
e.zh: 他毫无章法的学习方式让考试变得困难得多。

e.en: The data collection was {unsystematic} and full of gaps.
e.zh: 数据收集毫无系统,充满了漏洞。

e.en: The hotel staff seemed cold and {unwelcoming} at check-in.
e.zh: 办理入住时酒店员工显得冷淡又不友好。

e.en: That dimly lit lobby has a rather {unwelcoming} atmosphere.
e.zh: 那间灯光昏暗的大堂给人一种不太欢迎客人的感觉。

unwell.t: adj. 身体不适的，不舒服

e.en: She called in sick because she felt {unwell} this morning.
e.zh: 她今早觉得身体不舒服,所以请了病假。

e.en: My grandfather has been {unwell} since the cold weather started.
e.zh: 自从天气转冷,我爷爷就一直不太舒服。

unwholesome.t: adj. 不健康的，有害身心的

e.en: The doctor warned against the {unwholesome} fast-food diet.
e.zh: 医生警告不要吃那种不健康的快餐饮食。

e.en: Parents worry about {unwholesome} content reaching their kids online.
e.zh: 家长们担心不良内容会通过网络传到孩子手中。

unwieldy.t: adj. 笨重难用的；难以操控的

e.en: The old laptop was heavy and {unwieldy} to carry.
e.zh: 那台旧笔记本电脑又重又难拿。

e.en: Their codebase has grown {unwieldy} after years of patches.
e.zh: 经过多年打补丁,他们的代码库变得越来越难以维护。

unwilling.t: adj. 不愿意的，不情愿的

e.en: He was {unwilling} to admit that he had made a mistake.
e.zh: 他不愿承认自己犯了错。

e.en: Many shoppers are {unwilling} to pay full price anymore.
e.zh: 如今许多购物者都不愿意再按原价付款了。

e.en: She {unwillingly} agreed to work over the holiday weekend.
e.zh: 她不情愿地答应在假日周末加班。

e.en: The child {unwillingly} handed over his phone at bedtime.
e.zh: 那孩子不情愿地在睡觉前交出了自己的手机。

e.en: Her {unwillingness} to compromise stalled the negotiations for weeks.
e.zh: 她不愿妥协,使谈判停滞了数周。

e.en: He showed clear {unwillingness} to share his password.
e.zh: 他明显不愿意分享自己的密码。

unwind.t:
v. 放松身心
v. 解开（缠绕物）

e.en: I like to {unwind} with a movie after work.
e.zh: 下班后我喜欢看部电影放松一下。

e.en: Carefully {unwind} the cable before plugging it in.
e.zh: 插电之前请小心把电线绕开。

unwinding.t: v. 放松；解开（unwind 的现在分词）

e.en: A hot bath is her favorite way of {unwinding}.
e.zh: 泡个热水澡是她最爱的放松方式。

e.en: The machine kept {unwinding} the spool of thread.
e.zh: 机器不停地把线轴上的线松开。

e.en: Critics called the lawsuit completely {unwinnable} from the start.
e.zh: 评论人士称这场官司从一开始就根本赢不了。

e.en: He refused to give up an {unwinnable} chess match.
e.zh: 他不肯放弃一盘根本赢不了的棋。

e.en: The technician left the alarm system {unwired} by mistake.
e.zh: 技术员不小心把报警系统的线路漏接了。

e.en: Many rural homes remain {unwired} for high-speed internet.
e.zh: 许多农村住宅仍未接通高速网络。

e.en: It would be {unwise} to invest your savings in crypto.
e.zh: 把积蓄投到加密货币里是不明智的。

e.en: Skipping breakfast before a long hike is {unwise}.
e.zh: 长途徒步前不吃早餐是不明智的。

e.en: He {unwisely} clicked the link in a suspicious email.
e.zh: 他不明智地点开了可疑邮件里的链接。

e.en: She {unwisely} agreed to the contract without reading it.
e.zh: 她没看就轻率地签下了那份合同。

unwitting.t: adj. 不知情的，无意中的

e.en: He became an {unwitting} accomplice to the online scam.
e.zh: 他在不知情的情况下成了网络诈骗的帮凶。

e.en: Tourists are often {unwitting} victims of pickpockets.
e.zh: 游客常常在不知不觉中成了扒手的目标。

unwittingly.t: adv. 不知不觉地，无意中

e.en: She {unwittingly} shared a fake news article on Facebook.
e.zh: 她在不知情下转发了一篇假新闻。

e.en: The intern {unwittingly} deleted the entire database.
e.zh: 那位实习生在不知情下删掉了整个数据库。

e.en: The boss spoke with {unwonted} warmth at the meeting.
e.zh: 老板在会上罕见地以温和的语气讲话。

e.en: She showed {unwonted} patience with the noisy children.
e.zh: 她对那些吵闹的孩子表现出少有的耐心。

unworkable.t: adj. 行不通的，不可行的

e.en: The proposed schedule turned out to be totally {unworkable}.
e.zh: 拟定的日程证明完全行不通。

e.en: Engineers rejected the design as {unworkable} in practice.
e.zh: 工程师认为该设计在实际中行不通,予以否决。

unworked.t: adj. 未加工的；未开采的

e.en: The land lay {unworked} for nearly a decade.
e.zh: 那块土地荒废了将近十年无人耕种。

e.en: He sold a chunk of {unworked} silver to the jeweler.
e.zh: 他把一块未经加工的银料卖给了珠宝商。

unworldly.t: adj. 不谙世事的；脱俗的

e.en: The young monk had a gentle, {unworldly} air about him.
e.zh: 那位年轻僧人身上散发着一种温和、超然世俗的气质。

e.en: She is brilliant but rather {unworldly} about money.
e.zh: 她很聪明,但对钱财相当不通世故。

unworn.t: adj. 未穿过的；未磨损的

e.en: The shoes were still {unworn}, with original tags attached.
e.zh: 那双鞋还没穿过,吊牌都没拆。

e.en: She returned the {unworn} dress for a full refund.
e.zh: 她把没穿过的裙子退掉,拿回了全额退款。

unworried.t: adj. 不担心的，不忧虑的

e.en: He looked completely {unworried} despite the looming deadline.
e.zh: 尽管截止日期临近,他看起来一点也不担心。

e.en: The CEO seemed {unworried} by the falling stock price.
e.zh: 面对下跌的股价,首席执行官显得毫不担忧。

e.en: He felt a deep sense of {unworthiness} after the praise.
e.zh: 受到赞扬后,他心中泛起一种深深的不配感。

e.en: Therapy helped her overcome years of perceived {unworthiness}.
e.zh: 治疗帮她走出了多年来觉得自己不够好的阴影。

e.en: Such rude behavior is {unworthy} of a team leader.
e.zh: 这种无礼的行为,不配做团队领导。

e.en: He felt {unworthy} of her unconditional love.
e.zh: 他觉得自己配不上她无条件的爱。

unwound.t: v. unwind 的过去式；解开，放松

e.en: She {unwound} the scarf and hung it by the door.
e.zh: 她解下围巾,把它挂在门边。

e.en: We {unwound} on the beach for a whole week.
e.zh: 我们在海滩上彻底放松了一整个星期。

e.en: The kids couldn't wait to {unwrap} their birthday gifts.
e.zh: 孩子们迫不及待地想拆开生日礼物。

e.en: Please {unwrap} the package gently—it's fragile.
e.zh: 请轻轻拆开包裹——里面是易碎品。

unwrapped.t:
adj. 已拆封的
v. unwrap 的过去式

e.en: She {unwrapped} the chocolate bar and took a bite.
e.zh: 她拆开巧克力包装,咬了一口。

e.en: Apple {unwrapped} its newest iPhone at the keynote event.
e.zh: 苹果在发布会上揭晓了最新款的 iPhone。

e.en: His shirt was perfectly {unwrinkled} for the interview.
e.zh: 他面试时衬衫平整得没有一丝褶皱。

e.en: The bedsheet looked smooth and {unwrinkled} after ironing.
e.zh: 床单熨过之后平滑无褶。

unwritten.t: adj. 不成文的（规矩、规则）

e.en: There's an {unwritten} rule against checking phones at dinner.
e.zh: 有条不成文的规矩:吃饭时不许看手机。

e.en: Office culture often relies on {unwritten} expectations.
e.zh: 办公室文化往往依赖一些不成文的默契。

e.en: She remained {unyielding} in her demand for a refund.
e.zh: 她在退款要求上毫不让步。

e.en: The mountain climbers faced {unyielding} winds near the summit.
e.zh: 登山者在接近山顶时遭遇了猛烈不息的狂风。

unzip.t:
v. 解压（文件）
v. 拉开拉链

e.en: Please {unzip} your jacket before entering the security check.
e.zh: 请在进入安检前拉开你的夹克拉链。

e.en: You'll need to {unzip} the file before installing it.
e.zh: 你需要先解压这个文件,然后才能安装。

unzipped.t: adj. 已解压的；拉链拉开的

e.en: He {unzipped} his backpack and pulled out a laptop.
e.zh: 他拉开背包,拿出一台笔记本电脑。

e.en: I {unzipped} the archive and found dozens of photos inside.
e.zh: 我解压了压缩包,发现里面有几十张照片。

e.en: Make sure your antivirus software is always {up-to-date}.
e.zh: 确保你的杀毒软件始终保持最新版本。

e.en: The blog keeps readers {up-to-date} on local election news.
e.zh: 该博客让读者及时了解当地选举新闻。

upanishad.t: n. 奥义书（印度教经典）

e.en: Each {Upanishad} explores the nature of self and reality.
e.zh: 每一部奥义书都探讨自我与实在的本质。

e.en: Scholars debate the precise dating of the earliest {Upanishad}.
e.zh: 学者们对最早的奥义书的确切年代有争议。

upbeat.t: adj. 乐观的，积极向上的

e.en: The team stayed {upbeat} despite losing the first game.
e.zh: 尽管输掉了第一场比赛,球队仍然保持乐观。

e.en: She always plays {upbeat} music during her morning workout.
e.zh: 她晨练时总是放欢快的音乐。

e.en: The coach would often {upbraid} players for sloppy passes.
e.zh: 教练经常因为传球马虎而训斥队员。

e.en: She didn't want to {upbraid} him in front of guests.
e.zh: 她不想在客人面前责备他。

e.en: His strict {upbringing} shaped how he raises his own kids.
e.zh: 他严格的家教影响了他抚养自己孩子的方式。

e.en: She had a happy {upbringing} in a small coastal town.
e.zh: 她在一个小海滨小镇有着快乐的成长经历。

upbringings.t: n. 教养，成长经历（复数）

e.en: The two friends had remarkably different {upbringings} and worldviews.
e.zh: 这两个朋友的成长经历和世界观截然不同。

e.en: Their similar {upbringings} gave them an instant connection.
e.zh: 相似的成长背景让他们一见如故。

upcoming.t: adj. 即将到来的，即将发生的

e.en: Don't forget about the {upcoming} team meeting on Friday.
e.zh: 别忘了周五即将召开的团队会议。

e.en: She's been training hard for the {upcoming} marathon.
e.zh: 她一直在为即将到来的马拉松刻苦训练。

upcountry.t:
adj. 内陆的
adv. 在内陆地区

e.en: They drove {upcountry} to visit her grandmother's farm.
e.zh: 他们开车去内陆乡下看望她奶奶的农场。

e.en: Life {upcountry} moves at a much slower pace.
e.zh: 内陆乡村的生活节奏要慢得多。

update.t:
v. 更新（软件、信息）
n. 更新，最新消息

e.en: I'll {update} you as soon as I hear back.
e.zh: 我一收到回复就告诉你最新情况。

e.en: The latest software {update} fixed the annoying notification bug.
e.zh: 最新的软件更新修复了那个烦人的通知漏洞。

e.en: She just {updated} her résumé with last summer's internship.
e.zh: 她刚刚把去年夏天的实习经历更新到简历里。

e.en: Please make sure your contact info is {updated}.
e.zh: 请确保你的联系方式是最新的。

updates.t:
n. 更新（复数）
v. update 的第三人称单数

e.en: The app pushes security {updates} automatically every Tuesday.
e.zh: 该应用每周二自动推送安全更新。

e.en: She {updates} her travel blog after every weekend trip.
e.zh: 她每次周末旅行后都会更新旅游博客。

updating.t: v. 正在更新；update 的现在分词

e.en: I'm {updating} the spreadsheet with this quarter's sales numbers.
e.zh: 我正在用本季度的销售数据更新表格。

e.en: Keep {updating} your operating system to stay protected.
e.zh: 持续更新你的操作系统以保持安全。

e.en: The eagle rode a warm {updraft} high into the sky.
e.zh: 老鹰乘着温暖的上升气流飞向高空。

e.en: Pilots often use an {updraft} to gain altitude efficiently.
e.zh: 飞行员常利用上升气流来高效爬升。

upend.t:
v. 颠覆，彻底改变
v. 倒置

e.en: Streaming services continue to {upend} the traditional movie industry.
e.zh: 流媒体服务持续颠覆着传统电影行业。

e.en: One bad review can {upend} a small restaurant's business.
e.zh: 一条差评就能颠覆一家小餐馆的生意。

upended.t: v. upend 的过去式；颠覆，倒置

e.en: The pandemic {upended} office routines around the world.
e.zh: 疫情彻底打乱了全球的办公常规。

e.en: He accidentally {upended} the entire bowl of soup.
e.zh: 他不小心把整碗汤打翻了。

e.en: The midfielder sent a long pass {upfield} to the striker.
e.zh: 中场球员将一脚长传送到前场给前锋。

e.en: She sprinted {upfield} to support the attacking play.
e.zh: 她向前场冲刺去支援进攻。

e.en: Only half the data they collected was actually {usable}.
e.zh: 他们收集的数据中只有一半实际可用。

e.en: The old laptop is still {usable} for basic tasks.
e.zh: 那台旧笔记本电脑仍可用于一些基本任务。

usaf.t: n. 美国空军（United States Air Force）

e.en: His father served in the {USAF} for twenty years.
e.zh: 他父亲在美国空军服役了二十年。

e.en: The {USAF} announced a new fighter jet program today.
e.zh: 美国空军今天宣布了一项新的战斗机项目。

usage.t:
n. 使用方式、用量
n. 惯用法

e.en: You can check your data {usage} in the settings menu.
e.zh: 你可以在设置菜单中查看你的数据使用情况。

e.en: This dictionary explains the modern {usage} of each word.
e.zh: 这本词典解释了每个词的现代用法。

e.en: {USAID} funds humanitarian projects around the world.
e.zh: 美国国际开发署在全球资助人道主义项目。

e.en: She works as an analyst for {USAID} in Washington.
e.zh: 她在华盛顿的美国国际开发署担任分析师。

use.t:
v. 使用、利用
n. 用途

useable.t: adj. 可使用的（usable 的异体）

e.en: The kitchen is finally {useable} after the long renovation.
e.zh: 经过漫长的装修后,厨房终于可以使用了。

e.en: Make sure the draft is {useable} before sending it.
e.zh: 在发送之前确保这份草稿是可用的。

used.t:
adj. 二手的、用过的
v. 曾经（used to）

e.en: She bought a {used} car for her college commute.
e.zh: 她买了一辆二手车用于上下学通勤。

e.en: I {used} to live in Tokyo for three years.
e.zh: 我曾经在东京住过三年。

e.en: This app is really {useful} for tracking my expenses.
e.zh: 这个应用对追踪我的开支非常有用。

e.en: Her advice was incredibly {useful} during the job interview.
e.zh: 她的建议在求职面试中非常有用。

e.en: You can {usefully} apply these tips to daily life.
e.zh: 你可以把这些技巧有效地运用到日常生活中。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {usefully} cleaning out the garage.
e.zh: 他下午很有意义地清理了车库。

e.en: The tool's {usefulness} became clear after a few weeks.
e.zh: 几周后这个工具的实用性就显现出来了。

e.en: Many people doubt the {usefulness} of daily horoscopes.
e.zh: 许多人怀疑每日星座运势的实用性。

e.en: My phone is completely {useless} without an internet connection.
e.zh: 没有网络连接,我的手机就完全没用了。

e.en: Arguing with him about politics is totally {useless}.
e.zh: 和他争论政治完全是徒劳的。

e.en: He waved his arms {uselessly} at the departing taxi.
e.zh: 他对着离去的出租车徒劳地挥手。

e.en: The fan spun {uselessly} after the power went out.
e.zh: 停电之后风扇徒劳地空转着。

e.en: She felt a deep sense of {uselessness} after retiring.
e.zh: 退休之后她深感自己毫无用处。

e.en: The {uselessness} of the meeting frustrated everyone present.
e.zh: 这场会议的毫无意义让在场所有人都很沮丧。

e.en: Each {user} needs a strong password for the account.
e.zh: 每个用户都需要为账户设置一个强密码。

e.en: The app has over a million active {user} accounts.
e.zh: 这款应用拥有超过一百万个活跃用户账户。

e.en: Please enter your {username} and password to log in.
e.zh: 请输入你的用户名和密码以登录。

e.en: That {username} is already taken—try a different one.
e.zh: 那个用户名已被占用——换一个试试。

e.en: The platform now has over ten million active {users}.
e.zh: 该平台现在拥有超过一千万活跃用户。

e.en: We surveyed {users} about their experience with the new feature.
e.zh: 我们就新功能的体验对用户进行了调查。

uses.t:
n. 用途（复数）
v. 使用（第三人称单数）

e.en: She {uses} her phone mainly for reading and messaging.
e.zh: 她的手机主要用来阅读和发消息。

e.en: This app has many practical {uses} for travelers.
e.zh: 这款应用对旅行者有许多实用的用途。

usher.t:
n. 引座员、迎宾
v. 引领、开启

e.en: The {usher} showed us to our seats in the theater.
e.zh: 引座员把我们带到了剧院的座位上。

e.en: These reforms will {usher} in a new political era.
e.zh: 这些改革将开启一个新的政治时代。

e.en: The host {ushered} the guests into the dining room.
e.zh: 主人把客人引进了餐厅。

e.en: The iPhone {ushered} in the era of smartphones.
e.zh: iPhone 开启了智能手机时代。

e.en: The {usherette} handed me a program at the door.
e.zh: 女引座员在门口递给我一份节目单。

e.en: She worked as an {usherette} at the cinema in college.
e.zh: 她大学时在电影院当女引座员。

e.en: AI is {ushering} in a new era of productivity.
e.zh: 人工智能正在开启一个全新的生产力时代。

e.en: The staff were busy {ushering} guests to their tables.
e.zh: 工作人员忙着把客人引到各自的桌位。

e.en: The new policy {ushers} in a wave of reforms.
e.zh: 这项新政策开启了一波改革。

e.en: One of the {ushers} guided us to our seats.
e.zh: 一位引座员把我们带到座位上。

using.t:
v. 使用（进行时）
prep. 用……

e.en: I'm {using} a new app to track my workouts.
e.zh: 我正在用一款新应用记录健身情况。

e.en: She solved the puzzle {using} only logic.
e.zh: 她仅凭逻辑就解开了这道谜题。

usk.t: n. 厄斯克（英国地名/河流）

uss.t: n. 美国军舰（舰名前缀）

ussr.t: n. 苏联（苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟）

e.en: The {USSR} dissolved at the end of 1991.
e.zh: 苏联于1991年底解体。

e.en: My grandfather grew up in the former {USSR}.
e.zh: 我祖父在前苏联长大。

e.en: I'll have my {usual} coffee, thanks.
e.zh: 麻烦给我来一杯老样子的咖啡。

e.en: The train arrived later than {usual} today.
e.zh: 今天火车比平时到得晚。

e.en: I {usually} work from home on Fridays.
e.zh: 我周五一般在家办公。

e.en: The shop is {usually} closed on Mondays.
e.zh: 这家店周一通常不营业。

e.en: The contract grants her {usufruct} of the orchard.
e.zh: 合同授予她对果园的用益权。

e.en: They hold {usufruct} but cannot sell the land.
e.zh: 他们拥有用益权,但不能出售土地。

e.en: The local {usurer} charged outrageous interest rates.
e.zh: 当地的放高利贷者收取离谱的利息。

e.en: Villagers feared falling into debt with the {usurer}.
e.zh: 村民们害怕欠下高利贷者的债。

usurious.t: adj. 高利贷的、放高利贷的

e.en: The loan came with {usurious} interest rates.
e.zh: 这笔贷款的利息高得离谱。

e.en: Regulators banned the company's {usurious} lending practices.
e.zh: 监管机构禁止了该公司的高利贷行为。

usurp.t: v. 篡夺、强占（权力、职位）

e.en: Rebels tried to {usurp} power from the king.
e.zh: 叛军试图篡夺国王的权力。

e.en: AI tools won't entirely {usurp} human creativity.
e.zh: 人工智能工具不会完全取代人类的创造力。

e.en: The general's {usurpation} of power shocked the nation.
e.zh: 将军篡夺权力一事震惊了全国。

e.en: History remembers his {usurpation} of the throne.
e.zh: 历史铭记着他对王位的篡夺。

e.en: The exiled prince called the new king a {usurper}.
e.zh: 流亡的王子称新国王为篡位者。

e.en: Loyal soldiers refused to serve the {usurper}.
e.zh: 忠诚的士兵拒绝效力于这个篡位者。

e.en: Many religions historically condemned {usury}.
e.zh: 许多宗教在历史上都谴责高利贷。

e.en: The lender was prosecuted for {usury}.
e.zh: 那名放贷者因放高利贷被起诉。

e.en: We hiked through the red canyons of {Utah}.
e.zh: 我们在犹他州的红色峡谷里徒步。

e.en: Salt Lake City is the capital of {Utah}.
e.zh: 盐湖城是犹他州的首府。

utd.t: n. 联队（United 的缩写，如 Man Utd）

utensil.t: n. 器皿、用具（尤指厨房）

e.en: A spatula is a handy kitchen {utensil}.
e.zh: 锅铲是一种很实用的厨房用具。

e.en: Pick whichever {utensil} feels comfortable to hold.
e.zh: 挑一件你拿着顺手的餐具就行。

e.en: Please wash the {utensils} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后请把餐具洗一下。

e.en: The drawer is full of cooking {utensils}.
e.zh: 抽屉里塞满了烹饪用具。

e.en: The doctor ordered tests for {uterine} fibroids.
e.zh: 医生开了检查,以排查子宫肌瘤。

e.en: Regular checkups help detect {uterine} problems early.
e.zh: 定期检查有助于尽早发现子宫问题。

utero.t: n. 子宫（常见于 in utero 子宫内）

e.en: The condition can be diagnosed in {utero}.
e.zh: 这种病在胎儿期就能被诊断出来。

e.en: Doctors performed surgery on the baby in {utero}.
e.zh: 医生在胎儿期就为这个宝宝做了手术。

e.en: The embryo implants in the wall of the {uterus}.
e.zh: 胚胎着床在子宫壁上。

e.en: An ultrasound showed her {uterus} was healthy.
e.zh: 超声检查显示她的子宫很健康。

utilisation.t: n. 利用、使用（英式拼写）

e.en: The report measures {utilisation} of office space.
e.zh: 该报告衡量了办公空间的使用率。

e.en: Better {utilisation} of resources cut our costs.
e.zh: 更好地利用资源帮我们降低了成本。

utilisations.t: n. 利用、使用（复数，英式）

e.en: The study compares different {utilisations} of farmland.
e.zh: 该研究比较了农田的不同利用方式。

e.en: Various {utilisations} of solar energy were tested.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了太阳能的多种利用方式。

utilise.t: v. 利用、使用（英式拼写）

e.en: Engineers {utilise} sensors to monitor the bridge.
e.zh: 工程师利用传感器监测这座桥。

e.en: We need to {utilise} every minute before the deadline.
e.zh: 截止日期前我们要充分利用每一分钟。

upfront.t:
adj. 预先的；先付的
adv. 预先；坦率地

e.en: Please be {upfront} about any fees before I sign.
e.zh: 请在我签字之前坦白说明所有费用。

e.en: The landlord wants two months' rent {upfront}.
e.zh: 房东要求预先支付两个月的租金。

upgrade.t:
v. 升级；提升
n. 升级（版本）

e.en: I finally decided to {upgrade} to the new iPhone.
e.zh: 我终于决定升级到新款 iPhone 了。

e.en: This software {upgrade} adds dark mode and faster search.
e.zh: 这次软件升级新增了深色模式和更快的搜索功能。

upgraded.t:
adj. 已升级的
v. 升级（过去式）

e.en: They {upgraded} our hotel room to a suite for free.
e.zh: 他们免费把我们的酒店房间升级成了套房。

e.en: I just {upgraded} my laptop's memory to sixteen gigabytes.
e.zh: 我刚把笔记本电脑的内存升级到了十六 G。

upgrades.t:
n. 升级项；升级版
v. 升级（第三人称单数）

e.en: The kitchen {upgrades} really increased the home's resale value.
e.zh: 厨房的升级大大提升了房子的转售价值。

e.en: He always {upgrades} his phone the day it launches.
e.zh: 他总是在新手机发布当天就升级。

upgrading.t:
v. 正在升级
n. 升级（过程）

e.en: We're {upgrading} the office Wi-Fi to handle more devices.
e.zh: 我们正在升级办公室的无线网络以支持更多设备。

e.en: She's thinking about {upgrading} from a sedan to an SUV.
e.zh: 她正在考虑把轿车换成 SUV。

e.en: Moving to a new country caused major emotional {upheaval}.
e.zh: 搬到新国家给她带来了巨大的情感波动。

e.en: The merger created tremendous {upheaval} within the company.
e.zh: 合并在公司内部引发了巨大的动荡。

e.en: The country survived several political {upheavals} during the decade.
e.zh: 这个国家在那十年间经历了几次政治动荡。

e.en: Personal {upheavals} can sometimes lead to surprising new opportunities.
e.zh: 人生的动荡有时会带来意想不到的新机会。

upheld.t: v. 维持；支持（uphold 的过去式）

e.en: The court {upheld} the original verdict on appeal.
e.zh: 法院在上诉中维持了原判。

e.en: She has always {upheld} the highest professional standards.
e.zh: 她始终秉持着最高的职业标准。

uphill.t:
adj. 上坡的；艰难的
adv. 向上；费力地

e.en: Convincing the board will be an {uphill} battle.
e.zh: 说服董事会将是一场艰难的攻坚战。

e.en: We hiked {uphill} for two hours before reaching the lookout.
e.zh: 我们爬了两个小时山才到达观景点。

e.en: Judges swear an oath to {uphold} the constitution.
e.zh: 法官宣誓维护宪法。

e.en: Every employee must {uphold} the company's privacy policies.
e.zh: 每位员工都必须遵守公司的隐私政策。

e.en: She is a strong {upholder} of traditional family values.
e.zh: 她是传统家庭价值观的坚定维护者。

e.en: The court acts as the main {upholder} of the constitution.
e.zh: 法院是宪法的主要捍卫者。

e.en: The judge is committed to {upholding} the rule of law.
e.zh: 这位法官致力于维护法治。

e.en: Thank you for {upholding} our community guidelines online.
e.zh: 感谢你在网上遵守我们的社区准则。

upholds.t: v. 维护；支持（第三人称单数）

e.en: The supreme court {upholds} the lower court's decision.
e.zh: 最高法院维持了下级法院的判决。

e.en: Our team {upholds} the highest standards of service.
e.zh: 我们团队坚守最高的服务标准。

upholster.t: v. 给家具装软垫或面料

e.en: We plan to {upholster} the old sofa in linen.
e.zh: 我们打算用亚麻布重新包覆这张旧沙发。

e.en: It costs a lot to {upholster} antique chairs properly.
e.zh: 妥善地重新装饰古董椅子的费用很高。

e.en: The chair is {upholstered} in soft green velvet.
e.zh: 这张椅子用柔软的绿色天鹅绒包覆。

e.en: She bought a beautifully {upholstered} headboard online.
e.zh: 她在网上买了一张精美包面的床头板。

e.en: A skilled {upholsterer} can restore almost any old chair.
e.zh: 熟练的家具装饰工几乎能修复任何旧椅子。

e.en: The {upholsterer} quoted us a fair price for the couch.
e.zh: 那位装饰工给我们的沙发报了个公道的价格。

upholstery.t: n. 家具软垫；软装面料

e.en: The car's leather {upholstery} still looks brand new.
e.zh: 这辆车的皮革内饰看起来还跟新的一样。

e.en: Stains on the {upholstery} are hard to remove.
e.zh: 沙发布面上的污渍很难去除。

upjohn.t: n. 普强公司（美国制药企业）

e.en: {Upjohn} was a major American pharmaceutical company.
e.zh: 普强公司曾是美国一家大型制药企业。

e.en: My grandfather worked at {Upjohn} for thirty years.
e.zh: 我祖父在普强公司工作了三十年。

e.en: The {upkeep} of an old house can be expensive.
e.zh: 维护一栋老房子可能花费不菲。

e.en: Regular {upkeep} keeps your bike running smoothly.
e.zh: 定期保养能让你的自行车顺畅运行。

upland.t:
n. 高地；山地
adj. 高地的

e.en: The {upland} villages get heavy snow in winter.
e.zh: 高地的村庄冬天会下大雪。

e.en: Sheep graze freely across the open {upland} pastures.
e.zh: 羊群在开阔的高地牧场自由地吃草。

uplift.t:
v. 提升；鼓舞
n. 振奋；隆起

e.en: Good music can really {uplift} your mood instantly.
e.zh: 好音乐真的能瞬间提振你的心情。

e.en: The charity aims to {uplift} struggling rural families.
e.zh: 该慈善机构旨在帮助贫困的农村家庭。

e.en: I felt {uplifted} after the inspiring keynote speech.
e.zh: 听完那场振奋人心的主题演讲后我深受鼓舞。

e.en: Her kind words {uplifted} everyone in the room.
e.zh: 她温暖的话语鼓舞了房间里的每个人。

uplifting.t: adj. 振奋人心的；鼓舞的

e.en: That movie had a really {uplifting} ending.
e.zh: 那部电影的结局非常振奋人心。

e.en: She shared an {uplifting} story on her podcast today.
e.zh: 她今天在播客上分享了一个鼓舞人心的故事。

uplink.t: n. 上行链路（向卫星传输）

e.en: The satellite {uplink} dropped during the live broadcast.
e.zh: 卫星上行链路在直播中断开了。

e.en: Engineers tested the {uplink} before the rocket launch.
e.zh: 工程师在火箭发射前测试了上行链路。

upload.t:
v. 上传（文件）
n. 上传内容

e.en: Please {upload} your resume as a PDF file.
e.zh: 请将你的简历以 PDF 格式上传。

e.en: I'll {upload} the photos to the cloud tonight.
e.zh: 我今晚会把照片上传到云端。

uploaded.t:
v. 已上传
adj. 上传好的

e.en: She {uploaded} the new video to YouTube this morning.
e.zh: 她今天早上把新视频上传到了 YouTube。

e.en: The documents were {uploaded} to the shared drive.
e.zh: 文件已上传到共享云盘。

uploading.t:
v. 正在上传
n. 上传（过程）

e.en: {Uploading} large files takes longer on slow Wi-Fi.
e.zh: 在慢速 Wi-Fi 下上传大文件需要更长时间。

e.en: He is {uploading} his latest song to Spotify now.
e.zh: 他正在把他最新的歌曲上传到 Spotify。

uploads.t:
n. 上传的文件
v. 上传（第三人称单数）

e.en: The platform automatically backs up all your {uploads}.
e.zh: 该平台会自动备份你所有上传的内容。
