e.en: The suspect remained {unapprehended} for months.
e.zh: 那名嫌疑人数月来仍未被逮捕。

e.en: The deeper meaning was {unapprehended} by most readers.
e.zh: 更深层的含义没有被多数读者理解。

e.en: She seemed strangely {unapprehensive} before the exam.
e.zh: 考试前她显得出奇地不担心。

e.en: He was {unapprehensive} of the danger ahead.
e.zh: 他没有意识到前方的危险。

e.en: The committee was {unapprised} of the change.
e.zh: 委员会并不知道这项变动。

e.en: He remained {unapprised} until the report arrived.
e.zh: 直到报告送达，他仍不知情。

e.en: His {unapproachability} made new staff nervous.
e.zh: 他的难以接近让新员工感到紧张。

e.en: The mountain's {unapproachability} protected the village.
e.zh: 那座山难以进入，反而保护了村庄。

unapproached.t: 未被接近的；未被处理的

e.en: The old house stood {unapproached} for years.
e.zh: 那座老房子多年来无人靠近。

e.en: Several hard questions remained {unapproached}.
e.zh: 几个棘手问题仍未被处理。

e.en: The fund still contains {unappropriated} money.
e.zh: 这笔基金里仍有尚未拨用的钱。

e.en: They settled on {unappropriated} land near the river.
e.zh: 他们在河边无人占有的土地上定居。

e.en: That was an {unapt} comparison.
e.zh: 那个比较并不恰当。

e.en: He is {unapt} at handling delicate disputes.
e.zh: 他不善于处理微妙的争端。

e.en: The policy was {unaptly} named a reform.
e.zh: 这项政策被不恰当地称为改革。

e.en: He spoke {unaptly} during the tense meeting.
e.zh: 在紧张的会议上他说话不得体。

e.en: The {unaptness} of the joke was obvious.
e.zh: 这个笑话的不合时宜很明显。

e.en: Her {unaptness} for management soon appeared.
e.zh: 她不适合做管理的特点很快显现出来。

e.en: The essay rests on an {unargued} assumption.
e.zh: 这篇文章建立在一个未经论证的假设上。

e.en: The point passed {unargued} in the meeting.
e.zh: 这一点在会议上没有被争辩就通过了。

e.en: The guards ordered him to {unarm}.
e.zh: 守卫命令他解除武装。

e.en: A kind word can {unarm} suspicion.
e.zh: 一句善意的话能化解猜疑。

unarming.t: 解除武装的；化解敌意的

e.en: The treaty began the slow {unarming} of militias.
e.zh: 该条约开启了民兵组织缓慢的解除武装过程。

e.en: Her smile had an {unarming} warmth.
e.zh: 她的微笑带着一种让人放下戒心的温暖。

e.en: The convoy included several {unarmoured} trucks.
e.zh: 车队里有几辆没有装甲的卡车。

e.en: He felt {unarmoured} against their criticism.
e.zh: 面对他们的批评，他觉得毫无防护。

e.en: The agreement {unarms} both sides gradually.
e.zh: 该协议使双方逐步解除武装。

e.en: Her honesty {unarms} even harsh critics.
e.zh: 她的坦诚甚至让严厉的批评者放下戒心。

e.en: The room had an {unartificial} charm.
e.zh: 这个房间有一种自然不做作的魅力。

e.en: They preferred {unartificial} materials for the restoration.
e.zh: 他们更喜欢用非人工材料来修复。

unartistic.t: 无艺术感的；不懂艺术的

e.en: The poster looked dull and {unartistic}.
e.zh: 这张海报显得单调，毫无艺术感。

e.en: He admitted he was rather {unartistic}.
e.zh: 他承认自己相当不懂艺术。

e.en: A {unary} operator takes one value.
e.zh: 一元运算符只接受一个值。

e.en: The system used a simple {unary} code.
e.zh: 该系统使用了一种简单的一元编码。

unascertainable.t: 无法查明的；不能确定的

e.en: The exact cause remains {unascertainable}.
e.zh: 确切原因仍然无法查明。

e.en: Some damages were {unascertainable} at the time.
e.zh: 当时有些损失无法确定。

e.en: The victim's identity is still {unascertained}.
e.zh: 受害者身份仍未查明。

e.en: They delayed payment for {unascertained} costs.
e.zh: 他们因费用尚未确定而推迟付款。

e.en: He gave me {unasked-for} advice.
e.zh: 他给了我一堆我没要的建议。

e.en: The gift felt {unasked-for} and awkward.
e.zh: 这份礼物来得突兀，让人尴尬。

e.en: The typo meant {unasnwerable} was not searchable.
e.zh: 这个拼写错误导致“unasnwerable”无法被搜索到。

e.en: She marked the strange word {unasnwerable} in the list.
e.zh: 她把列表里这个奇怪的词标为无法回答。

e.en: He seemed content and {unaspiring}.
e.zh: 他看起来满足而没有什么抱负。

e.en: The novel portrays an {unaspiring} clerk.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了一个不求上进的职员。

e.en: The judge stressed the evidence's {unassailability}.
e.zh: 法官强调这些证据无可攻击。

e.en: Her reputation had an air of {unassailability}.
e.zh: 她的声誉带着一种不可质疑的气势。

unassailably.t: 无可争辩地；坚不可摧地

e.en: The conclusion was {unassailably} supported by data.
e.zh: 这个结论有数据支撑，无可争辩。

e.en: The fortress stood {unassailably} above the valley.
e.zh: 那座堡垒坚不可摧地矗立在山谷上方。

e.en: She began to {unbag} the groceries on the counter.
e.zh: 她开始把食品杂货从袋子里拿出来放到台面上。

e.en: The volunteers {unbagged} the donated clothes for sorting.
e.zh: 志愿者把捐赠衣物拆袋取出，方便分类。

unbailable.t: 不得保释的；无法保释的

e.en: The judge called the charge {unbailable} under the new law.
e.zh: 法官称根据新法律，这项指控不得保释。

e.en: He feared the offense might be treated as {unbailable}.
e.zh: 他担心这项罪名可能会被视为不能保释。

e.en: The crew had to {unballast} the vessel before repairs.
e.zh: 船员必须在维修前卸去船上的压舱物。

e.en: Engineers {unballasted} the platform to raise it slowly.
e.zh: 工程师减轻平台压载，使它慢慢升起。

e.en: The {unballasted} boat rocked badly in the wind.
e.zh: 那艘未加压舱物的船在风中摇晃得很厉害。

e.en: His plans felt {unballasted} by experience or evidence.
e.zh: 他的计划缺少经验或证据支撑，显得不稳。

e.en: The forum agreed to {unban} the user after review.
e.zh: 论坛审核后同意解除对该用户的封禁。

e.en: Officials may {unban} the product next month.
e.zh: 官员可能在下个月解除对该产品的禁令。

e.en: The nurse will {unbandage} the wound tomorrow.
e.zh: 护士明天会解开伤口上的绷带。

e.en: Do not {unbandage} your hand without permission.
e.zh: 没有许可不要自行拆开手上的包扎。

unbaned.t: 未受诅咒的；未被禁止的

e.en: The old poem describes an {unbaned} soul at peace.
e.zh: 那首古诗描写了一个未受诅咒、安宁的灵魂。

e.en: They entered the {unbaned} hall without fear.
e.zh: 他们毫无畏惧地走进那座未被禁入的大厅。

unbanked.t: 无银行账户的；未倾斜的

e.en: The app helps {unbanked} workers receive digital payments.
e.zh: 这款应用帮助没有银行账户的工人接收电子付款。

e.en: The car slid on the {unbanked} curve.
e.zh: 汽车在没有倾斜设计的弯道上打滑了。

e.en: He went to {unbar} the heavy wooden gate.
e.zh: 他去拔开那扇厚重木门的门闩。

e.en: The ruling helped {unbar} access to the records.
e.zh: 这项裁决帮助解除对这些记录的查阅阻碍。

e.en: Use an {unbarbed} hook to release the fish safely.
e.zh: 使用无倒刺鱼钩可以安全放生那条鱼。

e.en: Her {unbarbed} reply surprised everyone in the room.
e.zh: 她并不尖刻的回答让屋里所有人都感到意外。

e.en: His {unbarbered} hair fell over his collar.
e.zh: 他未修剪的头发垂到了衣领上。

e.en: The actor kept an {unbarbered} look for the role.
e.zh: 那位演员为了角色保留了未经修整的形象。

e.en: Workers {unbark} the logs before cutting them.
e.zh: 工人在切割木料前先剥去原木的树皮。

e.en: The passengers began to {unbark} at dawn.
e.zh: 乘客们在黎明时开始下船上岸。

e.en: The door was {unbarred} when we arrived.
e.zh: 我们到达时，那扇门没有上闩。

e.en: The decision left the path {unbarred} for appeal.
e.zh: 这一决定使上诉之路不再受阻。

e.en: The guard was {unbarring} the cell at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时，守卫正在打开牢房的门闩。

e.en: The policy is {unbarring} more students from entry.
e.zh: 这项政策正在为更多学生解除入学障碍。

e.en: She {unbars} the window every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上都会打开窗户的闩。

e.en: The reform {unbars} small firms from bidding.
e.zh: 这项改革解除限制，让小公司也能投标。

e.en: The storm continued with {unbated} force overnight.
e.zh: 暴风雨整夜以未减弱的力量持续着。

e.en: His anger remained {unbated} after the apology.
e.zh: 道歉之后，他的怒气仍未缓和。

e.en: The campers were tired and {unbathed} after three days.
e.zh: 露营者三天后又累又没洗澡。

e.en: He felt awkward arriving {unbathed} at dinner.
e.zh: 他没洗澡就来吃晚饭，觉得很尴尬。

e.en: A thing cannot simply {unbe} because we dislike it.
e.zh: 一件事不会只因我们不喜欢就不再存在。

e.en: The philosopher asked what it means to {unbe}.
e.zh: 那位哲学家追问“不再存在”意味着什么。

e.en: The portrait shows him young and {unbearded}.
e.zh: 这幅画像显示他年轻时没有胡须的样子。

e.en: The {unbearded} actor looked much younger on stage.
e.zh: 那位没有胡子的演员在舞台上显得年轻许多。

unbeatably.t: 无可匹敌地；极其出色地

e.en: The hotel is {unbeatably} close to the station.
e.zh: 这家酒店离车站近得无可比拟。

e.en: They priced the service {unbeatably} for students.
e.zh: 他们给学生的服务定价极有竞争力。

e.en: The building was practical but {unbeautiful}.
e.zh: 那栋楼很实用，但缺乏美感。

e.en: She found an {unbeautiful} honesty in the rough landscape.
e.zh: 她在粗粝的风景中发现了一种并不漂亮却真实的坦率。

e.en: The nurse had to {unbed} the patient gently.
e.zh: 护士必须轻轻扶病人离床。

e.en: He refused to {unbed} before sunrise.
e.zh: 他不肯在日出前起床。

e.en: His joke was {unbefitting} for the solemn ceremony.
e.zh: 他的玩笑不适合那场庄重的仪式。

e.en: Such cruelty is {unbefitting} a public servant.
e.zh: 这样的残酷行为不符合公职人员的身份。

unbefriended.t: 无人为友的；孤立无助的

e.en: The child felt {unbefriended} in the new school.
e.zh: 那个孩子在新学校感到无人为友。

e.en: She died poor and {unbefriended} in the city.
e.zh: 她在城里贫困而孤苦地去世了。

unbegotten.t: 非被生出的；永恒未生的

e.en: The creed calls the Son {unbegotten} in a special sense.
e.zh: 这份信经在特殊意义上称圣子并非被生出。

e.en: The myth speaks of an {unbegotten} light before creation.
e.zh: 这个神话讲述创世之前一种永恒未生的光。

e.en: She felt {unbelonging} in the crowded room.
e.zh: 在人群拥挤的房间里，她感到自己格格不入。

e.en: His {unbelonging} shaped much of his poetry.
e.zh: 他的无归属感塑造了他许多诗作。

e.en: The policy remained {unbeloved} by most voters.
e.zh: 这项政策仍然不受大多数选民喜欢。

e.en: He grew up feeling {unbeloved} and ignored.
e.zh: 他从小觉得自己无人爱护、被人忽视。

e.en: He stopped to {unbelt} his heavy coat.
e.zh: 他停下来解开厚外套上的带子。

e.en: The mechanic had to {unbelt} the machine first.
e.zh: 机修工得先卸下机器的皮带。

e.en: She was {unbelting} her suitcase in the hall.
e.zh: 她正在大厅里解开行李箱上的带子。

e.en: The workers began {unbelting} the old conveyor.
e.zh: 工人们开始卸下旧传送带。

e.en: He {unbelts} his coat before sitting down.
e.zh: 他坐下前解开外套上的带子。

e.en: The crew {unbelts} the equipment for repair.
e.zh: 维修时，工作人员会卸下设备的皮带。

e.en: The frame is light but {unbendable}.
e.zh: 这个框架很轻，但不能弯曲。

e.en: She showed an {unbendable} commitment to justice.
e.zh: 她表现出对正义坚定不移的承诺。

unbenefited.t: 未受益的；没有得到好处的

e.en: Many villages remained {unbenefited} by the reforms.
e.zh: 许多村庄仍未从改革中受益。

e.en: The fund left smaller schools largely {unbenefited}.
e.zh: 这笔基金基本没有让小学校得到好处。

e.en: The ship lay {unberthed} outside the harbor.
e.zh: 那艘船未能靠泊，停在港外。

e.en: Once {unberthed}, the ferry moved into open water.
e.zh: 渡轮一离开泊位，就驶入开阔水域。

e.en: Such anger would {unbeseem} a judge.
e.zh: 这样的怒气不适合一位法官。

e.en: It may {unbeseem} him to boast so loudly.
e.zh: 他这样大声吹嘘，恐怕有失体面。

e.en: His laughter was {unbeseeming} at the funeral.
e.zh: 他在葬礼上的笑声很不得体。

e.en: The letter used an {unbeseeming} tone.
e.zh: 那封信用了不合适的语气。

unbesought.t: 未经请求的；主动给出的

e.en: She offered {unbesought} advice after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后，她主动提出了没人请她给的建议。

e.en: An {unbesought} gift arrived at his door.
e.zh: 一份未经索求的礼物送到了他门口。

e.en: Only one {unbespoken} table remained at the inn.
e.zh: 客栈里只剩下一张未被预订的桌子。

e.en: Her {unbespoken} fear was clear in her face.
e.zh: 她未说出口的恐惧清楚地写在脸上。

e.en: We need an {unbiassed} account of the dispute.
e.zh: 我们需要一份对这场争端公正无偏的说明。

e.en: The panel promised an {unbiassed} review.
e.zh: 小组承诺会进行公正的审查。

e.en: Some clergy called the practice {unbiblical}.
e.zh: 一些神职人员称这种做法不合圣经。

e.en: The novel gives an {unbiblical} version of creation.
e.zh: 这部小说给出了一个非圣经式的创世版本。

unbid.t: 未受邀请的；未经吩咐的

e.en: He entered the room {unbid}.
e.zh: 他未经邀请就走进了房间。

e.en: Tears came {unbid} to her eyes.
e.zh: 泪水不由自主地涌上她的眼眶。

e.en: They held an {unbirthday} party in July.
e.zh: 他们在七月办了一场非生日派对。

e.en: The child loved the idea of an {unbirthday}.
e.zh: 那个孩子很喜欢“非生日”这个想法。

unbishop.t: 解除主教职位；废黜主教

e.en: The council voted to {unbishop} the corrupt cleric.
e.zh: 委员会投票决定解除那名腐败神职人员的主教职位。

e.en: No king could easily {unbishop} a rival prelate.
e.zh: 没有哪位国王能轻易废黜敌对的高级主教。

e.en: The sailors prepared to {unbitt} the cable.
e.zh: 水手们准备解开系在缆桩上的缆绳。

e.en: They had to {unbitt} quickly before the tide turned.
e.zh: 他们必须在潮水转向前迅速松开缆绳。

unbitted.t: 未上马嚼子的；已松缆的

e.en: The young horse was still {unbitted}.
e.zh: 那匹小马还没有上马嚼子。

e.en: The cable was {unbitted} as the vessel departed.
e.zh: 船离开时，缆绳已从缆桩上解开。

e.en: The tea was surprisingly {unbitter}.
e.zh: 这茶出人意料地不苦。

e.en: After all that, she remained {unbitter}.
e.zh: 经历了那一切之后，她仍然没有怨恨。

unblamed.t: 未受责备的；无可责怪的

e.en: He was left {unblamed} for the mistake.
e.zh: 这个错误没有归咎到他身上。

e.en: The captain stood {unblamed} after the inquiry.
e.zh: 调查结束后，船长没有受到责备。

e.en: The software is {unblanking} the hidden fields.
e.zh: 软件正在恢复显示那些隐藏字段。

e.en: Screen {unblanking} failed after the update.
e.zh: 更新后，屏幕恢复显示功能失效了。

e.en: She faced the accusation {unblenched}.
e.zh: 她面对指控毫不退缩。

e.en: His {unblenched} stare unsettled the witness.
e.zh: 他坚定不惧的凝视让证人感到不安。

unassailed.t: 未受攻击的；未遭质疑的

e.en: Her reputation remained {unassailed} after the inquiry.
e.zh: 调查之后，她的声誉仍未受到质疑。

e.en: The fortress stood {unassailed} through the winter.
e.zh: 那座堡垒整个冬天都未遭攻击。

unassimilable.t: 无法同化的；难以吸收的

e.en: Some ideas seemed {unassimilable} to the old system.
e.zh: 有些观念似乎无法被旧体系吸收。

e.en: The community treated the newcomers as {unassimilable}.
e.zh: 这个社区把新来者视为无法同化的人。

unassimilated.t: 未被同化的；未被吸收的

e.en: The minerals remained {unassimilated} in the soil.
e.zh: 这些矿物仍未被土壤吸收。

e.en: They felt culturally {unassimilated} after many years abroad.
e.zh: 在海外多年后，他们仍觉得自己在文化上未被同化。

e.en: Boxes of {unassorted} papers filled the room.
e.zh: 一箱箱未分类的文件堆满了房间。

e.en: The shop sold {unassorted} buttons by weight.
e.zh: 这家店按重量出售未拣选的纽扣。

unassuageable.t: 无法缓和的；难以安抚的

e.en: He carried an {unassuageable} grief for years.
e.zh: 多年来他一直怀着无法缓解的悲痛。

e.en: Her anger seemed {unassuageable} after the betrayal.
e.zh: 遭到背叛后，她的愤怒似乎难以安抚。

e.en: His doubts remained {unassuaged} by their explanation.
e.zh: 他们的解释并没有消除他的疑虑。

e.en: The apology left her pain {unassuaged}.
e.zh: 那句道歉并未缓解她的痛苦。

e.en: She sounded {unassured} during the interview.
e.zh: 她在面试中听起来缺乏自信。

e.en: The project's funding is still {unassured}.
e.zh: 这个项目的资金仍然没有保障。

e.en: The diagram shows a {unate} signal response.
e.zh: 这张图显示的是单向信号响应。

e.en: In logic design, a {unate} function changes predictably.
e.zh: 在逻辑设计中，单向函数的变化是可预测的。

unattacked.t: 未受攻击的；未被批驳的

e.en: The convoy passed through {unattacked} at dawn.
e.zh: 车队在黎明时分未受攻击地通过了。

e.en: His central argument went {unattacked} in the debate.
e.zh: 他的核心论点在辩论中没有受到批驳。

e.en: The goal remained {unattained} after months of work.
e.zh: 经过数月努力，这个目标仍未实现。

e.en: She regretted the dreams left {unattained}.
e.zh: 她为那些未能实现的梦想感到遗憾。

e.en: Several questions were left {unattempted} on the exam.
e.zh: 考试中有几道题没有作答。

e.en: The climb remained {unattempted} until spring.
e.zh: 这次攀登直到春天前都无人尝试。

e.en: The sound reached us {unattenuated} across the water.
e.zh: 声音穿过水面传来，几乎没有减弱。

e.en: The drug was tested in an {unattenuated} form.
e.zh: 这种药以未稀释的形态进行了测试。

e.en: The word is {unattested} in earlier manuscripts.
e.zh: 这个词在更早的手稿中没有例证。

e.en: That claim remains {unattested} by reliable sources.
e.zh: 那个说法仍未得到可靠来源证实。

unattributable.t: 无法归因的；无法署名的

e.en: The quote is {unattributable} to any known writer.
e.zh: 这句话无法归于任何已知作家名下。

e.en: Some symptoms were {unattributable} to the infection.
e.zh: 有些症状无法归因于这次感染。

e.en: The {unau} moves slowly through the trees.
e.zh: 二趾树懒在树间缓慢移动。

e.en: Early naturalists described the {unau} in detail.
e.zh: 早期博物学家详细描述了二趾树懒。

e.en: The journey began under {unauspicious} signs.
e.zh: 这趟旅程在不祥的征兆下开始。

e.en: It was an {unauspicious} moment to ask for money.
e.zh: 那不是开口要钱的好时机。

e.en: The signature looked {unauthentic} to the expert.
e.zh: 专家看来，这个签名不像是真的。

e.en: Tourists complained that the show felt {unauthentic}.
e.zh: 游客抱怨这场表演感觉不够原汁原味。

e.en: The server rejected the {unauthenticated} request.
e.zh: 服务器拒绝了未经认证的请求。

e.en: The report included several {unauthenticated} photos.
e.zh: 这份报道包含几张未经核实的照片。

e.en: The article relied on {unauthoritative} sources.
e.zh: 这篇文章依赖的是不权威的来源。

e.en: His answer sounded confident but {unauthoritative}.
e.zh: 他的回答听起来很自信，但缺乏权威依据。

e.en: Their efforts were of {unavail} against the storm.
e.zh: 面对暴风雨，他们的努力毫无作用。

e.en: Warnings proved {unavail} once panic began.
e.zh: 恐慌一旦开始，警告就不起作用了。

e.en: The murder remained {unavenged} for decades.
e.zh: 这起谋杀案几十年来都未能昭雪。

e.en: He could not forget his {unavenged} brother.
e.zh: 他无法忘记尚未报仇的兄弟。

e.en: She had an {unaverage} talent for languages.
e.zh: 她在语言方面有着不一般的天赋。

e.en: The team needed an {unaverage} solution quickly.
e.zh: 团队很快需要一个不同寻常的解决办法。

e.en: He acted from an {unavowed} desire for revenge.
e.zh: 他的行动出于一种未公开承认的复仇欲望。

e.en: The policy had an {unavowed} political purpose.
e.zh: 这项政策有一个隐秘的政治目的。

e.en: The children remained {unawakened} by the noise.
e.zh: 孩子们没有被那阵噪声吵醒。

e.en: His artistic sense was still {unawakened}.
e.zh: 他的艺术感受力尚未觉醒。

e.en: The proposal was {unbacked} by any evidence.
e.zh: 这个提议没有任何证据支持。

e.en: The currency became {unbacked} by gold.
e.zh: 这种货币不再由黄金担保。

e.en: The whiskey was served {unblended} from a single cask.
e.zh: 这款威士忌直接来自单一酒桶，未经调和。

e.en: Her report kept the data {unblended} with opinion.
e.zh: 她的报告让数据保持纯粹，没有掺入个人意见。

e.en: They buried him in an {unblessed} corner of the old cemetery.
e.zh: 他们把他葬在旧墓地一个未受祝福的角落。

e.en: The family felt {unblessed} by luck that winter.
e.zh: 那个冬天，这家人觉得自己没有受到好运眷顾。

e.en: The poet called the island an {unblest} and lonely shore.
e.zh: 诗人把那座岛称作一片未蒙福的孤寂海岸。

e.en: He lived an {unblest} life after the war.
e.zh: 战后他过着不幸而凄清的生活。

e.en: The researchers will {unblind} the trial data next week.
e.zh: 研究人员将在下周揭开试验数据的盲法。

e.en: The surgery helped {unblind} one eye after years of darkness.
e.zh: 手术让一只眼睛在多年黑暗后重见光明。

e.en: The {unblinded} results showed a clear treatment effect.
e.zh: 揭盲后的结果显示治疗效果很明显。

e.en: She felt suddenly {unblinded} to his selfish motives.
e.zh: 她突然看清了他的自私动机。

unblooded.t: 未经战斗的；没见过血的

e.en: The army sent {unblooded} recruits to guard the bridge.
e.zh: 军队派出未经实战的新兵去守桥。

e.en: He was still {unblooded} in serious political debate.
e.zh: 在严肃的政治辩论中，他还没有真正历练过。

e.en: The rebels hoped for an {unbloody} transfer of power.
e.zh: 反叛者希望权力交接不流血。

e.en: It was an {unbloody} but humiliating defeat.
e.zh: 那是一场没有流血却很屈辱的失败。

e.en: He told an {unblushing} lie to the committee.
e.zh: 他厚着脸皮向委员会撒了谎。

e.en: Her {unblushing} confidence impressed the whole room.
e.zh: 她毫不羞怯的自信给全场留下了印象。

e.en: He {unblushingly} claimed credit for her work.
e.zh: 他厚颜无耻地把她的工作功劳揽到自己身上。

e.en: She {unblushingly} admitted that she wanted the prize.
e.zh: 她坦然承认自己想要那个奖项。

e.en: He remained {unboastful} despite his remarkable success.
e.zh: 尽管成就卓越，他仍然不自夸。

e.en: Her {unboastful} manner made the victory seem effortless.
e.zh: 她谦逊的态度让这场胜利显得毫不费力。

e.en: The novel describes an {unbodied} voice in the dark.
e.zh: 小说描写了黑暗中一个没有形体的声音。

e.en: He imagined thought as something {unbodied} and free.
e.zh: 他把思想想象成脱离身体、自由存在的东西。

e.en: The tiles stayed {unbonded} because the glue had failed.
e.zh: 由于胶水失效，瓷砖一直没有粘牢。

e.en: The company hired an {unbonded} contractor for the repair.
e.zh: 公司雇了一名未提供保证金的承包商来维修。

e.en: The villagers would {unbonnet} when the procession passed.
e.zh: 游行队伍经过时，村民们会脱帽致意。

e.en: She stopped to {unbonnet} the child by the door.
e.zh: 她在门边停下，给孩子摘下软帽。

e.en: The child stood {unbonneted} in the cold wind.
e.zh: 孩子没戴帽子，站在寒风里。

e.en: The guests waited {unbonneted} before the memorial stone.
e.zh: 来宾们脱帽站在纪念碑前等候。

e.en: It was an {unbonny} village, but the people were kind.
e.zh: 那村子并不好看，但人们很友善。

e.en: The scar left an {unbonny} mark across his cheek.
e.zh: 那道疤在他脸颊上留下了难看的痕迹。

e.en: Several rooms were still {unbooked} on Friday night.
e.zh: 周五晚上还有几个房间没有被预订。

e.en: The auditor found {unbooked} expenses in the project files.
e.zh: 审计员在项目档案中发现了未入账的费用。

e.en: He sat by the fire to {unboot} after the long ride.
e.zh: 长途骑行后，他坐在火边脱靴。

e.en: The servant helped {unboot} the exhausted officer.
e.zh: 仆人帮疲惫的军官脱下靴子。

e.en: She chose to {unbosom} her fears to an old friend.
e.zh: 她选择向一位老朋友倾诉自己的恐惧。

e.en: He would not {unbosom} himself before strangers.
e.zh: 他不愿在陌生人面前吐露心事。

e.en: At last he {unbosomed} his grief to his sister.
e.zh: 他终于向姐姐倾诉了自己的悲痛。

e.en: Her {unbosomed} secrets changed how they saw her.
e.zh: 她吐露出的秘密改变了他们对她的看法。

e.en: The diary became a patient {unbosomer} of his private fears.
e.zh: 日记成了他倾诉私人恐惧的耐心对象。

e.en: She was known as a gentle {unbosomer} among her friends.
e.zh: 在朋友中，她以善于温和倾听和倾诉而闻名。

e.en: His {unbosoming} lasted until dawn.
e.zh: 他的倾诉一直持续到黎明。

e.en: She was {unbosoming} her doubts in a quiet letter.
e.zh: 她正在一封安静的信里吐露自己的疑虑。

e.en: He {unbosoms} his worries only after midnight.
e.zh: 他只在午夜过后才吐露自己的忧虑。

e.en: The poem {unbosoms} a grief too private for speech.
e.zh: 这首诗倾诉了一种难以开口的私人悲伤。

e.en: She filmed herself as she {unboxed} the new phone.
e.zh: 她拍下自己拆开新手机包装的过程。

e.en: Please {unbox} the printer before the technician arrives.
e.zh: 请在技术人员到达前把打印机开箱。

e.en: He tried to {unbrace} his shoulders after the argument.
e.zh: 争吵过后，他试着放松肩膀。

e.en: The workers had to {unbrace} the frame before moving it.
e.zh: 工人们必须先拆掉框架的支撑再移动它。

e.en: The {unbraced} wall shook in the storm.
e.zh: 那堵没有支撑的墙在风暴中摇晃。

e.en: She felt {unbraced} and nervous before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前她觉得没有底气，非常紧张。

e.en: She {unbraces} the tent poles before packing them away.
e.zh: 她收拾前先松开帐篷杆。

e.en: The mechanic {unbraces} the panel with a small tool.
e.zh: 机修工用小工具解开那块面板的支撑。

e.en: He was {unbracing} the shelf when it slipped.
e.zh: 他正在松开架子的支撑时，架子滑落了。

e.en: The crew began {unbracing} the damaged wall carefully.
e.zh: 施工队开始小心拆除受损墙面的支撑。

e.en: She helped her daughter {unbraid} her hair.
e.zh: 她帮女儿拆开头发上的辫子。

e.en: Carefully {unbraid} the rope before washing it.
e.zh: 清洗前要小心把绳子的编结解开。

e.en: She sat by the mirror, {unbraiding} her hair.
e.zh: 她坐在镜子旁拆开自己的辫子。

e.en: The sailor was {unbraiding} the old rope strand by strand.
e.zh: 水手一股一股地解开那根旧绳子。

e.en: Every night she {unbraids} her hair before bed.
e.zh: 她每天睡前都会拆开辫子。

e.en: He {unbraids} the cord to repair the broken section.
e.zh: 他解开绳索的编结来修补断掉的部分。

unbreathable.t: 无法呼吸的；透不过气的

e.en: The smoke made the room almost {unbreathable}.
e.zh: 烟雾让房间几乎无法呼吸。

e.en: This plastic suit feels hot and {unbreathable}.
e.zh: 这套塑料衣服又热又不透气。

e.en: The poet imagined words still {unbreathed} in the dark.
e.zh: 诗人想象那些话仍未在黑暗中说出口。

e.en: The sealed cave held air {unbreathed} for centuries.
e.zh: 那座封闭洞穴里有数百年未被呼吸过的空气。

e.en: The mare remained {unbred} through the season.
e.zh: 这匹母马整个季节都没有配种。

e.en: His manners seemed rough and {unbred} to the guests.
e.zh: 客人们觉得他的举止粗鲁、缺乏教养。

e.en: The judge had a reputation as {unbribable}.
e.zh: 那位法官以无法收买而闻名。

e.en: They needed an {unbribable} official to oversee the vote.
e.zh: 他们需要一名廉洁的官员监督投票。

e.en: The rider stopped to {unbridle} the horse.
e.zh: 骑手停下来给马卸下笼头。

e.en: The victory seemed to {unbridle} their wildest hopes.
e.zh: 胜利似乎释放了他们最狂热的希望。

e.en: She {unbridles} the pony after each ride.
e.zh: 她每次骑完都会给小马卸下笼头。

e.en: Anger {unbridles} a force he can barely control.
e.zh: 愤怒释放出一股他几乎控制不住的力量。

e.en: The vase arrived {unbroke} despite the rough delivery.
e.zh: 尽管运输粗暴，花瓶送到时没有破。

e.en: The young horse was still {unbroke} and nervous.
e.zh: 那匹小马还没被驯服，显得很紧张。

unbrotherly.t: 不像兄弟般的；不友爱的

e.en: His {unbrotherly} silence hurt more than his criticism.
e.zh: 他那种不友爱的沉默比批评更伤人。

e.en: It was {unbrotherly} to leave him alone with the debt.
e.zh: 把债务全留给他一个人很不够兄弟情分。

unbudgeable.t: 无法移动的；不肯让步的

e.en: The old cabinet was heavy and {unbudgeable}.
e.zh: 那个旧柜子很沉，怎么也挪不动。

e.en: She remained {unbudgeable} on the question of safety.
e.zh: 在安全问题上，她始终不肯让步。

e.en: The stone sat {unbudgeably} in the narrow path.
e.zh: 那块石头牢牢卡在狭窄的小路上。

e.en: He argued {unbudgeably} against any delay.
e.zh: 他固执地反对任何延期。

e.en: The repair created an {unbudgeted} expense for the school.
e.zh: 这次维修给学校带来了一笔未列入预算的开支。

e.en: They postponed several {unbudgeted} purchases until next quarter.
e.zh: 他们把几项未列入预算的采购推迟到下个季度。

e.en: The door stayed {unbudging} despite their efforts.
e.zh: 尽管他们用力，那扇门仍纹丝不动。

e.en: Her {unbudging} refusal surprised the committee.
e.zh: 她毫不让步的拒绝让委员会感到意外。

e.en: The team had to {unbuild} the stage overnight.
e.zh: 团队不得不连夜拆掉舞台。

e.en: You cannot simply {unbuild} years of bad policy.
e.zh: 多年形成的糟糕政策不是说拆就能拆掉的。

e.en: The workers began {unbuilding} the temporary bridge.
e.zh: 工人们开始拆除那座临时桥。

e.en: The essay is an {unbuilding} of a familiar myth.
e.zh: 这篇文章是在解构一个熟悉的神话。

e.en: The architect kept drawings of several {unbuilt} houses.
e.zh: 建筑师保留着几栋未建成房屋的图纸。

e.en: The road remains {unbuilt} because funding disappeared.
e.zh: 由于资金消失，那条路至今没有修成。

e.en: The company plans to {unbundle} its streaming services.
e.zh: 公司计划拆分其流媒体服务。

e.en: Please {unbundle} the cables before storing them.
e.zh: 收纳前请先把这些电缆解开。

unbundler.t: 拆分打包内容的人或工具

e.en: The {unbundler} separated the archive into smaller modules.
e.zh: 这个拆包工具把归档文件分成了较小的模块。

e.en: A software {unbundler} can expose hidden dependencies.
e.zh: 软件拆包工具能暴露隐藏的依赖关系。

e.en: The storm {unburies} old bones near the shore.
e.zh: 风暴把岸边的旧骨头重新冲露出来。

e.en: Her research {unburies} a forgotten political scandal.
e.zh: 她的研究重新揭开了一桩被遗忘的政治丑闻。

e.en: They tried to {unbury} the trapped car after the landslide.
e.zh: 山体滑坡后，他们试图把被埋的车挖出来。

e.en: The memoir helps {unbury} memories he had avoided for years.
e.zh: 这本回忆录帮助他重新面对多年回避的记忆。

e.en: His casual reply sounded {unbusinesslike} to the client.
e.zh: 他随意的回复在客户听来很不专业。

e.en: It was {unbusinesslike} to ignore the contract details.
e.zh: 忽视合同细节显得很不像商务做法。

e.en: She served {unbuttered} toast with the soup.
e.zh: 她配汤端上了没有涂黄油的吐司。

e.en: The recipe calls for {unbuttered} bread crumbs.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要未加黄油的面包屑。

e.en: The rescuers planned to {uncage} the birds at dawn.
e.zh: 救援人员计划在黎明时把鸟放出笼子。

e.en: The speech seemed to {uncage} his anger.
e.zh: 那场演讲似乎释放了他的怒火。

e.en: The {uncaged} fox ran straight into the woods.
e.zh: 被放出笼子的狐狸径直跑进树林。

e.en: Her {uncaged} energy filled the room.
e.zh: 她释放出来的活力充满了整个房间。

e.en: He gave an {uncalculating} smile when she arrived.
e.zh: 她到来时，他露出了毫无算计的笑容。

e.en: Her generosity was warm and {uncalculating}.
e.zh: 她的慷慨热情而真诚，不带算计。

e.en: The printer used {uncalendered} paper for a rough texture.
e.zh: 印刷商使用未经压光的纸张来呈现粗糙质感。

e.en: {Uncalendered} cloth absorbs dye more unevenly.
e.zh: 未经压光处理的布料吸收染料更不均匀。

e.en: His insult was completely {uncalled-for}.
e.zh: 他的侮辱完全没有必要。

e.en: The manager apologized for the {uncalled-for} delay.
e.zh: 经理为这次不应有的延误道了歉。

e.en: The engineer rejected the {uncambered} beam design.
e.zh: 工程师否定了无预拱度的梁设计。

e.en: An {uncambered} road may drain water poorly.
e.zh: 没有横向弧度的道路排水可能较差。

e.en: The witness gave an {uncandid} answer under pressure.
e.zh: 证人在压力下给出了不坦率的回答。

e.en: Her memo felt polished but {uncandid}.
e.zh: 她的备忘录看似精致，却显得不够诚恳。

e.en: The chef prefers {uncanned} tomatoes in summer.
e.zh: 厨师夏天更喜欢用非罐装番茄。

e.en: His {uncanned} response made the interview feel honest.
e.zh: 他非预设的回答让采访显得很真实。

e.en: The resemblance grew {uncannier} in the old photographs.
e.zh: 在那些旧照片里，相似之处变得更加诡异。

e.en: Her predictions became {uncannier} after each event.
e.zh: 每次事件发生后，她的预测都显得更加离奇。

e.en: The film's {uncanniness} comes from its quiet rooms.
e.zh: 这部电影的诡异感来自那些安静的房间。

e.en: There was an {uncanniness} in how accurately she guessed.
e.zh: 她猜得如此准确，其中有一种离奇之处。

e.en: The editor removed an {uncanonical} passage from the text.
e.zh: 编辑从文本中删去了一段非正典内容。

e.en: Developers should avoid {uncanonical} paths in this API.
e.zh: 开发者应避免在这个接口中使用非规范路径。

e.en: I ordered {uncarbonated} water with dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时我点了不含碳酸的水。

e.en: The drink tastes sweeter when it is {uncarbonated}.
e.zh: 这种饮料无气泡时喝起来更甜。

e.en: The garden looked {uncared-for} after months of rain.
e.zh: 几个月的雨后，花园显得无人打理。

e.en: Many {uncared-for} children need stable homes.
e.zh: 许多无人照料的孩子需要稳定的家庭。

e.en: The workers began to {uncart} the heavy crates.
e.zh: 工人们开始把沉重的木箱从车上卸下。

e.en: Please {uncart} the tools before sunset.
e.zh: 请在日落前把工具从车上卸下来。

e.en: He paused to {uncase} the violin carefully.
e.zh: 他停下来小心地把小提琴从盒中取出。

e.en: The technician had to {uncase} the device before repairs.
e.zh: 技术员维修前必须先拆开设备外壳。

e.en: The {uncased} instrument lay on the table.
e.zh: 未装盒的乐器放在桌上。

e.en: {Uncased} sausage cooks faster in the sauce.
e.zh: 去掉肠衣的香肠在酱汁里熟得更快。

e.en: Several roles remained {uncast} a week before filming.
e.zh: 开拍前一周，仍有几个角色没有选定演员。

e.en: The final votes were still {uncast} at noon.
e.zh: 到中午时，最后几张票仍未投出。

e.en: The librarian decided to {uncatalog} the duplicate records.
e.zh: 图书管理员决定把重复记录从目录中移除。

e.en: They may {uncatalog} outdated files during the migration.
e.zh: 迁移期间他们可能会取消旧文件的目录登记。

e.en: The museum found {uncataloged} letters in storage.
e.zh: 博物馆在库房里发现了未编入目录的信件。

e.en: An {uncataloged} error can be hard to trace.
e.zh: 未登记归类的错误可能很难追踪。

unchurched.t: 未加入教会的；未受宗教影响的

e.en: The mission focused on {unchurched} families in the city.
e.zh: 这项传教工作关注城里未加入教会的家庭。

e.en: He described himself as {unchurched} but spiritually curious.
e.zh: 他说自己没有教会背景，但对灵性问题很好奇。

e.en: The dispute {unchurches} people who once felt welcome.
e.zh: 这场争端让一些曾经觉得受欢迎的人离开教会。

e.en: A harsh doctrine {unchurches} anyone who questions it.
e.zh: 严苛的教义会把质疑它的人排斥在教会之外。

e.en: The essay discusses the {unchurching} of rural communities.
e.zh: 这篇文章讨论了农村社区逐渐脱离教会的现象。

e.en: They saw the policy as an {unchurching} of dissenters.
e.zh: 他们认为这项政策是在把异议者逐出教会。

unci.t: 英寸；古罗马盎司的复数

e.en: The manuscript used {unci} as a measure in the margin.
e.zh: 这份手稿在页边用古代的英寸单位作计量。

e.en: Several {unci} of silver were listed in the account.
e.zh: 账目中列出了若干古罗马盎司的银子。

unciae.t: 古罗马盎司；十二分之一单位

e.en: The scholar converted the {unciae} into modern weights.
e.zh: 那位学者把古罗马盎司换算成现代重量。

e.en: Roman fractions were often counted in {unciae}.
e.zh: 罗马分数常以十二分之一单位来计算。

uncial.t: 安色尔字体的；大写圆体字母

e.en: The gospel was written in a clear {uncial} script.
e.zh: 这部福音书用清晰的安色尔字体写成。

e.en: She studied an {uncial} from the fourth century.
e.zh: 她研究了一份四世纪的大写圆体手稿。

uncially.t: 以安色尔字体；以大写圆体

e.en: The title was copied {uncially} across the page.
e.zh: 标题以安色尔字体抄写在页面上。

e.en: Some letters were formed {uncially} rather than cursively.
e.zh: 有些字母写成大写圆体，而不是草书体。

e.en: The tool has an {unciform} end for lifting wire.
e.zh: 这个工具有一个钩状末端，用来挑起金属丝。

e.en: An {unciform} bone lies near the wrist.
e.zh: 腕部附近有一块钩形骨。

e.en: The insect has an {uncinal} claw on each leg.
e.zh: 这种昆虫每条腿上都有一个弯钩形爪。

e.en: Doctors noted the {uncinal} shape of the structure.
e.zh: 医生注意到这个结构呈钩状。

e.en: The vet identified {uncinaria} in the dog's stool sample.
e.zh: 兽医在狗的粪便样本中发现了钩虫。

e.en: {Uncinaria} can infect animals through contaminated soil.
e.zh: 钩虫可通过受污染的土壤感染动物。

e.en: The puppy was treated for {uncinariasis} last week.
e.zh: 这只小狗上周接受了钩虫病治疗。

e.en: Poor sanitation increases the risk of {uncinariasis}.
e.zh: 卫生条件差会增加钩虫感染的风险。

e.en: The bird's beak has an {uncinate} tip.
e.zh: 这只鸟的喙尖呈弯钩状。

e.en: The surgeon located the {uncinate} process on the scan.
e.zh: 外科医生在扫描图上找到了钩突。

e.en: Each bristle ended in a tiny {uncinus}.
e.zh: 每根刚毛末端都有一个小钩。

e.en: The anatomist labeled the {uncinus} in the diagram.
e.zh: 解剖学家在图中标出了钩状结构。

e.en: He bought an {uncirculated} coin from the mint.
e.zh: 他从造币厂买了一枚未流通的硬币。

e.en: The report remained {uncirculated} until the inquiry ended.
e.zh: 这份报告直到调查结束前都没有传阅。

e.en: The text contrasts circumcision with {uncircumcision}.
e.zh: 这段文字把受割礼和未受割礼作对比。

e.en: In that community, {uncircumcision} carried religious meaning.
e.zh: 在那个社群中，未受割礼具有宗教含义。

uncircumstantial.t: 不详尽的；非间接证据的

e.en: Her account was brief and {uncircumstantial}.
e.zh: 她的叙述很简短，缺少具体细节。

e.en: The lawyer wanted direct, {uncircumstantial} proof.
e.zh: 律师想要直接的、非间接性的证据。

e.en: They rejected the old idea that remote peoples were {uncivilised}.
e.zh: 他们摒弃了认为偏远民族未开化的旧观念。

e.en: His {uncivilised} behavior shocked the guests.
e.zh: 他不文明的举止让客人们感到震惊。

e.en: The meeting collapsed into open {uncivility}.
e.zh: 会议最终演变成公开的无礼争吵。

e.en: She answered his {uncivility} with calm silence.
e.zh: 面对他的粗鲁，她以平静的沉默回应。

e.en: The child ran {unclad} into the warm rain.
e.zh: 孩子没穿衣服就跑进温暖的雨中。

e.en: The wall was left {unclad} after renovation.
e.zh: 翻修后那面墙仍保持裸露状态。

e.en: Please {unclamp} the hose before starting the pump.
e.zh: 启动水泵前请先松开软管夹。

e.en: The technician had to {unclamp} the panel carefully.
e.zh: 技术员必须小心地解除面板的固定。

e.en: The contract's {unclarity} caused months of argument.
e.zh: 合同表述不清导致了数月争执。

e.en: There is still {unclarity} about who pays the fee.
e.zh: 关于谁来支付这笔费用仍然不清楚。

e.en: The archive keeps {unclassed} documents in a separate room.
e.zh: 档案馆把未分类的文件存放在单独房间。

e.en: Several runners finished as {unclassed} competitors.
e.zh: 几名跑者完赛后被列为无名次参赛者。

unclassical.t: 非古典的；不合古典规范的

e.en: The composer used an {unclassical} structure for the sonata.
e.zh: 作曲家为这首奏鸣曲采用了非古典的结构。

e.en: Critics disliked the statue's {unclassical} proportions.
e.zh: 评论家不喜欢这座雕像不合古典规范的比例。

e.en: My {uncle-in-law} helped us move into the apartment.
e.zh: 我的姻亲叔叔帮我们搬进了公寓。

e.en: She invited her {uncle-in-law} to the wedding dinner.
e.zh: 她邀请了配偶的叔伯参加婚宴。

uncatalogued.t: 未编入目录的；未登记的

e.en: The library found several {uncatalogued} manuscripts in storage.
e.zh: 图书馆在库房里发现了几份未编入目录的手稿。

e.en: Much of the archive remains {uncatalogued} and hard to search.
e.zh: 档案中还有许多资料未登记，检索起来很困难。

e.en: The {uncatalyzed} reaction proceeded very slowly at room temperature.
e.zh: 这个未被催化的反应在室温下进行得很慢。

e.en: Researchers compared catalyzed and {uncatalyzed} samples.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了催化样品和未催化样品。

e.en: The editor left the paragraph {uncate} despite its awkward ending.
e.zh: 尽管结尾别扭，编辑还是让这一段保持未删截状态。

e.en: A few {uncate} branches still hung over the path.
e.zh: 还有几根未剪掉的树枝悬在小路上方。

e.en: The folder contains hundreds of {uncategorized} photos.
e.zh: 这个文件夹里有数百张未分类的照片。

e.en: Please move each {uncategorized} item into the correct group.
e.zh: 请把每个未分类的项目移到正确的组里。

e.en: The essay describes an {uncentering} of traditional authority.
e.zh: 这篇文章描述了传统权威的去中心化。

e.en: Her sudden doubt was {uncentering} and difficult to ignore.
e.zh: 她突如其来的怀疑让人失去重心，难以忽视。

e.en: Only certificated teachers may supervise {uncertificated} assistants.
e.zh: 只有持证教师可以监督未获证书的助教。

e.en: The shares were issued in {uncertificated} electronic form.
e.zh: 这些股票以无纸质凭证的电子形式发行。

e.en: They promised to {unchain} the prisoner at dawn.
e.zh: 他们答应在黎明时解开囚犯的锁链。

e.en: The reform could {unchain} new energy in the market.
e.zh: 这项改革可能释放市场中的新活力。

e.en: The guard was {unchaining} the gate when we arrived.
e.zh: 我们到达时，守卫正在解开大门上的链条。

e.en: The policy is {unchaining} small firms from old restrictions.
e.zh: 这项政策正在把小企业从旧限制中解放出来。

e.en: The handler {unchains} the dog every morning.
e.zh: 训犬员每天早上都会解开狗的链子。

e.en: Good education {unchains} a child's imagination.
e.zh: 良好的教育能释放孩子的想象力。

e.en: The old bridge looked {unchancy} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，那座旧桥看起来危险难测。

e.en: He avoided the {unchancy} investment and kept his savings.
e.zh: 他避开了那笔靠不住的投资，保住了积蓄。

e.en: She remained {unchangeably} loyal to her old friends.
e.zh: 她对老朋友始终不变地忠诚。

e.en: The rule was applied {unchangeably} in every case.
e.zh: 这条规则在每个案例中都固定不变地适用。

e.en: The court agreed to {uncharge} him after new evidence appeared.
e.zh: 新证据出现后，法院同意撤销对他的指控。

e.en: The crew worked to {uncharge} the cargo before nightfall.
e.zh: 船员们赶在天黑前卸下货物。

e.en: There was clear {uncharity} in his remarks about the poor.
e.zh: 他谈到穷人时，话里明显带着刻薄。

e.en: She regretted the {uncharity} of her first judgment.
e.zh: 她后悔自己最初的判断太不仁慈。

e.en: The audience seemed {uncharmed} by his jokes.
e.zh: 观众似乎并没有被他的笑话逗乐。

e.en: She remained {uncharmed} by the luxury hotel.
e.zh: 面对那家豪华酒店，她依然不为所动。

e.en: His {uncharming} habit of interrupting annoyed everyone.
e.zh: 他爱打断别人这个讨人厌的习惯惹恼了大家。

e.en: The town looked rather {uncharming} in the rain.
e.zh: 雨中的小镇显得相当不迷人。

e.en: The novel was condemned for its {unchaste} scenes.
e.zh: 这部小说因其中不贞洁的场景而受到谴责。

e.en: Such {unchaste} thoughts troubled him deeply.
e.zh: 这些淫念让他深感不安。

e.en: The preacher accused them of living {unchastely}.
e.zh: 传教士指责他们生活不贞洁。

e.en: He wrote {unchastely} by the standards of his age.
e.zh: 按他那个时代的标准，他写得颇为淫荡。

e.en: The sermon warned against {unchasteness} in thought and deed.
e.zh: 布道告诫人们不要在思想和行为上不贞洁。

e.en: Critics saw {unchasteness} where modern readers see honesty.
e.zh: 批评者看到的是淫荡，而现代读者看到的是坦诚。

e.en: She was unfairly accused of {unchastity}.
e.zh: 她被不公正地指控为不贞。

e.en: The play treats {unchastity} as a social accusation.
e.zh: 这部戏把失贞视为一种社会指控。

unchivalrous.t: 无骑士风度的；不体面的

e.en: His {unchivalrous} joke embarrassed the guests.
e.zh: 他那个无骑士风度的笑话让客人们很尴尬。

e.en: It seemed {unchivalrous} to blame her in public.
e.zh: 当众责怪她显得很不体面。

e.en: The mechanic told us to {unchock} the wheels carefully.
e.zh: 机械师让我们小心移去车轮挡块。

e.en: Do not {unchock} the aircraft until the signal is given.
e.zh: 未收到信号前，不要移开飞机的轮挡。

e.en: A plumber came to {unchoke} the kitchen drain.
e.zh: 水管工来疏通厨房下水道。

e.en: The rescue team tried to {unchoke} the blocked airway.
e.zh: 救援队试图清除堵塞的气道。

e.en: They called his refusal to help {unchristian}.
e.zh: 他们说他拒绝帮忙不符合基督教精神。

e.en: Her tone was harsh and almost {unchristian}.
e.zh: 她的语气很严厉，几乎称得上不仁慈。

e.en: He spoke {unchristianly} of people who needed mercy.
e.zh: 他谈到需要怜悯的人时，语气很不合基督精神。

e.en: They behaved {unchristianly} toward the stranger.
e.zh: 他们对那个陌生人的行为不合基督教的仁爱精神。

e.en: The council voted to {unchurch} the rebellious minister.
e.zh: 委员会投票决定把那名反叛的牧师逐出教会。

e.en: Such doctrines could {unchurch} an entire congregation.
e.zh: 这样的教义可能使整个会众被剥夺教籍。

unclimbable.t: 无法攀登的；爬不上去的

e.en: The cliff looked {unclimbable} after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后，那面悬崖看起来根本爬不上去。

e.en: They called the icy wall {unclimbable}.
e.zh: 他们说那堵结冰的墙无法攀登。

e.en: She had to {unclinch} her fist slowly.
e.zh: 她不得不慢慢松开攥紧的拳头。

e.en: The mechanic tried to {unclinch} the bent clamp.
e.zh: 机修工试图松开那个弯曲的夹子。

e.en: The report helped {uncloak} the hidden scheme.
e.zh: 这份报告帮助揭露了那个隐秘计划。

e.en: At the door, he began to {uncloak}.
e.zh: 到了门口，他开始脱下斗篷。

e.en: The spy was finally {uncloaked} by the files.
e.zh: 那些文件最终揭露了这个间谍的身份。

e.en: The traveler stood {uncloaked} beside the fire.
e.zh: 旅人脱下斗篷，站在火旁。

e.en: The article is {uncloaking} years of corruption.
e.zh: 这篇文章正在揭露多年来的腐败。

e.en: His quiet {uncloaking} made the room stare.
e.zh: 他安静地脱下斗篷，让屋里的人都看了过来。

e.en: The investigation {uncloaks} a network of fraud.
e.zh: 这项调查揭露了一个诈骗网络。

e.en: She {uncloaks} before entering the hall.
e.zh: 她进大厅前脱下斗篷。

uncloister.t: 使走出隐居；解除修道院隔离

e.en: Travel helped {uncloister} his sheltered mind.
e.zh: 旅行帮助他摆脱封闭的见识。

e.en: The abbess agreed to {uncloister} the young novice.
e.zh: 女修道院院长同意让那名年轻见习修女离开院墙。

e.en: He tried to {unclose} the heavy gate.
e.zh: 他试着打开那扇沉重的大门。

e.en: The witness would not {unclose} the secret.
e.zh: 证人不愿揭开这个秘密。

e.en: The browser warned about an {unclosed} tag.
e.zh: 浏览器提示有一个未闭合的标签。

e.en: An {unclosed} door let in the cold air.
e.zh: 一扇没关上的门把冷空气放了进来。

e.en: The nurse helped {unclothe} the patient for surgery.
e.zh: 护士帮助病人为手术脱去衣服。

e.en: The scandal seemed to {unclothe} his ambition.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻似乎揭去了他野心的伪装。

e.en: She {unclothes} the child before the bath.
e.zh: 洗澡前她给孩子脱衣服。

e.en: The poem {unclothes} grief without sentimentality.
e.zh: 这首诗不煽情地揭示了悲伤。

e.en: The doctor asked about {unclothing} the injured arm.
e.zh: 医生询问是否可以脱掉受伤手臂上的衣物。

e.en: The essay is {unclothing} a polite lie.
e.zh: 这篇文章正在揭开一个体面的谎言。

unclubbable.t: 不合群的；不适合社交俱乐部的

e.en: His colleagues found him brilliant but {unclubbable}.
e.zh: 同事觉得他很聪明，但不太合群。

e.en: The old society rejected anyone deemed {unclubbable}.
e.zh: 那个旧社交圈排斥任何被认为不适合入会的人。

e.en: We need to {unclutter} the kitchen before guests arrive.
e.zh: 客人到来前，我们得把厨房的杂物清理一下。

e.en: The redesign will {unclutter} the app's main screen.
e.zh: 这次改版会让应用主屏幕更简洁。

e.en: It was an {unco} sight on the moor.
e.zh: 那是荒原上一幕奇怪的景象。

e.en: He was {unco} pleased with the bargain.
e.zh: 他对这笔交易高兴得很。

e.en: The sample remained {uncoagulated} after an hour.
e.zh: 一个小时后，样本仍然没有凝固。

e.en: {Uncoagulated} blood can indicate a clotting problem.
e.zh: 血液未凝固可能说明凝血功能有问题。

uncock.t: 放下击锤；解除待发状态

e.en: He carefully {uncocked} the old pistol.
e.zh: 他小心地放下那把旧手枪的击锤。

e.en: Always {uncock} the trap before cleaning it.
e.zh: 清理陷阱前一定要解除它的待发状态。

e.en: The archive still contains some {uncoded} survey answers.
e.zh: 档案里仍有一些未编码的问卷答案。

e.en: They sent the message in {uncoded} form.
e.zh: 他们以未加密的形式发送了这条消息。

e.en: The court ordered them to {uncoffin} the remains.
e.zh: 法院命令他们将遗骸从棺中取出。

e.en: The villagers refused to {uncoffin} the buried saint.
e.zh: 村民拒绝打开棺木取出那位圣人的遗体。

uncoffined.t: 未入棺的；从棺中取出的

e.en: The {uncoffined} body lay under a white sheet.
e.zh: 那具未入棺的遗体盖在白布下。

e.en: The relics were {uncoffined} for examination.
e.zh: 这些遗物被从棺中取出接受检查。

uncoined.t: 未铸成钱币的；尚未创造的

e.en: The museum displayed {uncoined} silver from the mine.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了矿中开采但尚未铸币的银子。

e.en: The feeling seemed to need an {uncoined} word.
e.zh: 这种感受似乎需要一个尚未创造出来的词来表达。

e.en: He spoke in an {uncolike} old dialect.
e.zh: 他说话带着一种奇特的古老方言味。

e.en: Her {uncolike} manner amused the guests.
e.zh: 她那种怪里怪气的举止逗乐了客人。

uncollided.t: 未碰撞的；未发生碰撞的

e.en: The simulation tracked every {uncollided} particle.
e.zh: 模拟程序跟踪了每个尚未碰撞的粒子。

e.en: Two {uncollided} beams passed through the chamber.
e.zh: 两束未发生碰撞的光束穿过了腔室。

uncollimated.t: 未准直的；未校准成平行的

e.en: The detector received an {uncollimated} beam.
e.zh: 探测器接收到一束未准直的射线。

e.en: {Uncollimated} light spreads quickly over distance.
e.zh: 未准直的光会随着距离迅速发散。

e.en: The data remained {uncombined} after the import.
e.zh: 导入后，这些数据仍未合并。

e.en: Chemists measured the amount of {uncombined} oxygen.
e.zh: 化学家测量了未结合氧的含量。

e.en: The old records were {uncome-at-able} without permission from the archive.
e.zh: 没有档案馆许可，那些旧记录很难查到。

e.en: His private feelings remained {uncome-at-able} even to close friends.
e.zh: 即使对亲近的朋友，他的内心感受也难以触及。

e.en: The critic noted the building's deliberate {uncomeliness}.
e.zh: 评论家指出这栋建筑有意呈现出不美感。

e.en: She feared the {uncomeliness} of the scar more than the pain.
e.zh: 比起疼痛，她更担心伤疤难看的样子。

e.en: The repairs left an {uncomely} patch on the wall.
e.zh: 修补后墙上留下了一块难看的痕迹。

e.en: Such anger was considered {uncomely} at a formal dinner.
e.zh: 在正式晚宴上，这样发怒被认为不得体。

uncomforting.t: 不能安慰人的；令人不安的

e.en: The doctor's silence was deeply {uncomforting}.
e.zh: 医生的沉默让人很不安心。

e.en: She offered an {uncomforting} smile before giving the bad news.
e.zh: 宣布坏消息前，她露出一个并不让人安心的微笑。

e.en: His motives were honest, but his methods were {uncommendable}.
e.zh: 他的动机是诚实的，但做法并不值得称赞。

e.en: Leaving the team without warning was hardly {uncommendable} behavior.
e.zh: 不打招呼就离开团队，实在不是什么值得称道的行为。

e.en: Grief can feel {uncommunicable} to those who have never shared it.
e.zh: 对从未有过相同经历的人，悲痛有时像是无法传达的。

e.en: The condition is serious but {uncommunicable}.
e.zh: 这种病情很严重，但不会传染。

e.en: Rain quickly softened the {uncompacted} soil near the path.
e.zh: 雨水很快把小路旁未压实的土壤泡软了。

e.en: The files remained {uncompacted} to preserve their original quality.
e.zh: 这些文件保持未压缩状态，以保留原始质量。

e.en: He became quiet and {uncompanionable} during the long winter.
e.zh: 漫长的冬天里，他变得沉默而不合群。

e.en: The hotel lobby felt strangely {uncompanionable} despite the crowd.
e.zh: 尽管人很多，酒店大堂却奇怪地让人觉得难以亲近。

uncomparable.t: 不可比较的；无可比拟的

e.en: The two studies are {uncomparable} because they measured different outcomes.
e.zh: 这两项研究衡量的结果不同，因此无法比较。

e.en: To her, the singer's voice was {uncomparable}.
e.zh: 在她看来，那位歌手的嗓音无可比拟。

e.en: The policy seemed {uncompassionate} toward families in crisis.
e.zh: 这项政策对陷入危机的家庭显得缺乏同情心。

e.en: He regretted his {uncompassionate} reply to her request for help.
e.zh: 他后悔自己对她求助时作出了冷漠无情的回应。

e.en: She gave years of {uncomplaining} service to the school.
e.zh: 她多年为学校服务，从不抱怨。

e.en: The nurses remained {uncomplaining} through the exhausting night shift.
e.zh: 护士们熬过疲惫的夜班，始终毫无怨言。

e.en: The machine has an {uncomplex} design that is easy to repair.
e.zh: 这台机器设计简单，维修起来很方便。

e.en: He preferred an {uncomplex} answer to a clever theory.
e.zh: 比起巧妙的理论，他更喜欢简单明了的答案。

e.en: The company faced penalties for remaining {uncomplying} after repeated warnings.
e.zh: 多次警告后公司仍不合规，因此面临处罚。

e.en: An {uncomplying} witness refused to answer the judge's questions.
e.zh: 一名不配合的证人拒绝回答法官的问题。

e.en: Her warning went {uncomprehended} until the disaster happened.
e.zh: 直到灾难发生，她的警告才被人明白。

e.en: The poem remained largely {uncomprehended} by its first readers.
e.zh: 这首诗最初的读者大多没有理解。

e.en: He stared at the form in complete {uncomprehension}.
e.zh: 他完全看不懂那张表，只是茫然地盯着。

e.en: Her {uncomprehension} of the joke made everyone laugh harder.
e.zh: 她没听懂那个笑话，反而让大家笑得更厉害。

e.en: The program {uncompresses} the archive before installing the files.
e.zh: 程序会先解压压缩包，然后再安装文件。

e.en: When the spring is released, it {uncompresses} and pushes the plate upward.
e.zh: 弹簧被释放时会伸展开，把板子向上推。

uncompromisable.t: 不可妥协的；不能让步的

e.en: For her, patient safety was an {uncompromisable} principle.
e.zh: 对她来说，患者安全是不可妥协的原则。

e.en: The border issue proved {uncompromisable} during the talks.
e.zh: 谈判中，边界问题被证明无法让步。

unconceivable.t: 难以想象的；不可思议的

e.en: Such a delay was almost {unconceivable} in a modern hospital.
e.zh: 在现代医院里，这样的延误几乎难以想象。

e.en: It seemed {unconceivable} that he would betray his closest friend.
e.zh: 他会背叛最亲近的朋友，这似乎不可思议。

uncondemned.t: 未受谴责的；未被定罪的

e.en: The attack should not pass {uncondemned} by local leaders.
e.zh: 地方领导人不应让这次袭击不受谴责。

e.en: Several suspects remained {uncondemned} because the evidence was weak.
e.zh: 由于证据薄弱，几名嫌疑人仍未被定罪。

uncondensable.t: 不能冷凝的；不可浓缩的

e.en: Engineers removed {uncondensable} gases from the cooling system.
e.zh: 工程师从冷却系统中清除了不能冷凝的气体。

e.en: Some emotions feel {uncondensable} into a single sentence.
e.zh: 有些情绪似乎无法浓缩成一句话。

uncondescending.t: 不居高临下的；不屈尊的

e.en: Her advice was direct but {uncondescending}.
e.zh: 她的建议很直接，却没有居高临下的口气。

e.en: The teacher maintained an {uncondescending} tone with every student.
e.zh: 这位老师对每个学生都保持不摆架子的语气。

e.en: The noisy room was {unconducive} to serious study.
e.zh: 这个吵闹的房间不利于认真学习。

e.en: Constant pressure is {unconducive} to creative work.
e.zh: 持续的压力无助于创造性工作。

e.en: The {unconfessed} mistake troubled him for years.
e.zh: 那个未坦白的错误困扰了他多年。

e.en: Her {unconfessed} admiration for him shaped many of her choices.
e.zh: 她对他未曾承认的仰慕影响了许多选择。

e.en: He sounded {unconfident} during the interview.
e.zh: 面试时他听起来不太自信。

e.en: Many new drivers feel {unconfident} on busy roads.
e.zh: 许多新手司机在繁忙道路上会觉得没把握。

unconfiding.t: 不轻信人的；不吐露心事的

e.en: After the betrayal, she became quiet and {unconfiding}.
e.zh: 遭到背叛后，她变得沉默，不再吐露心事。

e.en: His {unconfiding} nature made teamwork difficult.
e.zh: 他不轻易信任别人的性格让团队合作变得困难。

unconformable.t: 不一致的；不相容的；不整合的

e.en: The new policy was {unconformable} to existing law.
e.zh: 这项新政策与现行法律不一致。

e.en: The two rock layers are {unconformable} at this boundary.
e.zh: 这两层岩石在这个界面处不整合。

unconformably.t: 不一致地；不相容地；不整合地

e.en: He acted {unconformably} with the agreed rules.
e.zh: 他的做法与商定规则不一致。

e.en: The strata lie {unconformably} above the older rocks.
e.zh: 这些地层不整合地覆在较老岩石之上。

unconformity.t: 不一致；不遵从；地层不整合

e.en: Her quiet {unconformity} annoyed the committee.
e.zh: 她沉默的不遵从让委员会很恼火。

e.en: Geologists found an {unconformity} between the two formations.
e.zh: 地质学家发现两个岩层之间有不整合面。

e.en: Warm sunlight began to {uncongeal} the wax.
e.zh: 温暖的阳光开始让蜡融化。

e.en: The sauce will {uncongeal} if you heat it gently.
e.zh: 轻轻加热后，酱汁会不再凝固。

uncongeniality.t: 不合意；不投缘；环境不适宜

e.en: The {uncongeniality} of the office drained her energy.
e.zh: 办公室环境的不合意耗尽了她的精力。

e.en: Their mutual {uncongeniality} made dinner painfully silent.
e.zh: 他们彼此不投缘，使晚餐沉默得令人难受。

e.en: The chart lists each {unconjugated} verb first.
e.zh: 表格先列出每个未变位的动词。

e.en: Doctors measured the level of {unconjugated} bilirubin.
e.zh: 医生测量了未结合胆红素的水平。

unconscionability.t: 极不公平；昧良心；不合情理

e.en: The court examined the contract's {unconscionability}.
e.zh: 法院审查了这份合同是否极不公平。

e.en: She was shocked by the {unconscionability} of the fee.
e.zh: 这笔费用的不合情理让她很震惊。

unconsecrated.t: 未祝圣的；未奉献给神的

e.en: They buried him in {unconsecrated} ground.
e.zh: 他们把他葬在未祝圣的土地上。

e.en: The old chapel contained several {unconsecrated} objects.
e.zh: 那座旧礼拜堂里有几件未奉献给神的物品。

e.en: His {unconsidering} reply hurt her deeply.
e.zh: 他那句欠考虑的回答深深伤了她。

e.en: The crowd was loud and {unconsidering} of the patients.
e.zh: 人群很吵，完全不体谅病人。

unconsious.t: 无意识的；失去知觉的（拼写变体）

e.en: The injured driver lay {unconsious} beside the road.
e.zh: 受伤的司机失去知觉，躺在路边。

e.en: Her {unconsious} habits shaped the conversation.
e.zh: 她无意识的习惯影响了这场谈话。

unconspicuous.t: 不显眼的；不引人注意的

e.en: The camera was hidden in an {unconspicuous} corner.
e.zh: 摄像头藏在一个不显眼的角落里。

e.en: She chose an {unconspicuous} dress for the meeting.
e.zh: 她为会议选了一条不引人注意的裙子。

unconstant.t: 多变的；不忠实的；不稳定的

e.en: The {unconstant} wind made sailing difficult.
e.zh: 多变的风让航行变得困难。

e.en: He feared her {unconstant} affection would soon fade.
e.zh: 他担心她不稳定的感情很快会消退。

e.en: Children played with complete {unconstraint} in the garden.
e.zh: 孩子们在花园里毫无拘束地玩耍。

e.en: His speech had the {unconstraint} of a private letter.
e.zh: 他的演讲带着私人信件般的自在感。

e.en: Several {unconstructed} roads still appear on the map.
e.zh: 地图上仍显示着几条尚未建成的道路。

e.en: The theory remained {unconstructed} after years of notes.
e.zh: 多年笔记之后，这套理论仍未构建成形。

unconstructive.t: 无建设性的；没有帮助的

e.en: His {unconstructive} criticism delayed the project.
e.zh: 他那些无建设性的批评拖慢了项目。

e.en: Arguing over blame was {unconstructive} at that moment.
e.zh: 那一刻争论责任归属并没有帮助。

unconsumed.t: 未消耗的；未吃完的；未烧尽的

e.en: The {unconsumed} food was packed for later.
e.zh: 没吃完的食物被打包留到之后。

e.en: Some {unconsumed} fuel remained after the test.
e.zh: 测试结束后仍有一些燃料未被消耗。

uncontemplated.t: 未曾考虑的；意料之外的

e.en: The agreement created {uncontemplated} tax problems.
e.zh: 这项协议造成了未曾考虑到的税务问题。

e.en: An {uncontemplated} delay forced them to change plans.
e.zh: 一场意料之外的延误迫使他们改变计划。

uncontradictable.t: 无法反驳的；不可否认的

e.en: She presented {uncontradictable} evidence at the hearing.
e.zh: 她在听证会上提出了无法反驳的证据。

e.en: His authority seemed {uncontradictable} to the younger staff.
e.zh: 在年轻员工看来，他的权威似乎不可质疑。

e.en: Her account remained {uncontradicted} by any witness.
e.zh: 没有任何证人反驳她的说法。

e.en: The {uncontradicted} facts supported the judge's decision.
e.zh: 这些无异议的事实支持了法官的判决。

uncontrived.t: 自然的；不做作的；非刻意安排的

e.en: Her smile looked warm and {uncontrived}.
e.zh: 她的笑容显得温暖而自然。

e.en: The film's humor feels {uncontrived} and honest.
e.zh: 这部电影的幽默自然真诚，并不做作。

e.en: The storm's {uncontrollability} frightened the sailors.
e.zh: 风暴的不可控制性让水手们感到害怕。

e.en: Therapists discussed the child's feelings of {uncontrollability}.
e.zh: 治疗师讨论了这个孩子那种难以自控的感受。

e.en: The report's main conclusion was {uncontroverted}.
e.zh: 报告的主要结论没有争议。

e.en: The witness gave {uncontroverted} testimony about the accident.
e.zh: 证人就事故作出了未被驳斥的证词。

e.en: The video provided {uncontrovertible} proof of the error.
e.zh: 视频提供了这个错误的确凿证据。

e.en: It is {uncontrovertible} that the deadline was missed.
e.zh: 错过截止日期这一点无可争辩。

e.en: The company faced {unconvenanted} obligations after the merger.
e.zh: 合并后，公司面临一些契约外的义务。

e.en: They described mercy as an {unconvenanted} gift.
e.zh: 他们把怜悯称为一种未立约的恩赐。

unconvertible.t: 不可转换的；不能兑换的

e.en: The old file format is {unconvertible} by this software.
e.zh: 这个软件无法转换那种旧文件格式。

e.en: The notes were {unconvertible} into gold after the crisis.
e.zh: 危机之后，这些票据不能再兑换成黄金。

e.en: The weak evidence did not {unconvince} the jury.
e.zh: 薄弱的证据并没有让陪审团不再相信原来的判断。

e.en: No argument could {unconvince} her once she had decided.
e.zh: 她一旦决定了，任何论点都无法使她改变信念。

e.en: It was {uncool} to laugh at his mistake.
e.zh: 嘲笑他的错误很不合适。

e.en: That jacket looked deliberately {uncool} and old-fashioned.
e.zh: 那件夹克看起来故意显得不酷又老派。

e.en: The contract promised {uncoonditional} support, despite the spelling error.
e.zh: 合同里写着无条件支持，尽管这个词拼错了。

e.en: She meant {uncoonditional} love when she wrote the note.
e.zh: 她写那张便条时想表达的是无条件的爱。

e.en: The team's {uncoordinted} response caused more confusion.
e.zh: 团队不协调的回应造成了更多混乱。

e.en: His movements seemed {uncoordinted} after the long illness.
e.zh: 久病之后，他的动作显得不太协调。

e.en: The old wall remained {uncoped} after the repairs.
e.zh: 修缮后，那堵旧墙仍没有加压顶石。

e.en: She left the stress {uncoped} and grew exhausted.
e.zh: 她一直没有处理压力，后来变得筋疲力尽。

uncopiable.t: 无法复制的；不可抄袭的

e.en: The file was marked {uncopiable} by the software.
e.zh: 软件把这个文件标记为无法复制。

e.en: Her style is nearly {uncopiable} because it feels so personal.
e.zh: 她的风格非常个人化，几乎无法被模仿。

e.en: Please {uncord} the package before opening it.
e.zh: 打开包裹前请先解开绳子。

e.en: The worker began to {uncord} the stacked timber.
e.zh: 工人开始解开捆着木材的绳索。

e.en: Their meeting was brief and {uncordial}.
e.zh: 他们的会面短暂而不友好。

e.en: The letter sounded formal but oddly {uncordial}.
e.zh: 那封信听起来很正式，却奇怪地缺少热情。

e.en: The answer was {uncorrect}, but the method was close.
e.zh: 答案不正确，但方法已经接近了。

e.en: Several mistakes remained {uncorrect} in the final draft.
e.zh: 终稿里仍有几处错误没有改正。

uncorrectably.t: 无法改正地；无可纠正地

e.en: The data was {uncorrectably} damaged by the crash.
e.zh: 数据因崩溃而损坏到无法修复的程度。

e.en: He behaved {uncorrectably} rudely at every dinner.
e.zh: 他每次晚餐上的举止都粗鲁得无可纠正。

e.en: An {uncorrecting} editor lets small errors survive.
e.zh: 不愿纠错的编辑会让小错误保留下来。

e.en: The lens was {uncorrecting} and produced distorted images.
e.zh: 这个镜头没有校正效果，拍出的图像会变形。

e.en: The pipe was surprisingly {uncorroded} after decades underground.
e.zh: 这根管子埋在地下几十年后竟然没有被腐蚀。

e.en: They found an {uncorroded} coin inside the dry box.
e.zh: 他们在干燥的盒子里发现了一枚未锈蚀的硬币。

e.en: The judge was known as an {uncorrupt} public servant.
e.zh: 这位法官以正直廉洁的公仆形象闻名。

e.en: The archive kept an {uncorrupt} copy of the file.
e.zh: 档案库保存了一份未损坏的文件副本。

uncorruptible.t: 不能腐蚀的；廉洁不受贿的

e.en: She had an {uncorruptible} sense of duty.
e.zh: 她有一种不可动摇的责任感，绝不徇私。

e.en: The hero was portrayed as brave and {uncorruptible}.
e.zh: 这位英雄被描写成勇敢且廉洁不受诱惑的人。

e.en: She preferred loose, {uncorseted} dresses in summer.
e.zh: 夏天她更喜欢宽松、不束胸的裙子。

e.en: His prose felt {uncorseted} by academic convention.
e.zh: 他的散文感觉不受学院规范的束缚。

e.en: The noun is used {uncountably} in this sentence.
e.zh: 这个名词在这个句子中作不可数用法。

e.en: Stars seemed to stretch {uncountably} across the sky.
e.zh: 星星仿佛无数地铺满天空。

uncoursed.t: 未分层排列的；未流经的

e.en: The cottage had rough {uncoursed} stone walls.
e.zh: 那间小屋有粗糙的未分层石墙。

e.en: The dry valley lay {uncoursed} by any stream.
e.zh: 干涸的山谷没有任何溪流经过。

e.en: His {uncourteous} reply offended the host.
e.zh: 他不礼貌的回答冒犯了主人。

e.en: It is {uncourteous} to interrupt every speaker.
e.zh: 打断每一位发言者是很粗鲁的。

e.en: His {uncourtliness} shocked the visiting nobles.
e.zh: 他的不文雅举止让来访的贵族感到震惊。

e.en: The comedy mocked the {uncourtliness} of rural manners.
e.zh: 这部喜剧嘲弄了乡村礼仪中缺乏雅致的一面。

uncovenanted.t: 无契约约束的；未立约的

e.en: They received an {uncovenanted} bonus at year end.
e.zh: 年底他们得到了一笔合同之外的奖金。

e.en: The land was {uncovenanted} and free of old promises.
e.zh: 这片土地没有契约约束，也没有旧承诺牵连。

e.en: The {uncovery} of the fraud took months.
e.zh: 揭露这起欺诈花了好几个月。

e.en: Her research led to the {uncovery} of new evidence.
e.zh: 她的研究促成了新证据的发现。

e.en: The monk stood {uncowled} in the rain.
e.zh: 那名修士没有戴兜帽，站在雨中。

e.en: An {uncowled} engine looked raw and unfinished.
e.zh: 没有罩壳的发动机看起来粗糙而未完成。

e.en: The vase remained {uncracked} after the fall.
e.zh: 花瓶摔下后仍然没有裂开。

e.en: The code stayed {uncracked} for several years.
e.zh: 这套密码好几年都没有被破解。

e.en: Workers will {uncrate} the sculpture tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 工人们明天早上会把雕塑从板条箱中取出。

e.en: We had to {uncrate} the machine before inspection.
e.zh: 检查前我们必须先把机器从木箱里拆出来。

e.en: He wore an {uncreased} white shirt to the interview.
e.zh: 他穿着一件没有折痕的白衬衫去面试。

e.en: The letter arrived clean and {uncreased}.
e.zh: 那封信送到时很干净，也没有被弄皱。

e.en: The novelist tried to {uncreate} the world she had built.
e.zh: 那位小说家试图抹去自己构建的世界。

e.en: No apology can {uncreate} the harm already done.
e.zh: 任何道歉都无法让已经造成的伤害消失。

e.en: The scholar described the dialect as largely {uncreolized}.
e.zh: 那位学者把这种方言描述为基本未克里奥尔化。

e.en: Some formal speech remained {uncreolized} in the colony.
e.zh: 殖民地里一些正式言语仍未发生克里奥尔化。

e.en: The proposal passed through the meeting {uncriticized}.
e.zh: 这项提案在会上没有受到批评就通过了。

e.en: Her early work remained strangely {uncriticized} for years.
e.zh: 她早期的作品多年来奇怪地未受评论界批评。

e.en: Please send the {uncropped} photo for printing.
e.zh: 请把未裁剪的照片发来用于打印。

e.en: The editor preferred an {uncropped} version of the interview.
e.zh: 编辑更喜欢这段采访未经删节的版本。

uncross.t: 解开交叉；放下交叉姿势

e.en: She had to {uncross} her legs before standing.
e.zh: 她站起来前必须先把交叉的双腿放开。

e.en: He paused to {uncross} the wires behind the desk.
e.zh: 他停下来把桌后交错的电线理开。

uncrosses.t: 解开交叉；放开交叉姿势

e.en: He {uncrosses} his arms when the discussion softens.
e.zh: 讨论缓和下来时，他放开了交叉的双臂。

e.en: The technician {uncrosses} the cables before testing them.
e.zh: 技术员在测试前先把缠交的线缆理开。

uncrossing.t: 解开交叉；放开交叉的动作

e.en: She smiled while {uncrossing} her arms.
e.zh: 她一边放开交叉的双臂，一边笑了。

e.en: The careful {uncrossing} of wires took several minutes.
e.zh: 小心理开交错电线花了好几分钟。

e.en: The rebels hoped to {uncrown} the young king.
e.zh: 叛军希望废黜那位年轻国王。

e.en: A scandal can {uncrown} even a celebrated champion.
e.zh: 一桩丑闻甚至可能让知名冠军失去荣耀。

e.en: He tried to {uncrumple} the receipt on the counter.
e.zh: 他试着在柜台上把皱巴巴的收据抚平。

e.en: A warm iron can {uncrumple} the linen quickly.
e.zh: 热熨斗能很快把亚麻布的皱褶熨平。

e.en: She handed me an {uncrumpled} copy of the letter.
e.zh: 她递给我一份已经抚平的信件副本。

e.en: His shirt looked freshly {uncrumpled} after ironing.
e.zh: 他的衬衫熨过后看起来刚刚被熨平。

e.en: The glasses came in an {uncrushable} case.
e.zh: 这些眼镜装在一个压不坏的盒子里。

e.en: She showed an {uncrushable} confidence under pressure.
e.zh: 她在压力下表现出不可摧毁的自信。

e.en: The mineral had an {uncrystalline} texture under the lens.
e.zh: 在镜头下，这种矿物呈现出非晶体质地。

e.en: The poet wanted a dull, {uncrystalline} light.
e.zh: 诗人想要一种暗淡而不晶莹的光。

e.en: The syrup stayed {uncrystallized} after cooling.
e.zh: 糖浆冷却后仍然没有结晶。

e.en: Their plans remained {uncrystallized} until spring.
e.zh: 他们的计划直到春天仍未明确成形。

e.en: His {unctuosity} made the apology sound false.
e.zh: 他的油滑让这番道歉听起来很虚假。

e.en: The waiter served us with unbearable {unctuosity}.
e.zh: 那个服务员用令人难受的殷勤油滑招待我们。

e.en: The essay attacked the {unculture} of the ruling class.
e.zh: 这篇文章抨击统治阶层的无文化状态。

e.en: He feared that noise and haste bred {unculture}.
e.zh: 他担心喧嚣和匆忙会滋生粗野无教养。

e.en: She traveled {uncumbered} by heavy luggage.
e.zh: 她旅行时没有沉重行李拖累。

e.en: The team worked {uncumbered} by old procedures.
e.zh: 团队工作时不再受旧流程束缚。

e.en: The doctor called the infection {uncurable}.
e.zh: 医生说这种感染无法治愈。

e.en: He had an {uncurable} habit of interrupting people.
e.zh: 他有个改不了的毛病，总爱打断别人。

e.en: The child had an {uncurbable} urge to laugh.
e.zh: 那个孩子有一种忍不住想笑的冲动。

e.en: Inflation seemed {uncurbable} without stricter policy.
e.zh: 如果没有更严格的政策，通胀似乎难以遏制。

uncurbed.t: 未受控制的；未装路缘的

e.en: His {uncurbed} anger frightened the room.
e.zh: 他不受控制的怒气吓到了屋里的人。

e.en: The road remained {uncurbed} along the field.
e.zh: 田边那段道路仍然没有铺设路缘石。

e.en: The scan showed pressure near the {uncus}.
e.zh: 扫描显示钩状部附近有受压迹象。

e.en: A small {uncus} can appear on some anatomical structures.
e.zh: 某些解剖结构上可能出现小的钩形突起。

e.en: He was {uncustomed} to such direct criticism.
e.zh: 他不习惯这种直接的批评。

e.en: The village kept an {uncustomed} silence that morning.
e.zh: 那天早上，村子里出现了不同寻常的寂静。

e.en: The rope was advertised as nearly {uncuttable}.
e.zh: 这种绳子被宣传为几乎割不断。

e.en: The director called the scene {uncuttable}.
e.zh: 导演说这个场景不能删。

uncynical.t: 不愤世嫉俗的；不犬儒的

e.en: Her {uncynical} hope surprised the older reporters.
e.zh: 她那种不犬儒的希望让年长记者感到意外。

e.en: The film offers an {uncynical} view of politics.
e.zh: 这部电影对政治呈现出一种不愤世嫉俗的看法。

undam.t: 拆除水坝；使不再受坝阻挡

e.en: The engineers decided to {undam} the river after years of flooding.
e.zh: 多年洪水之后，工程师决定拆除河上的水坝。

e.en: Activists want to {undam} the valley and restore the salmon run.
e.zh: 活动人士希望拆坝放开山谷，让鲑鱼洄游恢复。

e.en: The instrument detected an {undamped} vibration in the bridge.
e.zh: 仪器检测到桥梁中一种未受阻尼的振动。

e.en: Her enthusiasm remained {undamped} despite the repeated delays.
e.zh: 尽管一再延误，她的热情仍未减弱。

e.en: The dancer's slow {undation} made the movement look fluid.
e.zh: 舞者缓慢的起伏让动作显得很流畅。

e.en: Scientists recorded the {undation} of the sea floor during the quake.
e.zh: 科学家记录了地震期间海底的波状起伏。

e.en: The core sample contained a thin layer of {undaturbidite}.
e.zh: 岩芯样本中含有一层薄薄的波状浊积岩。

e.en: Geologists used the {undaturbidite} to reconstruct ancient underwater currents.
e.zh: 地质学家利用这种波状浊积岩重建古代水下洋流。

e.en: Her {undauntable} spirit carried the team through the crisis.
e.zh: 她不可吓倒的精神带领团队渡过了危机。

e.en: The climbers seemed {undauntable} even in the storm.
e.zh: 即使在暴风雪中，登山者们也显得无所畏惧。

e.en: The evidence made his guilt {undebatable}.
e.zh: 这些证据使他的罪责变得无可争辩。

e.en: It is {undebatable} that the policy changed the market.
e.zh: 这项政策改变了市场，这是无可争辩的。

e.en: The tile was shaped like an {undecagon} with eleven sides.
e.zh: 这块瓷砖呈十一边形，有十一条边。

e.en: She drew an {undecagon} for the geometry assignment.
e.zh: 她为几何作业画了一个十一边形。

e.en: The perfume contains {undecalactone} for a creamy peach note.
e.zh: 这款香水含有十一内酯，带来柔和的桃香。

e.en: Food chemists measured {undecalactone} in the ripe fruit.
e.zh: 食品化学家测量了成熟水果中的十一内酯含量。

e.en: The lab identified {undecanal} in the citrus oil sample.
e.zh: 实验室在柑橘油样本中鉴定出十一醛。

e.en: Perfumers use {undecanal} to add a waxy floral tone.
e.zh: 调香师用十一醛增加一种蜡感花香。

e.en: The fuel mixture included a small amount of {undecane}.
e.zh: 这种燃料混合物中含有少量十一烷。

e.en: Students learned that {undecane} has eleven carbon atoms.
e.zh: 学生们了解到十一烷含有十一个碳原子。

e.en: The synthesis produced {undecanonitrile} as a clear liquid.
e.zh: 这次合成产生了透明液体状的十一腈。

e.en: Researchers tested {undecanonitrile} as a fragrance intermediate.
e.zh: 研究人员测试十一腈作为香料中间体的用途。

e.en: The hormone fragment is an {undecapeptide} with eleven amino acids.
e.zh: 这种激素片段是一种含有十一个氨基酸的十一肽。

e.en: They synthesized an {undecapeptide} for the receptor study.
e.zh: 他们为受体研究合成了一种十一肽。

e.en: The report helped {undeceive} investors about the company's finances.
e.zh: 这份报告帮助投资者看清公司的财务状况，不再受骗。

e.en: I had to {undeceive} him about the rumor.
e.zh: 我不得不让他明白那个传闻并不是真的。

e.en: Once {undeceived}, she refused to support the scheme.
e.zh: 一旦醒悟过来，她就拒绝支持这个计划。

e.en: He left the meeting {undeceived} by their polished promises.
e.zh: 他离开会议时并没有被他们漂亮的承诺蒙骗。

e.en: A careful audit {undeceives} anyone who trusts those figures.
e.zh: 一次细致审计会让任何相信那些数字的人醒悟。

e.en: Time often {undeceives} people about easy success.
e.zh: 时间常常让人们不再相信轻易成功的幻觉。

e.en: Her {undeceiving} explanation ended the family's confusion.
e.zh: 她那番使人醒悟的解释终结了家人的困惑。

e.en: The lawyer spent months {undeceiving} clients about the false investment.
e.zh: 律师花了数月让客户看清那项虚假投资。

e.en: The game jokingly awarded him an {undecillion} points.
e.zh: 游戏开玩笑地给了他十一亿兆分。

e.en: An {undecillion} is far beyond ordinary counting.
e.zh: 十一亿兆这个数远远超出日常计数范围。

e.en: The manuscript's {undecipherability} frustrated every historian who studied it.
e.zh: 这份手稿难以辨认，让研究它的每位历史学家都很沮丧。

e.en: Encryption increases the {undecipherability} of sensitive messages.
e.zh: 加密会提高敏感信息的无法破译性。

e.en: The small {undecked} boat was used near the shore.
e.zh: 这艘无甲板小船用于近岸活动。

e.en: The hall stood {undecked} after the festival banners were removed.
e.zh: 节日横幅撤下后，大厅显得未加装饰。

e.en: In this exercise, the noun remains {undeclined}.
e.zh: 在这道练习中，这个名词保持未变格形式。

e.en: Sales were {undeclined} despite the gloomy forecast.
e.zh: 尽管预测悲观，销售额并未下降。

undecomposable.t: 不可分解的；不能分解的

e.en: The chemist described the residue as {undecomposable} under mild heat.
e.zh: 化学家称这种残渣在低温加热下不可分解。

e.en: Some theories treat consciousness as an {undecomposable} feature of mind.
e.zh: 有些理论把意识视为心灵中不可分解的特征。

e.en: Small shops often {under-price} handmade goods to attract buyers.
e.zh: 小店常把手工商品定价过低来吸引买家。

e.en: Do not {under-price} your work just to win the contract.
e.zh: 不要为了拿到合同就低估自己工作的价值。

e.en: Critics tend to {under-rate} her early novels.
e.zh: 评论家往往低估她早期小说的价值。

e.en: Managers should not {under-rate} quiet employees.
e.zh: 管理者不应低估沉默寡言的员工。

under-rehearsed.t: 排练不足的；准备不充分的

e.en: The band sounded {under-rehearsed} during the opening song.
e.zh: 乐队在开场曲中听起来排练不足。

e.en: Her speech felt {under-rehearsed} but honest.
e.zh: 她的演讲显得准备不充分，但很真诚。

e.en: Some companies {under-report} workplace injuries.
e.zh: 有些公司少报工作场所的伤害事故。

e.en: Surveys may {under-report} illegal income.
e.zh: 调查可能会低报非法收入。

e.en: The study {under-reports} the number of temporary workers.
e.zh: 这项研究少报了临时工的人数。

e.en: He {under-reports} his earnings every year.
e.zh: 他每年都少报自己的收入。

e.en: The chart is {under-representing} rural voters.
e.zh: 这张图没有充分体现农村选民的情况。

e.en: By ignoring part-time staff, the report is {under-representing} women.
e.zh: 报告忽略兼职员工，因此低估了女性的比例。

e.en: Several {under-secretaries} attended the emergency meeting.
e.zh: 几位副部长参加了这次紧急会议。

e.en: The {under-secretaries} briefed the minister before the vote.
e.zh: 投票前，几名次长向部长作了简报。

e.en: The {under-secretary} announced new trade measures.
e.zh: 副部长宣布了新的贸易措施。

e.en: She served as {under-secretary} for education.
e.zh: 她曾担任教育部次长。

e.en: Check the {under-side} of the table for screws.
e.zh: 检查桌子的底面有没有螺丝。

e.en: The insect has bright markings on its {under-side}.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的下侧有鲜艳的斑纹。

e.en: I do not {understand} this question.
e.zh: 我不明白这个问题。

e.en: She can {understand} spoken English well.
e.zh: 她能很好地听懂英语口语。

e.en: The race has a category for {under-tens}.
e.zh: 这场比赛设有十岁以下儿童组。

e.en: Tickets are cheaper for {under-tens} at the museum.
e.zh: 博物馆给十岁以下儿童提供更便宜的门票。

under-the-counter.t: 私下出售的；暗中交易的

e.en: They sold imported cigarettes {under-the-counter}.
e.zh: 他们私下出售进口香烟。

e.en: The shop kept {under-the-counter} medicine for regular customers.
e.zh: 这家店给老顾客留着私下出售的药品。

e.en: He was paid {under-the-table} in cash.
e.zh: 他拿的是私下支付的现金。

e.en: The deal included an {under-the-table} payment.
e.zh: 这笔交易包含一笔暗中的非法付款。

e.en: Many schools {under-utilize} their computer labs.
e.zh: 许多学校没有充分利用电脑教室。

e.en: Do not {under-utilize} the skills of older workers.
e.zh: 不要低估并闲置年长员工的技能。

e.en: Investors often {under-value} small local companies.
e.zh: 投资者常常低估本地小公司的价值。

e.en: Do not {under-value} your experience in interviews.
e.zh: 面试时不要低估自己的经验。

e.en: The market {under-values} the company's patents.
e.zh: 市场低估了这家公司的专利价值。

e.en: She {under-values} her own contribution to the team.
e.zh: 她低估了自己对团队的贡献。

e.en: The bank agreed to {underwrite} the bond issue.
e.zh: 银行同意承销这次债券发行。

e.en: A private donor will {underwrite} the exhibition.
e.zh: 一位私人捐赠者将资助这场展览。

e.en: Food was {underabundant} during the long winter.
e.zh: 漫长冬季里食物供应不足。

e.en: Reliable data remains {underabundant} in this field.
e.zh: 这个领域可靠的数据仍然不充足。

e.en: The program helps gifted {underachievers} regain confidence.
e.zh: 这个项目帮助有天赋但表现不佳的学生重拾信心。

e.en: Critics called the team {underachievers} after another loss.
e.zh: 再次失利后，评论人士称这支队伍表现低于应有水平。

e.en: Good film actors know when to {underact}.
e.zh: 优秀的电影演员知道何时要表演得克制。

e.en: He chose to {underact} the grief scene.
e.zh: 他选择在悲伤场景中克制表演。

underacted.t: 表演克制的；演得不足的

e.en: Her quiet, {underacted} performance impressed the critics.
e.zh: 她安静而克制的表演打动了评论家。

e.en: The final scene felt {underacted} and emotionally flat.
e.zh: 最后一幕显得演得不足，情感也很平淡。

e.en: His {underacting} made the character seem real.
e.zh: 他的克制表演让这个角色显得真实。

e.en: In comedy, {underacting} can be funnier than exaggeration.
e.zh: 在喜剧中，克制表演有时比夸张更好笑。

e.en: Government {underaction} worsened the housing crisis.
e.zh: 政府行动不足加剧了住房危机。

e.en: The report criticized corporate {underaction} on climate risks.
e.zh: 报告批评企业对气候风险反应不够。

e.en: Thyroid {underactivity} can cause fatigue.
e.zh: 甲状腺功能低下会导致疲劳。

e.en: Economic {underactivity} hurt small businesses downtown.
e.zh: 经济活动不足伤害了市中心的小企业。

e.en: He is a skilled {underactor} in quiet dramas.
e.zh: 他是在安静剧情片中擅长克制表演的演员。

e.en: A good {underactor} can suggest emotion with small gestures.
e.zh: 优秀的克制型演员能用细微动作表现情感。

underacts.t: 表演不足；演得克制过头

e.en: The actor {underacts} so much that the scene feels flat.
e.zh: 那名演员演得太克制，整场戏显得平淡。

e.en: She deliberately {underacts} the grief instead of crying loudly.
e.zh: 她故意把悲伤演得很收敛，而不是大声哭喊。

underadvertising.t: 广告投放不足；宣传不够

e.en: The launch failed partly because of {underadvertising}.
e.zh: 这次发布失败，部分原因是宣传不够。

e.en: Chronic {underadvertising} left the brand invisible to new buyers.
e.zh: 长期广告投放不足让新买家几乎看不到这个品牌。

e.en: Critics tend to {underate} his early poems.
e.zh: 评论家往往低估他的早期诗作。

e.en: Do not {underate} the cost of maintaining old equipment.
e.zh: 不要低估维护旧设备的成本。

e.en: {Underbaking} the bread leaves the center sticky.
e.zh: 面包烤得不够会让中间发黏。

e.en: The recipe warns against {underbaking} the cheesecake.
e.zh: 食谱提醒不要把芝士蛋糕烤得不够熟。

e.en: A slight {underbalance} made the machine vibrate.
e.zh: 轻微配重不足让机器产生振动。

e.en: The report shows an {underbalance} between risk and reward.
e.zh: 报告显示风险与回报之间平衡不足。

e.en: She kept winter blankets in the {underbed} drawer.
e.zh: 她把冬天的毯子放在床下抽屉里。

e.en: Dust collects quickly in the {underbed} space.
e.zh: 床下空间很容易积灰。

e.en: The contract was {underbidden} by a small local firm.
e.zh: 一家本地小公司对这份合同出价过低。

e.en: Several {underbidden} lots were withdrawn from the auction.
e.zh: 几个叫价不足的拍卖品被撤回了。

e.en: The dentist said the child has an {underbite}.
e.zh: 牙医说这个孩子有下颌前突。

e.en: A severe {underbite} can make chewing uncomfortable.
e.zh: 严重反咬合会让咀嚼变得不舒服。

e.en: The roofer replaced the damaged {underboarding}.
e.zh: 屋顶工更换了受损的底层铺板。

e.en: Good {underboarding} keeps the floor from flexing.
e.zh: 良好的下部木板层能防止地板弯曲。

e.en: The hotel was {underbooked} during the rainy season.
e.zh: 雨季期间这家酒店预订量不足。

e.en: Her clinic is usually {underbooked} on Friday afternoons.
e.zh: 她的诊所周五下午通常预约不满。

e.en: We {underbought} snacks for the party.
e.zh: 我们为聚会买的零食太少了。

e.en: The retailer was {underbought} in winter coats.
e.zh: 这家零售商冬季外套采购不足。

e.en: The wall was {underbraced} and began to lean.
e.zh: 那面墙支撑不足，开始倾斜。

e.en: An {underbraced} frame may fail in strong wind.
e.zh: 加固不够的框架可能在强风中失稳。

underbreath.t: 低声说话；耳语般的声音

e.en: He muttered an apology in an {underbreath} tone.
e.zh: 他用低声的语气嘟囔着道歉。

e.en: Her {underbreath} comment still reached the front row.
e.zh: 她压低声音说的话还是传到了第一排。

underbred.t: 教养不足的；出身低微的

e.en: The insult made him sound {underbred}.
e.zh: 那句侮辱让他显得很没教养。

e.en: Old novels often use {underbred} as a class insult.
e.zh: 旧小说常把出身低微当作阶级羞辱来写。

e.en: Inspectors found cracks in the {underbridge} supports.
e.zh: 检查员在桥下支撑结构中发现了裂缝。

e.en: Graffiti covered the dark {underbridge} walkway.
e.zh: 涂鸦覆盖了阴暗的桥下人行道。

e.en: The photo looked {underbright} on the old monitor.
e.zh: 这张照片在旧显示器上看起来亮度不足。

e.en: An {underbright} lamp made the desk hard to use.
e.zh: 一盏不够明亮的灯让书桌不好用。

e.en: Rain dripped from the {underbrim} of his hat.
e.zh: 雨水从他帽檐下侧滴落。

e.en: The designer lined the {underbrim} with red fabric.
e.zh: 设计师用红布衬在帽檐下侧。

underbudgeted.t: 预算不足的；经费估低了

e.en: The project was badly {underbudgeted} from the start.
e.zh: 这个项目从一开始预算就严重不足。

e.en: An {underbudgeted} repair can become more expensive later.
e.zh: 经费估低的维修以后可能变得更贵。

e.en: Cities often {underbuild} housing near new transit lines.
e.zh: 城市常在新交通线路附近住房建设不足。

e.en: If you {underbuild} the foundation, the shed will not last.
e.zh: 如果地基建得不够牢，棚屋就用不久。

e.en: Years of {underbuilding} caused a shortage of apartments.
e.zh: 多年建设不足导致公寓短缺。

e.en: The engineers reinforced the {underbuilding} before adding floors.
e.zh: 工程师在加建楼层前先加固了下层建筑。

e.en: {Underbunching} the cables made the panel look messy.
e.zh: 线缆没有充分扎成束，让面板看起来很乱。

e.en: The fabric failed because of {underbunching} at the seam.
e.zh: 布料因接缝处聚拢不足而出了问题。

e.en: Do not {underburn} the clay, or it will stay fragile.
e.zh: 不要把陶土烧得不够，否则它会一直很脆。

e.en: The forest crew used an {underburn} to clear dry brush.
e.zh: 林业队用低强度燃烧清理干灌木。

e.en: The bricks were {underburnt} and crumbled in the rain.
e.zh: 这些砖烧制不足，在雨中碎裂了。

e.en: An {underburnt} glaze can look dull and powdery.
e.zh: 没烧透的釉面可能显得暗淡且像粉末。

e.en: Rabbits hid in the thick {underbush}.
e.zh: 兔子躲在浓密的林下灌丛里。

e.en: The trail disappeared beneath the tangled {underbush}.
e.zh: 小路消失在纠结的下层灌木下面。

e.en: Do not {underbuy} paint for a large room.
e.zh: 给大房间刷漆时不要买太少油漆。

e.en: Stores that {underbuy} popular toys lose holiday sales.
e.zh: 热门玩具采购不足的商店会失去节日销售机会。

undercalcined.t: 煅烧不足的；未烧透的材料

e.en: The bricks were {undercalcined} and crumbled in the rain.
e.zh: 这些砖煅烧不足，一遇雨就碎裂了。

e.en: A lab test found {undercalcined} lime in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室检测发现样品中有煅烧不足的石灰。

e.en: The budget failed because of serious {undercalculation}.
e.zh: 预算因严重低估而失败。

e.en: His {undercalculation} of the load damaged the bridge.
e.zh: 他对载荷估算不足，导致桥梁受损。

undercapitalization.t: 资本不足；资本结构偏低

e.en: The startup collapsed from chronic {undercapitalization}.
e.zh: 这家初创公司因长期资本不足而倒闭。

e.en: Regulators warned the bank about {undercapitalization}.
e.zh: 监管机构就资本不足问题警告了这家银行。

undercapitalize.t: 使资本不足；投入资金过少

e.en: They chose to {undercapitalize} the project at first.
e.zh: 他们一开始选择给这个项目投入过少资金。

e.en: New owners should not {undercapitalize} a risky business.
e.zh: 新业主不应让高风险企业资本不足。

e.en: The mechanic inspected the {undercart} for cracks.
e.zh: 机械师检查了车下架是否有裂纹。

e.en: A removable {undercart} carried the heavy platform.
e.zh: 一个可拆卸的下部小车承载着沉重平台。

e.en: The old inn kept wine in an {undercellar}.
e.zh: 这家老客栈把酒存放在地下酒窖里。

e.en: Workers found an {undercellar} beneath the kitchen floor.
e.zh: 工人在厨房地板下面发现了一个下层地窖。

e.en: The cashier may {undercharge} customers during busy hours.
e.zh: 收银员在忙时可能会少收顾客的钱。

e.en: Do not {undercharge} the battery before storage.
e.zh: 存放前不要让电池充电不足。

undercharged.t: 被少收费的；充电不足的

e.en: We were {undercharged} for the hotel room.
e.zh: 酒店房费少收了我们的钱。

e.en: An {undercharged} battery can fail in cold weather.
e.zh: 充电不足的电池在寒冷天气里可能失效。

e.en: The company often {undercharges} loyal clients.
e.zh: 这家公司经常给老客户少收费。

e.en: Repeated {undercharges} hurt the store's profits.
e.zh: 反复少收费损害了商店利润。

e.en: The audit found years of {undercharging}.
e.zh: 审计发现多年来一直存在少收费。

e.en: Battery {undercharging} reduces performance over time.
e.zh: 电池长期充电不足会降低性能。

e.en: Mud had collected on the truck's {underchassis}.
e.zh: 卡车底盘下部积满了泥。

e.en: The sensor is mounted near the {underchassis}.
e.zh: 传感器安装在下底架附近。

underchurched.t: 教会服务不足的；缺少教堂的

e.en: Missionaries worked in an {underchurched} rural district.
e.zh: 传教士在教会服务不足的农村地区工作。

e.en: The report described the suburb as {underchurched}.
e.zh: 报告称这个郊区缺少教堂和宗教服务。

e.en: Miners found thick {underclay} beneath the coal seam.
e.zh: 矿工在煤层下面发现了厚厚的底粘土。

e.en: The fossil roots were preserved in {underclay}.
e.zh: 这些化石根系保存在下伏黏土中。

e.en: An {underclerk} copied the records by hand.
e.zh: 一名下级书记员手工抄写了记录。

e.en: He began as an {underclerk} in the law office.
e.zh: 他最初在律师事务所做低级职员。

e.en: Wildflowers grew along the sheltered {undercliff}.
e.zh: 野花生长在受遮蔽的崖脚地带。

e.en: The path crossed a narrow {undercliff} above the sea.
e.zh: 小路穿过海面上方狭窄的崖下斜坡。

e.en: She hid the letter inside her {undercloak}.
e.zh: 她把信藏在内披风里。

e.en: The actor wore a red {undercloak} beneath the robe.
e.zh: 演员在长袍下面穿了一件红色内披风。

e.en: The table had a plain {undercloth} below the lace.
e.zh: 桌上的蕾丝下面铺着一块素色衬布。

e.en: A strong {undercloth} supports the embroidered surface.
e.zh: 结实的底层布支撑着刺绣表面。

underclub.t: 用小一号球杆击球；球杆不足

e.en: Many beginners {underclub} on uphill approach shots.
e.zh: 许多初学者在上坡攻果岭时会选小一号球杆。

e.en: His {underclub} left the ball short of the green.
e.zh: 他球杆选短了，球停在果岭前。

e.en: The engineer noted {undercommutation} in the motor design.
e.zh: 工程师指出电机设计中存在换向不足。

e.en: The lawyer argued that {undercommutation} made the sentence unfair.
e.zh: 律师主张减刑不足使判决不公。

e.en: Staff complained about {undercompensation} after the merger.
e.zh: 合并后员工抱怨报酬过低。

e.en: The system shows {undercompensation} when temperatures rise quickly.
e.zh: 温度快速升高时，该系统表现出补偿不足。

undercompounded.t: 复合不足的；调合不足的

e.en: The pharmacist rejected the {undercompounded} mixture.
e.zh: 药剂师拒收了调合不足的混合物。

e.en: An {undercompounded} engine may run less efficiently.
e.zh: 复合不足的发动机运行效率可能较低。

e.en: The formula failed because of {undercompounding}.
e.zh: 这个配方因调合不足而失败。

e.en: Engineers adjusted the design to prevent {undercompounding}.
e.zh: 工程师调整设计以防止复合不足。

e.en: The medicine failed because of {underconcentration}.
e.zh: 药物因浓度不足而没有效果。

e.en: His {underconcentration} during practice caused mistakes.
e.zh: 他训练时注意力不足，导致出现错误。

underconstrained.t: 约束不足的；限制条件不够的

e.en: The model was {underconstrained} and produced many solutions.
e.zh: 这个模型约束不足，产生了许多解。

e.en: An {underconstrained} joint can move unpredictably.
e.zh: 约束不足的关节可能会出现不可预测的移动。

e.en: Economists blamed the slump on {underconsumption}.
e.zh: 经济学家把衰退归因于消费不足。

e.en: Chronic {underconsumption} kept factories below capacity.
e.zh: 长期需求不足使工厂产能无法充分利用。

e.en: The chicken was still {underdone} in the middle.
e.zh: 这只鸡中间还没有熟透。

e.en: Her argument felt {underdone} and needed more evidence.
e.zh: 她的论证显得不够充分，还需要更多证据。

e.en: Doctors warned that patients should not {underdose} antibiotics.
e.zh: 医生警告病人不要把抗生素剂量用得不足。

e.en: The trial failed because several volunteers were {underdosed}.
e.zh: 试验失败了，因为几名志愿者给药剂量不足。

e.en: The fire burned hotter when the {underdraft} opened.
e.zh: 炉底通风口打开后，火烧得更旺。

e.en: A cold {underdraft} moved along the valley floor.
e.zh: 一股冷的下层气流沿着谷底移动。

e.en: The field needs an {underdrain} to remove excess water.
e.zh: 这块田需要一条地下排水管来排走多余的水。

e.en: Workers repaired the old {underdrain} beneath the road.
e.zh: 工人修好了路面下方的旧暗渠。

underdrainage.t: 地下排水；暗渠排水系统

e.en: Good {underdrainage} keeps the soil from becoming waterlogged.
e.zh: 良好的地下排水能防止土壤积水。

e.en: The garden design included {underdrainage} below the beds.
e.zh: 花园设计在花坛下方加入了暗渠排水系统。

e.en: The company may {underdraw} its credit line this quarter.
e.zh: 公司本季度可能少提取其信用额度。

e.en: Artists often {underdraw} the figure before adding paint.
e.zh: 画家常先画出人物的底稿，再上颜料。

e.en: She kept old letters in the {underdrawer} of the desk.
e.zh: 她把旧信放在书桌的下层抽屉里。

e.en: The tailor packed a clean {underdrawer} for the costume.
e.zh: 裁缝为那套服装装入了一条干净的内裤。

e.en: He packed two pairs of {underdrawers} for the trip.
e.zh: 他为这次旅行带了两条内裤。

e.en: Victorian men often wore long {underdrawers} in winter.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的男子冬天常穿长衬裤。

e.en: You should not {underdress} for a formal interview.
e.zh: 正式面试时你不该穿得过于随便。

e.en: The costume included a plain white {underdress}.
e.zh: 这套服装里有一件素白色的内裙。

e.en: The museum displayed silk {underdresses} from the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了十九世纪的丝质内裙。

e.en: He often {underdresses} for office events.
e.zh: 他参加办公室活动时常常穿得过于随便。

underdressing.t: 穿着过于随便；内层敷料

e.en: Her {underdressing} made her stand out at the gala.
e.zh: 她穿得过于随便，在晚会上显得很突兀。

e.en: The nurse changed the {underdressing} beneath the bandage.
e.zh: 护士更换了绷带下面的内层敷料。

e.en: The {underdrift} carried colder water beneath the surface.
e.zh: 下层漂流把较冷的水带到水面下方。

e.en: Miners used the {underdrift} to reach the lower seam.
e.zh: 矿工利用地下平巷到达较低的矿层。

e.en: The truck switched to {underdrive} on the steep hill.
e.zh: 卡车在陡坡上切换到低速传动。

e.en: The weak motor caused {underdrive} in the conveyor system.
e.zh: 电机无力导致传送系统驱动不足。

underdriven.t: 驱动不足的；动力偏弱的

e.en: The small speaker sounded {underdriven} at high volume.
e.zh: 这个小音箱在高音量下听起来驱动不足。

e.en: An {underdriven} machine may stall under heavy load.
e.zh: 动力偏弱的机器在重负荷下可能会停转。

e.en: The legend describes an {underearth} kingdom of shadows.
e.zh: 传说描写了一个阴影中的地下王国。

e.en: Roots spread through the dark {underearth} below the forest.
e.zh: 树根在森林下方黑暗的地底蔓延。

undereaten.t: 吃得过少的；营养摄入不足的

e.en: The child looked tired and {undereaten} after the illness.
e.zh: 病后这个孩子显得疲惫，吃得也太少。

e.en: Athletes become weaker when they are {undereaten} during training.
e.zh: 运动员训练期间营养摄入不足时会变弱。

undereducation.t: 教育不足；受教育程度低

e.en: Poverty and {undereducation} often reinforce each other.
e.zh: 贫困和教育不足常常相互加剧。

e.en: The report links {undereducation} to limited job opportunities.
e.zh: 报告把受教育程度低与就业机会有限联系起来。

e.en: The course suffers from an {underemphasis} on practical skills.
e.zh: 这门课的问题是对实践技能强调不足。

e.en: There is an {underemphasis} on safety in the proposal.
e.zh: 这份提案对安全问题重视不够。

e.en: Teachers should not {underemphasize} clear writing.
e.zh: 教师不应不够重视清晰写作。

e.en: The article tends to {underemphasize} the economic risks.
e.zh: 这篇文章往往对经济风险强调不足。

underemphasized.t: 被强调不足的；未被足够重视的

e.en: The health risks were {underemphasized} in the announcement.
e.zh: 公告中对健康风险强调得不够。

e.en: Local knowledge is often {underemphasized} in national policy.
e.zh: 地方知识在国家政策中常常未被足够重视。

e.en: The textbook {underemphasizes} the role of women in science.
e.zh: 这本教材对女性在科学中的作用强调不足。

e.en: His speech {underemphasizes} how difficult the reform will be.
e.zh: 他的讲话没有足够强调改革会有多困难。

underemphasizing.t: 正在过少强调；不够重视

e.en: The panel was {underemphasizing} the cost of the project.
e.zh: 小组当时对项目成本强调得不够。

e.en: By {underemphasizing} grammar, the course encouraged fluent speaking.
e.zh: 这门课降低了对语法的强调，从而鼓励流利表达。

e.en: The generator showed signs of {underexcitation} during the test.
e.zh: 发电机在测试中出现了励磁不足的迹象。

e.en: Neural {underexcitation} may reduce the strength of the response.
e.zh: 神经激发不足可能会减弱反应强度。

underexcite.t: 使激发不足；使励磁不足

e.en: Low voltage can {underexcite} the generator.
e.zh: 低电压可能使发电机励磁不足。

e.en: The weak stimulus may {underexcite} the nerve cells.
e.zh: 微弱刺激可能使神经细胞激发不足。

e.en: Office workers often {underexercise} during busy seasons.
e.zh: 办公室职员在忙季常常运动不足。

e.en: The dog became restless from {underexercise}.
e.zh: 这只狗因为锻炼不够而变得躁动。

undecomposed.t: 未分解的；未腐解的；未拆分的；未解析的

e.en: The sample contained {undecomposed} organic matter after drying.
e.zh: 干燥后，样本中仍含有未分解的有机物。

e.en: The melody appears as one {undecomposed} phrase in the manuscript.
e.zh: 在手稿中，这段旋律呈现为一个未拆分的乐句。

undecorative.t: 无装饰性的；不作装饰的

e.en: The room had an {undecorative} simplicity that suited the workshop.
e.zh: 这个房间朴素而无装饰，很适合作为工作间。

e.en: She chose an {undecorative} border for the technical diagram.
e.zh: 她为这张技术图选择了不作装饰的边框。

undecorticated.t: 未去皮的；未剥除外层的

e.en: The lab stored {undecorticated} seeds for later testing.
e.zh: 实验室保存了未去皮的种子，以便日后测试。

e.en: The doctor noted that the specimen was {undecorticated}.
e.zh: 医生记录说该标本尚未剥除外层。

e.en: The chemist added an {undecyl} chain to the molecule.
e.zh: 化学家给这个分子加入了一条十一烷基链。

e.en: An {undecyl} group can change the compound's solubility.
e.zh: 十一烷基基团会改变该化合物的溶解性。

e.en: The bacterium produced {undecylprodigiosin} under low-nutrient conditions.
e.zh: 这种细菌在低营养条件下产生了十一烷基灵菌红素。

e.en: Researchers measured {undecylprodigiosin} in the red pigment extract.
e.zh: 研究人员在红色色素提取物中测定了十一烷基灵菌红素。

e.en: The shield bore an {undee} line across its center.
e.zh: 盾牌中央有一条波纹状的线。
