e.zh: 药剂师认出 urosalinum 是尿中盐类的旧称。

e.en: An old prescription mentioned {urosalinum} in a list of chemical substances.
e.zh: 一张旧处方在化学物质清单中提到了尿盐混合物。

e.en: Acute {uroschesis} requires prompt medical attention.
e.zh: 急性尿潴留需要及时就医。

e.en: The patient described painful {uroschesis} after the operation.
e.zh: 患者说手术后出现了疼痛性的排尿受阻。

e.en: Medieval doctors relied on {uroscopic} signs when judging illness.
e.zh: 中世纪医生判断疾病时依赖尿诊迹象。

e.en: The museum displayed a glass flask used for {uroscopic} examination.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一个用于尿液观察检查的玻璃瓶。

e.en: Before modern tests, {uroscopy} was a common diagnostic practice.
e.zh: 现代检测出现以前，尿诊是一种常见诊断做法。

e.en: The historian studied how {uroscopy} shaped early medical beliefs.
e.zh: 历史学家研究尿诊如何影响早期医学观念。

urostyle.t: 尾杆骨；两栖动物尾骨结构

e.en: A frog's {urostyle} supports the pelvis and helps with jumping.
e.zh: 青蛙的尾杆骨支撑骨盆，并有助于跳跃。

e.en: The fossil showed a clear {urostyle}, suggesting it belonged to an early frog.
e.zh: 化石显示出清楚的尾杆骨，说明它可能属于早期蛙类。

e.en: Cancer can develop in the {urothelium} lining the bladder.
e.zh: 癌症可能发生在膀胱内衬的尿路上皮中。

e.en: The {urothelium} stretches as the bladder fills with urine.
e.zh: 膀胱充满尿液时，尿路上皮会随之伸展。

urotropin.t: 乌洛托品；六亚甲基四胺

e.en: The old label listed {urotropin} as the active urinary antiseptic.
e.zh: 旧标签把乌洛托品列为有效的尿路抗菌成分。

e.en: Chemists know {urotropin} as hexamethylenetetramine.
e.zh: 化学家把乌洛托品称为六亚甲基四胺。

urotropine.t: 乌洛托品；六亚甲基四胺

e.en: The physician prescribed {urotropine} for a recurrent urinary infection.
e.zh: 医生为反复尿路感染开了乌洛托品。

e.en: In chemistry class, {urotropine} was described as a crystalline compound.
e.zh: 化学课上，乌洛托品被描述为一种晶体化合物。

e.en: The yellow color of the sample was linked to {uroxanthin}.
e.zh: 样本的黄色与尿黄素有关。

e.en: Older analysts separated {uroxanthin} from other urinary pigments.
e.zh: 早期分析人员曾把尿黄素同其他尿液色素分离开来。

uroxin.t: 尿毒素；旧称尿中毒性物质

e.en: The article used {uroxin} for a supposed toxic substance in urine.
e.zh: 那篇文章用 uroxin 指称一种被认为存在于尿中的毒性物质。

e.en: Modern textbooks rarely use {uroxin} as a clinical term.
e.zh: 现代教材很少把 uroxin 当作临床术语使用。

e.en: The faded textbook described {urrhodin} as a red pigment of urine.
e.zh: 那本褪色的教材把尿红素描述为尿液中的红色色素。

e.en: Researchers later replaced {urrhodin} with more precise chemical names.
e.zh: 后来研究人员用更精确的化学名称取代了尿红素这一说法。

ursa.t: 母熊；雌熊；熊形星座名成分

e.en: The Latin word {ursa} means a female bear.
e.zh: 拉丁词 ursa 的意思是母熊。

e.en: Astronomers recognize {Ursa} Major as the Great Bear constellation.
e.zh: 天文学家把 Ursa Major 识别为大熊星座。

e.en: The old herbarium sheet held an {ustulate} leaf.
e.zh: 那张旧植物标本纸上夹着一片烧焦发黑的叶子。

e.en: Its {ustulate} edges showed where the flame had touched.
e.zh: 它灼黑的边缘显示火焰曾经烧到过那里。

e.en: The chemist described the {ustulation} of the sample.
e.zh: 化学师描述了样品的灼烧过程。

e.en: Gentle {ustulation} darkened the surface without melting it.
e.zh: 轻微灼烧使表面变黑，但没有把它熔化。

e.en: The lawyer explained {usucapion} in Roman property law.
e.zh: 律师解释了罗马财产法中的时效取得所有权。

e.en: Long possession could support a claim by {usucapion}.
e.zh: 长期占有可以支持通过时效取得所有权的主张。

e.en: The {usufructuary} may use the orchard but not sell it.
e.zh: 用益权人可以使用果园，但不能出售它。

e.en: Her {usufructuary} rights ended when the lease expired.
e.zh: 她的用益权在租约到期时终止。

e.en: The council rejected his {usurpative} claim to power.
e.zh: 委员会驳回了他篡夺权力的主张。

e.en: Such {usurpative} conduct weakened the old constitution.
e.zh: 这种篡夺性的行为削弱了旧宪法。

e.en: The judge condemned the minister's {usurpatory} actions.
e.zh: 法官谴责了那名部长的篡夺性行为。

e.en: A {usurpatory} decree ignored the elected assembly.
e.zh: 一道篡权的法令无视了民选议会。

e.en: He acted {usurpingly}, as if the office were already his.
e.zh: 他以篡夺者的姿态行事，好像职位已经属于他。

e.en: The army moved {usurpingly} into civilian authority.
e.zh: 军队以侵夺方式介入了文职权力。

e.en: He drove the {ute} across the muddy field.
e.zh: 他开着那辆多用途小卡车穿过泥泞的田地。

e.en: The builders loaded timber into the {ute}.
e.zh: 建筑工人把木料装进了小卡车。

e.en: The patient reported severe {uteralgia} after the procedure.
e.zh: 病人说手术后出现了严重的子宫痛。

e.en: Persistent {uteralgia} should be assessed by a doctor.
e.zh: 持续的子宫痛应由医生评估。

e.en: The surgeon scheduled a {uterectomy} for the following week.
e.zh: 外科医生把子宫切除术安排在下一周。

e.en: Recovery after {uterectomy} varies from patient to patient.
e.zh: 子宫切除术后的恢复情况因人而异。

e.en: The textbook compared the {uteri} of several mammals.
e.zh: 教材比较了几种哺乳动物的子宫。

e.en: Doctors examined the {uteri} for signs of disease.
e.zh: 医生检查这些子宫是否有疾病迹象。

e.en: The infection was diagnosed as {uteritis}.
e.zh: 这种感染被诊断为子宫炎。

e.en: Untreated {uteritis} can cause serious complications.
e.zh: 未经治疗的子宫炎可能引发严重并发症。

e.en: The midwife prepared a {uterotonic} after delivery.
e.zh: 助产士在分娩后准备了一种促子宫收缩药。

e.en: A {uterotonic} drug can reduce postpartum bleeding.
e.zh: 促子宫收缩药可以减少产后出血。

e.en: The article mentioned {uteroverdin} in old medical terminology.
e.zh: 文章提到旧医学术语中的子宫绿色素。

e.en: Few modern clinicians would recognize {uteroverdin}.
e.zh: 如今很少有临床医生会认得子宫绿色素这个词。

e.en: Several {utes} were parked outside the worksite.
e.zh: 工地外停着几辆多用途小卡车。

e.en: Farmers often prefer {utes} for rough country roads.
e.zh: 农民常喜欢用小卡车走崎岖的乡间路。

e.en: The backup {util} runs every night.
e.zh: 这个备份工具程序每晚都会运行。

e.en: She wrote a small {util} to clean the logs.
e.zh: 她写了一个小工具程序来清理日志。

e.en: The device had little {utilance} outside the laboratory.
e.zh: 这台设备在实验室外几乎没有什么用途。

e.en: Writers once used {utilance} where we would say usefulness.
e.zh: 过去作家会用utilance来表示我们现在所说的有用性。

e.en: The committee chose the most {utile} proposal.
e.zh: 委员会选择了最有实际用处的方案。

e.en: His argument was elegant but not especially {utile}.
e.zh: 他的论证很漂亮，但并不特别实用。

e.en: Pipes and cables ran through the Arctic {utilidor}.
e.zh: 管道和电缆穿过北极地区的地下公用设施通道。

e.en: The town built a {utilidor} to protect utilities from freezing.
e.zh: 小镇修建了地下公用设施通道，以防设施结冰。

e.en: Only half the data was {utilisable} after the crash.
e.zh: 崩溃之后，只有一半数据还能使用。

e.en: The old warehouse is still {utilisable} with minor repairs.
e.zh: 那座旧仓库只需小修后仍可使用。

utility-grade.t: 公用事业级；工业级耐用

e.en: The pump uses {utility-grade} components for long service.
e.zh: 这台泵采用公用事业级部件，使用寿命更长。

e.en: They installed {utility-grade} meters across the site.
e.zh: 他们在整个场地安装了工业级电表。

e.en: Only half the data was {utilizable} after the crash.
e.zh: 系统崩溃后，只有一半数据还能使用。

e.en: The old barn became {utilizable} storage space.
e.zh: 那座旧谷仓变成了可利用的储物空间。

e.en: The treaty invoked {utipossidetis} to fix the borders.
e.zh: 该条约援引保持占有原则来确定边界。

e.en: Lawyers debated {utipossidetis} in the territorial dispute.
e.zh: 律师们在领土争端中讨论了保持占有原则。

utopianist.t: 空想主义者；乌托邦论者

e.en: The reformer was dismissed as a {utopianist}.
e.zh: 那位改革者被斥为空想主义者。

e.en: A careful {utopianist} can still expose real injustice.
e.zh: 谨慎的乌托邦论者仍能揭示真实的不公。

e.en: The manifesto seemed to {utopiate} its young readers.
e.zh: 这份宣言似乎让年轻读者沉迷于乌托邦幻想。

e.en: Promises of perfection can {utopiate} a movement.
e.zh: 完美社会的承诺会使一场运动陷入空想。

utopism.t: 乌托邦主义；空想社会论

e.en: His early novels are full of {utopism}.
e.zh: 他的早期小说充满了乌托邦主义色彩。

e.en: The critic saw {utopism} as a political danger.
e.zh: 那位评论家把空想社会论视为一种政治危险。

e.en: The engineer was a practical {utopist} at heart.
e.zh: 这位工程师骨子里是个务实的乌托邦主义者。

e.en: Every {utopist} must explain who pays the cost.
e.zh: 每个空想家都必须说明代价由谁承担。

e.en: Her plan sounded noble but {utopistic}.
e.zh: 她的计划听起来高尚却很空想。

e.en: The essay used {utopistic} language about technology.
e.zh: 那篇文章用乌托邦式的语言谈论科技。

e.en: The {utricle} helps the body sense balance.
e.zh: 内耳椭圆囊帮助身体感知平衡。

e.en: A tiny {utricle} held the plant's seed.
e.zh: 一个小囊包裹着这株植物的种子。

e.en: The doctor tested his {utricular} function.
e.zh: 医生检查了他的椭圆囊功能。

e.en: The specimen had a {utricular} structure near the base.
e.zh: 标本底部附近有一个小囊状结构。

e.en: The botanist noted the plant's {utriculate} fruit.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这种植物具小囊的果实。

e.en: Its {utriculate} surface trapped tiny insects.
e.zh: 它囊状的表面困住了微小昆虫。

e.en: The specialist suspected {utriculitis} after the vertigo returned.
e.zh: 眩晕复发后，专科医生怀疑是椭圆囊炎。

e.en: Severe {utriculitis} can disturb a patient's balance.
e.zh: 严重的椭圆囊炎会扰乱患者的平衡感。

e.en: The {utriculus} lies within the inner ear.
e.zh: 椭圆囊位于内耳之中。

e.en: The drawing labels the {utriculus} beside the saccule.
e.zh: 图中把椭圆囊标在球囊旁边。

e.en: The grief was barely {utterable} at first.
e.zh: 起初那种悲伤几乎说不出口。

e.en: The code name had to be easily {utterable}.
e.zh: 这个代号必须容易发音。

e.en: She stood in {utterless} shock.
e.zh: 她震惊得站在那里说不出话。

e.en: The valley held an {utterless} beauty at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分，山谷有一种难以言说的美。

e.en: The report misspelled {utulization} in its title.
e.zh: 报告标题里把“利用”这个词拼错成了utulization。

e.en: Poor {utulization} of space made the room feel cramped.
e.zh: 空间利用不佳让房间显得拥挤。

e.en: The village sits inside a broad {uvala}.
e.zh: 这个村庄坐落在一片宽阔的喀斯特洼地中。

e.en: Rainwater collected at the bottom of the {uvala}.
e.zh: 雨水汇集在这处溶蚀盆地的底部。

e.en: The ring was set with bright green {uvarovite}.
e.zh: 这枚戒指镶着鲜绿色的钙铬榴石。

e.en: Collectors prize {uvarovite} for its vivid color.
e.zh: 收藏者因其鲜艳色泽而珍视钙铬榴石。

e.en: Inflammation of the {uvea} can blur vision.
e.zh: 葡萄膜发炎可能导致视力模糊。

e.en: The surgeon examined the {uvea} under magnification.
e.zh: 外科医生在放大视野下检查了葡萄膜。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed {uveitis} after her eye became painful and red.
e.zh: 她的眼睛疼痛发红后，医生诊断为葡萄膜炎。

e.en: Untreated {uveitis} can sometimes damage vision.
e.zh: 葡萄膜炎若不治疗，有时会损害视力。

e.en: The rare infection caused {uveomeningitis} in the patient.
e.zh: 这种罕见感染导致患者出现葡萄膜脑膜炎。

e.en: Specialists discussed whether {uveomeningitis} explained both symptoms.
e.zh: 专家讨论葡萄膜脑膜炎是否能解释这两种症状。

e.en: Her fever and eye pain suggested {uveoparotitis}.
e.zh: 她的发热和眼痛提示可能是葡萄膜腮腺炎。

e.en: Doctors once used {uveoparotitis} to describe this unusual syndrome.
e.zh: 医生过去用葡萄膜腮腺炎来描述这种少见综合征。

e.en: The surgeon planned {uveoplasty} to repair the damaged tissue.
e.zh: 外科医生计划进行葡萄膜成形术来修复受损组织。

e.en: Modern {uveoplasty} requires careful imaging before surgery.
e.zh: 现代葡萄膜成形术在手术前需要仔细影像检查。

e.en: Severe {uveoscleritis} made the eye tender to touch.
e.zh: 严重的葡萄膜巩膜炎使眼睛一碰就疼。

e.en: The report linked {uveoscleritis} with an autoimmune disease.
e.zh: 报告把葡萄膜巩膜炎与一种自身免疫病联系起来。

e.en: The chart compared normal and swollen {uvulae}.
e.zh: 图表比较了正常和肿胀的悬雍垂。

e.en: Medical students examined models of {uvulae} in class.
e.zh: 医学生在课堂上检查悬雍垂模型。

e.en: French uses a {uvular} r in many accents.
e.zh: 法语许多口音使用小舌音的 r。

e.en: The patient had mild {uvular} swelling after the infection.
e.zh: 感染后，患者的悬雍垂有轻微肿胀。

e.en: The old textbook described {uvulatomy} as a throat operation.
e.zh: 那本旧教材把悬雍垂切开术描述为一种咽喉手术。

e.en: Few hospitals now perform {uvulatomy} for snoring alone.
e.zh: 如今很少有医院仅为打鼾而做悬雍垂切开术。

e.en: Acute {uvulitis} can make swallowing very painful.
e.zh: 急性悬雍垂炎会让吞咽变得非常疼痛。

e.en: The child's {uvulitis} improved after treatment.
e.zh: 孩子的悬雍垂炎在治疗后好转了。

e.en: The museum displayed an old {uvulotome} in the surgical case.
e.zh: 博物馆在外科器械柜里展出了一把旧悬雍垂切除刀。

e.en: A modern {uvulotome} must be sterilized before use.
e.zh: 现代悬雍垂切除刀使用前必须消毒。

e.en: The specialist recommended {uvulotomy} only after other treatments failed.
e.zh: 只有在其他治疗失败后，专家才建议做悬雍垂切开术。

e.en: Historical records mention {uvulotomy} for throat obstruction.
e.zh: 历史记录提到用悬雍垂切开术处理咽喉阻塞。

e.en: The poem praises his {uxorial} devotion with formal language.
e.zh: 这首诗用正式的语言赞美他对妻子的深情。

e.en: Lawyers debated his {uxorial} rights under the old statute.
e.zh: 律师们讨论他在旧法规下作为妻方相关人的权利。

e.en: The novel centers on a trial for {uxoricide}.
e.zh: 这部小说围绕一起杀妻案审判展开。

e.en: The historian studied {uxoricide} in nineteenth-century newspapers.
e.zh: 这位历史学家研究十九世纪报纸中的杀妻案件。

e.en: She studied {Uygur} music during her fieldwork.
e.zh: 她在田野调查期间研究维吾尔族音乐。

e.en: The inscription includes several words in {Uygur}.
e.zh: 碑文中包含几个维吾尔语词。

e.en: The paper described {uzarin} as a cardiac glycoside.
e.zh: 论文把乌扎林描述为一种强心苷。

e.en: Researchers measured {uzarin} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了植物提取物中的乌扎林含量。

e.en: She typed {unbrealla} when she meant umbrella.
e.zh: 她想打umbrella，却误拼成了unbrealla。

e.en: The word {unbrealla} is a common misspelling in the note.
e.zh: 笔记里的unbrealla是一个常见拼写错误。

e.en: He wrote {unbrella} instead of umbrella on the form.
e.zh: 他在表格上把umbrella误写成了unbrella。

e.en: The teacher circled {unbrella} and corrected the spelling.
e.zh: 老师圈出了unbrella，并改正了拼写。

unbugeability.t: 无法撼动性；不易改变性

e.en: Her {unbugeability} frustrated everyone at the meeting.
e.zh: 她那种无法动摇的固执让会议上的每个人都很沮丧。

e.en: The design's {unbugeability} made quick revisions almost impossible.
e.zh: 这个设计很难改动，几乎无法快速修订。

unbundion.t: 疑似拼写错误；无通用词义

e.en: The editor marked {unbundion} as an unclear word.
e.zh: 编辑把unbundion标为含义不明的词。

e.en: No one in the workshop understood {unbundion} in that sentence.
e.zh: 工作坊里没人理解那句话中的unbundion是什么意思。

e.en: The mechanic inspected the car's {under-carriage} for rust.
e.zh: 技师检查了汽车底盘是否生锈。

e.en: The plane's {under-carriage} failed to lower before landing.
e.zh: 飞机降落前起落架未能放下。

e.en: The report focused on the urban {under-class}.
e.zh: 这份报告关注城市底层群体。

e.en: He argued that poor schools helped create an {under-class}.
e.zh: 他认为薄弱学校助长了下层阶级的形成。

under-clerk.t: 下级办事员；助理书记员

e.en: An {under-clerk} copied the records by hand.
e.zh: 一名下级办事员用手抄写了这些记录。

e.en: The old office employed an {under-clerk} for routine paperwork.
e.zh: 那间旧办公室雇了一名助理书记员处理日常文书。

e.en: The census may {under-count} migrant workers.
e.zh: 人口普查可能会少算流动工人。

e.en: A serious {under-count} changed the funding formula.
e.zh: 严重的少算改变了拨款公式。

e.en: The new evidence may {under-cut} his argument.
e.zh: 新证据可能会削弱他的论点。

e.en: Small shops cannot {under-cut} the supermarket's prices.
e.zh: 小店无法用更低价格和超市竞争。

under-determine.t: 证据不足以决定；未充分限定

e.en: The data {under-determine} several possible explanations.
e.zh: 这些数据不足以决定哪一种解释才对。

e.en: Philosophers say observations can {under-determine} a theory.
e.zh: 哲学家说，观察结果可能不足以充分限定一种理论。

under-determined.t: 证据不足决定的；未充分限定的

e.en: The conclusion remains {under-determined} by the available facts.
e.zh: 现有事实仍不足以决定这个结论。

e.en: The equation is {under-determined} because it has too many unknowns.
e.zh: 这个方程未知数太多，因此条件不足。

under-determines.t: 证据不足以决定；未充分限定

e.en: This evidence {under-determines} the choice between the two models.
e.zh: 这些证据不足以决定应选择两个模型中的哪一个。

e.en: A sparse dataset {under-determines} any strong causal claim.
e.zh: 稀疏的数据集不足以支持任何强因果结论。

e.en: Do not {under-dress} for the formal dinner.
e.zh: 参加正式晚宴不要穿得过于随便。

e.en: The costume included a thin {under-dress} beneath the gown.
e.zh: 这套服装在长裙里面配了一件薄内裙。

e.en: Do not {under-estimate} the cost of repairs.
e.zh: 不要低估维修费用。

e.en: His early {under-estimate} led to a shortage of supplies.
e.zh: 他早先估计不足，导致物资短缺。

e.en: She often {under-estimates} how long reports take.
e.zh: 她常常低估写报告需要的时间。

e.en: The budget {under-estimates} the real cost of transport.
e.zh: 这份预算低估了交通的实际成本。

e.en: The wagon's {under-frame} was made of steel.
e.zh: 这辆货车的底架是钢制的。

e.en: Engineers reinforced the {under-frame} before testing the vehicle.
e.zh: 工程师在测试车辆前加固了下部框架。

under-fund.t: 资金投入不足；拨款不足

e.en: Governments often {under-fund} rural clinics.
e.zh: 政府常常对乡村诊所拨款不足。

e.en: If they {under-fund} maintenance, the system will fail.
e.zh: 如果他们维护资金投入不足，系统就会出故障。

e.en: She packed a clean {under-garment} for each day.
e.zh: 她每天都打包了一件干净的内衣。

e.en: The fabric is soft enough for an {under-garment}.
e.zh: 这种布料足够柔软，适合做贴身衣物。

e.en: My brother is an {under-graduate} at a state university.
e.zh: 我哥哥是一所州立大学的本科生。

e.en: The lab accepts {under-graduate} research assistants each summer.
e.zh: 这个实验室每年夏天招收本科研究助理。

under-insure.t: 保险金额不足；投保不足

e.en: Many homeowners {under-insure} their property without realizing it.
e.zh: 许多房主在不知情的情况下给房产投保不足。

e.en: If you {under-insure} the shop, a fire could ruin you.
e.zh: 如果店铺保险金额不足，一场火灾可能让你破产。

e.en: The {under-manager} handled complaints when the owner was away.
e.zh: 老板不在时，副经理负责处理投诉。

e.en: An {under-manager} supervised the night shift at the factory.
e.zh: 一名下级经理监督工厂的夜班。

e.en: Constant criticism can {under-mine} a child's confidence.
e.zh: 不断的批评会削弱孩子的自信。

e.en: Floodwater may {under-mine} the bridge supports.
e.zh: 洪水可能会侵蚀桥梁支撑的基础。

e.en: The captain sent an {under-officer} to inspect the gate.
e.zh: 上尉派了一名下级军官去检查大门。

e.en: An {under-officer} recorded the prisoners' names.
e.zh: 一名副官候补登记了囚犯的姓名。

under-one.t: 一岁以下的；不满一岁的

e.en: The clinic has a separate room for {under-one} patients.
e.zh: 诊所为一岁以下的病人设有单独房间。

e.en: Parents of {under-one} babies often need extra support.
e.zh: 不满一岁婴儿的父母常常需要更多支持。

under-paid.t: 工资过低的；报酬不足的

e.en: Many nurses feel {under-paid} for the work they do.
e.zh: 许多护士觉得自己的工作报酬过低。

e.en: He stayed loyal despite being {under-paid}.
e.zh: 尽管工资偏低，他仍然保持忠诚。

e.en: The new fund began to {under-perform} after March.
e.zh: 这只新基金三月后开始表现不佳。

e.en: Students may {under-perform} when they feel anxious.
e.zh: 学生感到焦虑时可能发挥低于水平。

e.en: Steel beams {under-pin} the old theatre walls.
e.zh: 钢梁支撑着这座旧剧院的墙体。

e.en: Trust must {under-pin} any lasting agreement.
e.zh: 任何持久协议都必须以信任为基础。

e.en: The house was {under-pinned} after cracks appeared.
e.zh: 房屋出现裂缝后进行了加固支撑。

e.en: Her argument was {under-pinned} by careful research.
e.zh: 她的论点以细致研究为基础。

e.en: A concrete frame {under-pins} the new extension.
e.zh: 混凝土框架支撑着新扩建部分。

e.en: Fairness {under-pins} the whole legal system.
e.zh: 公平构成整个法律制度的基础。
